titulo: Natural language man-machine interaction unmanned aerial vehicle inspection maintenance planning method and device
depositantes: UNIV SOUTHERN SCI & TECH | PENG CHENG LAB
resumo: The invention discloses a method and a device for unmanned aerial vehicle inspection maintenance planning of natural language man-machine interaction, which relate to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle multi-task collaborative scheduling. And adopting a self-adaptive algorithm to solve and generate a candidate maintenance plan set, determining a target maintenance plan based on multi-dimensional evaluation, and finally synchronously outputting a maintenance scheduling scheme and an updated routing task allocation scheme. According to the scheme, through natural language analysis and knowledge graph reasoning, the dependence on data input of manual experience and scheme planning is reduced, automation of maintenance decision is realized, maintenance and inspection are uniformly optimized under a multi-target framework, a preventive maintenance mechanism is introduced, the transition from passive response to active prevention is realized, and the overall utilization efficiency of resources is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Dynamic pricing and scheduling method for electric vehicle charging station
resumo: The application relates to a dynamic pricing and scheduling method of an electric vehicle charging station, which comprises the steps of obtaining the global state of the electric vehicle charging station in real time, constructing a global Markov decision process based on the global state, solving a real-time optimal three-gear charging price based on a SAC reconstruction algorithm, selecting a target gear and a target electric quantity state from the real-time optimal three-gear charging price by a user, obtaining the local state of each charging pile in the electric vehicle charging station in real time, constructing a dynamic graph and a local Markov decision process based on the local state of each charging pile, solving the charging power of each charging pile based on a graph attention network and a multi-charging pile depth reinforcement learning algorithm, and charging a user vehicle according to the charging power correspondingly solved by the selected charging piles for the charging pile selected by the user until the user vehicle reaches the target electric quantity state.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Automobile service scheduling method and system based on Internet of Things
resumo: The invention relates to the technical field of internet of things scheduling, in particular to an automobile service scheduling method and system based on the internet of things, comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting heart rate and triaxial acceleration sequences of an automobile maintenance technician through a bracelet sensor, analyzing heart rate variability, integrating acceleration synthesis, comparing with a fatigue threshold value, mapping risk grades, counting grid signal density, calculating distance between a vehicle and a task, physiologically correcting, evaluating matching score, sequencing and optimizing, and generating an automobile service target task scheduling instruction set. According to the invention, fatigue degree quantitative identification and dynamic monitoring are realized by fusion analysis of heart rate and acceleration data of an automobile maintenance technician, task urgency weighting is combined, comprehensive perception of task density and urgency degree is enhanced, states and task positions of the automobile maintenance technician are associated, matching priority is optimized by means of input-output ratio, scheduling accuracy and response efficiency are improved, problems of uneven personnel load and resource mismatch are relieved, and scheduling intelligence and service stability are enhanced.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Second-hand car dynamic pricing method and system based on income management and survival analysis
depositantes: BEIJING HAOCHE SHUAISHUAI TECH CO LTD
resumo: The application discloses a second-hand vehicle dynamic pricing method based on yield management and survival analysis, which is characterized in that a price-sales time relation model is built by adopting a survival analysis method based on preprocessed second-hand vehicle sales process data, sales probability functions and expected sales time distribution corresponding to different listing prices are calculated through the price-sales time relation model, the sales probability functions are embedded into a yield management framework, a yield expected function containing vehicle holding cost is built, an optimal price path for maximizing the yield expected function is solved under preset price adjustment constraint conditions, the listing prices of the second-hand vehicles to be sold are automatically adjusted according to the optimal price path, and new sales process data are continuously collected to update the price-sales time relation model and the yield expected function in a rolling mode. The second-hand vehicle dynamic pricing method based on the benefit management and survival analysis provided by the application realizes dynamic linkage and benefit maximization of price and market reaction.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Scheduling and passing sorting method for vehicle-road collaborative traffic
depositantes: YUHUA GUOYE BEIJING ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST CO LTD
resumo: The invention relates to a scheduling and traffic sequencing method of cooperative traffic of a vehicle and a vehicle, which is applied to a system comprising a road side unit and vehicles, wherein the road side unit receives a multi-vehicle traffic request and requests data information carrying vehicle driving intention, current position and speed and an allowable time range for entering a conflict traffic area, the road side unit determines candidate vehicles and generates candidate traffic sequences based on the data information, the road side unit issues revocable preemptive traffic grants to a preset number of front candidate vehicles according to the sequences, the grants comprise preemption valid period, a time window for allowing entry and traffic constraints to be met, the road side unit receives vehicle feedback within the valid period, and withdraws grants and grants to subsequent vehicles of the sequences if the overtime is not fed back or the feedback indicates that the constraints cannot be met, and confirms that the grants are final traffic grants and generates and issues traffic sequencing results if the feedback indicates that the constraints can be met.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Online car-hailing dynamic pricing and punishment strategy determination method considering order cancellation behavior
resumo: The invention discloses a method for determining a dynamic pricing and punishment policy of an online booking car considering order canceling behavior, which relates to the technical field of online booking car transaction and comprises the steps of arranging an order whole-flow log according to regions and time slices, extracting order process characteristics and generating an order process sample set; the method comprises the steps of executing cancellation cause identification and causal evidence calculation on an order process sample set to form a strategy learning data set, training an offline reinforcement learning strategy by utilizing the strategy learning data set to obtain a candidate pricing and punishment strategy package, calling the candidate pricing and punishment strategy package to execute guarantee pre-authorization on an order, generating contract vouchers, executing order-level automatic clearing according to order process events to generate an execution record and clearing result, executing anti-fact strategy evaluation on the execution record and clearing result, and outputting a pricing and punishment scheme. According to the method, pricing and punishment schemes are screened on the same-caliber samples through the anti-facts strategy evaluation, and stability, traceability and trade execution consistency of strategy determination are improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Unmanned vehicle cooperative scheduling method and device and road side unit
depositantes: XINJIANG TIANCHI ENERGY SOURCES CO LTD
resumo: The application provides a cooperative dispatching method and device for unmanned vehicles and a road side unit, and relates to the technical field of unmanned vehicles. The method comprises the steps of obtaining environmental state information of a target area and first state information of surrounding vehicles in real time, wherein the target area corresponds to a road side unit, the surrounding vehicles are vehicles with the distance between the surrounding vehicles and the road side unit being within a preset threshold value range, determining a plurality of target vehicles according to the environmental state information and the first state information, wherein the target vehicles are vehicles with space-time conflict and space conflict in the surrounding vehicles, and dispatching the target vehicles to pass through the target area according to second state information of the target vehicles and preset road right rules. According to the method, the passing target areas of all target vehicles are scheduled through the preset road right rule, so that high-precision cooperative scheduling of multiple vehicles in the areas can be realized, and the passing efficiency of the intersections is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Big data-based vehicle rental dynamic pricing optimization system
depositantes: YUANZHU INFORMATION TECH SERVICE HANGZHOU CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses a big data-based vehicle lease dynamic pricing optimization system which comprises a data acquisition module, a decision acquisition module, a pricing optimization module, a pricing execution module and a vehicle lease dynamic pricing optimization module, wherein the data acquisition module acquires original multi-mode data from a plurality of heterogeneous data sources, performs preprocessing operation of space-time alignment and feature fusion on the original multi-mode data to obtain a vehicle condition fusion feature tensor, the decision acquisition module generates an initial potential demand mode spectrum through tensor decomposition based on the vehicle condition fusion feature tensor, inputs the initial potential demand mode spectrum and an realized demand mode spectrum in a real historical order together into an antagonism verification network to perform iterative antagonism training, and outputs the vehicle condition space-time demand mode spectrum, the pricing optimization module takes the vehicle condition space-time demand mode spectrum as a global state to input, builds a double-layer vehicle pricing intelligent body through a meta training process of internal and external double loops to generate optimal pricing strategy probability distribution, and the pricing execution module realizes vehicle lease dynamic pricing optimization based on the optimal pricing strategy probability distribution.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle risk early warning and insurance recommendation system
depositantes: UNIV QINGDAO AGRICULTURAL | QINGDAO LYUBO AUTOMOBILE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent transportation and financial insurance, and discloses a vehicle risk early warning and insurance recommendation system which comprises a data acquisition layer, a data fusion and characteristic engineering layer, a risk calculation engine, an early warning generation and pushing module, an insurance product dynamic matching engine and a user interaction terminal. The data acquisition layer acquires multi-source heterogeneous data, performs space-time alignment, feature extraction and dimension reduction through the fusion and feature engineering layer to form a standardized feature data stream, the risk calculation engine generates multi-dimensional and comprehensive risk scores according to the multi-dimensional and comprehensive risk scores, the early warning module performs self-adaptive multi-mode hierarchical early warning according to the risk grades, the insurance matching engine combines the risk scores and user preferences, a personalized insurance scheme and dynamic pricing are generated through knowledge graph and reinforcement learning, and the user interaction terminal realizes visual display, early warning prompt and feedback acquisition. The invention realizes the closed loop from risk perception to insurance recommendation, and improves the driving safety and insurance matching efficiency.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Unmanned aerial vehicle operation service multi-dimensional dynamic pricing method and system
depositantes: HUNAN KONGZHONG KUAIDI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional dynamic pricing method and system for unmanned aerial vehicle operation services. The method comprises the following steps of receiving a service order request sent by a user, obtaining regional coefficients, specification coefficients and meteorological coefficients according to the service order request, obtaining information of a no-fly zone around a service place and calculating airspace complexity coefficients, obtaining digital elevation data and building density data of the service place and calculating flight complexity coefficients, carrying out product operation on the regional coefficients, the specification coefficients, the meteorological coefficients, the airspace complexity coefficients and the flight complexity coefficients and preset reference prices to generate final quotations, serializing real-time values, calculation basis and original data sources of all the coefficients into structural data, and storing the structural data and the final quotations in a lasting mode. The invention can sense the change of external environmental factors such as meteorological conditions, airspace control states, terrain flight complexity and the like in real time, and realize the effective correspondence of the price and the actual operation risk cost.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Multi-source fusion-based intelligent management and control method and system for power supply field service intelligent cabin
depositantes: STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD HEFEI POWER SUPPLY CO | LUJIANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses a power supply field service intelligent cabin intelligent control method and system based on multisource fusion, which relate to the technical field of electric power Internet of things and intelligent operation and maintenance and comprise the steps of triggering RFID batch scanning through radio frequency field perturbation, and carrying out time sequence consistency check on a scanning result to obtain unique tool identification information and current in-place state data; collecting environment data in the intelligent cabin, and performing time alignment and fusion on the environment data and tool in-place state data in an event-driven mode to generate a multi-source perception data set; the intelligent power supply intelligent cabin management system and the intelligent power supply intelligent cabin management method solve the problems that the state sensing accuracy of the tools in the intelligent power supply intelligent cabin is low, the fusion quality of the multi-source data is poor, the health evolution trend cannot be identified, and the storage path optimization is unreasonable.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle dynamic pricing system and platform based on reinforcement learning and risk rule fusion
depositantes: ZHONGLIAN HUIJIE SHANGHAI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses a vehicle mortgage dynamic pricing system and platform based on reinforcement learning and risk rule fusion. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a residual value attenuation prediction module, a risk constraint construction module and an reinforcement learning pricing module, wherein the data acquisition module acquires static attribute and dynamic time sequence characteristic electronic data and loads the static attribute and dynamic time sequence characteristic electronic data into a first data cache region, the residual value attenuation prediction module generates predicted disposal residual value probability distribution tensor data at the expiration time of a preset mortgage time limit based on a time sequence characteristic encoder, the risk constraint construction module extracts a pressure residual value and writes the pressure residual value into a second data cache region, and the reinforcement learning pricing module constructs an asymmetric action exploration constraint function based on the ratio of the pressure residual value to a vehicle purchase price field, and respectively limits a lower interest rate limit to an upper limit and outputs pricing data. The invention solves the technical problem that the data read-write conflict and the risk constraint are not synchronous in mortgage pricing through a double-physical address space isolation architecture and an asymmetric constraint mechanism.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Parking management method, parking management system and vehicle
resumo: The application provides a parking management method, a parking management system and a vehicle, and relates to the technical field of intelligent driving. In the method, a first gateway in the parking lot can acquire the position information of the first vehicle, and execute corresponding parking lot management operation according to the position information of the first vehicle. The position information of the first vehicle can be determined based on the interaction information between the first vehicle and the road side equipment arranged in the parking lot, so that the parking management method can realize accurate positioning of the first vehicle depending on the road side equipment, and the first gateway is utilized to match proper parking lot management operation for the first vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Logistic with GPS tracking and status lifecycle management system
resumo: A system and method for providing real-time GPS tracking and comprehensive status lifecycle management for emergency roadside service dispatches. The system receives GPS breadcrumbs from service vehicles during the en route to on scene phase, tracks services through comprehensive status states with edge case handling, stores all status changes and GPS events in a unified event status record structure linked to Dispatch records, and integrates with mobile APIs to provide mobile-native status updates on device lock screens. The system implements phase-specific GPS collection, status-GPS correlation logic that ensures proper sequencing and prevents duplicate notifications, conditional mobile API triggering based on event state checking, and unified event storage that enables dispute resolution through correlation analysis. The unified event storage stores all event types in a single indexed table structure.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Socorro e Reboque (C1))

titulo: METHOD FOR GENERATING A MOTOR VEHICLE REPAIR QUOTATION
resumo: This method describes an automated process for generating quotations for the repair of damage to motor vehicles, wherein a first AI model is trained with historical repair data from different motor vehicle repair companies, including information regarding repair procedures, costs and required time. The first AI model is further optimized with specific data of a single repair company, including old quotations. In addition, a second AI model is deployed to characterize instances of damage to the vehicle based on received images. Based on these analyses, the first AI model determines suitable repair processes and generates accurate quotations. This approach offers an efficient solution for the traditional, time-consuming quotation process, by automatically drawing up quotations based on visual damage information and AI technology.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Intelligent community electric vehicle charging dynamic pricing method and system
depositantes: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG | CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO | UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG
resumo: The invention discloses a dynamic pricing method and a system for charging an electric automobile in an intelligent community, wherein the method comprises the steps that a community operator collects electric automobile data served in a future dispatching period and builds a lower response model by taking the minimum electricity cost of an electric automobile owner as a target; the operator considers future photovoltaic output and electric automobile charging response and arranges an energy storage system, builds an upper dynamic electricity price design model with minimum fluctuation of an equivalent load curve, and considers restrictions on upper and lower limits and average values of electricity prices, and adopts a genetic algorithm to solve a lower response model and the upper dynamic electricity price design model, so as to obtain dynamic electricity price parameters with highest fitness and issue the dynamic electricity price parameters at the initial moment of a future scheduling period. The system comprises a lower model building module, an upper model building module and a solving module. The method solves the problem that the expected response is inconsistent with the actual charging behavior in the existing electric vehicle charging behavior regulation model.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Electric vehicle charging and discharging quantity calculation method and system for aggregator participating in multi-level markets
depositantes: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY
resumo: The invention discloses a method and a system for calculating charge and discharge amount of an electric automobile with a polymerization merchant participating in a multi-level market; the method comprises the steps of guiding an electric vehicle user to adjust a power consumption mode by fully excavating mass behavior characteristics of an electric vehicle monomer on a demand side, relieving a problem of shortage of power consumption in a short-time peak load period, constructing an upper dynamic pricing model related to participation of an electric vehicle aggregator in a multi-level market under the uncertain factors of market electricity price and electric vehicle user price of an electric vehicle charging station at an electric vehicle aggregator level, and quantifying the relation between upper price and lower response will by combining the upper dynamic pricing model and a lower energy management model.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Method for improving order completion rate based on Saas online car-hailing and car-pooling
depositantes: BEIJING BAIJU YIXING TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention relates to the traffic field and discloses a method for improving the completion rate of taxi sharing based on Saas network, which is used for solving the problem that the prior taxi sharing method can not be used when the order of the same tenant under different channels needs to be shared, wherein the method comprises the steps that the tenant configures a price template and price preferential proportion in a tenant management background, when a plurality of passengers enter a taxi sharing entrance in different channels, the pre-price information is acquired according to the price template, the passengers select the tenant and the taxi sharing willingness to be shared, and after the order is ended, the driver settles according to the total amount of all orders in the journey, so that the problem that the orders of the same tenant in different channels cannot be spliced is effectively solved, and the experience of passengers and tenants is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Automobile part price sensitivity analysis and dynamic pricing method and system
depositantes: CHINA AUTOMOTIVE INFORMATION TECH TIANJIN CO LTD
resumo: The invention is suitable for the field of automobile accessory pricing, provides an automobile accessory price sensitivity analysis and dynamic pricing method and system, according to the method, an OBD interface, a manufacturer cloud database and a weather and environment monitoring platform are utilized to collect vehicle operation data, user maintenance history and regional environment indexes, and a three-dimensional data base is constructed. Secondly, aiming at the safety, abrasion and functional accessories, a replacement demand assessment model is established based on a analytic hierarchy process, the sensitivity of the user demand is calculated, and the replacement priority is generated. Then, the demand sensitivity and the guest price are combined to divide four groups of user groups, and the price sensitivity of each group is analyzed through the price elasticity coefficient. Finally, dynamic pricing policies are formulated. According to the scheme, through accurate grouping and dynamic pricing of data driving, user suitability and enterprise income of accessory services are improved, and the method is suitable for intelligent operation of the automobile aftermarket.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Multi-layer self-adaptive control framework of photovoltaic integrated grid-connected electric vehicle charging station
depositantes: SHANXI URBAN POWER NEW ENERGY CO LTD
resumo: The invention relates to the field of electric vehicle charging infrastructure control, in particular to a multilayer self-adaptive control framework of a photovoltaic integrated grid-connected electric vehicle charging station, which comprises a prediction layer, a control layer and a behavior layer, wherein the prediction layer is used for acquiring real-time user data through a body area network, training a local data prediction model by adopting federal learning so as to generate a global energy demand prediction model on the premise of protecting user privacy, the control layer is used for carrying out multi-objective optimization scheduling by utilizing deep reinforcement learning and adjusting a charging and discharging plan of the charging station in real time, and the behavior layer is used for introducing a foreground theory into user behavior modeling and exciting a user to select renewable energy sources to charge through a dynamic pricing mechanism and a customized excitation strategy. The invention is suitable for various complex energy management scenes, including efficient management of urban energy systems, large-scale renewable energy integration and development of future intelligent power grids, and has wide application prospect and commercial potential.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Three-dimensional point cloud-based intelligent management and control method and system for uninterrupted operation of distribution network
depositantes: DEZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO
resumo: The invention discloses an intelligent management and control method and system for distribution network uninterrupted operation based on three-dimensional point cloud, and relates to the technical field of power operation management and control. And calculating a shooting angle based on the position relation between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the tower, classifying images, and fusing multi-source data to optimize model accuracy. And screening the effective images to determine optimal angle parameters to generate a preferable route, automatically identifying the abnormal state of the equipment according to the real-time data acquisition and comparison model of the route, triggering fault alarm and scheduling maintenance resources, and realizing dynamic monitoring and closed-loop control. The invention has the advantages of integrating three-dimensional modeling, intelligent path planning and real-time analysis, remarkably improving inspection efficiency and safety, reducing manual intervention requirements and adapting to network distribution operation and maintenance in complex environments.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Charging terminal management operation and maintenance platform
resumo: The application relates to the technical field of charging terminal management, and discloses a charging terminal management operation and maintenance platform which comprises a client module, a terminal monitoring module, a charging guiding module and a price management module, wherein the client module is used for guiding a client to use a charging terminal and acquiring vehicle information of a user, and the terminal monitoring module is used for acquiring use information and use states of the charging terminal. The accurate recommendation based on the user behavior data not only can help the user save the charging cost, but also can optimize the utilization rate of charging resources and improve the overall operation efficiency.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Automobile protection delay service cost optimization method and system based on big data analysis
depositantes: SHANGHAI LIZHEN AUTO SERVICE CONSULTING CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses an automobile delay service cost optimization method and system based on big data analysis, and particularly relates to the technical field of cost optimization; the vehicle-mounted diagnosis method comprises the steps of carrying out semantic analysis on vehicle historical maintenance record data to generate fault feature vectors, carrying out time sequence alignment processing on real-time vehicle-mounted diagnosis data streams to construct time sequence fault features, dividing a high-frequency fault mode and a low-frequency fault mode based on the fault feature vectors and the time sequence fault features to respectively construct a high-frequency fault probability distribution model and a low-frequency fault risk factor set, calculating expected maintenance cost for the high-frequency fault mode by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method, constructing a fault propagation network for the low-frequency fault mode based on topology association analysis, optimizing and outputting an delay cost decision matrix through a risk loss function, and generating delay service pricing strategies by combining an insurance calculation rule base to improve accuracy and stability of delay cost assessment.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Automobile repair plant matching optimization system and method for tire emergency repair
depositantes: SHANGHAI HUILUN ENVIRONMENTAL PROT CO LTD
resumo: The invention relates to the field of tire emergency repair, in particular to an automobile repair shop matching optimization system and method for tire emergency repair, comprising a database module, a database module and a database module, wherein the database module is used for receiving and integrating original tire damage data graphs from different scanning devices; the invention relates to a method for repairing a tire, which comprises the steps of judging a damage type by a damage cause identification module, calculating a damage index, judging repair feasibility by combining a built-in rule, calling a repair scheme matching module, screening and matching an adaptive feasible repair scheme, displaying the matching scheme to a repair technician by a repair resource scheduling module, guaranteeing the standardization of repair quality, supporting a user to check the repair progress in real time by the information intercommunication of a user end and a repair end, integrating multi-source data, accurately identifying the damage, intelligently matching the scheme, visually scheduling repair resources, realizing bidirectional transparency of the progress, and promoting the intelligent, standardized and efficient development of tire emergency repair service.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Oficinas e Manutenção (C2))

titulo: Vehicle maintenance quotation method and device based on AI large model, and related system
resumo: The application provides a vehicle maintenance quotation method, a device and a related system based on an AI large model, which are applied to a server, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a fault code, vehicle information and a fault photo set of a target vehicle; determining a fault area in the target vehicle according to the fault code to obtain a first fault area, extracting a fault photo corresponding to the first fault area from the fault photo set to obtain a first fault photo set, performing fault diagnosis on the target vehicle based on a preset AI large model, the first fault photo set and the fault code to obtain a first diagnosis result, determining a maintenance scheme of the target vehicle according to the first diagnosis result and the vehicle information to obtain a target maintenance scheme, and generating a maintenance quotation of the target vehicle according to the target maintenance scheme. Thus, the accuracy of vehicle fault diagnosis and the efficiency of maintenance quotation can be improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Orçamentação e Custos (C3))

titulo: Residential area-working area interactive electric vehicle dynamic pricing method for promoting peak load shifting and distributed photovoltaic consumption
resumo: A residential area-working area interactive electric vehicle dynamic pricing method for promoting peak clipping and valley filling and distributed photovoltaic digestion comprises the steps of making dynamic time-of-use electricity prices for electric vehicle users who stop the working area for charging, making fixed time-of-use electricity prices for electric vehicle users who choose the residential area for charging, building an electric vehicle user demand-price response model under the regional electricity prices to measure the sensitivity degree of electric vehicle user electricity consumption to electricity price change, and building a multi-objective function to optimize and schedule the electric vehicle by taking the maximum photovoltaic utilization rate of the working area, the minimum peak-valley difference of equivalent load of the residential area and the minimum electric vehicle user charging cost as targets. And solving the multi-objective optimization problem by adopting NSGA-II with elite strategy. According to the method, based on the condition that an electric automobile owner tends to charge in a period with lower electricity price, the charging place and time of the electric automobile are transferred through a mechanism of regional setting of electricity price, and optimal distribution of the electric automobile in time dimension and space dimension is achieved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Distributed energy management and control and dynamic pricing method and system for vehicle section
resumo: The invention relates to a distributed energy management and control and dynamic pricing method and system for a vehicle section station, and belongs to the technical field of energy management. The method comprises the steps of distributing the edge server, setting time and a main and auxiliary branch detection range, obtaining a main branch standard value and detection data, calculating real-time leakage rate through calibration, and calculating energy cost by combining basic cost, time interval coefficient and real-time leakage rate. The system comprises a distributed deployment module, a detection range setting module, a reference value acquisition and detection data detection module, a real-time leakage rate calculation module, a construction cost model module and a dynamic calculation cost module. The invention dynamically corrects the energy cost accounting result, can improve the cost accounting precision, supports the integrated management and control of multiple energy types such as electric power, fuel oil, water and the like, realizes accurate loss positioning in a complex scene, real-time cost correction and multi-source collaborative optimization, and comprehensively improves the energy management efficiency and economic benefit of a vehicle section.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Electric vehicle active power distribution network operation method driven by multi-scene dynamic pricing mechanism
depositantes: STATE GRID CORP CHINA | CHENGXI POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY | STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO
resumo: The invention discloses an operation method of an active power distribution network of an electric vehicle driven by a multi-scene dynamic pricing mechanism, which comprises the steps of carrying out double-layer optimization on scheduling between an active power distribution network operator and an electric vehicle aggregator, establishing a double-layer-four-level random robust model based on double-layer optimization, carrying out iterative solution on the double-layer-four-level model through a dichotomy coupling CCG-AIS, and outputting a strategy according to the condition of ending iteration of the double-layer-four-level model, wherein the output strategy is used as the operation method. The multi-scene dynamic electricity price mechanism provided by the invention can effectively guide the EV to carry out ordered charging according to the charging and discharging characteristics of different scenes, and is more in line with the actual requirements. Compared with the traditional fixed TOU electricity price and unordered charging mode, the method not only improves the level of new energy consumption, but also effectively reduces the load fluctuation range of ADN, and further improves the economy of ADN. The model combines the advantages of RO and SO, successfully balances the robustness and economy of the system.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Electric vehicle optimal scheduling method based on dynamic pricing of generating capacity of distributed power supply
depositantes: NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER ENERGY TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses an electric automobile optimizing and scheduling method based on dynamic pricing of power generation capacity of a distributed power supply, which comprises the steps of data acquisition, dynamic electricity price model establishment, optimizing model construction, charge and discharge instruction issuing and executing, effect verification and the like. According to the method, the distributed power supply generating capacity-electricity price dynamic coupling mechanism is established, and the function relation between the electric vehicle charging and discharging electricity price and the distributed power supply generating capacity is established to excite the electric vehicle user to participate in optimal scheduling, so that the distributed power supply consumption is increased, the load peak-valley difference is reduced, the user charging cost is reduced, the problem of collaborative optimization of the distributed power supply consumption and the ordered charging of the electric vehicle is effectively solved, and win-win of a power grid and the user is finally realized. The method can achieve 1) the wind and light discarding rate is greatly reduced, the clean energy absorbing capacity is remarkably improved, 2) the user charging cost is greatly reduced, 3) the peak-valley difference of the load is reduced, and the peak clipping and valley filling effects of the load of the power distribution network are effectively achieved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle energy management method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product
depositantes: GEELY HOLDING GROUP CO LTD | GEELY AUTOMOBILE RES INSTITUTE NINGBO CO LTD
resumo: The application provides a vehicle energy management method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product, and relates to the technical field of vehicles, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining vehicle data and external environment data at least comprising power grid information, executing a reverse power supply potential prediction task on the vehicle data and the external environment data based on a vehicle-mounted large model to obtain potential benefits of reverse power supply of the vehicle to the power grid and attenuation cost of a vehicle battery, and generating reverse power supply potential evaluation information as a model prediction result based on the potential benefits and the attenuation cost; and generating an intelligent charging scheme of the vehicle by combining the model prediction result and a power grid dynamic pricing strategy obtained based on analysis of the power grid information, and controlling the charging operation of the vehicle and/or performing reverse power supply operation to the power grid based on the intelligent charging scheme. By adopting the intelligent charging method and the intelligent charging device, the intelligent level of the electric automobile can be improved, so that the experience of a user on intelligent charging of the electric automobile is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Electric vehicle charging dynamic pricing method and system based on user consumption psychology
depositantes: STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST | STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD | STATE GRID CORP CHINA
resumo: The invention discloses an electric vehicle charging dynamic pricing method and system based on consumer psychology, the method comprises the following steps of S1, calculating a user response time period and the shortest charging time according to charging behavior data of an electric vehicle user, screening a user with demand response capability, S2, constructing a three-dimensional psychology feature vector based on the user with the demand response capability, and weighting and calculating user type decision parameters The method comprises the steps of dividing user types, S3, constructing a differentiated comprehensive satisfaction model aiming at different types of users, S4, constructing an electric vehicle charging double-layer pricing model based on a stackelberg game, and making a charging station price strategy so as to realize flexible regulation and control of charging load of the electric vehicle. The invention has the advantages of reducing the deviation between the dispatching instruction and the actual response, obviously improving the regulating and controlling effect of the price signal on the load, and the like.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Electric vehicle charging pricing method and system based on double-layer attention reinforcement learning
resumo: The invention discloses a trolley charging pricing method and system based on double-layer attention reinforcement learning. Aiming at the problem of dynamic pricing of charging stations in a new energy power grid, the invention provides a reinforced learning model based on a double-layer diagram attention mechanism, and realizes the explicit coding of the topological association of a power network and a traffic network under the condition of simultaneously considering the charging and discharging constraint of an electric vehicle, the constraint of road capacity and charging station capacity and multiple optimization targets, and the electric price pricing is carried out through the model to maximize the traffic cost and the total energy management benefit of the smart city. The intelligent urban traffic energy collaborative optimization system is simple in network structure, effective in result and feasible and advantageous in intelligent urban traffic energy collaborative optimization scenes.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Field service scheduling system and method based on artificial intelligence
depositantes: SHENZHEN QIANHAI ZHONGKE SHUKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD
resumo: The application relates to the technical field of project management, in particular to an artificial intelligence-based on-site service scheduling system and method. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing field service information to obtain a plurality of pieces of preprocessed information, creating a scheduling model, calculating the field task grade and the capability grade of a worker based on the field task information and the field personnel information through the scheduling model, carrying out service scheduling by combining the field task grade and the capability grade of the worker, finally collecting real-time field information and obtaining the real-time task grade, calculating the energy efficiency value of surrounding personnel based on the real-time field information, and carrying out field scheduling by combining the energy efficiency value and the real-time task grade.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Análogo - Field Service Management (C4))

titulo: Civil aircraft field service operation scheduling control system
resumo: The invention belongs to the field of civil aviation, and provides a civil aviation airport ground service operation scheduling control system for solving the problem of low ground service scheduling multi-link cooperative efficiency. The file management is based on an Arian OSS development interface, supports multi-format files, realizes the functions of authority access, encryption and the like, builds an IM system by adopting an MQ/MQTT architecture for communication, supports multi-type message transmission and http network communication, encapsulates a multi-language database interface for data processing, and realizes the secure intercommunication of an internal network and an external network through a gateway agent. The flight function covers control, dynamic updating and cross-department communication of the guaranteed nodes, real-time flight data are docked, task dispatch of unified operation is achieved according to work types, and multi-terminal and nail access such as a web terminal and a handheld terminal are supported. The ground service multi-scene requirement can be met, and the running efficiency and the management level are improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Vehicle fault processing method, device and related system
resumo: The application provides a vehicle fault processing method, a device and a related system, which are applied to a server, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining vehicle information and maintenance request information of a target vehicle, wherein the maintenance request information comprises the vehicle fault information and a target position where the target vehicle breaks down; the method comprises the steps of inputting vehicle fault information into a preset fault maintenance model to obtain maintenance information of a target vehicle, inputting the maintenance information and the vehicle information into a preset maintenance recommendation model to obtain candidate maintenance factory information, wherein the candidate maintenance factory information comprises a candidate maintenance factory list and candidate recommendation scores corresponding to the candidate maintenance factories, screening maintenance factories in a preset length range of a target position from the candidate maintenance factory list to obtain a maintenance factories, determining the target maintenance factories based on preset recommendation rules, the candidate recommendation scores and the a maintenance factories, and recommending the target maintenance factories to owners of the target vehicle. When the vehicle breaks down, the efficiency of repairing the vehicle faults can be improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Roadside parking access charging method and system based on image recognition
resumo: The invention discloses a road side parking access charging method and system based on image recognition, and relates to the technical field of image recognition, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a parking space image sequence, extracting vehicle state characteristics, generating a vehicle state characteristic vector, constructing an entrance behavior recognition model based on a long-short-time memory network, inputting the vehicle state characteristic vector into the entrance behavior recognition model to judge parking behavior probability, and determining entrance time and entrance images; the parking space image sequence is continuously acquired, vehicle state parameters are extracted, an embedded matrix is constructed, a departure behavior recognition model is constructed based on a self-attention mechanism, the embedded matrix is input into the departure behavior recognition model to recognize the departure behavior of the vehicle, the departure time and the departure image are determined, semantic recognition is respectively carried out on the entrance image and the departure image, vehicle tag information is acquired, a tag item set is generated, a preset dynamic pricing rule base is called, and parking cost is determined by combining the tag items according to basic charging unit price.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Dynamic pricing method for wireless charging of electric vehicle
resumo: The invention discloses a dynamic pricing method for wireless charging of an electric vehicle, which is characterized in that a strategy network is configured for each type of electric vehicle, a price network is configured for the whole charging road and used for evaluating action value, when the electric vehicle is about to enter the charging road, information of the electric vehicle and a charging lane is collected, a state is formed and is input into the strategy network corresponding to the type of the electric vehicle to determine the charging price, the electric vehicle performs charging behavior for a certain time based on the price, and after the electric vehicle leaves the charging road, the strategy network and the value network are updated according to generated rewards. The invention adopts online reinforcement learning to dynamically determine the charging price of the electric vehicle, and improves the system benefit of the charging road while maximizing the utilization rate of the charging road.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: New energy automobile charging pile operation management system
resumo: The invention relates to the technical field of charging pile management and discloses a new energy automobile charging pile operation management system which comprises a data acquisition module, a vehicle priority calculation module, a scheduling pricing module, an execution control module and a parameter updating module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring charging pile operation data and vehicle arrival data, the vehicle priority calculation module is used for calculating vehicle priority based on the vehicle arrival data and a preset congestion coefficient to generate a vehicle queuing sequence, the scheduling pricing module is used for constructing a state matrix, matching a current operation state, extracting an energy storage control tag and a pricing additional parameter to generate an energy storage power control instruction and a service gear price, the execution control module is used for executing charging power issuing according to the service gear price, the preset station power demand and the energy storage power control instruction, and the parameter updating module is used for counting the triggering times of operation state items and queuing waiting time in a corresponding period and regularly adjusting the pricing additional parameter. The invention realizes intelligent scheduling and dynamic pricing integrated management based on multidimensional running states.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Travel field service order dispatching method and system based on LBS (Location Based Service)
resumo: The invention discloses an LBS-based travel field service dispatch method and system, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent travel. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a travel field service request comprising a user real-time position and specific service requirements, obtaining and constructing a candidate server set based on the user real-time position, generating a preliminary matched server list based on the specific service requirements and the candidate server set, outputting an optimal dispatch decision aiming at the preliminary matched server list, and sending a dispatch instruction to a target server according to the optimal dispatch decision. The invention combines the service full-flow monitoring and dynamic reputation mechanism by sensing the state of the server, precisely matching traffic and multiple constraints and optimizing decisions with multiple targets in real time, and solves the problems of poor travel field service experience and low resource utilization efficiency caused by response delay, single matching dimension and opaque process in the prior art.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: System for Facilitating Vehicle Diagnostics, Scheduling, & Part Sourcing and Related Methods
resumo: A system can include one or more processors and one or more non-transitory computer-readable media storing computing instructions that, when executed on the one or more processors, cause the one or more processors to perform operations. The operations can include receiving vehicle data and one or more of a customer complaint or a technician finding. The operations further can include generating a complaint-finding signature based on the vehicle data and the one or more of the customer complaint or the technician finding. The operations also can include searching historical data for one or more cases similar to the complaint-finding signature. The operations also can include generating a list of candidate parts. The operations also can include generating a sourcing plan based on the list of the candidate parts and facilitating placement of an order based on the sourcing plan. Other embodiments are disclosed.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: New energy automobile charging pile remote monitoring management control method and system
depositantes: JIANGXI IND TRADE VOCATIONAL TECHNICAL COLLEGE JIANGXI GRAIN CADRE SCHOOL JIANGXI GRAIN STAFF SCHOOL
resumo: The invention provides a remote monitoring management control method and a remote monitoring management control system for a charging pile of a new energy automobile, which realize real-time monitoring of state, abnormal noise and electric parameters of the charging gun by deploying a multi-mode sensor, reduce data redundancy based on edge calculation and dynamic threshold cleaning, improve transmission efficiency, combine a self-attention mechanism and a Drools rule engine to perform multi-source data fusion and fault root cause analysis, dynamically evaluate risk levels, optimize resource utilization based on dynamic power distribution of a health state and a power grid load, guide peak-to-peak charging through a peak-valley dynamic pricing and integration mechanism, ensure that maintenance data cannot be tampered by adopting a hash chain, combine emergency degree and engineering master resource optimization scheduling paths, and improve system robustness by combining user feedback and an extreme weather data iteration model, thereby realizing intelligent management of the full life cycle of the charging pile and improving operation and maintenance efficiency, safety and user charging experience.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Electric vehicle charging station dynamic pricing method based on graph attention multi-agent reinforcement learning
resumo: The present invention discloses a dynamic pricing method for electric vehicle charging stations based on graph attention multi-agent reinforcement learning, comprising: S1.1: constructing a two-layer user equilibrium (UE) demand modeling framework, the upper layer constructing a dynamic origin destination (OD) allocation model based on the distribution of points of interest (POI) and road network topology, and the lower layer implementing charging demand allocation guided by traffic flow through a probability model. This graph attention multi-agent reinforcement learning based dynamic pricing method for electric vehicle charging stations effectively solves the problems of disconnected demand modeling, insufficient spatial competition perception, and inefficient multi-agent collaboration in traditional methods, improves system revenue, reduces the proportion of congested nodes, optimizes and reduces the coefficient of variation of utilization, and can provide support for urban charging facility operation and power grid scheduling.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: T-shaped intersection small-flow vehicle continuous flow forming method based on automatic driving
resumo: The invention relates to a continuous flow forming method of a T-shaped intersection small-flow vehicle based on automatic driving, which comprises the following steps of S1, setting four control sections for three inlet directions of the T-shaped intersection, S2, sensing basic information of the vehicle by road side facilities when the vehicle reaches the control section four and enters a sensing pre-control section, S3, defining a dynamic conflict area, S4, determining time required by the same vehicle formation to pass through the intersection, S5, determining constraint conditions, S6, calculating vehicle uniform passing time, S7, determining vehicle safety control conditions, checking safety among all vehicles, setting safety control boundary conditions, S8, determining a vehicle speed control strategy, and S9, regulating and controlling vortex passing vehicles. The invention forms space-time resource optimization in the passing process, can greatly improve the passing efficiency, and can well apply the automatic driving technology in sensing and tracking the track and surrounding conditions of the vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Resource allocation method and device based on unmanned aerial vehicle/ground cooperative unloading
depositantes: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD | INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses a resource allocation method and device based on unmanned aerial vehicle/ground cooperative unloading, and relates to the technical field of communication. The method comprises the steps of collecting global information by a mobile base station MBS, generating a dynamic pricing strategy of each RSU based on the global information, selecting one of all RSUs as a target cooperative RSU based on the dynamic pricing strategy for each task unmanned aerial vehicle to form a preliminary unloading decision, dynamically optimizing a task division ratio and a communication bandwidth allocation ratio of each task unmanned aerial vehicle on the target cooperative RSU by using a particle swarm optimization algorithm based on the preliminary unloading decision, and determining a final unloading decision and a resource allocation result according to the optimized task division ratio and the bandwidth allocation ratio.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Service sequence optimization method and device for electric vehicle charging station and medium
depositantes: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NINGBO POWER SUPPLY CO | UNIV HANGZHOU DIANZI
resumo: The invention relates to the technical field of electric vehicle charging stations, in particular to a service sequence optimization method, equipment and medium of an electric vehicle charging station, which comprises the steps of constructing a multidimensional database according to time-of-use electricity price, user data and station data of the electric vehicle charging station, and constructing an initial dynamic pricing model taking total income maximization as an objective function based on the multidimensional database; the station data comprises geographic positions, total capacity of the charging station, the number of queuing vehicles, current service duration, real-time power load and operation cost, simulation environments containing electric automobile intelligent bodies and the charging station intelligent bodies are built to conduct reinforcement learning on an initial dynamic pricing model to obtain a trained dynamic pricing model, time-of-use electricity prices, user data and station data are input into the dynamic pricing model, and the dynamic pricing model outputs a dynamic service charge sequence. The technical problem that the current charging station is weak in profit regulation and control capability in a fixed-period pricing mode is solved, and maximization of total profit of charging station operation is achieved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Collaborative data disaster recovery method of unmanned aerial vehicle cluster in disaster scene and related equipment
depositantes: XIJIAO NETWORK SPACE SAFETY RESEARCH INST | UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG
resumo: The invention discloses a collaborative data disaster recovery method of an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster in a disaster scene and related equipment, dividing unmanned aerial vehicle nodes in the cluster into data acquisition and storage nodes, and establishing a data disaster backup game model to describe storage transactions of the unmanned aerial vehicle nodes and the data acquisition and storage nodes. The data collection node aims at maximizing self comprehensive utility, the utility is determined by data value, storage cost, transmission delay and load balancing penalty, the data storage node aims at maximizing service benefit, and the benefit is determined by storage cost and maintenance cost. The optimal strategy is determined through two-step decision, namely, a model is solved by a distributed optimization algorithm under the goal of maximizing the overall social benefit of the cluster, the optimal storage strategy of the data acquisition node is determined by a Nash bargaining game solving method based on the optimal storage strategy, and finally disaster recovery operation is executed. The method solves the problems of difficult implementation, high delay and high cost of the traditional cloud backup in disaster areas, solves the problems of lack of excitation, neglect of data importance and load balancing of the traditional scheme, makes up the limitation of game models, and ensures the data safety in disaster scenes.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)
