titulo: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR DETECTING A VEHICLE EVENT
resumo: Aspects of the disclosure relate to computer systems and/or methods to determine whether a vehicle event occurred during a trip. A computer model may be implemented on one or more computing devices in a vehicle computing environment to monitor sensor outputs from one or more sensors of the computing devices, and/or monitor outputs of one or more sub-models running on the computing devices to detect a vehicle event occurred. The computer model may predict whether roadside assistance is needed for a vehicle event based on the sensor output and/or the output of one or more sub-models. For example, based on a prediction that roadside assistance is needed, the computer model may generate a request for the roadside assistance and transmit the request to a service provider to provide the roadside assistance.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYNCHRONIZED INTERACTIVE VOICE RESPONSE SYSTEM AND GRAPHICAL USER INTERFACE FOR AUTOMATED ROADSIDE SERVICE
resumo: Systems and methods are disclosed for providing roadside service through a synchronized interactive voice response (IVR) system and graphical user interface (GUI). One method may include: receiving, based on an incoming phone call from a vehicle user device, a request for roadside service for a disabled vehicle of a vehicle user; sending a text to a phone number of the vehicle user device, wherein the text includes a link to a mobile application for roadside service requests; receiving, from the vehicle user device and via the mobile application, information associated with the request for roadside service; determining, based on a location sensor of the vehicle user device, a location of the disabled vehicle; matching a roadside service provider with the disabled vehicle based on the request for roadside service; and enabling the vehicle user to track the service status of the roadside service provider through the mobile application.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Generation method and device of online car-hailing order price guidance template, equipment and medium
depositantes: BEIJING BAILONGMA YUNXING TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile service, and discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for generating a network vehicle order price guidance template, wherein the method comprises the following steps: calculating a basic pricing template according to a preset pricing template and the number of response orders of each tenant on the network contract vehicle multi-tenant aggregation platform; adjusting the basic pricing templates to obtain basic pricing templates with different pricing standards; acquiring order information of an order issued by a passenger, and calculating a pre-valuation of a corresponding order according to a valuation standard of each basic valuation template; simulating an order response process, and predicting the completion rate of an order issued by a passenger; and selecting the basic pricing template with the highest completion rate as a price guiding template of the network contract vehicle multi-tenant aggregation platform. The price guide template with wider applicability is obtained, price guidance is provided for users, excessive dependence of tenants on manpower in configuration of the price guide template is reduced, experience thresholds of newly-entered tenants are reduced, and configuration flow of the price guide template is more intelligent and reasonable.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Electric vehicle charging station management system
depositantes: YUNNAN SHANGAO NEW ENERGY CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses an electric vehicle charging station management system, which belongs to the technical field of charging station management systems and comprises a plurality of charging stations and an intelligent management platform; a charging unit, a numbering unit and a fault detection unit are arranged in the charging pile of the charging station; the intelligent management platform comprises a monitoring statistical unit, an intelligent grouping unit and a period setting unit; the intelligent grouping unit is used for dividing the charging piles in the charging station into an open group and a dormant group for each unit time T. The invention has the advantages that: on one hand, the problem that the fault is not easy to find in time due to long-term non-use of part of the charging piles can be avoided, and the operation and maintenance cost is reduced; on the other hand, the user can be ensured to charge smoothly, and the user experience is good.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Maintenance case writing method and device, equipment and storage medium
resumo: The application discloses a maintenance case writing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the field of vehicle diagnosis and comprise the following steps: triggering corresponding request generation operation based on a preset interface in the process of writing the maintenance case based on the preset diagnosis equipment client so as to obtain a corresponding information acquisition request; the information acquisition request is sent to a corresponding dialog box, and a corresponding request response result obtained based on a preset third-party server is automatically acquired; if the request response result is successfully audited by the current technician, continuing to execute corresponding case writing operation based on the request response result; and if the request response result is failed to be checked by the current technician, re-jumping to the step of triggering corresponding request generation operation based on a preset interface to obtain a corresponding information acquisition request. Therefore, the speed of writing the maintenance case can be effectively improved, and the quality of the case content can be improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Dispatching system and method for unmanned mining truck
resumo: The application discloses a dispatching system and a dispatching method for an unmanned mining truck. The system comprises: cloud platform, unmanned mining truck; the unmanned mining truck at least comprises a first mining truck and a second mining truck; the first mining truck is used for sending out self synchronous information in a broadcast mode when the mining truck runs out of the signal range of the base station; the second mining truck is used for sending the synchronous information to the cloud platform under the condition that the synchronous information is received and the signal range of the base station is within, so as to receive a dispatching instruction of the cloud platform and forward the received dispatching instruction to the first mining truck; wherein the synchronization information and the scheduling instruction include an authorized ID of the first mining truck. By adopting the technical scheme, when the connection between the mine card and the cloud platform is interrupted, the scheduling information can be acquired through V2V direct communication, and the scheduling information is forwarded to the cloud system by a vehicle end or roadside unit which can be connected to the base station. The operation efficiency and the operation safety of the mine card are improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Electric vehicle charging dynamic pricing method and related device
depositantes: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST | STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses a dynamic pricing method and a related device for electric vehicle charging, wherein a quick charging station is used as an intelligent body, charging price is adjusted to act, benefits of the quick charging station are used as rewards, a vehicle and charging station simulation model is used as an environment, the total load value of the quick charging station, the number of vehicles of the quick charging station and road network information within the arrangement range of the quick charging station are used as states, a dynamic pricing model based on deep reinforcement learning is constructed, the charging price of the quick charging station at the next moment can be adjusted according to current traffic flow data, the vehicle is guided through adjustment of the charging price, and the overall profit of the quick charging station is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Taxi-taking scheduling method and device, terminal equipment, system and storage medium
resumo: The application provides a taxi taking scheduling method, a taxi taking scheduling device, a taxi taking scheduling terminal device, a taxi taking system and a storage medium, wherein the taxi taking method comprises the following steps: acquiring an intention taxi taking position of an intention taxi taking person sent by a roadside camera; the intention driver is identified by the road side camera according to the acquired road surface video; acquiring candidate positions of candidate vehicles in a preset range, and sending the intention driving position and each candidate position to each candidate vehicle; when receiving response information sent by a target vehicle, forwarding the response information to each candidate vehicle; the target vehicle is a vehicle that is determined to be traveling to the intended drive-up location among the candidate vehicles. The method can enable taxi taking personnel to take taxis efficiently and conveniently, and therefore convenience and efficiency of taxi taking of users are improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Non-signalized intersection vehicle passing sequence decision and trajectory optimization method and system
resumo: The invention discloses a method and a system for determining and optimizing a traffic sequence and a track of a vehicle at a signalless intersection. The method comprises the following steps: collecting information of all vehicles in the signal-free intersection appearance area; sequencing all vehicles in the signal-free intersection appearance area according to the arrival order to form a virtual queue; determining an optimal motorcade composition scheme and a collision-free passing sequence, and planning the moment when each motorcade enters the no-signalized intersection convergence zone and the allocated occupied time of the no-signalized intersection convergence zone; and generating an optimal track for the intelligent network head car through a nonlinear programming model, and giving a speed suggestion of a next period for the head car of the network human driving vehicle willing to follow the speed suggestion through a speed suggestion model, so that the head car brings a fleet to pass through the signalless intersection control area and the confluence area according to the programming. The system comprises road side sensing and communication equipment, a road side computing unit and a vehicle-mounted unit. By adopting the method and the system, the traffic efficiency of vehicles at the signalless intersection can be effectively improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle Repair Cost Estimate Acquisition System and Method
resumo: A computer-based method for obtaining repair estimates for a vehicle, and a related network server, are provided. The method comprises receiving a vehicle identification number (VIN) over a network from a customer computer, retrieving vehicle information, associated with the VIN, from a database, sending the vehicle information and a graphical representation of the vehicle, including a plurality of selectable vehicle damage locations, over the network to the customer computer, receiving a selection of at least one vehicle damage location over the network from the customer computer, receiving at least one image of the vehicle over the network from the customer computer, storing the vehicle information, the selected damage location and the vehicle image as a repair job in a non-volatile memory or the database, and sending a notification, indicating that the new repair job is available for review, over the network to at least one repair provider computer.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Commercial vehicle maintenance service digital management system
depositantes: NANJING FENGANTU NETWORK TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses a digital management system for maintenance service of a commercial vehicle, which comprises a front-end user interface module, a rear-end server module, a third-party server module and a database management module; the front-end user interface module is provided with a user operation sub-module and an administrator operation sub-module; the back-end server module is in communication connection with the front-end user interface module, the front-end user interface module sends data to the back-end server module, and the back-end server module processes the request; the third party server module is used for acquiring configuration information corresponding to a plurality of third party services. The digital management system for the maintenance service of the commercial vehicle aims to optimize the management of the vehicle assets, maintenance scheduling, supply chain management and operation and planning optimization of a logistics fleet through an integrated digital solution. The system realizes nationwide scheduling of vehicle maintenance through database management, and simultaneously promotes communication and digital management of an upstream ecological system and a downstream ecological system.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle price determination method and system, computing device and storage medium
resumo: The invention discloses a vehicle price determining method, a system, a computing device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of requesting a first server for obtaining basic information of a target vehicle, obtaining historical transaction price information related to the basic information, and determining a preliminary estimated price of the target vehicle according to the basic information and the historical transaction price information; requesting a second server to acquire target maintenance information of a target vehicle, and determining a maintenance influence value of the target maintenance information on the preliminary estimated price according to a maintenance influence coefficient model corresponding to the target vehicle system; requesting a third server to acquire target risk information of a target vehicle, and determining a risk influence value of the target risk information on the preliminary estimated price according to a risk influence coefficient model corresponding to the target vehicle system; and determining the final price of the target vehicle according to the preliminary estimated price, the maintenance influence value and the risk influence value. According to the technical scheme of the invention, the vehicle can be estimated more accurately by combining the actual use condition of the vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Automobile maintenance data query service system
depositantes: NANTONG ZHONGQIANG AUTOMOBILE SERVICE CO LTD
resumo: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile service systems, and discloses an automobile maintenance data query service system which comprises a user login module, a target identification module and an information statistics module. The automobile maintenance data query service system is displayed in the same interface through the image selection unit and the character selection unit, so that a user can conveniently select different types of automobile parts through a three-dimensional model or characters, manual input is reduced, time and labor are saved in operation, image query result display is more visual, and an information statistics module calculates the occupancy rate of the automobile maintenance parts Price ratio of automobile maintenance And automobile maintenance cycle The system response is quick, the service experience is good, and the user login module calculates the increment duty ratio of the registered user The method is beneficial to the optimization of the service level of the automobile brand side.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Cross-regional vehicle repair resource collaborative management and sharing system based on cloud computing
depositantes: BEIJING ZHONGCHEXING HI TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses a cross-regional repair resource collaborative management and sharing system based on cloud computing, which relates to the technical field of repair data processing, and comprises the following components: performing task skill level analysis and task complexity level analysis to obtain a local task skill level and a local task complexity level; calculating to obtain task skill level and task complexity level; calling technical characteristic information; carrying out mechanic selection optimization to obtain an optimized mechanic group; and selecting an optimal technician by a technician, and dispatching the optimal technician to a local area for processing the steam repair task. The technical problems that the distribution of the steam repair resources among areas is uneven, the steam repair information is difficult to share, the matching degree of the skill and the maintenance task is low in the existing steam repair resource management are solved, and further the maintenance efficiency and quality are low, and the resource utilization efficiency is insufficient are solved, the real-time sharing and the optimal allocation of the cross-area steam repair resources are realized, and the technical effects of improving the steam repair resource utilization efficiency and the maintenance efficiency and the quality are achieved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Oficinas e Manutenção (C2))

titulo: Online car-hailing service provider price determination method and system
resumo: The invention relates to the technical field of network about car service, and discloses a method and a system for determining the price of a network about car service provider, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring target vehicle scale data of a target network vehicle-restraining service provider and non-target vehicle scale data of a non-target network vehicle-restraining service provider; calculating autonomous pricing data of the target network vehicle-booking service provider which does not depend on the aggregation platform based on the target vehicle scale data and the non-target vehicle scale data, and determining autonomous profit data of the target network vehicle-booking service provider; calculating platform pricing data of a target network vehicle booking service provider depending on an aggregation platform based on the target vehicle scale data and the non-target vehicle scale data, and determining platform profit data of the target network vehicle booking service provider according to the platform pricing data; comparing the autonomous profit data with the platform profit data, and determining pricing of the target network car booking service provider according to the comparison result; the invention helps the network about car service provider to provide decisions on the pricing, and ensures that the maximum benefit is maintained while the aggregation platform enters the market.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Análogo - Field Service Management (C4))

titulo: Student car using method
resumo: The invention discloses a method for student to use a car, S11: the user selects a rights card and purchases the rights card; s12: the user selects a corresponding vehicle using mode, fills in vehicle using information, a vehicle using point, a destination and vehicle using time, and enters step S13 after filling in time date and address information; s13: filling in student bus information and handover person information, and setting emergency contacts; meanwhile, a protection service can be set; s14: confirming a journey plan, entering a confirmation page, displaying back information filled in by a user and predicting price, wherein the user can select whether to apply for insurance, and can automatically purchase accident insurance for a driver when the driver starts; according to the scheme, a set of vehicle use flow is specially created for a student vehicle use scene, batch ordering is achieved, and the student vehicle use flow is regularly sent and received, so that service safety is guaranteed; the ordering amount of the vehicle for students is greatly improved, and meanwhile, the problem that a plurality of parents catch up with the children to pick up the children for learning is solved; at the same time, the public praise and income of the platform can be improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Automobile fault maintenance system and method
depositantes: NANTONG ZHONGQIANG AUTOMOBILE SERVICE CO LTD
resumo: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile maintenance systems, and discloses an automobile fault maintenance system which comprises a fault analysis module, a maintenance operation module and a data statistics module. According to the automobile fault maintenance system and method, the fault analysis module is used for collecting the vehicle data set and calculating the vehicle maintenance parameters And a vehicle failure index The system analysis is comprehensive, the damage degree of the vehicle is visual, the frequency of the subsequent maintenance period is judged to be more specialized, and the maintenance operation module system calculates the maintenance operation time of the automobile Time and labor are saved, a user can accurately manage maintenance time, travel inconvenience is reduced, and after the data statistics module collects the automobile price data set, an automobile maintenance valuation is calculated And the second hand price ratio of the automobile And the maintenance cost performance is judged by the user through numerical comparison, and the service experience is better.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Oficinas e Manutenção (C2))

titulo: Method for improving instant single response rate of online car-hailing platform
resumo: The invention discloses a method for improving the instant single response rate of a network taxi-taking platform, which comprises the following steps of S1: the passenger side APP user orders, and the user inputs vehicle utilization information; s2: the passenger side APP initiates a booking with the coordinates of the getting-on and getting-off addresses and the account information of the user; s3: the order system creates an order, and requests the order system after assembling parameters; s4: the order is successfully placed, and an order number generated by the order system is returned to the agent layer system; s5: the agent layer system receives the order number returned by the order system and assembles the order parameter information to request the order system; s6: meanwhile, the agent layer system inquires the vehicle type which is not selected by the current user, and requests the charging system to acquire the estimated price of the vehicle type which is not selected by the current user; the network vehicle-booking platform of the invention reduces the sensitivity of a user to the price by increasing the difference between the vehicle type display and the selected vehicle type on the single-dispatching page, and properly uses products or operation means to prompt passengers to select high-price vehicle types so as to improve the utilization rate, response rate, completion rate and completion flow of idle drivers of the price vehicle types.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Electric vehicle charging station MARL dynamic pricing method with drainage mechanism
resumo: The invention discloses a dynamic pricing method for an electric vehicle charging station MARL with a drainage mechanism. Specifically, the charging station is regarded as an intelligent agent, and a collaborative multi-intelligent-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) system is constructed, so that the pricing strategy of the charging station is optimized, and the long-term benefit and user benefit maximization of the charging network are realized. When the user preference function is designed, the congestion level of the charging station is fully considered, and the congestion level is taken as one of important factors in the user decision process. In order to more accurately predict the congestion level of each charging station, the invention adopts a traffic flow prediction model based on a long-short-term memory (LSTM) neural network. In addition, a drainage mechanism is introduced, and according to the congestion level prediction of each charging station in the charging network, the user which is not served is guided to the charging station with lower congestion degree, so that the allocation of user traffic is optimized, and the efficient utilization of resources among the charging stations is ensured.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle mileage price determination method and device, equipment and storage medium
depositantes: GEELY HOLDING GROUP CO LTD | GEELY AUTOMOBILE RES INSTITUTE NINGBO CO LTD
resumo: The application provides a price determining method, device, equipment and storage medium for vehicle mileage, which are used for determining a target value attribute corresponding to at least one candidate mileage strategy according to user portrait, vehicle information, basic value attribute of at least one candidate mileage strategy and supply mileage of a battery in a vehicle, recommending the at least one candidate mileage strategy and the target value attribute corresponding to the at least one candidate mileage strategy to the user.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR MANAGING VEHICLE REPAIRING
resumo: The present invention relates to a method for repairing a vehicle (100) by means of a repairing management system (1), comprising a booking module (2), an estimation module (3), a technician assignment module (4) and a repair assistant module (5). The booking module (2) receives a first request with vehicle data. The estimation module (3) receives and analyses the vehicle data, obtaining a repairing list (7) containing actions to be done. The technician assignment module receives repairing list (7). The technician assignment module creates a workflow (9) which contains all the actions of the repairing list in order, and assigns each action to be done to a technician. When a technician starts an assigned action, the repair assistance module (5) provides the technician with instructions for performing the repairing. From the confirmation of the booking date to the finishing of all the assigned actions, the technician assignment module verifies that the assigned action is finished in due date, and if there is a delay in any action of the workflow, the technician assignment module redates the actions of the workflow which are subsequent to the delayed action.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Diagnosis interface display method and device, equipment and storage medium
depositantes: SHENZHEN YIXIN YIYI SOFTWARE DEV CO LTD
resumo: The application discloses a diagnostic interface display method, a diagnostic interface display device, diagnostic interface display equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of vehicle diagnosis, wherein the diagnostic interface display method comprises the following steps: obtaining a topological graph node in a visible area of a pre-drawn topological graph; sending a label information inquiry request to a server side based on a topological graph node in a topological graph visible area, so that the server side inquires and obtains label information of the topological graph node based on the label information inquiry request; receiving label information returned by the server side; in response to the click command of the topological graph node, the label information corresponding to the topological graph node is displayed.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Price determination method, device and equipment for online car-hailing fixed-price order
depositantes: BEIJING BAILONGMA YUNXING TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent transportation and discloses a price determining method, a device and equipment for a fixed price order of a network about car, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring first target information, wherein the first target information comprises first order information of the target fixed price order sent by a user and first supply and demand information of a city area corresponding to the target fixed price order at the current moment; and according to the price adjustment ratio with the highest price adjustment ratio, adjusting the initial quotation of the target fixed price order to obtain the final quotation of the target fixed price order. According to the invention, the order completion rate of each price adjustment rate is predicted according to the actual order information and the network about vehicle supply and demand information, and then the price adjustment rate with the highest order completion rate is determined as the price adjustment rate, so that the driver cancellation rate of the network about vehicle fixed price order can be reduced.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: On-demand service matching method, device and equipment in 6G air-space-ground Internet of Vehicles
resumo: The invention provides a method, a device and equipment for on-demand service matching in a 6G space-sky-earth vehicle network. The method comprises the steps of carrying out virtualization processing on physical network resources through SDN and NFV technologies to obtain virtual network resources, obtaining user requirements, carrying out fine-grained demand analysis based on scene recognition on the user requirements to obtain fine-grained user requirements, carrying out initial grouping processing on all users based on the virtual network resources and the fine-grained user requirements to obtain a plurality of initial user groups, carrying out problem modeling on the virtual network resources, the fine-grained user requirements and the plurality of initial user groups to obtain an optimized problem model, carrying out problem reconstruction on the optimized problem model to obtain a TMSC frame, carrying out R-TMSC simplification processing on the TMSC frame to obtain a preference list, carrying out resource on-demand matching on users, the initial user groups and path mapping by utilizing a three-party matching algorithm and the preference list to obtain a resource allocation result of an actual user group.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: EV charging and discharging optimization method considering user will and battery loss
resumo: The EV charging and discharging optimization method considering user wish and battery loss comprises the steps of constructing a V2G model according to driving characteristics and user habits of an EV owner, analyzing subjective factors and objective factors affecting decision of the user of the electric automobile, modeling, adding discharging benefits and battery loss cost into comprehensive charging cost, modeling and quantifying the battery loss cost based on temperature and discharging depth, analyzing three-dimensional relation among the temperature, discharging depth and battery life, finally considering seasonal characteristics of the temperature loss, adding dynamic adjustment of the user wish and seasonal characteristics of loss into an optimization strategy, constructing a typical scene, and optimizing the comprehensive charging cost of a user side and peak-valley difference of a power grid side by using a dung-horse algorithm. The optimization method optimizes the charge and discharge behaviors by introducing user will, improves user satisfaction, considers battery loss, prolongs battery life, reduces maintenance cost, and improves the overall efficiency of the system by combining seasonal characteristics to ensure stable operation.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Rental vehicle moving method and system and computer readable storage medium
resumo: The invention discloses a vehicle renting method, a system and a computer readable storage medium, which comprise the following steps of S1, detecting whether a vehicle is at a designated position after a vehicle renting user returns the vehicle, ending a vehicle renting order if the vehicle renting user returns the vehicle, deducting extra vehicle renting cost of the vehicle renting user and entering S2 if the vehicle renting user does not return the vehicle renting order, S2, acquiring vehicle information, calculating to obtain the remaining driving mileage R1 of the vehicle, S3, positioning longitude and latitude information of a vehicle returning point and combining the vehicle information acquired by S2, requesting an API of a third party map server, calculating the mileage R2 from the actual position of the vehicle to the vehicle returning point, pushing the actual position of the vehicle to an operation and maintenance personnel if the vehicle is smaller than R2, notifying the operation and maintenance personnel of the vehicle, and generating an order of award and pushing the vehicle to a user nearby the actual position of the vehicle if the R1 is larger than R2. The invention has the advantages of reducing the operation cost, increasing the viscosity and loyalty of users, reducing the operation loss risk caused by the vehicle moving problem, having better profit capability and the like.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Method and device for determining charging and discharging electricity price of electric vehicle
resumo: The invention discloses a charge and discharge electricity price determining method and device for an electric automobile. The method comprises the steps of obtaining aggregate load data, aggregate data of flexible resources, power supply capacity data of a power grid and time-of-use power price data of an electric vehicle in a current time period, inputting the aggregate load data, the aggregate data, the power supply capacity data and the time-of-use power price data which are subjected to data cleaning into a pricing model to be processed, and obtaining power price pricing in the current time period, wherein the pricing model is a model constructed by taking the maximization of benefits of a virtual power plant operator as a target under the condition that a plurality of constraint conditions are met, and the constraint conditions are constraint conditions obtained by constraining factors affecting a plurality of dimensions of power price pricing. The invention solves the technical problems that the pricing model used for the pricing of the power grid and the charging (converting) power station in the related technology only usually considers the electricity price, but does not fully consider the factors influencing the electricity price, so that the pricing result is not ideal.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle-connected MEC computing task scheduling method based on dynamic pricing and terminal equipment mobility
depositantes: DALIAN MARITIME UNIVERSITY; 大连海事大学
resumo: The invention relates to an Internet-of-Vehicles MEC computing task scheduling method based on dynamic pricing and terminal equipment mobility, which comprises the following steps of: establishing an Internet-of-Vehicles mobile edge computing system, dividing the Internet-of-Vehicles mobile edge computing system into a user side and a task side, establishing a user side task unloading model, and in binary task unloading scheduling, performing task unloading on the user side. Establishing a mathematical model for maximizing the long-term utility of the mobile user vehicle under the condition of satisfying budget and time delay limitation; establishing an edge side task processing model, establishing a mathematical model for maximizing the overall utility of the roadside unit, introducing a simplified variable and a relaxation integer constraint condition, solving the mathematical model for maximizing the overall utility of the roadside unit through a KKT condition, and obtaining a service price for enabling the overall utility of the roadside unit to be optimal; and based on the optimal service pricing, a multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm is adopted to solve the maximized mobile user vehicle long-term utility mathematical model, and a final edge computing server for mobile user vehicle computing task unloading is determined.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Online car-hailing price elasticity evaluation method, device and equipment and storage medium
depositantes: BEIJING YUNXING ONLINE SOFTWARE DEV CO LTD
resumo: The invention relates to a network contract price elastic assessment method, device, equipment and storage medium, which comprises the steps of obtaining transaction data of a network contract vehicle platform, wherein the transaction data comprise price inquiring time, price ordering time, vehicle type, mileage, pre-assessment, price completion information and supply and demand information, selecting characteristics according to a principle that the higher the price elastic correlation is, the more preferential the price elastic correlation is based on the transaction data, constructing a DML price elastic model, wherein the DML price elastic model comprises two submodules, one submodule is used for estimating the price of the network contract vehicle serving as a processing variable, the other submodule is used for estimating the riding requirement serving as a response variable, training the DML price elastic model by means of a residual fitting method based on the transaction data, and carrying out price elastic assessment on the network contract vehicle price based on the trained DML price elastic model to obtain an assessment result.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Method and system for generating unmanned aerial vehicle tower fault emergency inspection route
depositantes: MAANSHAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY | ANHUI TRANS AND TRANSFORMATION ENGINEERING CO LTD
resumo: The embodiment of the invention provides a generation method and a system of an unmanned aerial vehicle tower fault emergency routing inspection route, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle dispatching. The method comprises the steps of obtaining towers of a route to be generated, traversing each tower, generating a routing inspection route of the unmanned aerial vehicle in each tower by adopting a preset first genetic method, determining an outlet, an inlet and a relative position relation of each tower and the number of unmanned aerial vehicles used for routing inspection, and generating routing inspection schemes of all towers of the unmanned aerial vehicle routing inspection by adopting a preset second genetic method according to the outlet, the inlet and the relative position relation and the number of the unmanned aerial vehicles. Compared with the prior art, the method and the system provided by the invention combine the distribution condition of the towers to generate the route, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can adapt to the special working condition of the towers, and the application range of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the dispatching efficiency when facing the inspection task of the towers are improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Traffic processing method for multiple networked vehicles, electronic equipment and storage medium
depositantes: GUANGZHOU GOSUNCN NETWORK TECH CO LTD
resumo: The application provides a method for processing the passing of a plurality of internet-connected vehicles, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which are applied to the current internet-connected vehicles, wherein the current internet-connected vehicles are positioned in a preset distance range of a current intersection; if yes, receiving running state information and cooperative intention information of each associated network-connected vehicle, iteratively determining a target network-connected vehicle according to the running state information and cooperative intention information of each associated network-connected vehicle and the current network-connected vehicle, acquiring a current passing scheme of the target network-connected vehicle, and executing the current passing scheme. All network vehicles waiting to pass through the same intersection can be decided together, and the passing scheme with consensus is executed together after consensus is achieved, so that road right distribution is carried out without depending on road side equipment, and each network vehicle can safely and effectively pass through the intersection.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Method for modifying location information of travel order based on online car-hailing
depositantes: BEIJING BAILONGMA YUNXING TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention relates to the field of order modification, and discloses a method for modifying travel order position information based on a net jockey car, which is used for solving the problem that when an order information modified by a passenger, the travel starting position of the driver after the modification is slower, and comprises the steps that the passenger inputs the position information to be modified in an interface, acquires the order information and the real-time condition information of the net jockey car driver, comprehensively evaluates the order information and the real-time condition information of the net jockey car driver, and the order modification judgment is carried out according to the evaluation result, the network taxi service end returns pre-evaluation information after the order is modified, the passenger end transmits the position modification information modified by the passenger and the pre-evaluation information to the server, the server updates and stores the new order position and the pre-evaluation information, and the driver end regenerates the navigation route according to the new position information, so that the experience of the passenger and the driver is effectively ensured.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: ELECTRIC VEHICLE FAST-CHARGING DEMAND GUIDANCE METHOD AND APPARATUS, DEVICE, AND MEDIUM
depositantes: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RESEARCH INSTITUTE [CN] | STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD [CN]
resumo: The present invention relates to the technical field of electric vehicle charging guidance, and in particular to an electric vehicle fast-charging demand guidance method and apparatus, a device, and a medium. The method comprises: establishing a dynamic traffic network capable of real-time updates; constructing a road traffic impedance model and an electric vehicle power consumption model; respectively constructing a private vehicle travel behavior model and a ride-hailing vehicle travel behavior model; constructing a user charging satisfaction quantification index; providing charging selection modes for different types of electric vehicles; and predicting the charging load of charging stations within each time period, and formulating a dynamic pricing strategy for the charging stations with the objective of minimizing load fluctuations at each charging station. For the travel models of different types of electric vehicles, including private vehicles and ride-hailing vehicles, the spatio-temporal distribution of fast-charging load is optimized, and by means of price regulation, the strategy can guide users to charge during low-load periods, thereby balancing the load of each charging station, reducing the power fluctuation pressure on a distribution network caused by fast charging, and ensuring stable operation of a power grid.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Accident vehicle part loss assessment price determination method and related equipment
resumo: The application discloses a method, a device, electronic equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product for determining the loss price of spare parts of an accident vehicle, which are used for solving the problem that the loss price of the same spare part in different loss determination places is possibly too large to be reasonable due to the loss price determination method provided by the prior art. The method comprises the steps of obtaining target loss price zone information corresponding to information of target parts by inquiring corresponding relation between information of different parts and corresponding loss price zone information, wherein the loss price zone information in the corresponding relation is determined according to a plurality of localization price characterization vectors with similarity, different localization feature characterization vectors corresponding to the same parts represent historical loss price of the same part at different loss places, predicting loss discount rate of the target parts at the target loss places based on the information affecting the loss discount rate of the target loss places, and determining the loss price of the target parts at the target loss places according to the target loss price zone information and the predicted loss discount rate.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: USER REQUIREMENT ANALYSIS-BASED ON-DEMAND SERVICE POLICY SYSTEM FOR SPACE-AIR-GROUND SCENARIOS
resumo: Disclosed in the present invention is a user demand analysis-based on-demand service policy system for space-air-ground scenarios, which solves the problem in the prior art of lacking in-depth analysis of personalized user demands and being unable to achieve accurate resource allocation on the basis of dynamically changing demands. The solution comprises: a user end comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module and a demand upload module which are successively connected; the user end is used for data acquisition, data preprocessing and demand uploading; a network end comprises a network state acquisition module, a demand analysis module, a policy calculation module and a scheduling module which are successively connected, the network state acquisition module being used for acquiring the current network resource in real time; the network end analyzes demands, and, on the basis of an analysis result, obtains a network resource allocation policy, so as to achieve efficient data transmission and dynamic resource configuration.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Online car-hailing intelligent management system
resumo: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic systems and discloses an online booking intelligent management system which comprises a collecting module, a dispatching module and a pricing module, wherein the collecting module acquires real-time order information and passenger history data and inputs the real-time order information and the passenger history data into the dispatching module and the pricing module, the dispatching module carries out vehicle dispatching and dispatching optimization selection of an optimal vehicle according to the acquired real-time order information and the passenger history data, and the pricing module dynamically calculates the order price of the optimal vehicle and adjusts the pricing parameter in real time according to the acquired real-time order information and the passenger history data in combination with pricing parameters of corresponding time periods and route areas. According to the invention, the large data and machine learning are utilized to optimize dispatch and dynamic pricing, so that the efficiency and the service quality are improved, the supply and demand changes are flexibly dealt with, the idle running is reduced, the payment flow is simplified, the convenient and environment-friendly travel experience is provided, and the urban traffic efficiency is integrally improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR GENERATING CAR MAINTENANCE INFORMATION
resumo: Disclosed in the present specification are an apparatus and a method for generating vehicle maintenance information. An apparatus for generating vehicle maintenance information according to the present specification may include: a storage unit for storing an accessory device requiring maintenance using vehicle performance state inspection record information as an input value and a neural network model (hereinafter referred to as a 'maintenance prediction model') for predicting a maintenance time; and a maintenance information generation unit for generating information related to at least one maintenance item for an inspection target vehicle (hereinafter referred to as 'maintenance item information') by inputting the performance state inspection record information of the inspection target vehicle to the maintenance prediction model.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Systems and Methods for Insurance Fraud Prevention using Artificial Intelligence
resumo: The disclosed invention pertains to a computer system enhanced by artificial intelligence designed to accurately assess vehicle damage and estimate repair costs. It includes a graphical user interface for capturing and uploading vehicle images, a server for analyzing these images to detect various damage levels, and a database for storing vehicle and report information. Key features include a self-diagnostic algorithm to ensure unbiased AI operation and a hybrid user interface that integrates damage reports with direct links to third-party repair services. The system employs a sophisticated AI capable of differentiating between minor, moderate, and major vehicle damage. This technology enables a streamlined, accurate, and user-friendly method for a variety of scenarios, including, but not limited to insurance value approximation, body shop estimating, used car appraisals, and the like.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR MANAGING AND PREDICTING MAINTENANCE SERVICES FOR EV CHARGING ARRAYS
resumo: A system for monitoring and maintaining electric vehicle (EV) chargers including at least one memory for storing computer-executable instructions and at least one processor for executing the instructions stored on the at least one memory. Execution of the instructions programs the at least one processor to perform operations that include receiving input data associated with at least one EV charger, monitoring the input data via at least one artificial intelligence (AI) model, detecting an anomaly in the input data, wherein the anomaly corresponds to a predicted failure of at least one component of the at least one EV charger, automatically scheduling a repair, in response to a determination that the repair has been completed, collecting feedback from at least one technician associated with the repair, and providing the feedback to the at least one AI model, wherein the feedback is used to continuously train the at least one AI model.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: POST-WORK SUMMARY GENERATION, REFINEMENT, AND UPDATE FOR FIELD SERVICE CALLS
resumo: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product aspects for textual post-work summary generation, refinement, and/or update. An example implementation operates by generating a first natural-language textual prompt based on a textual transcription of a first speech of a user and a first prompt template selected based on a work order. The implementation then queries a LLM with the first natural-language textual prompt to generate a textual post-work summary. The implementation then generates a second natural-language textual prompt based on a textual transcription of a second speech of the user and a second prompt template. The implementation then queries the LLM with the second natural-language textual prompt that directs the LLM to refine the textual post-work summary. In addition, the implementation updates the work order based on the refined textual post-work summary. In some aspects, the implementation may generate an updated textual post-work summary based on incorporating a textual transcription of a third speech of the user into the generated and/or the refined textual post-work summary, and then update the work order based on the updated textual post-work summary.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: AUTOMATED GENERATION OF A FIELD SERVICE TECHNICIAN PRE-WORK BRIEF
resumo: Methods, systems, and machine-readable media user generative artificial intelligence (AI) to generate a pre-work brief for display on a field service technician mobile device. An instruction to generate a pre-work brief is received. Work order data based on a field service technician user identifier associated with the instruction to generate the pre-work brief is retrieved. A generative AI prompt template is retrieved based on the work order data. A generative AI prompt is generated based on the prompt template and the work order data. The prompt is provided to a generative AI. The pre-work brief is received as an output of the generative AI. The pre-work brief is transmitted to the mobile device of the field service technician.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: PREDICTIVE SUBLET MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS AND METHODS
resumo: Embodiments of the disclosure provide systems and methods for predictive sublet service management based on an automotive repair estimate. According to one embodiment, a method for managing one or more third-party service providers can comprise receiving an estimate for repair of damage to a vehicle, obtaining a list of recommended third-party service providers related to the repair of the damage to the vehicle based on the estimate, and generating one or more service request lines based on the list of recommended third-party service providers. Each service request line can define a service to be performed in the repair of the damage to the vehicle. A service provider recommendation can be generated for each of the one or more service request lines. The generated one or more service request lines can be provided to a system of the service provider based on the service provider selected for each service request line.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: COST PROJECTION FOR BOTH PROPERTY DAMAGE AND BODILY INJURY BASED ON VEHICLE DAMAGE
resumo: A computer-implemented method comprises providing images and attributes of a damaged vehicle that has been damaged in a collision event to a trained computer vision machine learning model, which in response indicators of physical damage sustained by the damaged vehicle during the collision event; providing the indicators, damage claim data related to the collision event, and bodily injury claim data related to an occupant of the damaged vehicle during the collision event to a trained regression machine learning model, which in response provides a projected cost to repair the damaged vehicle and a projected cost to treat bodily injury sustained by the occupant during the collision event, and providing the projected costs to an analyst for use in evaluating a bodily injury claim related to the occupant of the damaged vehicle and the collision event and a damaged vehicle physical damage claim related to the collision event.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: AUTOMOBILE MAINTENANCE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
resumo: 본 발명 자동차 정비 관리 시스템은 고객단말; 자동차정비소 단말; 상기 고객단말로 차량수리에 따른 예상견적 서비스를 지원하고, 상기 자동차정비소 단말에서 영업일 기간에 발생된 청구내역 및 정비내역과 상기 고객단말에서 제공한 서비스 평점을 기초로 제휴된 공업사 가맹점들의 영업실태에 대한 관리평점을 산출하고, 고객위치 및 성향, 고객자동차 정보 등을 파악하여 실시간으로 고객의 성향과 위치에 맞는 가맹 자동차정비업체 또는 협력 자동차정비업체를 매칭하는 관리서버플랫폼을 포함한다.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: GUI WITH A BONUS SYMBOL WINDOW FOR INITIATING A JACKPOT CHANCE GAME AND A FEATURE GAME WITH ONE OR MORE FEATURE GAME ENHANCEMENTS
resumo:
A graphical user interface for providing, on-demand, a game of chance with a hold-and-spin feature game mechanic in a format that features a larger number of reels and chances to receive prizes than are provided in typical hold-and-spin games. The graphical interface is configured to nevertheless provide a hold-and-spin gameplay experience similar to that found in hold-and-spin games having a smaller number of reels.

titulo: Comprehensive energy system low-carbon optimization method and device considering participation of electric vehicle
depositantes: CHENGXI POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY | TIANJIN CHENGXI GUANGYUAN ELECTRIC POWER ENG CO LTD | STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO | STATE GRID CORP CHINA
resumo: The invention discloses a low-carbon optimization method and device of a comprehensive energy system considering electric automobile participation. The method comprises the following steps: establishing an IES scheduling optimization model, which comprises the following steps: establishing a device power model of the comprehensive energy system; establishing a carbon transaction model for controlling the total carbon emission in a grading manner; according to matching coefficients of electric power, distributed power output, user side load, distributed power output and user side load of a combined heat and power generation unit in the comprehensive energy system, establishing an electric vehicle ordered charging dynamic pricing model considering that the distributed power output is matched with the user side load; establishing an electric automobile charging load model according to the number, parameters, charging time and driving distance of the electric automobiles; setting an objective function with the minimum operation cost of the comprehensive energy system as a target; setting constraint conditions of the comprehensive energy system; and solving the IES scheduling optimization model, and scheduling according to a solving result. The IES operation cost can be reduced, the wind power and photovoltaic internet access rate is improved, and the EV operation cost is reduced.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Railway vehicle equipment fault two-stage maintenance scheme optimization method and system and medium
resumo: The invention relates to the technical field of railway vehicles, in particular to a method, a system and a medium for optimizing a two-stage maintenance scheme of equipment failure of a railway vehicle. According to the optimization method for the two-stage maintenance scheme of the rail vehicle equipment fault, the two-stage maintenance model of the rail vehicle equipment is constructed, and model optimization is carried out based on the maintenance cost rate and the mileage availability, so that complete modeling of maintenance of the rail vehicle equipment is realized, model data accords with reality, various costs of maintenance of the rail vehicle can be effectively reduced as a result of optimization, the interpretation is strong, and the optimization method has important significance in the field of the rail vehicle equipment.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle valuation method, device and equipment and storage medium
depositantes: PING AN TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD
resumo: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and discloses a vehicle estimation method, device, equipment and storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical claim settlement data and historical maintenance data of a target vehicle; preprocessing the historical claim settlement data to obtain claim settlement rules corresponding to the historical claim settlement data; performing data conversion on the historical maintenance data to obtain a fault defect of the target vehicle; determining vehicle damage assessment data of the target vehicle according to claim rules corresponding to historical claim settlement data and fault defects of the target vehicle, and obtaining a vehicle damage assessment value of the target vehicle according to the vehicle damage assessment data; and estimating the target vehicle according to the vehicle loss estimation value to obtain an estimation result of the target vehicle. According to the scheme, the historical claim maintenance data of the vehicle is obtained by analyzing the vehicle risk information, and the vehicle estimation is rapidly completed according to the claim maintenance data, so that the accuracy of the vehicle estimation is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Method and device for remotely assisting vehicle maintenance
resumo: The invention discloses a method and a device for remotely assisting in vehicle maintenance, wherein the method detects a maintenance help request sent by a maintenance help terminal; analyzing help content of the target vehicle to obtain an analysis result; generating maintenance help parameters of the target vehicle according to the analysis result of the target vehicle, and publishing or pushing the maintenance assistance request of the target vehicle to a matched maintenance assistance end; the service assistance request of the target vehicle includes a service help parameter of the target vehicle, and the service help parameter of the target vehicle includes a vehicle identification of the target vehicle. Therefore, the help seeking content sent by the vehicle maintenance help seeking end is analyzed, so that corresponding maintenance help seeking parameters are generated and published or directly and accurately sent to the matched maintenance assisting end, the vehicle maintenance help seeking end is not limited to acquaintance circles any more, the vehicle maintenance help seeking area is widened, the vehicle maintenance efficiency is improved, and when a maintenance problem is met, the probability of being solved is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Oficinas e Manutenção (C2))

titulo: Method and system for determining charging and discharging electricity price of micro-grid electric vehicle
depositantes: SHANDONG YILIAN DIGITAL ENERGY TECH CO LTD
resumo: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a system for determining charging and discharging electricity prices of electric vehicles with micro-grids, which relate to the field of grids and are used for obtaining power predicted values of a plurality of preset time periods in the future; calculating an energy storage theoretical available charging power predicted value P_es_ch_max (h) and an energy storage theoretical required discharging power predicted value P_es_dch_max (h), an energy storage power actual charging power predicted value P_es_ch (h) in a first period, an energy storage power actual discharging power predicted value P_es_dch (h) in a second period and a new energy power generation surplus power predicted value P_pv_s (h); and calculating the charge and discharge electricity price of the electric automobile in the micro-grid park according to the surplus power P_pv_s (h) of the new energy power generation. And according to the ratio of surplus or shortage of future power generation and power consumption daily forecast power of the micro-grid park, daily pricing is carried out, and compared with the current grid peak-valley flat electricity price, the micro-grid park is closer to different micro-grid operation characteristics, so that the load follow-up source movement of the micro-grid park is facilitated.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle price offset prompting method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
depositantes: HANGZHOU YIQI QINGCHEN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD
resumo: The application provides a vehicle price offset prompting method, a device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, comprising the following steps: acquiring a first-order estimated price based on a hot sales condition estimated result, vehicle rule parameters, depreciation attributes and preset standard prices of a target vehicle type; determining a current second-order estimated price of the target vehicle type based on the first-order estimated price and the historical estimated average price of the target vehicle type; and determining a target price interval based on the current second-order estimated price of the target vehicle type and a preset manual weighting proportion, autonomously estimating the price by the early warning system, determining the target price interval, and judging whether the vehicle price provided by a merchant deviates or not by the early warning system based on the vehicle price of the target vehicle type and the target price interval, if so, carrying out early warning, generating vehicle price deviation prompt information, and sending the vehicle price deviation prompt information to the management terminal for display.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Car insurance field service intelligent scheduling method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
depositantes: PING AN TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD
resumo: The invention relates to the field of intelligent decision making, and discloses an intelligent scheduling method for vehicle insurance outwork, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a historical vehicle insurance order, inquiring a vehicle insurance place and a vehicle insurance time of the historical vehicle insurance order, and extracting vehicle insurance features of the historical vehicle insurance order according to the vehicle insurance place and the vehicle insurance time; according to the vehicle risk characteristics, calculating a space distance matrix and a time distance matrix between road segment nodes in the vehicle risk site; according to the space distance matrix and the time distance matrix, calculating the space-time density of road segment nodes in the vehicle risk site, and clustering the road segment nodes with the space-time density larger than a preset threshold value to obtain a plurality of node clustering centers; when the density of the road section nodes in the plurality of clustering centers is up, combining the road section nodes to obtain a plurality of combined clustering centers, constructing a road section density distribution diagram of the vehicle insurance place based on each combined clustering center, and constructing a dispatching personnel distribution scheme of the vehicle insurance place according to the road section density distribution diagram. The invention can improve the timeliness of the vehicle insurance external service scheduling.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Emergency service vehicle dynamic scheduling method under static service
resumo: A dynamic dispatching method for emergency service vehicles under static service belongs to the field of agricultural machinery operation and maintenance service. In busy season, the farm machinery equipment clusters dynamically cross areas to carry out operation tasks, so that the maintenance service demands are increased rapidly, and the problem that the static service stations and emergency service vehicles cannot be dynamically managed and the dynamic maintenance demands are difficult to adapt in the prior art is solved. The method comprises the steps of establishing a dynamic scheduling model of the emergency service vehicle under static service by determining initial parameters, static service provider parameters and key parameters of the emergency service vehicle of an operation and maintenance service network area and taking minimized service cost as an optimization target; and a genetic algorithm is adopted to solve the number of emergency service vehicles used by the maintenance service network, the positions of the emergency service vehicles in each stage and the transfer path of each emergency service vehicle, so that the planning efficiency of the maintenance service network is improved. The invention is suitable for the field of agricultural machinery operation and maintenance, can reasonably configure the number of dynamic service vehicles, and reduces the maintenance and service cost.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Second-hand car price prediction method and system, computer equipment and storage medium
resumo: The application discloses a method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium for predicting the price of a second-hand vehicle, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring vehicle attribute information of a target second-hand vehicle; inputting the vehicle attribute information into a vehicle price prediction model, and outputting a first estimated price of the target second hand vehicle; inputting the vehicle attribute information into a vehicle attribute identification model, outputting a vehicle attribute identification result of the target second hand truck, and matching the vehicle attribute identification result with historical vehicle information in a vehicle price base to obtain the vehicle matching degree of the target second hand truck and a corresponding second estimated price; and based on the first estimated price, the second estimated price and the vehicle matching degree of the target second hand truck, realizing price prediction of the target second hand truck. The method can solve the problems of inaccurate prediction and low prediction efficiency of the second-hand vehicle price prediction method in the prior art.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Evaluation method, device and equipment for automobile interior resin part and medium
resumo: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for evaluating an automotive interior resin part, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the number of sub-parts contained in the automotive interior resin part and the types of the sub-parts; the types of the sub-parts include injection molding resin parts, spray coating resin parts, electroplating resin parts, skin coating resin parts and film coating resin parts; determining an estimated price of each sub-part according to the type of each sub-part; and adding and summing the estimated prices of the sub-parts to determine the estimated price of the automotive interior resin part. By using the method, a designer is helped to quickly, accurately and conveniently determine the estimated price of the automotive interior resin part, the price is simple and easy to popularize, and meanwhile, the understanding of the cost composition of the automotive interior resin part or the sub-part by the designer is deepened, so that the rationality of quotation of a resin part supplier is judged.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle maintenance method, system and device and electronic equipment
resumo: The embodiment of the application provides a vehicle maintenance method, a system, a device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring fault information of a current vehicle; based on the fault information, determining maintenance information of the current vehicle, wherein the maintenance information is advice of a maintenance end for maintaining the current vehicle for a user in terms of time and cost; and pushing the maintenance information to the user side and/or the current vehicle. After the fault information of the vehicle is obtained, the maintenance information is determined according to the fault information of the vehicle, and the maintenance information is timely notified to a user so as to improve the experience of the user.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Centralized vehicle collaborative decision-making ramp convergence separation method and device and cloud
resumo: The application discloses a centralized vehicle collaborative decision ramp remittance separation method, a device and a cloud, belonging to the technical field of automatic driving, comprising the following steps: according to the current position information and the destination address of the target vehicle, planning a global path of the target vehicle by adopting a rapid expansion random tree; the global path is combined with the expected running speed to obtain the position of each time point of the target vehicle on the global path, so that other vehicles are combined with the position of each time point of the target vehicle on the global path to plan the global path; if the global path planning time of the target vehicle is later than the global path planning time of other vehicles when the target vehicle reaches the target road section and the planned ramp is imported or separated to have been occupied by other vehicles, generating a cooperative control strategy based on the perception data of the road side equipment, the running data of the vehicle and the perception data of the vehicle end sensor. The intelligent vehicle driving system and the intelligent vehicle driving method have the advantages that on the premise of ensuring the driving safety of the intelligent vehicle, the driving efficiency of the single intelligent vehicle and the traffic efficiency of roads are improved to the greatest extent.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: AI on-demand service method based on 6G network
resumo: The invention discloses an AI on-demand service method based on a 6G network, which comprises the following steps: carrying out modularized processing on the AI model in advance to obtain a plurality of processing modules, wherein each processing module has a specific function; classifying user tasks according to service requests and service demands initiated by users, and arranging dynamic scheduling strategies of the user tasks, wherein the dynamic scheduling strategies comprise the sequence of AI models to be called, multiplexed or combined; according to the calculation and storage resources of the network node, deploying a processing module of an AI model contained in the dynamic scheduling strategy on the network node in the 6G network; invoking a processing module of the AI model at the network node to perform the current task. The invention realizes ubiquitous AI on-demand service by modularizing the AI model and deploying the AI model on a network node in the 6G network; and the calling and the combination of different AI model modules are supported, so that the AI service capacity and the AI service efficiency of the 6G network are improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Vehicle dynamic parking reservation system capable of parking scheduling
resumo: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent parking, in particular to a vehicle dynamic reservation berth system capable of berth scheduling. The intelligent scheduling system comprises an information acquisition unit, a cloud server, an intelligent scheduling center and a mobile intelligent terminal; the information acquisition unit detects the occupation condition of parking berths of each parking lot by the geomagnetic sensor, gathers the berth occupation information of a plurality of parking lots, and transmits the parking berth occupation information of each parking lot to the cloud server; the cloud server is used for integrating and storing various information in real time; the intelligent dispatching center is used for receiving various information transmitted by the cloud server in real time. According to the vehicle dynamic reservation berth system capable of berth scheduling, the occupancy information of the parking berths is detected through the sensors, the berth occupancy information is unified to the information acquisition unit and then transmitted to the cloud server, and information integration of multiple yards is achieved; more choices are provided for the berth reservation of the vehicle owners, and information provision is provided for realizing dynamic pricing of the berths.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Second-hand car rapid pricing method and system based on LightGBM model
depositantes: SHANGHAI XINBAO BOTONG E COMMERCE CO LTD
