resumo: The application relates to a quick pricing method and system for a second-hand vehicle based on a LightGBM model, comprising the steps of preprocessing second-hand vehicle historical data, and carrying out feature analysis on the preprocessed data to obtain vehicle features; inputting the vehicle characteristics to a pre-constructed LightGBM model, and obtaining a vehicle estimation model through training; estimating the price of the vehicle to be estimated through a vehicle estimation model; and calibrating the estimated price output by the model to obtain a vehicle estimated value result. The scheme not only solves the problems that the traditional method relies on manual experience and is difficult to duplicate quickly, but also solves the problem that the prediction result deviation is large because the simple tree model cannot sense market dynamics; in architecture, an off-line training and calculating mode and an on-line prediction mode are adopted, so that the prediction efficiency is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR PROVIDING TECHNICAL SERVICE TO AN AGRICULTURAL WORKING MACHINE
resumo: A method for providing technical service to an agricultural working machine is provided. A digital service module of a server coordinating the technical service receives a request for service, the request for service including at least one part and at least one service needed to fix a problem with the agricultural working machine. The server includes a database, which stores information about locations of parts (which may be in service vehicles, locations assigned to service providers, or at a central storage), service providers, and part runners. The digital service module determines: (i) possible service events at which the service provider can fix the problem of the agricultural working machine; (ii) possible routes for the part runners to deliver the at least one part from central storage; (iii) the part runner, from a plurality of available part runners, to deliver the part; (iv) the service vehicle, from a plurality of available service vehicles, to provide the service; and (v) the at least one part, from a plurality of parts usable for the service.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Control method of automobile self-service equipment and self-service equipment
depositantes: SHANGHAI XINGXIAN NETWORK TECH CO LTD
resumo: The application relates to a control method of automobile self-service equipment and self-service equipment, which are characterized in that an automobile technician management library and a maintenance item library are established, the professional direction of an automobile technician, a scheduling task and maintenance items which can be provided by an automobile service place are displayed to an automobile owner for the automobile owner to select, and according to each maintenance record, each maintenance item in a maintenance item table is formed into an influence relation table so as to prompt a user of potential maintenance items of vehicle faults, so that the capability of the automobile owner to cope with vehicle problems and the definition of understanding of the vehicle maintenance items are greatly improved. After receiving and executing a first instruction of calling a first key address of an automobile technician, the user maintenance management folder is established, and then a video library of each station is sequentially called according to an established automobile technician work flow chart, videos of each station are respectively imported into a site video storage subfolder, and at the moment, an automobile owner can call videos of each maintenance stage, so that the automobile owner can clearly know the maintenance process of the automobile.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Electric vehicle charging and discharging dynamic pricing method and system considering incentive mechanism
resumo: The invention discloses an electric vehicle charging and discharging dynamic pricing method and system considering an excitation mechanism, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing an electric vehicle charge-discharge model in a V2G environment and acquiring state information of the electric vehicle charge-discharge model; selecting an appropriate excitation scheme through the Q-network based on the state information; feeding back the subsidy electricity price of the dynamic pricing strategy to the electric car user to obtain a decision result; based on the decision result, carrying out state update to obtain a reward value of the incentive scheme, an updated incentive budget sum and updated state information; the corresponding prize values for other alternative incentive schemes are estimated and the Q network is updated. The system comprises: the system comprises a model construction module, an information acquisition module, a dynamic pricing module, a strategy feedback module, an information updating module and a reward estimation module. By using the method, the power load of the power grid can be balanced to the maximum limit within the limited excitation budget, and the charge and discharge behaviors of different electric vehicles can be regulated and controlled more flexibly. The invention can be widely applied to the technical field of reinforcement learning.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Expressway vehicle formation control and confluence simulation method
resumo: The invention provides a highway vehicle formation control and confluence simulation method, which comprises the following steps: s1, broadcasting information by a ramp vehicle in the ramp running process; s2, the road side unit integrates and broadcasts the position and speed information of the ramp vehicle closest to the junction point of the intersection with the position coordinates of the road side unit; s3, in the simulation program environment, generating a main road vehicle instance according to predefined vehicle formation generation logic; the method comprises the steps of performing vehicle formation control on vehicles which are determined to be in automatic driving formation in advance, adjusting acceleration of a head vehicle through control interval, and forming vehicle formation by following a vehicle by adopting an IDM model; s4, merging the main road vehicle formation with vehicles on the ramp according to the control logic. By controlling the deceleration of the main road vehicle, when the main road vehicle approaches an intersection area, proper adjustment behaviors can be made according to the running condition of the ramp vehicle, so that the fluency and the safety of road traffic are improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Field service low-carbon scheduling optimization method with disturbance management function
depositantes: HANGZHOU DE&E SMART HOME CO LTD | UNIV NANJING AERONAUTICS & ASTRONAUTICS
resumo: The invention relates to a field service low-carbon scheduling optimization method with a disturbance management function, which comprises the following steps: step 1: carrying out interference identification on the change of the customer service requirement; step 2: measuring disturbance of customer service demands, including disturbance measurement of customers of a service scheduling system, disturbance measurement of service center managers and disturbance measurement of environments; step 3: the method comprises the steps of constructing a field service low-carbon scheduling interference management model, namely constructing an objective function which minimizes the initial service time deviation of a client as a primary objective, minimizes the carbon emission deviation as a secondary objective and minimizes the service cost deviation as a field service low-carbon scheduling interference management problem of a third objective, and constructing a corresponding constraint set; step 4: the design of the rule-based variable neighborhood search algorithm for model solving comprises the design of a rule-based variable neighborhood search algorithm solving process and the design of evolution operators including greedy rules, service engineer assignment rules and the like, so that the algorithm searching efficiency is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Long queue hierarchical control model method under multi-virtual head vehicle structure
resumo: The invention discloses a long queue hierarchical control model method under a multi-virtual head car structure, which comprises the following steps that a road side control end collects long queue train running data, the running data is loaded into an optimal virtual head car sequence calculation model, whether a result output by the model meets a genetic algorithm termination condition or not, if the result output meets the genetic algorithm termination condition, the optimal virtual head car sequence is output, if the result output meets the genetic algorithm termination condition, selection operation, cross operation and mutation operation are continuously carried out in sequence, a vehicle queue control model is based on the optimal virtual head car sequence, and speed differences of adjacent sub-queue head cars of a long queue and speed differences of sub-queue following cars and sub-queue head cars are respectively led into a control layer to obtain a sub-queue head car control layer model and a sub-queue following car control layer model. The modeling type has higher recognition degree on the speed change of the head car, can effectively reduce the speed disturbance influence caused by the speed change, and ensures the high efficiency of long-queue running of the automatic driving vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYSTEM FOR PROVIDING PEER TO PEER BASED USED CAR TRADING PLATFORM SERVICE
depositantes: JEONG TAE EUN [KR] | KIM DOO SOON [KR]
resumo: Provided is a system for providing a used car trading platform service based on P2P comprising: a seller terminal that uploads a sale request by uploading vehicle information comprising a vehicle price, an instant trading price, a vehicle history, and a photograph of the used car to be sold; a buyer terminal that transmits a purchase request for the used car after searching for the vehicle information comprising the provided comparative quote, vehicle price, and instant trading price; and a platform service providing server comprising a storage part that maps and stores the seller terminal and vehicle information when uploading the vehicle information in the seller terminal, a blind part that performs de-identification after extracting at least one unique identification code that can identify the used car and the seller among the vehicle information, a transmission part that transmits a purchase request to the seller terminal when uploading a purchase request to purchase the used car of the seller terminal in the buyer terminal, and a brokerage part that brokers a contract between the seller terminal and the buyer terminal when approval for the sale and purchase of the used car is completed between the seller terminal and the buyer terminal. Therefore, the present invention is capable of helping with quick decision making.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Method for reducing online car-hailing order cost-related customer complaints
resumo: The invention discloses a method for reducing customer complaints related to order cost of network about vehicles, which comprises the following specific steps: s1: the driver receives passengers and starts to send driving strokes, the driver side APP continuously monitors yaw events of the navigation route, and reports the residual mileage and duration before yaw when yaw occurs; the LBS continuously accumulates yaw values; s2: the LBS system acquires the last reported residual time T1 and mileage D1, acquires the yaw time T2 and mileage D2, (T2-T1) ×1+ (D2-D1) ×3, and continuously calculates a yaw value; s3: if the accumulated yaw value of the LBS system is larger than the yaw threshold value, an IM instant message and a short message are sent to the user; the driver side is monitored in real time, the navigation yaw event is timely reminded, and the deviation between the settlement price and the estimated price is confirmed or fed back on a guide line, so that user complaints caused by the problem that the estimated price is inconsistent with the actual price are reduced, and the service quality is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Self-adaptive route planning and scheduling elastic public transportation system
resumo: The invention discloses an elastic bus system for self-adaptive route planning and scheduling, and relates to the technical field of elastic bus systems. The bus reservation system comprises a reservation riding module, a vehicle dispatching module, a route adjusting module and a navigation module, wherein the reservation riding module is used for providing a platform for sending a reservation application for passengers with riding demands, the vehicle dispatching module is used for distributing and dispatching vehicles according to passenger information collected by the reservation riding module and dividing the vehicles into buses and special buses, the route adjusting module is used for re-planning driving routes of the vehicles according to the vehicles distributed by the vehicle dispatching module, and the navigation module is used for providing real-time navigation services for bus drivers and passengers according to the route re-planned by the route adjusting module. According to the invention, the vehicle scheduling module is arranged, so that the buses and special vehicles are combined, passengers carrying passenger capacity are promoted, the receiving and delivering service is more flexible, and the station is combined with the street lamp by arranging the line adjusting module, so that the line planning is more flexible, the street lamp can be used as a roadside sign, and the street lamp is convenient to distinguish.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Image or video data processing method
resumo: The invention relates to the technical fields of Internet information and Internet of things, and discloses an image or video data processing method, which comprises the following steps: step one, designing a system architecture: designing a maintenance system and a settlement system, and simultaneously installing display screens accessed to the maintenance system and the settlement system in a store; step two, using VLPR for vehicle identification technology, automatically identifying vehicle information when a vehicle enters the field, and associating the vehicle information with a maintenance system to establish a vehicle maintenance file; thirdly, after the identification information of the vehicle is input into the maintenance system, the maintenance system projects the identification information to a display screen in real time to disclose the maintenance progress; step four, sending maintenance progress updating and settlement information to the client in a short message and APP client login mode; step five, combining a maintenance system and a settlement system: the cost details generated during the maintenance process are directly linked to the accounting system.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Intelligent network connection fleet compiling and decoding and data management method, device, visual platform and system
resumo: The invention discloses an intelligent network linkage vehicle team compiling and data management method, equipment, a visual platform and a system. The intelligent network fleet full life cycle comprises fleet generation, fleet operation and fleet transformation and decomposition processes. In an intelligent networking environment, in order to manage and monitor the whole flow, vehicle and fleet data are required to be collected, operated and interacted with information, and a fleet data system management and control technology is provided based on the intelligent networking environment; secondly, for the processes of different stages, stage conversion and the like of vehicles and motorcades in the whole life cycle, a motorcade conversion control application management system aiming at each stage and stage conversion process is provided; then, defining the application flow and specification of the fleet data management and the fleet control management by an implementation example; finally, an in-vehicle apparatus, a device, and a roadside device basic unit required for realizing the above-described functions of the fleet system are proposed.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Method for improving online car-hailing order price estimation accuracy
resumo: The invention discloses a method for improving the price estimation accuracy of a network taxi order, which comprises the following steps of S1: after a user selects a get-on/off address, a passenger side APP sends a prediction request, and an LBS returns three groups of predicted mileage, predicted duration, high-speed charge and routeID to a charging system through a prediction interface to calculate a predicted price; s2: the LBS system returns labels, estimated mileage, estimated duration, real-time road conditions and route tracks of the three routes to the proxy layer; the LBS system informs the passenger end of the route with the lowest estimated price so as to allow the passenger end to select by default; s3: according to the estimated price returned by the charging system, returning the estimated price to the passenger end from low to high through the route ID, the track returned by the LBS system and the road condition for displaying; according to the invention, the user selects the route before ordering according to own habits, the network taxi platform predicts the price according to the actual running route, the accuracy of the predicted price is improved, and the user complaint caused by the problem that the predicted price is inconsistent with the actual price is reduced.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: TRAVEL PLANNING DEVICE AND TRAVEL PLANNING SYSTEM
resumo: The present disclosure relates to a travel planning apparatus. A travel planning apparatus according to the present disclosure is a travel planning apparatus that changes a travel plan of a vehicle, the travel planning apparatus including: a travel plan changing unit that changes the travel plan based on at least one of people flow information that is information on people flow, popular spot information that is information on popular spots, real estate information that is information on real estate, facility-related information that is information on facilities, road information that is information on roads, or roadside apparatus installation information that is information on installed roadside apparatus, in an area where the vehicle travels; and a travel plan output unit that outputs a changed travel plan, in which the people flow information includes information on people flow according to the number of people using a commercial facility or a tourist spot.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Method for reducing terminal point modification frequency of online car-hailing platform user
resumo: The invention discloses a method for reducing the frequency of modifying an end point by a network taxi-taking platform user, which comprises the following steps of S1: the passenger side APP user orders, the user adds a plurality of passing points according to own requirements, requests the LBS system to respectively acquire longitude and latitude coordinates and names of the passing points, and then inputs destination points: s2: the passenger side APP carries the coordinates of a plurality of passing points, requests the charging system to perform segmented multiple prediction, and then calculates the total predicted amount; s3: the agent layer system combines the order placing parameter information to request the order management system, contains all order public information, and simultaneously requests the order system after assembling parameters of order passing point information and pre-estimated information; according to the method designed by the invention, through setting the corresponding passing point when the network taxi-taking platform user places a list, setting the passing point 1, the passing point 2, the end point and the like according to the order of the following route, the end point is prevented from being modified for many times in the journey, the frequency of modifying the end point is reduced, and the experience is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Method for dynamically recommending purchase preferences on online car-hailing platform
resumo: The invention discloses a method for dynamically recommending purchasing offers by a network taxi platform, which comprises the following steps of S1: firstly, configuring a strategy tool management system to conduct configuration related to recommended purchase preference types; s2: the passenger side APP enables a user to select a get-on/off address and time information to enter a page displaying a pre-valuation, and the agent layer system assembly request policy tool management system recommends a purchase offer interface and a charging system cost forecast interface; s3: the agent layer system calculates the amount of the vehicle type which is currently selected by the user and can be preferential according to the recommended purchase preferential interface of the policy tool management system and the charging system cost prediction data, and the recommended purchase preferential type of the maximum preferential amount is returned to the passenger side; the online booking platform dynamically recommends purchasing offers aiming at the current user journey, so that a user can quickly know the offers suitable for the user, user experience is improved, further, re-purchasing is improved, and further, the online booking platform flows.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Method for improving ordering efficiency of online car-hailing platform
resumo: The invention discloses a method for improving the ordering efficiency of a network taxi-taking platform, which comprises the following steps: step one: predicting a get-off address according to the current vehicle information of the user and the history order record; step two: the passenger side APP user orders, and the user selects according to own requirements; step three: the passenger APP carries the taxi taking information of the user, assembles the parameters through the proxy layer system and requests the destination prediction system to predict the destination, requests the order management system to acquire the type of the vehicle selected by the user in the last time in the city, and requests the charging system to acquire the pre-valuation; step four: the agent layer system returns the information acquired through the request to the passenger side APP to show the one-key ordering card to the user; the beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the problem of complex single-flow multi-flow under the commute scene of the network taxi-taking platform is solved; the network vehicle-booking platform can recommend a common vehicle type of a common destination to a user on a first page to order by one key, so that ordering efficiency is improved, and further, conversion rate is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Second-hand vehicle estimation value prediction method, device and equipment and storage medium
depositantes: SHANGHAI ZHONGDIAO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses a secondary vehicle estimation prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium, relates to the technical field of secondary vehicle price prediction, and can solve the problems that in the prior art, the predicted future secondary vehicle price mainly depends on manual experience assessment, the assessment result is unstable and the efficiency is low. The specific technical scheme is as follows: firstly, acquiring target second hand cart data and corresponding target prices in each preset period; then converting the target price into a standard price according to the influence coefficient of each preset train and the target second-hand car data; obtaining the estimated price of each period of target vehicle model under the standard vehicle age according to the standard price by using a regression model; finally, fitting the estimated price and corresponding time information of each period target vehicle type according to a time sequence model; if the fitting is successful, a prediction estimated value is obtained, and the target vehicle type is determined to be the first vehicle type. The method is used for predicting the future price of the second-hand vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Second-hand car price evaluation method and device
depositantes: SHANGHAI ZHONGDIAO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating the price of a second-hand vehicle, relates to the technical field of big data analysis and application, and can solve the problems that the price of the second-hand vehicle in the prior art mainly depends on manual experience evaluation, the evaluation result is unstable and the efficiency is low. The specific technical scheme is as follows: firstly, acquiring target second-hand vehicle data and corresponding target price, wherein the target second-hand vehicle data comprises at least one of vehicle condition information, color information, mileage information, regional information, household number information and use property information; then converting the target price into a first standard price according to a first influence coefficient of each preset train and target second-hand car data; calculating estimated prices corresponding to the target prices according to the first standard prices and the first influence coefficients; and finally, carrying out dynamic iteration on the estimated price, and outputting a second-hand vehicle price evaluation model when a preset dynamic planning target is reached. The method is used for evaluating the price of the second-hand vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Automobile aftermarket vat oil construction digitization method
depositantes: NANJING AIFULU AUTOMOBILE TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention relates to the technical field of Internet, and discloses a method for digitizing large barrel oil construction in the automobile after-market, which has the technical scheme that the key points are that a mapping relation between maintenance work order basic data and equipment is established in maintenance factory management software; selecting an item to be made by a work order, and judging whether mapping relations exist between a maintenance store and a vat oil filling device, between material codes selected in the work order and oil brands filled by the vat oil; after receiving the data, the large barrel oil equipment suppliers select corresponding vehicles according to license plate numbers and start to fill engine oil; after the construction is finished, printing a settlement bill for a customer to carry out cashing operation; according to the actual oil filling amount of the engine oil filling equipment, the use amount of materials added in a maintenance work order is automatically updated, the total price is updated, the engine oil is automatically delivered out of the warehouse, the operation steps of a maintenance factory on a digital system are simplified, the labor cost is saved, and the flow efficiency is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Mobile vehicle-road cooperation roadside equipment and scheduling method thereof
resumo: The invention discloses a mobile vehicle-road cooperation road side device and a scheduling method thereof, wherein the mobile vehicle-road cooperation road side device comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle for transmitting traffic flow information and self state information to a scheduling cloud platform; the scheduling cloud platform periodically receives the state information and traffic flow information of all unmanned aerial vehicles, records the current moment and generates an unmanned aerial vehicle information total set; and generating a scheduling instruction of the task according to the intersection position and traffic flow information of the corresponding intersection, screening the unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain an unmanned aerial vehicle executing the task according to the unmanned aerial vehicle information aggregate, and issuing the scheduling instruction to the corresponding unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the corresponding unmanned aerial vehicle moves to the task position and performs information interaction with vehicles in a communication coverage range of the unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the intelligent road side intelligent system, the unmanned aerial vehicle temporarily serves as the intelligent road side infrastructure of the intersection without the traffic signal lamp, and the intelligent vehicle-road cooperation road side intelligent system is more conveniently, efficiently and cheaply improved through control of the dispatching cloud platform.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Method for optimizing process steps of manufacturing, repair or maintenance process of motor vehicle
resumo: The invention relates to a method for optimizing process steps of a manufacturing, repair or maintenance process of a motor vehicle (80), which can be carried out by means of a running device (2), comprising the following steps: detecting (100) data for determining a current position of the operating device (2) by means of the sensor unit (20); detecting (200) data for determining a current position of the motor vehicle (80) by means of the sensor unit (20); determining (300) a current location of the operating device (2) and of the motor vehicle (80) by means of the processing unit (22); and giving (400) permission for performing the process steps by means of the control unit (24) on the basis of the determination (300) of the current location of the operating device (2) and of the motor vehicle (80).
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR AUTONOMOUS DELIVERY ROBOT-BASED DELIVERY SERVICE
depositantes: ELECTRONICS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS RES INST [KR] | ELECTRONICS AND TELECOMMUNICATIONS RESEARCH INST [KR]
resumo: A method and apparatus for an autonomous delivery robot-based delivery service are disclosed. An operating method of a delivery robot includes moving to a pick-up location through autonomous driving based on delivery information generated by a delivery robot service provider, loading goods at the pick-up location, delivering the goods to a delivery location through autonomous driving based on the delivery information, and sharing a current location of the delivery robot and a loading status of the goods with the delivery robot service provider.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Customer-customized service provision system through linkage between vehicle maintenance companies and other companies
depositantes: LEE CHANG EON [KR] | JUNG GWANG MYEON [KR]
resumo:
본 발명에 따른 고객 맞춤형 정비 서비스 제공장치 시스템은 정비 대상 차량의 정비를 요청을 정비 요청 데이터를 전송하는 사용자 단말; 렌터카 배정을 관리하는 렌터카 관리서버; 픽업 서비스를 제공하는 담당자를 관리하는 픽업서비스 제공서버; 및 상기 정비 요청 데이터를 접수하여 상기 정비 대상 차량에 대한 정비 스케쥴을 관리하고, 상기 렌터카 관리서버를 통하여 렌터카를 배정받고 상기 배정된 렌터카와 상기 정비 대상 차량의 대차를 위한 픽업서비스를 위한 담당자를 상기 픽업서비스 제공서버로부터 배정받는 정비서비스 제공서버;를 포함하고, 
상기 사용자 단말은, 사용자 단말에 대응하는 사용자에 대한 개인정보 및 차량정보를 등록하고 정비 서비스 신청을 상기 서비스 제공 서버에 전달하는 사용자 인증 모듈; 정비관련 이상 증상에 대하여 설명하는 텍스트 데이터, 사진, 오디오 데이터 및 동영상 데이터 중 적어도 어느 하나를 포함하는 정비관련 데이터를 입력받아 정비 서비스 제공서버로 전송하는 정비관련 데이터 전송 모듈; 및 정비 서비스 제공서버로부터 수리 내역, 수리 시간, 수리 견적을 포함하는 예상 수리 내역을 전달받아 상기 예상 수리 내역에 대한 승인여부를 사용자로부터 입력받고, 렌터카 및 픽업 서비스 매칭에 필요한 기본 요청사항을 입력하고, 렌터카 및 픽업 서비스 매칭에 따른 스케쥴에 대하여 승인여부를 입력하는 정비 스케쥴 관리 모듈;을 포함하고, 
상기 정비서비스 제공서버는, 상기 사용자 단말로부터 전송된 정비관련 데이터를 분석하여 정비 전 예상되는 정비 원인을 적어도 하나 이상 도출하고, 도출된 정비 원인에 대한 확률을 산출하여 정비 원인에 따른 수리 내역, 예상 수리 시간, 예상 수리 견적에 대한 수리내역 예정안을 도출하는 유형분석 모듈; 및 상기 수리내역 예정안을 상기 사용자 단말에 송부하고, 상기 사용자 단말로부터 상기 수리내역 예정안에 대한 승인을 얻어 상기 정비 대상 차량에 대한 작업 지시서를 발급하는 진행관리 모듈;을 포함하고, 
상기 픽업 서비스 제공서버는, 픽업 서비스를 제공하는 담당자의 픽업서비스 제공 단말기로부터 픽업 서비스와 직접 관련된 경로 외의 경로 추가 신청을 접수 받고, 접수된 경로 추가 신청을 직접 승인 및 사용자 단말(100)을 통한 승인 중 어느 하나의 승인을 얻어 상기 픽업서비스 제공 단말기로 회신한다.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Video based determination system for selling price of used car
resumo: Provided is a video-based system for determining selling price of a used vehicle comprising: a vehicle identification number input unit for receiving a vehicle identification number of a used vehicle that a seller intends to sell; a listing search unit for searching for used vehicle listings of the same vehicle type as the used vehicle corresponding to the vehicle identification number input through the vehicle identification number input unit; a vehicle video display unit for displaying vehicle videos for used vehicle listings; and a video-based selling price determination unit for determining a video-based selling price of the used vehicle corresponding to the vehicle identification number based on the vehicle videos displayed by the vehicle video display unit. According to the present invention, the used vehicle seller determines the selling price of the used vehicle by searching for the used vehicle under a similar condition to the used vehicle that the used vehicle seller wants to sell. Therefore, the used vehicle seller determines the selling price of the used vehicle. Accordingly, the used vehicle seller registers the used vehicle in a used vehicle trading system and sells the used vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: INFORMATION PROCESSING DEVICE, INFORMATION PROCESSING METHOD, AND A NON-TRANSITORY STORAGE MEDIUM
resumo: A controller is configured to acquire a scheduled visit period in which a user is scheduled to visit a facility at which the user is able to have a vehicle maintained. The controller is configured to determine whether a specific item is present among a plurality of maintenance items for the vehicle. The specific item is a maintenance item for which a recommended period in which it is recommended to have the vehicle maintained is included within a predetermined period that includes the scheduled visit period. The recommended period is a period that does not overlap the scheduled visit period. The controller is configured to: acquire item information about a maintenance content of the specific item when the specific item is present; and determine, based on the item information, whether maintenance corresponding to the specific item is to be performed in the scheduled visit period or in the recommended period.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: AI Integrated vehicle maintenance management system for providing vehicle maintenance estimates and AI recommendation service of maintenance items
resumo: The present invention relates to a vehicle-maintenance integrated management system that provides an estimate-cost for the maintenance (inspection) of specific parts of a specific maintenance company, based on a request of a client; simultaneously recommends maintenance items and parts for vehicles under the same conditions as a relevant vehicle by utilizing AI; maximizes the convenience and reliability of a maintenance service by allowing a driver to accurately recognize maintenance quotation in advance; and effectively prevents accidents in advance by recommending the inspection of the maintenance items in a vehicle of the same condition to the driver.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Method and system for GNSS tolling with dynamic toll adjustment using in-vehicle data
resumo: A method for dynamically managing toll charges in a vehicle toll management system, comprises receiving, by a toll managed services server (TMSS), a first message from a vehicle with location data indicating the vehicle has entered into a toll area associated with the TMSS. The TMSS calculates a toll charge for the vehicle to use the toll area based on the location data in the first message. The TMSS also receives one or more second messages from the vehicle with toll-related data collected by the vehicle while operating in the toll area, from the vehicle accessing one or more in-vehicle sensors and an in-vehicle data storage device. The TMSS transmits a third message to the vehicle with the toll charge for viewing by an operator of the vehicle. The toll charge can also depend upon the toll-related data in the second message. The entrance of the vehicle into the toll area can be determined through the use of a geofence. The vehicle may have a location sensor such as a GPS receiver. A toll charging authority may replace the TMSS. The vehicle sensors and data may relate to the number of passengers, vehicle towing status, axle count, vehicle weight, etc..
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR VERIFYING THE SUITABILITY OF A BILL FOR PARTS
resumo: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a method for verifying the validity of a parts billing statement submitted to an insurance company. A system for verifying the parts price of a parts billing statement includes: a verification server that creates one or more virtual servers; a load balancer for distributing traffic based on the load; a queue for sequentially transmitting vehicle information and parts information from the virtual server to the external service server; a worker for receiving the vehicle information and parts information from the queue and transmitting it to the external service server; and a database for receiving and storing parts information for a vehicle model based on the vehicle identification number or price information for parts requiring repair.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: COMPUTER SOFTWARE, COMPUTER SYSTEM, AND COMPUTER-IMPLEMENTED METHOD FOR PREPARING AN ELECTRONIC DATA PACKAGE AND AN ELECTRONIC DATA PACKAGE PREPARED BY SAME
resumo: Computer software and computer-implemented method for preparing an electronic data package in connection with a damaged vehicle for submission to the vehicle owner's insurance company for settlement of a claim or for use by an Original Equipment Manufacturer to determine compliance with established repair requirements. A computer-readable medium for storing executable software for preparing the package for a damaged vehicle, a computer system including the executable computer software stored in the computer-readable medium for preparing the package for a damaged vehicle damage are also disclosed. An electronic date package for vehicle damage repair is prepared by the computer-implemented method by executing the computer software stored in the computer-readable medium of a computer system.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: USED CAR TRANSACTION BROKER SYSTEM AND METHOD THEREOF
depositantes: HYUNDAI MOTOR CO LTD [KR] | KIA CORP [KR]
resumo: The present invention relates to a used car transaction brokerage system capable of presenting the best transaction to both a seller and a buyer, and a method thereof. The used car transaction brokerage apparatus comprises: a storage unit for storing a table in which a purchase price for each characteristic information of a vehicle is recorded; and a control unit for receiving unique information of a used car, an appearance photograph, and location information from a seller terminal, and obtaining characteristic information of the used car, and obtaining a market price of the used car, and obtaining a maintenance estimate price, and determining an appropriate price of the used car, and transmitting the appropriate price of the used car to the seller terminal, and searching for the purchase price of the used car in the table, and transmitting the purchase price of the used car to the seller terminal, and transmitting the characteristic information and the appearance photograph of the used car to a plurality of purchaser terminals located within a preset distance from the location of the used car when a comparison estimate is requested from the seller terminal, and transmitting the estimate price received from the plurality of purchaser terminals to the seller terminal.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Auto Market Rep
resumo: The Auto Market Rep/My Car App provides a unique solution to the problem of finding reliable and affordable auto service vendors. With the ability to add vehicles and track maintenance needs, consumers can quickly and easily submit service requests to a wide range of vendors with a variety of specialties, including auto repair, auto body, tires, glass, electric, towing, upholstery, and more. The app's special algorithm matches consumers with the most suitable vendors, saving them time and money. The app also offers the ability for vendors to bid on jobs and for consumers to compare quotes, ensuring they receive the best service at the best price. The Auto Market Rep/My Car App is a game-changer for the auto service industry, providing a convenient and efficient way for consumers to manage their auto service needs.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Oficinas e Manutenção (C2))

titulo: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR VERIFYING THE SUITABILITY OF PARTS IN A COMPONENT BILLING STATEMENT
resumo: The present invention relates to a system for verifying component consistency in a component payment invoice. The system comprises: a verification server which receives information of the component payment invoice from an insurance company server operated by an insurance company, and transmits vehicle information and information of components requiring repair to an external service server based on the information of the component payment invoice; and the external service server which transmits the component consistency and component price information to a storage as a response to the vehicle information and the component information requiring repair. The component consistency includes component information according to a vehicle model included in the information of the component payment invoice. According to an embodiment of the present specification, it is possible to verify whether the parts of the component payment invoice filed with the insurance company are matched.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Method and system for providing all-in-one service related to automobiles
resumo: The present invention relates to a method for providing an all-in-one service related to a vehicle and a system thereof and, more specifically, to a method for providing an all-in-one service related to a vehicle and a system thereof, which integrate and provide all services related to a vehicle including necessary parts transactions related to a vehicle, inquiries related to failure diagnosis, estimates of various maintenance, car washing, and gloss to easily and quickly proceed transactions and estimates between a business operator (company) and a user or between a user and a user, or between a business operator and a business operator through one platform.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: ROUTE DETERMINATION APPARATUS, ROUTE DETERMINATION METHOD, AND TOWING VEHICLE
resumo: A route determination apparatus capable of determining a route of a vehicle or a towed vehicle based on whether or not the vehicle is equipped with a power feeding port is provided. A route determination apparatus includes: an acquisition unit configured to acquire information about presence/absence of a power feeding port of a first vehicle including a power feeding port and that of a second vehicle including no power feeding port; a route determination unit configured to determine a route along which the first vehicle or the second vehicle travels by itself or is towed based on the information; and an instruction unit configured to provide an instruction to the first and second vehicles. The route of the first vehicle includes a power feeding apparatus on the route.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: INFORMATION PROCESSING APPARATUS
resumo: In an information processing apparatus, a controller receives input of an information including a type of a vehicle desired by a user, an options desired by the user, and a payment terms for acquiring the right to use the vehicle. In response to the receiving input of the information including the type of the vehicle desired by the user, the options desired by the user, and the payment terms for the fees to acquire the right to use the vehicle, the controller outputs an information comparing the payment amounts including maintenance fees for plurality of payment methods.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: VEHICLE PRICE DETERMINATION SUPPORT SYSTEM AND VEHICLE PRICE DETERMINATION SUPPORT METHOD
resumo: To provide a vehicle price determination support system and a vehicle price determination support method capable of supporting appropriate situation grasping and price determination of a used car even when various factors affecting a purchase price and a sales price of the used car are complicatedly entangled.SOLUTION: A vehicle price determination support system: acquires a reference distribution showing deviation values of successful bid prices based on data of the successful bid prices in auction of used cars matching predetermined vehicle features; acquires actual purchase prices of the used cars and actual sales prices of the used cars in all sales bases including a plurality of sales bases of the used cars; calculates a whole distribution that represents distributions of the deviation values of the purchase prices and the sales prices in the all sales bases based on the reference distribution; acquires actual sales prices of the used cars and actual purchase prices of the used car in specific sales bases included in the all sales bases; calculates an individual distribution that represents distributions of deviation values of the purchase prices and the sales prices in the specific sales bases based on the reference distribution; and shows at least one of the whole distribution and the individual distribution.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR INTERWORKING BETWEEN AUTONOMOUS DRIVING DELIVERY ROBOT AND TRANSPORTATION INFRASTRUCTURE
resumo: A method and apparatus for interworking between an autonomous delivery robot and a transportation infrastructure are disclosed. A method of operating a delivery robot service provider that manages a delivery robot, the method may include: generating delivery information in response to a delivery request from a user; assigning a delivery robot that is to perform the delivery request; transmitting the delivery information to the delivery robot; checking whether the delivery robot arrives at a transportation infrastructure located on a delivery route based on delivery status information transmitted from the delivery robot; and transmitting signal request information associated with the transportation infrastructure to a traffic information service provider that manages the transportation infrastructure to allow the delivery robot to use the transportation infrastructure.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: METHOD OF COORDINATING PRIORITIES AMONG MULTIPLE AUTONOMOUS DRIVING ROBOTS AND APPARATUS PERFORMING THE SAME
resumo: Disclosed are a method and device for coordinating a priority between a plurality of autonomous driving robots. An operating method of a first delivery robot service provider managing a first delivery robot includes: in response to the first delivery robot encountering a second delivery robot at an infrastructure used jointly, obtaining an identifier of the second delivery robot; obtaining information of a second delivery robot service provider managing the second delivery robot based on the identifier of the second delivery robot; and negotiating a priority for using the infrastructure between the first delivery robot and the second delivery robot based on the information of the second delivery robot service provider.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR CALCULATING ACCIDENT VEHICLE REPAIR COST ESTIMATES
depositantes: SAMSUNG FIRE & MARINE INSURANCE CO LTD [KR]
resumo: The present disclosure relates to a method and system for providing by calculating an appropriate repair cost estimation of a vehicle thereof when an accident occurs in the vehicle, which is a target of automobile property insurance, that may: extract, from a database, one or more pairs of an official billing document and a component billing document matching vehicle information and damage types inputted from a customer terminal; remove again a pair of billing documents using an unauthorized component from each pair of billing documents from which the billing document has been primarily removed after removing a pair of billing documents comprising an abnormal official billing or the price of an abnormal component from each extracted pair of billing documents; and extract, as a representative estimation document, one official billing document and one component billing document from the remaining pair of billing documents from which the first and second billing documents have been removed and provide to the customer terminal.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Orçamentação e Custos (C3))

titulo: CHARGING SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR ELECTRIC VEHICLE
depositantes: HYUNDAI MOTOR CO LTD [KR] | KIA CORP [KR] | HCHARGELAB INC [KR]
resumo: According to one aspect of the present invention, an electric vehicle charging system may include: a host terminal in which a host application for receiving an instruction for an operation mode of a shared charger and an additional fee for use of the shared charger is installed; and a charging service provider server for calculating a charger use fee based on a shared charging fee obtained by adding a predetermined basic fee to the additional fee provided from the host terminal and a usage time of the shared charger by a user. The charging service provider server may receive, from the user terminal of the user, a share change request for requesting to change an operation mode of the shared charger to a share mode available to the user, and transmit the share change request to the host terminal.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR DETECTING ACCIDENTAL SERVICE BUTTON KEYPRESS
resumo: A computer-implemented method that, when executed by data processing hardware, causes data processing hardware to perform operations comprising receiving a service request associated with a service request button of a vehicle, receiving one or more service button engagement scoring inputs each associated with a corresponding vehicle status, calculating a service request confidence score based on the one or more service button engagement scoring inputs, assigning a service request cancellation period based on the one or more service button engagement scoring inputs, determining whether a cancellation request is received within the service request cancellation period, and either cancelling the service request when the cancellation request is received within the service request cancellation period, or transmitting the service request to a service provider when the cancellation request is not received within the service request cancellation period.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: RECOMMENDATION SYSYEM AND METHOD FOR VEHICLE MAINTENANCE RESERVATIONS
depositantes: HYUNDAI MOTOR CO LTD [KR] | KIA CORP [KR]
resumo: A recommendation system for a vehicle maintenance reservation includes a reservation sentence acquisition module configured to obtain a reservation current state sentence indicating a current state of a vehicle to be serviced from consultation data provided in a form of a human language; a repair order sentence acquisition module configured to obtain a repair order current state sentence indicating the current state of the vehicle being serviced from data written in a repair order; a first correct answer set generating module configured to generate a first correct answer set using the reservation current state sentence and the repair order current state sentence; and a maintenance work recommendation module configured to recommend a task for vehicle maintenance based on a user's language obtained through reservation consultation, using a first model trained with the first correct answer set.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: RENTAL CAR PRICE DETERMINATION SYSTEM
resumo: The present invention relates to a rental car price determination system and, more specifically, to a rental car price determination system in which: a rental car use rate is predicted by analyzing a correlation between a use rate of rental cars and a reservation rate of accommodations in a tourist destination, and a rental car price is determined according to the predicted use rate, so that it is possible to determine a reasonable rental car price; and the rental car price is adjusted and provided in accordance with a rental car use state, a driving habit of a rental car reservation holder, a price change degree of nearby rental car companies, and whether a system-linked tourism product, etc. is purchased, so that the rationality of the rental car price can be increased.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: MACHINE LEARNING-BASED DAMAGE ESTIMATE AND REPAIR ENTITY EVALUATIONS
depositantes: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO [US]
resumo: Techniques described herein relate to training, deploying, and executing machine learning models to evaluate damage estimates received from repair entities. In various examples, machine learning models may be trained based on damage estimate data, associated vehicle damage data, vehicle specifications, and repair entity attributes. Trained estimate evaluation models may be used to predict damage estimate repair costs, parts and services lists, etc., and/or to score damage estimates for accuracy and competitiveness, and the like. Damage estimate scores can be based on and/or used to determine the accuracy and competitiveness scores for the repair entities that generated the estimates. Estimate evaluation systems may use damage estimate scores and/or entity scores to automatically initiate damage repairs, identify errors/inconsistencies within estimates and request updated versions, and/or identify outlier estimates for additional downstream analysis.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: AI Real-time vehicle diagnostic and real-time notification device through AI-based vehicle multi- scanner
resumo: Disclosed is a real-time vehicle diagnosis and notification device using an ai-based vehicle multi-scanner. It collects electronic device data and the vehicles data collecting part stores. It is connected to the mobile app and the bluetooth inter-working unit transmits data. The mobile app receives a message car data. The state analysis part analyzes the error code. It is based on in the error code and the ai model offers the diagnosis result, the proper repair cost and interpretation information. The alarm part consigns the mobile notification in the error occurrence on a real time basis. The present invention collects and analyzes vehicle electronic device data with an ai-based multiscanner, and provides an error code and appropriate repair cost as a real-time mobile notification to increase consumer information accessibility and maintenance reliability.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: ONLINE SERVICE BOOKING AND PRODUCT ORDERING PLATFORM
depositantes: ABRIL, Sarah Mae B; SALVALEON, Kim Carlo C
resumo: The present invention for repair service booking and product ordering is a comprehensive platform specifically designed to ease the process of booking repair services and ordering replacement parts or products through a singular interface. It is consisting of interconnected components that includes a communication link, user terminal, admin terminal, client-side framework, server-side framework, content management system, mapping and location software, database server, email client terminal, and an email server. The user terminal is powered by client-side framework allowing users to conveniently search and book services, order products, monitor transactions, communicate with product seller and service providers, and make payments online. The present invention offers various modules within customer, service provider, and product seller accounts, catering to specific needs including scheduling, booking, shopping, payment processing, among others. The present invention provides a streamlined product ordering and repair booking process, minimizing errors, and maximizing productivity for service providers, product sellers and customers.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Incluída em CI/CE (N=96), mas reprovada em QQ (< 3,5)

titulo: VEHICLE REPAIR COST AUTO ESTIMATION AND SERVICE SYSTEM
depositantes: Savitha N J; Jyothi N M; CMR INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, BENGALURU
resumo: Road accidents are the most dangerous situations people deal with on a daily basis. Minor accidentsmerely cause physical damage to vehicles alone and require only a financial settlement between thetwo parties involved in the accident. Most often, during such a situation, neither the party whocaused the accident nor the party whose vehicle got damaged will be aware of the amount needed torepair or replace the damaged part or parts of their vehicles. The two parties will get into a heatedargument if one claims an unreasonable amount for the damage caused, further resulting in variousinconveniences to the public, like traffic jams, manhandling, abusing, and hurting. To estimate thecorrect amount needed to repair the damaged parts, both parties must invest their time to consult theconcerned authority. Due to the busy life schedule, both parties will need more time to spare.This invention relates to a feature wherein, during the time of the accident resulting in vehiculardamages, the cost of repair or replacement can be estimated by taking images of the damaged partsof the vehicle from a mobile phone and using the; mobile application that will estimate the cost ofrepair or replacement from the images fed into the hppIi'cation, thus giving an amicable solution toboth parties. Apart from this, the mobile application can be used to connect to the nearest vehiclerepair and service provider and get the service and repair done.This field of invention correSponds to a mobile application that can estimate the cost of repair orreplacement of damaged part or parts of the vehicle during the time of accidents that results invehicular damage. It also connects to the nearest vehicle repair and service provider.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Orçamentação e Custos (C3))

titulo: MOBILE APPLICATION-BASED BICYCLE REPAIR, WARRANTY CLAIM PROCESSING, RECALL NOTIFICATION, AND TRIP ANALYSIS
resumo: Methods of supporting mobile application-based bicycle repair, warranty claim processing, and trip analysis include storing a bicycle serial number in association with a user identifier identifying a user of a mobile application and receiving bicycle trip data from a mobile communication device having the mobile application installed thereon, the bicycle trip data derived by the mobile application based at least in part on sensor data collected from one or more sensors disposed on a bicycle. The bicycle trip data may be associated with the bicycle serial number based on the association between the bicycle serial number and the user identifier identifying the user of the mobile application. The bicycle trip data may, for example, be provided to a bicycle repair service provider capable of deriving bicycle repair service information therefrom, which may be provided to the mobile communication device and displayable by the mobile application.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Supplemental service recommendation system
resumo: A supplemental service recommendation system that enables roadside assistance via crowdsourcing. Registered members store their data in the cloud-based server, facilitating efficient assistance requests for clients, providers, and participating shops via a software program such as an app. Geographical correlation and algorithmic analysis of the database ensure seamless matching for the most suitable assistance service. Users can track the approaching service provider in real-time. The system incorporates a secure payment method, enabling users to make direct payments within the platform. With enhanced data utilization and convenient payment options, this system optimizes roadside assistance, fostering a reliable and swift user experience.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Socorro e Reboque (C1))

titulo: Location sharing application in association with services provision
resumo: A system for exchanging GPS or other position data between wireless devices for purposes of group activities, child location monitoring, work group coordination, dispatching of employees etc. Cell phones and other wireless devices with GPS receivers have loaded therein a Buddy Watch application and a TalkControl application. The Buddy Watch application communicates with the GPS receiver and other wireless devices operated by buddies registered in the users phone as part of buddy groups or individually. GPS position data and historical GPS position data can be exchanged between cell phones of buddies and instant buddies such as tow truck drivers via a buddy watch server. Emergency monitoring services can be set up with notifications to programmable individuals in case an individual does not respond. Positions and tracks can be displayed. TalkControl simplifies and automates the process of joining talk groups for walkie talkie services such as that provided by Nextel.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Mobile operation method for new installation exploration site of low-voltage user
depositantes: JIANGSU FANGTIAN POWER TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.; 江苏方天电力技术有限公司
resumo: The invention discloses a mobile operation method for a new installation exploration site of a low-voltage user. The method comprises the steps that a power supply service command platform creates a site exploration work order; the marketing system receives an on-site investigation work order; creating a field investigation plan according to the accepted business; according to the field investigation plan, the marketing system pushes a field investigation work order to the mobile operation terminal; and the mobile operation terminal receives the on-site investigation work order from the marketing system. According to the method, the current work order to be supplemented and collected can be checked in real time, the rapid flow of the process is realized, and the method has a very remarkable practical effect on shortening the waiting time of customers, improving the field service efficiency and improving the customer satisfaction.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: A SECURE ARCHITECTURE USING BLOCK CHAIN TECHNOLOGY FOR SHARED ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING
depositantes: Dr. Somasekhar Borugadda; B. Md. Irfan; Praful V. Nandankar; Dr. T V V Pavan Kumar; Mrs. Sujatha Godavarthi; Dr. Madhurikkha.S; Dr. P.N.E. Naveen; Mr. S Jegadeesan; Monisha SM
resumo: A system and method for a secure and decentralized architecture for managing shared electric vehicle (EV) charging using blockchain technology. The system ensures secure and transparent transaction processing, user authentication, and dynamic pricing for charging services through immutable record-keeping. Smart contracts automate billing and energy distribution to enhance operational efficiency and user experience. A custom consensus mechanism ensures decentralized transaction validation, maintaining system integrity. The system integrates predictive maintenance and supports renewable energy sources, promoting sustainability and a peer-to-peer energy transaction model for a robust EV charging infrastructure.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: VEHICLE SELF-INSPECTION APPARATUS AND METHOD
resumo: A system and method for self-inspection of a vehicle is disclosed. The self-inspection may be performed by an application executed on a mobile device, with the application being configured to determine excessive wear and use. The mobile device may obtain images from a plurality of predetermined views of the vehicle, with damage input being determined for the plurality of predetermined views. In turn, a cost estimate may be output for repair or replacement due to the damage for each of the plurality of predetermined views as well as a total cost for repair or replacement, which may be dynamically updated as additional damage is input for the plurality of predetermined views.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Energy support excitation method and system, computer equipment, storage medium and terminal
resumo: The invention belongs to the technical field of network economic information processing, and discloses an energy support excitation method, a system, computer equipment, a storage medium and a terminal, wherein the energy support excitation method utilizes a bilateral auction mechanism in an economic theory to introduce bilateral auction; the quality of data collected by the electric vehicle is used as the basis of electric quantity distribution, social welfare maximization is achieved in the proposed bilateral auction algorithm, and the electric vehicle and roadside nodes are kept to have effectiveness. The social welfare maximization takes multi-path side nodes and multiple electric vehicles as backgrounds and takes the maximum available electric quantity resources and distribution values of the roadside nodes as constraint conditions. The energy supporting stimulation system comprises: a utility function implementation module; a resource allocation amount processing module; and (5) an iterative processing module. The invention solves the problem of electric quantity distribution by using the effective bids given by the two parties. Meanwhile, when an objective function of the auction is designed, the data quality is used as the quotation of both sides, and the data quality provided by the electric vehicle can be ensured.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: COMPUTER-IMPLEMENTED METHOD AND A SYSTEM FOR PROVIDING RECOMMENDATION DATA ASSOCIATED TO A VEHICLE
resumo: A system and to a computer-implemented method of providing recommendation data associated to a vehicle before, when or after it arrives at a predetermined location, the predetermined location being on an assembly line or in a workshop, is provided. A wireless request signal is sent from an off-board transceiver towards. A wireless response signal is trigger by the wireless request signal and is transmitted from an on-board transceiver of the vehicle and received by the off-board receiver. The wireless response signal contains an identification of the vehicle chassis number of the vehicle. A control unit accesses a database and identifies recommendation data associated with the identified vehicle chassis number in said database. The control unit presents the identified recommendation data via a user interface.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: METHOD SERVER AND SYSTEM FOR PROVIDING DIGITAL VEHICLE SALSE PLATFORM WITH DYNAMIC PRICING BASED ON DIGITAL
resumo: 디지털 기반의 동적 가격을 책정하는 차량 판매 플랫폼을 제공하는 방법, 서버 및 시스템이 제공된다. 상기 방법은, 차량 판매 플랫폼을 이용하여 차량 판매를 중개하고자 하는 사용자의 가입 정보를 획득하고, 사용자의 가입 정보를 검증함으로써 사용자를 등록하고, 사용자의 플랫폼에서의 차량 판매를 지원하기 위한 제1 리워드에 관련된 정보를 사용자에게 제공하고, 차량에 대한 구매 요청 정보를 획득하고, 구매 요청 정보에 기초하여, 차량의 구매자 및 구매 조건을 식별하고, 차량의 가격을 포함하는 견적 정보를 생성하되, 차량의 가격은, 구매자에 따라 동적으로 가격이 책정되는 것이며, 구매자의 금융 심사를 위한 구매자 정보를 검증하고, 견적 정보 및 금융 심사 정보를 구매자에게 제공하고, 차량의 구매를 결정하는 구매 결정 응답이 식별됨에 따라, 사용자의 판매 이력을 저장하고, 제2 리워드에 관련된 정보를 사용자에게 제공한다.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Shared vehicle accessory optimization method, system and equipment based on conjugate gradient algorithm and medium
depositantes: SHANGHAI JUNZHENG NETWORK TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for optimizing shared vehicle accessories based on a conjugate gradient algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring and preprocessing warehousing data of shared vehicle accessories; constructing a regression model for predicting the total cost of the vehicle accessories based on the preprocessed storage data of the shared vehicle accessories; optimizing the regression model according to a conjugate gradient algorithm; and selecting core accessories of the shared vehicle and inputting accessory information into the optimized regression model to obtain the optimal value of the total cost of the core accessories of the shared vehicle in the service life and the optimal purchase unit price of the core accessories. According to the invention, a regression model is introduced into the technical scheme of shared vehicle accessory optimization, and is combined with the actual operation condition, so that the optimal balance point is found between the purchasing cost and the operation and maintenance cost, the optimal purchasing accessory cost is provided in a more global angle, meanwhile, the quality of a shared vehicle can be ensured, and the functions of cost control and better user experience are achieved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Accident vehicle loss assessment method and device, computer equipment and readable storage medium
depositantes: CHINA PING AN PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD
resumo: The application relates to the technical field of insurance vehicle loss assessment, and provides a method, a device, computer equipment and a readable storage medium for insurance vehicle loss assessment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a taxi image sent by terminal equipment; determining the accessory type of the damaged accessory of the emergency car and the damage degree information of the damaged accessory according to the emergency car picture; determining the maintenance mode and the maintenance cost of the damaged part according to the part type of the damaged part and the damaged degree information of the damaged part; if the maintenance mode of the damaged part is replacement, determining the remanufacturing benefit of the damaged part according to the part type and the damaged degree information based on a preset remanufacturing rule; determining the damage assessment cost of the damaged part according to the maintenance cost and the remanufacturing benefit; and sending the loss assessment cost to the terminal equipment. The insurance vehicle loss assessment process is automated, and insurance vehicle loss assessment cost is standardized, so that insurance application experience of an insurance vehicle owner is improved. In addition, the application also relates to a blockchain technology, and the emergency car pictures can be stored in the blockchain.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Railway vehicle 360-degree image dynamic comparison algorithm
depositantes: JILIN YUNFAN INTELLIGENT ENG CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses a railway vehicle 360-degree image dynamic comparison algorithm, which comprises an information residence module, a market price judgment module, a depreciation evaluation module and a logistics arrangement module, and is characterized in that: the information residence module is used for storing express transport vehicle information, the market price judgment module is used for evaluating actual value information of the express transport vehicle, the depreciation evaluation module is used for evaluating normal loss value of the express transport vehicle in express transport, the logistics arrangement module is used for confirming information of express stored on the express transport vehicle, the market price judgment module, the depreciation evaluation module and the logistics arrangement module are all connected with the information residence module through a network, and the information residence module comprises an initial value determination module, an express weight placement express module, an express size placement express module and an express position placement express module.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Data processing method, device and equipment based on block chain
resumo: The invention discloses a data processing method, a device and equipment based on a block chain, wherein the method comprises the following steps: building a block chain, wherein at least one piece of automobile data information corresponding to the automobile identification is stored in the block chain; after receiving a maintenance item list comprising a target automobile identifier, matching automobile data information corresponding to the target automobile identifier in the block chain; and generating expense information according to the maintenance item list and the matched automobile data information. The invention can provide the cost information of the automobile maintenance project for the user, and prevent the economic loss of the user.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle valuation method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
resumo: The invention provides a vehicle valuation method, a vehicle valuation device, computer equipment and a storage medium, which are used for acquiring vehicle type information, travel state information, credit information and maintenance information of a vehicle to be valued; obtaining a residual value of the vehicle to be estimated according to the vehicle type information and the travel state information of the vehicle to be estimated; inputting the residual value and the credit information into a preset regression model, and outputting to obtain a risk coefficient of the vehicle to be estimated; determining an initial estimation value of a vehicle to be estimated from a mapping table of a preset risk coefficient and a vehicle estimation value; and obtaining a target estimated value of the vehicle to be estimated through a preset rule based on the conversion coefficient obtained by the maintenance information and the initial estimated value. Based on the vehicle type information, the travel state information, the credit information and the maintenance information of the vehicle, the estimation is carried out, the objectivity and the rationality of the vehicle estimation are improved, and the characteristic factors of the vehicle are input into a corresponding preset model, so that the accuracy of the vehicle estimation is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Integrated intelligent bus use supervision platform
depositantes: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO | STATE GRID SIJI FEITIAN LANZHOU YUNSHU TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses an integrated intelligent bus use supervision platform which comprises a central server, a storage module, a transmission module, a mobile phone terminal and an automobile service terminal, wherein the central server comprises a rule management module, a management module function, an appointment processing module, a supervision module, a vehicle maintenance module and a charging service system, and the central server stores data of the mobile phone terminal and the automobile service terminal through the storage module; the integrated intelligent bus use supervision platform can compare the preset time path with the actual time path, review related personnel when data is in large scale, avoid the condition of private use of buses, carry out data reference for later supervision, and collect facial information of users in the driving process, so that the information matching between the users and the vehicles is ensured, the information inconsistency between the users and the borrowers is avoided, and the charging service system starts a charging program when the fact that the users and the borrowers are not detected.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)
