titulo: Roadside unit deployment and content caching and transmission method based on request probability
resumo: The invention discloses a roadside unit deployment and content caching and transmission method based on request probability, which is based on vehicles on streets, roadside units deployed on streets and content cached in a content library in the roadside units, and based on a target vehicle, a content request is sent out, and the position of the content corresponding to the content request in a target area is cached, so that the transmission distance of the content is minimum by optimizing the caching method of the roadside units, and the caching process of the roadside units on the content is completed. Meanwhile, the content is preferentially selected to be forwarded by the running vehicle, and meanwhile, the roadside parking vehicle caches the content according to the request probability of the content and the distance between the street where the roadside parking vehicle is located and the content request street. And obtaining the shortest transmission path from the content corresponding to the content request to the target vehicle cache. By the technical scheme, the deployment cost of the network is reduced, the cache resources of the network are fully utilized, and the performance of the network is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: USED CAR EVALUATION METHOD AND APPARATUS BASED ON MANUFACTURER'S EXTERNAL PARTS INFORMATION AND INTERNAL PARTS INFORMATION
resumo: One embodiment of the present invention relates to a method and device for evaluating a used car based on exterior component information and interior component information, that can provide evaluation having high accuracy and reliability using information regarding components provided by a manufacturer. The method comprises: a step of obtaining vehicle identification number and mileage of a vehicle; a step of comprising at least one among exterior component information, interior component information, labor information, and painting information; a step of enabling depreciation through different devaluation curves; a step of obtaining data for at least one among the vehicle identification number, the mileage, a transaction date and time, a purchase amount, and a sales amount; a step of calculating a repair estimate; and a step of calculating the residual value.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Second-hand car loss cost determination method and device
depositantes: BEIJING SOUTHWEST WIND INFORMATION TECH CO LTD
resumo: The disclosure provides a used vehicle loss cost determination method and device. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring vehicle-mounted automatic diagnosis system data of a second-hand vehicle; according to preset weight, carrying out weighting processing on data of a target vehicle-mounted automatic diagnosis system to obtain loss indexes of a plurality of components; determining whether each component needs to be replaced; determining a replacement cost of a first component requiring replacement; determining a depreciation cost of the second component that does not require replacement; and determining the loss cost of the second-hand vehicle according to the loss cost and the replacement cost. According to the method and the device, various data of the loss cost can be easily understood by non-professional persons, the loss condition of the second-hand car can be reflected more objectively, a more powerful price certificate is provided for a purchaser, the opacity of information is reduced, the purchaser can know the maintenance condition of the car, and the dependence on the foreign existing model is reduced.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Electric vehicle electric power two-way transaction method and system
depositantes: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY MARKETING SERVICE CENTER | STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO | STATE GRID CORP CHINA
resumo: The embodiment of the invention discloses a bidirectional electric power transaction method for an electric vehicle, which comprises the following steps: acquiring effective charging demand information of a charging EV and effective sealed discharging bidding information of a discharging EV; comparing the effective charging demand information with the effective sealed discharging bidding information, and selecting a winning discharging EV; and charging the charging EV through the winning discharging EV to finish the power transmission transaction. The embodiment of the invention is based on the Etheng intelligent contract technology, breaks through the information barrier between the power supply and demand party, namely the electric automobile and the user, and realizes decentralization, publicity and transparence of power transaction; the auction is carried out by using a dynamic pricing strategy, the uncertainty of the demand response time period and schedulable power of the electric vehicle caused by charging and discharging is fully considered, and the benefit maximization of both the power supply and demand parties is realized.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR PROVIDING VEHICLE REPAIR AND SALES BROKERAGE SERVICE
resumo: A vehicle repair and sales brokerage service providing server may obtain a picture of a user's vehicle from a user terminal. The server may obtain a plurality of repair estimates for the user vehicle from a plurality of repair shop terminals based on the photos of the user vehicle. The server may obtain selected repair estimate information for one of the plurality of repair estimates from the user terminal. The server may generate an expected appearance upon completion of repair of the user's vehicle based on the selected repair estimate information. The server may obtain a plurality of used car dealer terminals, based on the expected appearance, a plurality of used car price estimate information for the user's vehicle. The server may obtain selected middle and high price quotation information for one of the plurality of high and high price quotations from the user terminal. COPYRIGHT KIPO 2023
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Incluída em CI/CE (N=96), mas reprovada em QQ (< 3,5)

titulo: Vehicle loss estimation method and device, storage medium and equipment
resumo: The application discloses a vehicle loss assessment method, a device, a storage medium and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a vehicle damage image obtained by shooting a damaged part of a vehicle; determining estimated maintenance cost of the damaged part based on the vehicle damage image; and displaying the estimated maintenance cost. According to the method, the user is helped to shoot the vehicle damage image, the estimated maintenance cost of the damaged part of the vehicle is determined based on the vehicle damage image, the vehicle is quickly estimated, the time spent by the user in estimating the vehicle damage is saved, and the use experience of the user is effectively improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Electric vehicle charging field station recommendation method, system, equipment and medium
resumo: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for recommending electric vehicle charging stations, which comprises the steps of obtaining electric vehicle charging parameters of all charging stations, calculating the minimum load difference value of the charging stations according to the electric vehicle charging parameters, calculating according to the electric vehicle charging parameters and the minimum load difference value to obtain a scheduling scheme under the condition of minimized cost, conducting electric vehicle charging guidance by using a price sensitivity pricing method according to the scheduling scheme, realizing the minimization of operation and maintenance cost of the charging stations by recommending matched charging stations for vehicles, attracting the vehicles to select the recommended charging stations by using a grid sensitivity pricing method, and realizing the compensation of charging cost of users.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Material cost determination method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
depositantes: CHINA ENERGY RAILWAY EQUIPMENT CO LTD
resumo: The invention belongs to the technical field of railway material management, and particularly relates to a material cost determination method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. A method of material cost determination, comprising: regularly acquiring warehousing data and expenditure material data from a railway material management system and a truck management system; determining a total expenditure material summary table according to the expenditure material data; updating a material library configuration table according to the warehousing data; and determining a material cost data table according to the total expenditure material summary table and the material library configuration table. According to the method, the barrier between the railway material management system and the truck management system is opened, the data are integrated and fused, the problem that the material cost accounting is lack of data support in the railway vehicle overhauling process is solved, and a data basis is provided for realizing accurate cost collection and accounting.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Maintenance cost management system and management method
depositantes: CRRC CHANGCHUN RAILWAY VEHICLES CO LTD
resumo: The invention relates to a maintenance cost management system and a management method, wherein the management system comprises: the maintenance cost model building module is used for calculating the vehicle material and human-hour cost and comparing the vehicle material and human-hour cost with the actual cost of a single vehicle; the single-vehicle actual cost counting module is used for counting the actual cost of the created order based on the actual material cost and the actual labor hour; and the cost comparison module is used for comparing the difference between the theoretical occurrence cost and the actual occurrence cost. According to the maintenance cost management system and the management method, the SMART maintenance management system is combined with the ERP system, the actual material cost and the human-hour cost which are generated in the maintenance production process are counted in real time, the counting dimension and the counting granularity of the traditional cost are deepened, the retrospective management of the cost deviation is realized through the established cost model and the cost comparison function, and a data basis and a management means are provided for the optimization of maintenance business and the upgrading of technology.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle maintenance pricing method and device and storage medium
depositantes: SUOTUO HANGZHOU AUTOMOBILE INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD
resumo: The invention relates to the field of data processing, and discloses a vehicle maintenance pricing method, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining key influence parameter values related to target vehicle maintenance information prediction, wherein the maintenance information comprises a time interval from last maintenance and maintenance cost; predicting subsequent maintenance information of the target vehicle based on key influence parameter values and a pre-trained maintenance information prediction model, and determining subsequent maintenance information values of the target vehicle, wherein the maintenance information prediction model is constructed based on key influence parameters and is obtained by training historical key influence parameter values and historical maintenance information values, and the key influence parameters are obtained by screening based on different-dimension vehicle driving parameters and known vehicle maintenance parameters; and determining the maintenance pricing information of the target vehicle based on the subsequent maintenance information value of the target vehicle. The embodiment can realize differentiated and accurate maintenance pricing of different vehicles.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Car insurance intelligent loss assessment method and system based on computer vision
depositantes: BANGBANG AUTOMOBILE SALES SERVICE BEIJING CO LTD
resumo: The application provides a vehicle insurance intelligent damage assessment method and system based on computer vision, which relate to the technical field of computers, and comprise the following steps: acquiring a damage assessment image and a damage assessment video of a target vehicle according to a claim settlement request corresponding to the target vehicle; inputting the damage assessment image into a vehicle insurance damage assessment model to obtain the vehicle type and the damage assessment part of the target vehicle; inputting the damage assessment video into the vehicle insurance damage assessment model to obtain damage assessment information and damage assessment scores of the target vehicle; obtaining an initial damage assessment strategy and an initial damage assessment amount based on the vehicle type, the damage assessment part and the damage assessment score; and adjusting the initial damage assessment strategy and the initial damage assessment amount based on the maintenance information and the user feedback information of the target vehicle to obtain a target damage assessment strategy and a target damage assessment amount. The method and the device can improve accuracy and efficiency of vehicle damage assessment and claim settlement.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Second-hand car valuation method and device and computer readable storage medium
depositantes: CHONGQING CHANG'AN AUTOMOBILE CO., LTD.; 重庆长安汽车股份有限公司
resumo: The invention relates to a second-hand car valuation method and device and a computer readable storage medium. The second-hand vehicle valuation method comprises the following steps: receiving vehicle identification information of a target vehicle sent by a user terminal; based on the vehicle identification information, obtaining vehicle basic information and vehicle state change information of the target vehicle; obtaining a basic estimated price of the target vehicle based on the vehicle basic information; based on the vehicle state change information, obtaining an influence factor of the target vehicle; the vehicle state change information at least comprises vehicle maintenance information, vehicle insurance information, vehicle accident information and vehicle fault maintenance information; and based on the basic estimated price and the influence factor, determining an estimated value result of the target vehicle. The invention further provides a second-hand car valuation device and a computer readable storage medium. The method solves the problem that an existing second-hand car valuation method is low in valuation accuracy.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Intelligent scheduling method and system for single-point non-signalized intersection based on formation
resumo: The invention relates to a single-point signalless intersection intelligent scheduling method and system based on formation, and belongs to the field of intelligent traffic. The method applies the concept of formation to an intelligent road side scheduling system without a signalized intersection, carries out unified scheduling in a centralized mode by taking formation as a unit, carries out formation and formation control based on a repeated dynamic game algorithm when vehicles enter a specific area of the intersection, only interacts with the intelligent road side scheduling system by a head car in formation, accepts scheduling, carries out conflict judgment and prediction on the formation in all directions through a formation track prediction model, determines a priority order at the same time, carries out speed guidance on the formation through a speed guidance algorithm, resolves conflicts and avoids parking waiting until all vehicles in the formation are released through the intersection. The invention applies the consistency and the high efficiency of the vehicle formation to the non-signalized intersection scheduling, improves the vehicle passing efficiency and the safety, and reduces the communication and calculation consumption.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Distributed power generation and electric vehicle charging transaction method and system
resumo: The invention discloses a distributed power generation and electric vehicle charging transaction method and system based on a block chain, which are used for acquiring a charging demand submitted by an electric vehicle owner and a charging service fee charging standard issued by a charging pile owner; acquiring quotation data of the distributed power generators according to the charging demands, and determining the bid-winning price of the bid-winning distributed power generators by adopting a second low-price bid-winning strategy; acquiring the charging electric quantity of the electric automobile; and after the charging is finished, determining the charging service fee and the charging electric charge of the electric vehicle owner for the current charging according to the charging service fee charging standard, the charging electric quantity and the winning price. The advantages are that: the direct transaction between the owner of the electric automobile and the distributed power generator is realized; integrating the charging piles and distributed power generation resources by means of a block chain technology; exciting the distributed generator commercial offer by taking the second low price as the winning price; the realization fills electric pile resource sharing, improves the utilization ratio that fills electric pile, promotes the nearby consumption of distributed power generation, better reaction electric automobile cost of charging.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: METHOD FOR OUT PUTTING, IN A MOTOR VEHICLE, A NAVIGATION INSTRUCTION TO HEAD TOWARD A POSSIBLE STOPPING POINT AS WELL AS THE MOTOR VEHICLE AND A SERVER DEVICE
resumo: The disclosure relates to a method for outputting a navigation instruction in a motor vehicle to head toward a possible stopping point, wherein a navigation system of the motor vehicle determines a current speed of the motor vehicle and at least one topology parameter in a predetermined vicinity of a previously determined possible stopping point and determines a time at which the outputting of the navigation instruction to the user to head toward the possible stopping point should occur, at least in dependence on the determined current speed and the at least one determined topology parameter. At the determined time, the navigation system outputs the navigation instruction to the user to head toward the possible stopping point. The disclosure furthermore relates to a server device that provides electronic map data to a navigation system of a motor vehicle in order to carry out such a method.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: COMPUTER, CAR SHARING SYSTEM, AND CAR SHARING METHOD
resumo: A computer is configured to, in a case where maintenance of a component is executed in one vehicle used by a plurality of users, decide a payment ratio of each user for a cost of the maintenance based on a kind of the component subjected to the maintenance and a usage mode of the vehicle of each user.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: OPTION FOR PURCHASING A VEHICLE
resumo: Various embodiments of the present disclosure include a method for purchasing a vehicle. In some embodiments, the method can include receiving an indication that a vehicle is damaged beyond repair. In some embodiments, the method can include receiving data related to the damaged vehicle. In some embodiments, the method can include determining a price for an option to purchase the damaged vehicle, wherein the price for the option to purchase the damaged vehicle is unique to the particular damaged vehicle and is determined based on the received data. In some embodiments, the method can include causing the price for the option to purchase the damaged vehicle to be presented to a user, along with at least some of the received data. In some embodiments, the method can include receiving a selection from the user to buy the option to purchase the damaged vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: On-demand service application that will allow allied healthcare professionals to work independently and connect with individuals, businesses, doctors, and laboratories that are in need of at-home allied healthcare services
resumo: The use of on-demand services has increased over the past couple of years. Examples of on-demand services include, but are not limited to, taxi services, food delivery, grocery services, etc. Direct Paramed Mobile Health Solutions mobile application will allow businesses, healthcare organizations, and individuals to directly connect with credentialed allied healthcare professionals on-demand. It eliminates the traditional appointment-based methodology, enabling healthcare professionals to work independently and connect with businesses, doctors, and laboratories in need of essential healthcare workers while building entrepreneurship. In contrast, it allows an individual peace of mind to be seen at home or in their office without the need for scheduling an appointment or going to a facility.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: SYSTEM FOR PROVIDING NON FACE-TO-FACE ESTIMATE COMPARISON SERVICE FOR VEHICLE
resumo: A system for providing a contact-free new vehicle purchase comparison estimate service is provided. The system comprises: a buyer terminal which receives and uploads new vehicle purchase information including a manufacturer, a vehicle name, a vehicle model, options, a purchase method, an initial cost, and a number of months of use, and receives and prints a comparative estimate; a seller terminal which receives new vehicle requirement information and uploads quote data including a capital company, a monthly payment fee, and a capital interest rate using a pre-established vehicle estimate program; and a comparison estimate service providing server which includes an estimate request unit which receives new vehicle purchase requirement information from the buyer terminal and transmits the received new vehicle purchase requirement information to the seller terminal, an estimate sheet generation unit which, when the seller terminal has uploaded estimate data, generates standard estimate sheets by entering estimate data as at least one item in a pre-stored standard estimate sheet format, a comparative estimate provision unit which ranks and sorts the standard estimate sheets to correspond to at least one preset condition and transmits the standard estimate sheets to the buyer terminal, a safety number transmission unit which, when the seller terminal is selected by the buyer terminal, generates a safety phone number for the buyer terminal and transmits the generated safety phone number to the seller terminal, and a contract proceeding unit which, when the buyer terminal performs purchasing decision and payment, conducts a contract based on an estimate of the standard estimate sheet selected by the buyer terminal. According to the present invention, a buyer can receive an estimate of a vehicle that he or she wants in a non-face-to-face manner.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR PROVIDING SERVICE BY USING MULTIPURPOSE VEHICLE
depositantes: HYUNDAI MOTOR CO LTD [KR] | KIA CORP [US] | KIA CORP [KR]
resumo: Introduced are a system and a method for providing a service by using a multipurpose vehicle, wherein a user, a service provider, and a multipurpose vehicle are matched, and a service of the matched service provider is provided to the matched user through the matched multipurpose vehicle, thereby enabling the user to simultaneously use the vehicle and the service.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: MOVING OBJECT CONTROL APPARATUS, METHOD FOR CONTROLLING MOVING OBJECT, MOVING OBJECT, INFORMATION PROCESSING METHOD, AND STORAGE MEDIUM
resumo: A moving object control apparatus in the present disclosure that adjusts a stop position of a moving object based on an instruction of a user, acquires instruction information of the user and acquires a captured image captured in a moving object. The apparatus determines a stop position of the moving object and controls traveling of the moving object to cause the moving object to travel toward the determined stop position. The apparatus (i) determines a first stop position using position information of a communication device used by the user or position information corresponding to a destination included in first instruction information of the user, and (ii) determines a second stop position based on second instruction information of the user and a region of a predetermined target identified in the captured image.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle Damage Assessment and Repair Process
resumo: An artificial intelligence (AI) system is configured to receive a series of images of a vehicle from one or more viewpoints, identify, for at least a first image from the series of images using a machine learning model, one or more parts of the vehicle captured in the image using a first classifier for identifying parts of the vehicle and identifying, for at least the first image, that one of the parts of the one or more parts of the vehicle incurred damage.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR GENERATING GRAPHICAL USER INTERFACES RELATING TO DETERMINED PARAMETRIC EVENTS
depositantes: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO [US]
resumo: Systems and methods are disclosed for providing a graphic user interface. The systems and methods may (1) receive an indication of a parametric event involving a vehicle; (2) provide a series of component graphic user interfaces, wherein the component graphic user interfaces may be configured to (i) initiate a claim filing, (ii) communicate with an insurer entity, (iii) communicate with an emergency response entity, (iv) communicate with a towing service entity, (v) communicate with a taxi or ride-share service entity, (vi) communicating with a vehicle repair service entity, (vii) communicating with a vehicle salvage entity, and/or (viii) communicating with a vehicle rental service entity; (3) detect one or more user interactions that may include one or more selections of the one or more actions; (4) perform the one or more actions; and/or (5) record a transaction indicating that the one or more actions has been performed to the blockchain.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: GLOBAL EMERGENCY ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE SYSTEM
resumo: A system for universal repair referral and history is provided comprising a server and an application executing on the server. The system receives a message from a motorist device requesting roadside automotive service and determines a geographic location of motorist device. The system also sends descriptions of providers of requested roadside service to the motorist device, the providers proximate the geographic location. The system also sends cost of requested roadside service quoted by each provider. The system also dispatches to the geographic location, based on a selection received from the motorist device, a first provider of the providers. The providers are previously qualified by the system to provide the requested roadside service proximate the geographic location.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Socorro e Reboque (C1))

titulo: AN INSURANCE SYSTEM FOR VEHICLE DAMAGE ASSESSMENT
resumo: An insurance system is disclosed for vehicle damage detection involving a damage (14) in one or more vehicles (12) in an accident (10); an insurance policy (18) purchased by a vehicle owner (16) providing financial assurance to cover the vehicle's (12) damage (14) in accordance with a predetermined specification; one or more accident photos (24) taken by the vehicle owner (16) with an electronic device (22) containing a camera to enable the determination of the damage (20); an upload area (28) where the vehicle owner uploads one or more damage files (26) to initiate the vehicle's damage assessment (20) and activate the insurance policy (18); a damage detection unit (30) analyzing the uploaded damage files (26) from the upload area (28) to perform damage assessment (20), including a modeling intermediate unit (32) configured to perform the vehicle's (12) damage assessment (20); and a display intermediate unit (40) providing a damage report (38) to the vehicle owner (16) after calculating the repair costs (36) of the vehicle's (12) damage (14) in accordance with the damage assessment (20) performed in the modeling intermediate unit (32).
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle Comparison Method and Vehicle Comparison Service Providing Server
depositantes: HYUNDAI MOTOR CO LTD [KR] | KIA CORP [KR]
resumo: An embodiment is a vehicle comparing method including providing a user question and a user propensity test to an application through a user terminal, receiving a response to the user question and the user propensity test from the user terminal, determining a user propensity based on the response, calculating a plurality of vehicle compatibilities representing vehicle-specific characteristics for each of the plurality of vehicles, determining a reference vehicle among the plurality of vehicles by comparing the user propensity with each of the plurality of vehicle compatibilities, and when receiving a response that either vehicle depreciation rate and a vehicle maintenance cost is considered, providing vehicle purchase information in which the reference vehicle is compared with a target vehicle corresponding to a higher trim or model of the reference vehicle according to a result of considering at least one of the depreciation rate of the vehicle and the vehicle maintenance cost.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: ROUTING FIELD SUPPORT TO VEHICLES FOR MAINTENANCE
resumo: Systems and methods are provided for recovery of autonomous vehicles. In particular, systems and methods are provided for vehicle recovery prioritization in a fleet of vehicles when multiple vehicles request recovery. A vehicle recovery event is generated for vehicles in need of recovery based on the vehicle's sensor log. The recovery service type is determined based on the vehicle recovery event, and vehicles in need of recovery are prioritized based on the recovery service type and the vehicle recovery event. The recovery support can include a recovery support representative and/or a recovery support service technician. Recovery response can be based on the recovery prioritization. Vehicle sensors and computing power can be used to inform onboard processors and/or central computers of a risk profile for the vehicle, and dispatch can trigger a response plan according to a recovery response framework.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Incluída em CI/CE (N=96), mas reprovada em QQ (< 3,5)

titulo: TOUCHLESS MAINTENANCE
resumo: Systems and methods for an automated process for vehicle service. In particular, an individually owned vehicle is integrated with a service provider platform for a fleet of vehicles such that data flows bidirectionally between the vehicle and the platform. The bidirectional flow of data enables an intelligent and automated end-to-end maintenance and/or repair process for the individually owned vehicle, including issue detection, accident management, and seamless vehicle exchange. For example, the vehicle can send a signal to the platform to schedule a repair and request a replacement vehicle from the platform during the repair. The platform can coordinate with a facility to schedule the repair, send a signal to the vehicle to autonomously drive itself to the scheduled repair, and provide a replacement vehicle to the vehicle's home during the repair.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Oficinas e Manutenção (C2))

titulo: SYSTEM FOR SALING USED VEHICLES AND THE METHOD FOR CONTROLLING THEREOF
resumo: Various embodiments of the present application provide a method of providing a used vehicle estimate providing system. The method comprises the steps of: receiving, by a user terminal, an input for at least one of vehicle information, a vehicle purchase method, and a vehicle purchase condition according to a vehicle purchase method and transmitting the input to a server, wherein the information on the vehicle includes information on a vehicle type, specifications, and a vehicle price, the method of purchasing the vehicle includes one of lump sum payment, installment, lease, or rental, and the conditions for purchasing the vehicle include at least one of the number of installment months, a lease period, a rental period, and down payment; extracting, by the server, at least one vehicle sales information from a memory among a plurality of vehicle sales information stored in a database which matches the received vehicle information, vehicle purchase method, and vehicle purchase conditions, and transmitting the extracted vehicle sales information to the user terminal, wherein the extracted at least one vehicle sales information includes the price of at least one vehicle, the new car price of the at least one vehicle, the repair history of the vehicle, and information about the condition of the vehicle and the sales conditions under which a seller sells the at least one vehicle corresponding to the purchase conditions; displaying the at least one vehicle sales information received by the user terminal through a display; receiving, by the user terminal, an input for selecting at least one vehicle sales information and transmitting the selected vehicle sales information to the server; and processing, by the server, payment for the selected vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: An apparatus for providing car center profiling service using a learning model based on natural language analysis of maintenance data and its operation method
resumo: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method for operating a service providing device comprises the steps of: pre-building a learning model for outputting car center profiling data based on natural language analysis of maintenance history data so that car center profiling information that can be matched with user maintenance request information is output when the maintenance history data including natural language-based unstructured data is input; collecting first maintenance history data corresponding to a first vehicle repair shop from a vehicle repair shop system equipped with a vehicle maintenance management program; inputting the first maintenance history data into the learning model; configuring car center profiling data corresponding to the first vehicle repair shop from the output of the learning model; and providing the car center profiling data of the first vehicle repair shop to a user terminal when maintenance request information received from a vehicle owner user terminal matches the car center profiling information corresponding to the first vehicle repair shop.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Incluída em CI/CE (N=96), mas reprovada em QQ (< 3,5)

titulo: AI-BASED DYNAMIC PRICING SYSTEM FOR ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING STATIONS
resumo: An AI-based dynamic pricing system for an electric vehicle charging station is disclosed. The AI-based dynamic pricing system includes: a user terminal being carried by a user who is driving an electric vehicle, and searching electric vehicle charging stations and making an electric vehicle charging reservation request; an electric vehicle charging payment terminal performing payment when electric vehicle charging corresponding to the electric vehicle charging reservation requested from the user terminal is performed; an electric vehicle charging adjustment server performing adjustment with the electric vehicle charging station on the basis of payment that is performed in the electric vehicle charging payment terminal; and an electric vehicle charging station terminal looking up and checking an electric vehicle charging reservation at an electric vehicle charging station, wherein the electric vehicle charging adjustment server is configured to determine an electric vehicle charging price of each electric vehicle charging station. According to the AI-based dynamic pricing system for an electric vehicle charging station, since it is configured to automatically adjust an electric vehicle charging price by an AI algorithm in real time in consideration of a path of an electric vehicle, a traffic volume, a real-time reservation situation, a location, the charging prices of competing charging stations, whereby there is an effect that it is possible to maximize the profit of electric vehicle charging stations and increase satisfaction of users.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: OPERATION PLAN CREATION DEVICE, OPERATION PLAN CREATION SYSTEM, AND OPERATION PLAN CREATION METHOD
resumo: In order to improve passenger satisfaction with a transportation service and to provide an operation plan creation means capable of reducing operating costs for a transportation service provider, an operation plan creation device comprises: a transportation leg network generation unit that generates transportation leg network information that defines each transportation leg of the transportation service; a cancellation determination unit that generates transportation leg cancellation possibility information that indicates whether or not cancellation of each transportation leg of the transportation service is possible; a travel route candidate determination unit that generates travel route candidate information that indicates a travel route candidate for each travel plan in passenger travel plan information; a people flow prediction unit that generates people flow prediction information that indicates a predicted people flow in the transportation service; and an operation plan generation unit that generates new operation plan information in which certain transportation legs of the transportation service are eliminated.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: RECOVERY AND RETRIEVAL SYSTEM FOR AN AUTONOMOUS VEHICLE FLEET
resumo: Systems and methods enable an autonomous vehicle (AV) to self-recover or be remotely recovered if the AV is rendered immobilized, without requiring in-person retrieval or tow of the AV. Upon the occurrence of a non-nominal event, the AV performs a dynamic driving task fallback maneuver to achieve a minimal risk condition and secures its cabin. Based on the type and severity of the event, residual AV health, and passenger confirmation, escalating grades of recovery or retrieval are executed as needed to recover from the event and resume operation. Multiple AVs can be monitored simultaneously and addressed based on priority of AV state and recovery/retrieval state, resulting in more efficient fleet management.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SERVER AND LEASE CHARGE CALCULATION METHOD
resumo: To provide a server capable of suppressing an increase in lease charges for secondary batteries caused by an environment in which electric vehicles are used.SOLUTION: A server 100 includes a communication unit 103 (acquisition unit) that acquires information on the capacity maintenance rate (degree of deterioration) of a battery 13 (secondary battery), and a processor 101 (control unit) that calculates a lease charge for the battery 13 using the information on the capacity maintenance rate. The processor 101 performs a suppression process to suppress an increase in the lease charge based on deterioration (decrease) in the capacity maintenance rate caused by an environment in which an electric vehicle 10 is used.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Matching System For The Vehicle Maintenance
resumo: The present invention provides a vehicle maintenance matching system characterized in that it selects and provides an optimal list of maintenance companies based on maintenance request information including vehicle information transmitted by a user of a vehicle requiring maintenance, and a delivery person transports the vehicle to a maintenance company on behalf of the user and transports the vehicle back to a location desired by the user after the maintenance is completed. The vehicle maintenance matching system includes: a main server that receives maintenance request information including information of a vehicle to be repaired from a user terminal, transmits a matching list of maintenance companies matching the maintenance request information to the user terminal, receives information on selected maintenance companies from the user terminal, transmits the maintenance request information to the maintenance company terminal, and processes a maintenance reservation; a user terminal that connects to the main server through a network, transmits the maintenance request information, receives a list of matching maintenance companies from the main server, and transmits preferred maintenance company information; and a maintenance company terminal that connects to the main server through a network, receives the maintenance request information, and transmits maintenance information including whether maintenance is possible to the main server.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Car condition self-diagnosis service method
resumo: The purpose of the present invention is to enable a user of a vehicle to immediately know the current state of the vehicle by executing a self-diagnosis application program installed on a smartphone immediately on the spot when the user of the vehicle recognizes or discovers any symptoms in the vehicle and simply selecting (check-indicating) the symptoms displayed on a self-diagnosis questionnaire. A method for a self-diagnosis service of a vehicle state comprises: a step (S210) of displaying a self-diagnosis questionnaire on a user terminal (120); a step (S220) in which at least one symptom is selected by the user terminal (120) from the plurality of symptoms; a step (S230) of transmitting the symptom selection information to a server (110) when the at least one symptom is selected from the plurality of symptoms; a step (S240) wherein the server (110) diagnoses a current condition of the automobile by traversing the self-diagnostic prescription database (112) to lead a condition of the automobile that is matched to the symptom selection information; a step (S250), wherein the server (110) determines at least one prescription of repair or replacement of a part; and a step (S260) in which the server (110) transmits the prescription information to the user terminal (120) and displays it through the user terminal (120).
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Detection and Repair Cost Prediction of Black Box Vehicle Damaged Areas
resumo: The purpose of the present invention is to solve the problem of determining damaged areas and faults by only viewing images recorded through the camera of a black box system for vehicles. A device for the detection and repair cost prediction of a black box vehicle damaged areas includes a Raspberry Pi OS (104) configured in a built-in cuboid case for detecting damaged areas of a vehicle and predicting repair costs through deep learning-based learning, a front camera (102) configured in a built-in cuboid case for connecting to a Raspberry Pi module for shooting and recording front images, a storage (103) configured in a form of using the built-in storage capacity of the Raspberry Pi and a USB port for storing the shot images, a power supply (105) configured in a form of connecting the power of the Raspberry Pi built in the cuboid case for supplying power from the vehicle and operating the Raspberry Pi, and a product case (101), which is a rectangular case for protection and vehicle attachment of various modules, and is configured in the front of the vehicle for protecting various modules and attaching them to the vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Customer-customized service provision system through linkage between vehicle maintenance companies and other companies
depositantes: JUNG GWANG MYEON [KR] | LEE CHANG EON [KR]
resumo: Provided is a system for providing a customized maintenance service, the system comprising: a user terminal configured to transmit maintenance request data to request maintenance of a vehicle to be maintained; a rental car management server configured to manage the allocation of a rental car; a pickup service providing server configured to manage a person in charge of providing a pickup service; and a maintenance service providing server configured to receive the maintenance request data and manage a maintenance schedule for the vehicle to be maintained, receive an allocated rental car through the rental car management server, and receive an allocated person in charge of providing the pickup service for the carriage of the allocated rental car and the vehicle to be maintained from the pickup service providing server. According to the present invention, the system can have the effect of quickly managing schedules and improving user convenience through expected repair details in regard to the provision of a maintenance service for a vehicle to be maintained, and can have the effect of providing an efficient maintenance service by minimizing responses to repetitive inquiries even in a maintenance site where maintenance is performed.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Oficinas e Manutenção (C2))

titulo: System and method for autonomous vehicle assistance
depositantes: UIPCO, LLC; United Services Automobile Association (USAA)
resumo: A roadside assistance management system for autonomous vehicles (AVs) is disclosed. The roadside assistance management system monitors and manages a plurality of AVs which are used in the transport of various items such as cash from one location to another. Each AV can request specific types of assistance. Upon receiving such a request, the roadside assistance management system can dispatch one or more additional AVs to the render assistance to the requesting AV.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Incluída em CI/CE (N=96), mas reprovada em QQ (< 3,5)

titulo: SMART COLLISION ALERT SYSTEM IN INTELLIGENT TRANSPORT
depositantes: SRM Institute of Science and Technology
resumo: ABSTRACTSMART COLLISION ALERT SYSTEM IN INTELLIGENT TRANSPORTThe present disclosure relates to a system(100) for intelligent transport with a smart collision alert. The system(100) comprises a repository(102) stores a dataset of driver details, vehicle details, car documents and threshold parameters, roadside, service provider, controller room, hospital. an input device(104) add input details. The communication network unit(106) connect and communicate with multiple vehicles, service provider, controller room, and hospital. The verification unit(108) cooperate with detection unit(108a) and validation unit(108b) validate driver and vehicle details. The sensing unit(110) sense and collect parameters from sensors, speed indicators, and tracking location. The evaluation unit(112) checks and monitor the state of vehicle based on the running state of vehicle, threshold parameter, and speed of vehicle. The collision alert unit(114) generate a warning message and prepare broadcast message. The sender unit(116) transmit broadcast message. The receiver unit(118) receive broadcast message. The display unit(120) display the warning message and broadcast message.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Location sharing application in association with services provision
resumo: A system for exchanging GPS or other position data between wireless devices for purposes of group activities, child location monitoring, work group coordination, dispatching of employees etc. Cell phones and other wireless devices with GPS receivers have loaded therein a Buddy Watch application and a TalkControl application. The Buddy Watch application communicates with the GPS receiver and other wireless devices operated by buddies registered in the users phone as part of buddy groups or individually. GPS position data and historical GPS position data can be exchanged between cell phones of buddies and instant buddies such as tow truck drivers via a buddy watch server. Emergency monitoring services can be set up with notifications to programmable individuals in case an individual does not respond. Positions and tracks can be displayed. TalkControl simplifies and automates the process of joining talk groups for walkie talkie services such as that provided by Nextel.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: SYSTEM FOR PROVIDING REPAIR INFORMATION OF VEHICLE
resumo: Disclosed is a system for providing repair information of a vehicle in the present invention. The system comprises: a model generating unit which learns data obtained by analyzing capturing images for damaged parts of vehicles and determining the same by damaged type, damaged kind, degrees of damage, and damaged part to generate a model; an image processing unit which receives and stores an appearance image signal obtained by capturing an entering vehicle for inspection by a camera; a damage diagnosing unit which extracts an appearance image of a damaged part from the appearance image of the vehicle to analyze and diagnose a damaged state; a repair determining unit which, based on the model generated through a damage diagnosis result and the model generating unit, determines a repair type about a damaged portion; a database which stores data on estimate calculation of a repair cost according to damage of the vehicle; a repair cost estimating unit which, based on repair cost estimate calculation data stored in the database, the damage diagnosis result, and repair type determination results, estimates a repair cost for parts or portions requiring vehicle repair or replacement; and a repair information providing unit which transmits information on a repair content, an estimate of repair, and an expected requiring time to a mobile communication terminal of a vehicle owner, and requires approval for confirming whether the repair is to be conducted. According to the present invention, the system clarifies the ground for estimate calculations through a consistent repair standard and provides the same for consumers. COPYRIGHT KIPO 2024
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Path planning system and method in field service business
depositantes: SHANGHAI TAIJU DATA TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention provides a path planning system and a method in field service business, which comprises the following steps: the first acquisition module is used for processing the acquired historical service data of each service network point to obtain the historical service frequency ratio of all the service network points; the second acquisition module is used for respectively acquiring a first distance between the service network node and the service center and a second distance between the service network node and all other service network nodes except the service network node to form a distance matrix; the path planning module is used for processing according to the historical service frequency ratio and the distance matrix to obtain a plurality of service paths and corresponding scheduling frequencies; and the scheduling module is used for processing according to the plurality of service paths, the scheduling frequency, and a preset upper limit value and a preset lower limit value of the interval time between two adjacent services of each service network point to obtain the service sequence combination of each service path and the scheduling interval time between two adjacent service paths. The method has the advantages of being suitable for operation scenes with indefinite or indefinite duration and reducing long-term operation cost.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Análogo - Field Service Management (C4))

titulo: Second-hand vehicle remote quotation method and device
depositantes: GUANGDONG WEIPU AUTOMOBILE E COMMERCE CO LTD
resumo: The embodiment of the application provides a method and a device for remotely quoting second-hand vehicles, which are applied to a check server, wherein the check server is respectively connected with a user terminal and a background terminal, and the method comprises the following steps: receiving a plurality of pieces of image data of the vehicles to be sold, which are sent by the user terminal; generating a three-dimensional image corresponding to the vehicle to be sold according to the image data, and sending the three-dimensional image to a background terminal; and receiving a target offer generated by the background terminal according to the three-dimensional image, and sending the target offer to the user terminal. Through this application embodiment, the evaluators of specialty can carry out accurate quotation through the three-dimensional image of waiting to sell the vehicle, and the evaluators of specialty need not to spend a large amount of time and energy and carry out the field analysis, and the evaluation mode is efficient, can adapt to the very big demand in the market of buying and selling of current used car.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: QUOTE DISPLAY METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR FAULTY AUTOMOBILE ACCESSORY, AND ELECTRONIC DEVICE
resumo: A quote display method includes: the automobile repair terminal sending a parameter test value of the automobile accessory to the test server; the test server sending the parameter test value to the big data platform; the big data platform determining a target keyword corresponding to a faulty automobile accessory according to the parameter test value and a parameter standard value of the automobile accessory, and sending the target keyword corresponding to the faulty automobile accessory to the test server: the test server sending the target keyword to the automobile repair terminal; the automobile repair terminal sending the target keyword to the quote server: the quote server determining, according to the target keyword, accessory information and accessory quote of a target automobile accessory, sending the accessory information and the accessory quote to the automobile repair terminal; the automobile repair terminal displaying the accessory information and the accessory quote.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Rail transit vehicle and maintenance cost modeling and maintenance interval optimization method and system
resumo: The invention discloses a rail transit vehicle and a method and a system for modeling maintenance cost and optimizing maintenance interval, which aim at maintenance strategies of the rail transit vehicle, and the maintenance categories are divided into preventive maintenance and corrective maintenance. The method realizes a mathematical calculation mode of maintenance cost in unit time, provides a theoretical basis for comparison of actual engineering results of different maintenance intervals, can gradually optimize the maintenance strategy of the rail vehicle, and continuously improves the economy of a vehicle system.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle map real-time road condition presentation control method and device
resumo: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for presenting and controlling real-time road conditions of a vehicle map, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the vehicle-mounted map refers to a software development kit of vehicle-mounted voice in advance, and monitors the instruction callback distributed by the software development kit; when the vehicle is in an automatic navigation auxiliary driving state, the vehicle-mounted system is in an environment simulation display state, and receives a voice request sent by a vehicle user aiming at the real-time road condition presentation control of a vehicle-mounted map; the software development kit receives instruction feedback of the cloud voice server aiming at the voice request, and dispatches the instruction callback monitoring; the vehicle-mounted map recalls the received instruction to generate a real-time road condition service processing instruction, and finishes starting map real-time road condition presentation corresponding to the voice request according to the real-time road condition service processing instruction; or the map real-time road condition display closing corresponding to the voice request is completed according to the real-time road condition service processing instruction.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR CONTROLLING THE MOVEMENT OF AUTONOMOUS VEHICLES BELONGING TO A FLEET OF SHARED VEHICLES
resumo: The invention relates to a method for controlling the movement of autonomous vehicles belonging to a fleet of shared vehicles, said vehicles comprising geolocation means. The method is characterised by the following steps: a) carrying out a first process which is suitable for defining a geographical zone in which the vehicles are located and for performing gridding of said zone so as to divide it into geographical sub-zones, b) carrying out a second logical computing process which is suitable for calculating, in each geographical sub-zone and for each vehicle which is available for reservation in the sub-zone in question, a mean wait time during which said vehicle will not be reserved, c) in a management server, geolocating the vehicles of the fleet which have been assigned a defined status and are available for reservation, and selecting at least one of said vehicles located in one or more geographical sub-zones in which the calculated mean wait time is greater than the lowest calculated mean wait time, d) generating, from the server, a request which initiates automatic movement of the vehicle selected in step c) towards the sub-zone having the lowest calculated mean wait time, which movement is defined according to a route plan calculated by a route plan calculation module of said server, e) transmitting the request to an onboard device of the vehicle selected in step c), f) receiving the request causes the automatic movement of the vehicle towards the sub-zone having the lowest calculated mean wait time according to the calculated route plan.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Method for Providing Vehicle Insurance
depositantes: THE HOLLARD INSURANCE CO PTY LTD [AU]
resumo:
The present invention is broadly directed to a method for providing vehicle insurance to a 
person, the method comprising the steps of: 
obtaining a request from the person for an offer of vehicle insurance wherein the 
person is requested to provide an estimate of a maximum distance to be travelled by the 
vehicle during a predetermined period; 
on receipt of the estimate of the maximum distance to be travelled, providing the 
offer for vehicle insurance to the person within a quote and at that time requesting an 
indication of the distance already travelled by the vehicle; 
in the event the indication of the distance already travelled is not received from the 
person, saving the quote for later receipt of the indication of the distance already travelled 
by the vehicle; 
allowing retrieval of the saved quote and receiving from the person via the retrieved 
quote the indication of the distance already travelled by the vehicle; 
insuring the person for insurance events which occur when the vehicle has travelled a 
distance less than or equal to a first predetermined distance limit calculated from the indication 
of the distance already travelled and the estimated maximum distance to be travelled.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: A SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR PREDICTING RISK FOR A FLIGHT OF AN UNMANNED AERIAL VEHICLE
resumo: The present disclosure provides a system and method for predicting risk for a flight of an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). The system includes a user device (101) including a user interface (102), connected to a risk prediction system (105). The risk prediction system (105) including a computing module (106), an artificial intelligence module (120), a risk evaluation module (121), a prediction module (123), a dynamic pricing unit (125) and a user recommendation unit (127). The method includes providing (201) details of flying the unmanned aerial vehicle, by a user using the user interface, computing (202) parameters affecting flight of the unmanned aerial vehicle based on the details, by the computing module (106), determining risks based on the computed parameters, by the risk evaluation module (121) and predicting a total risk of the flight of the UAV based on the determined risks, by the prediction module (123).
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Order dispatching method for improving order placing efficiency of online car-hailing transport capacity
resumo: The invention provides a method for dispatching orders to improve the order efficiency under the network appointment vehicle transport capacity, which comprises the following steps: receiving a ordering request of a network appointment platform, and assembling ordering information; estimating according to the ordering information capacity computing system to obtain the pre-estimation value of each capacity provider; the transport force side open platform calls order service to pre-place orders according to the order number and the transport force side ID of the network booking platform and the assembled order information, and carries out decision-making order distribution on a transport force order distribution system; after a driver is decided, calling an order system to carry out pre-binding, entering a pre-binding single link, and generating initial transport capacity order information; after the pre-binding is successful, the order informs the transport capacity opening platform; and after the network appointment platform decides a driver, the transportation capacity opening platform is informed, the order dispatching system calls the order to update the order to a state to be served, and the order starts to be served. The problem that the capacity of the online taxi booking platform is insufficient is solved, the ordering efficiency and the utilization rate of database resources are improved, and the pressure of order service processes is reduced.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Electric vehicle charging dynamic pricing method considering user urgency degree
resumo: The invention discloses an electric vehicle charging dynamic pricing method considering user urgency. The method comprises the following steps: dividing the urgency degree of a user into M levels, wherein each level corresponds to a charging power; constructing a charging station-electric vehicle user income model; constructing an objective function of the model; setting constraint conditions; setting a total charging price strategy of different powers of a charging station in one day; and establishing an optimal charging price strategy of the electric automobile when the urgency level is m in the equilibrium state. The invention provides a reasonable different charging power price through the dynamic game of the charging station and the user to guide the user to select the corresponding charging mode, thereby maximizing the user profits of the charging station and the electric vehicle and simultaneously reducing the load impact of the power grid.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle body lamp repair management control system
depositantes: SUZHOU XINHANGDAO AUTOMOBILE TECH SERVICE CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses a vehicle body lamp repair management control system which comprises a server and modules, wherein the server exchanges data with the modules and processes the data, a graph scanning module transmits picture data obtained from the outside to the server for processing, a data storage module stores data results processed by the server, a manual recording module is used for comparing the server with historical orders, data are recorded manually after the matched historical orders are not obtained, and an intelligent quotation module generates reference quotations according to the data after the server is compared with the historical orders. The device has the advantages that the recording management can be automatically carried out, and meanwhile, more accurate quotation can be achieved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: System establishment method of power enterprise standard cost dynamic library
depositantes: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD | ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses a system establishment method of a standard cost dynamic library of a power enterprise, which comprises the following steps: s1: standard cost classification: according to the driving factor of cost occurrence (i.e. cost driving factor), other operating expenses of the power enterprise can be divided into five categories: (1) personnel movement cost: the main factors are the number of workers, including the business charge, the traveling charge, the water and electricity charge, the vehicle use charge, the low-value consumable, the labor protection charge, the external labor charge and the like; (2) asset cause cost: the main factors are the original value of the asset equipment, including the protection fee of the electric power facilities, the property insurance fee, the maintenance fee of the intellectual property rights, the intermediary fee, the scattered maintenance fee of the house for the property management and the management, the greening fee, the operation and maintenance fee of the information system and the like. Through cross-department circulation and collaborative office, the standard cost basic data is rapidly collected, and the working efficiency is improved. Meanwhile, the standard cost is more closely linked with the service, and the accuracy is higher.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: MAINTENACE AND MANAGEMENT DEVICE OF ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGER
resumo: An electric vehicle charger maintenance management device according to the present invention comprises: a communication module that receives failure information of an electric vehicle charger from a charging service provider, a charger manufacturer, or an electric vehicle user; a maintenance management module that monitors maintenance part information and maintenance personnel information for each type of electric vehicle chargers, and creates and manages a quote for maintenance details of an electric vehicle charger; and a maintenance control module for allocating maintenance personnel in consideration of the location of the electric vehicle charger where a failure occurred, and controlling transmission of failure information to a terminal of a maintenance personnel. Accordingly, the present invention performs rapid and systematic maintenance, and reduces the cost required for maintenance. Transparency of maintenance costs is improved, and thus users' satisfaction can be improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYSTEM FOR PROVIDING AUTO REPAIR SERVICE USING MEMBERSHIP REWARD
resumo: A vehicle maintenance service providing system using membership points is provided. The vehicle maintenance service providing system comprises: a user terminal that performs payment in at least one vehicle maintenance terminal using membership points granted by purchasing or contracting at least one linked product, after purchasing or contracting at least one linked product; and a vehicle maintenance service provider server including a registration unit that registers at least one affiliated store terminal providing at least one linked product, an accumulation unit that grants membership points to the user terminal according to the percentage of points previously mapped to sales and stored when sales are generated from the purchase or contract of the user terminal in at least one affiliated store terminal, and a payment unit that checks the membership points accumulated in the user terminal and outputs an event according to payment approval or rejection when the user terminal tries to perform payment using membership points. Products can be offered at low prices.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Incluída em CI/CE (N=96), mas reprovada em QQ (< 3,5)

titulo: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR DETERMINING AND OUTPUTTING JOURNEY COSTS OF A VEHICLE
resumo: A method for determining and outputting journey costs of a vehicle involves automatically determining the journey costs taking into account costs for a plurality of operating means, maintenance operating costs, and costs for parameters that can be influenced by a vehicle user.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Online car-hailing real-time order estimated price determination method
depositantes: FIRST PROVINCE SCIENCE AND TECH BEIJING LIMITED COMPANY
resumo: The invention provides a method for determining an estimated price of an online taxi appointment real-time order, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that after a user selects an on-off address on an online taxi appointment platform, a plurality of recommended routes are obtained; obtaining labels of three routes from the plurality of recommended routes, wherein the three routes are the recommended route, the route with the shortest mileage and the route with the shortest time; obtaining path information corresponding to the three routes, wherein the path information comprises estimated mileage, estimated duration, real-time road conditions and route tracks; calculating a corresponding estimated price according to the route information; and obtaining the route corresponding to the lowest estimated price. The deviation between the estimated price and the actual price is reduced, the user complaints caused by the problem that the estimated price is inconsistent with the actual price are reduced, and the brand image is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Accident repair vehicle depreciation price identification method
depositantes: CHANGCHUN NAT CREDIT MOTOR VEHICLE PRICE IDENTIFICATION AND EVALUATION LIMITED COMPANY
resumo: The invention provides a method for identifying depreciation prices of accident damage repairing vehicles, which is characterized in that through a scientific calculation method, aiming at different grade prices, different success rates, different use properties, different damage parts, different damage degrees, different maintenance processes, different repairing costs and different market variable prices (eight elements of depreciation identification), the depreciation prices of the accident damage repairing vehicles are calculated by applying corresponding accessory replacement standards, prices and maintenance cost standards according to the principle of equal quality, the depreciation identification has operability, and can objectively, reasonably, scientifically and justly embody various interest consumers and accident liability persons of the vehicle depreciation, and is finally beneficial to the conciseness and social stability of accidents.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle dynamic pricing method, system and device and storage medium
depositantes: SHANGHAI LEXI LIKU SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention provides a vehicle dynamic pricing method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, which are characterized in that firstly, an inventory evaluation model is built based on hierarchical analysis according to various parameters of vehicle inventory to form a shared inventory pool, different vehicle groups based on user requirements are formed by clustering vehicle characteristics, user demand characteristics and user vehicle interaction characteristics, a shared inventory relation of APP and OTA channels and a maximum future expected revenue function of dynamic time mutual exclusion are built based on the shared inventory pool, an optimal dynamic pricing model is obtained based on single probability, and a heuristic algorithm is used for overlapping and considering an enhanced learning algorithm to solve, so that a dynamic pricing result of each day in a corresponding future period is calculated and used as an auxiliary basis for front-end pricing of the system.

titulo: Vehicle fault processing method and related equipment
depositantes: UNICOM INTELLIGENCE NETWORK SCIENCE AND TECH SHARE LIMITED COMPANY
resumo: The invention relates to the field of automobiles, in particular to a vehicle fault processing method and related equipment. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining vehicle information and driver information reported by a vehicle-mounted terminal of a target vehicle, wherein the driver information comprises driver driving age information; determining whether there is fault data in the vehicle information; if the vehicle information contains fault data, determining a fault reason according to the fault data; determining the fault grade of the target vehicle according to the fault reason; determining that the failure handling manner of the target vehicle is remote guidance if the failure level is less than a first threshold and the driver's driving age information is greater than a second threshold; determining that the failure handling manner of the target vehicle is dispatching a technician if the failure level is greater than a third threshold or the failure level is less than a first threshold and the driver's driving age information is less than or equal to a second threshold.

titulo: Dynamic pricing for electric vehicle charging (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
depositantes: APPLIED RESEARCH TO TECH S R L [IT]
resumo: Dynamic charging for electrical device charging includes defining a region according to different charging zones in the region, each zone including different charging stations for electric vehicles, each located near a road, a parking area or a building area. A quota of electricity that is expected to be distributed is assigned to each charging zone in an electrical network. A request is then received at one of the charging stations to deliver electric charge to a corresponding vehicle at a certain time. In response, a base price for charging is charged at the charging station and an electricity distribution run rate for the charging zone associated with the charging station is determined based on an amount of electricity already distributed by all charging stations located in the cargo area. Finally, the base price is adjusted upwards when the execution rate exceeds the quota, but downwards when the execution rate does not reach the quota. titulo: SMART TOLL APPLICATION DETERMINING FOR VARIOUS TOLL APPLICATIONS USING V2X COMMUNICATIONS
resumo: A toll advertisement message (TAM) broadcast from a roadside unit (RSU) is received by a vehicle via V2X communication, the TAM indicating geographic locations of lanes of a roadway for which tolls are due and cost information for traversing the lanes of the roadway. A heading of the vehicle is determined in relation to a TAM reference point indicating a geographic location of a toll gantry. A toll zone boundary region for the vehicle is identified by filtering the geographic locations of the lanes in the TAM to include only those lanes in a travel direction consistent with the heading. A lane straddling algorithm is utilized to identify, for each of the lanes in the travel direction, a respective percentage within each lane that the vehicle is traveling. A tolling usage message (TUM) is sent via the V2X communication, indicating to the RSU the percentage lane usage of the vehicle.

titulo: PERSONALIZING A SHARED RIDE IN A MOBILITY-ON-DEMAND SERVICE
resumo: The disclosure includes embodiments of personalizing a shared ride in a mobility-on-demand service using a response matrix.
