titulo: VEHICLE DAMAGE DETECTION SYSTEM AND METHOD
resumo: A vehicle damage detection system operating on a computer system for evaluating specific damage to a vehicle. The vehicle damage detection system capturing a 3D point cloud of a damaged vehicle with a 3D scanner and identifies one or more sites of vehicle damage based on comparison of the captured 3D point cloud of the damaged vehicle to a baseline 3D file by identifying points within the 3D point cloud of the damaged vehicle that deviate from an original equipment manufacturer (OEM) standard vehicle of the same type. The damage detection system can be used to determine and identify replacement parts and components and generate an estimate and parts list based on previously damaged vehicles having a similar damage pattern, allowing an improved method for vehicle damage assessment and repair.

resumo: Embodiments for a method, computer system, and computer program product for vehicle maintenance prediction are provided. titulo: SERVICE PROVISION SERVER, SERVICE PROVISION SYSTEM AND SERVICE PROVISION METHOD
resumo: A service provision server collects and accumulates, for each vehicle, vehicle information obtained by an onboard device of the vehicle and environmental information related to a travel history of the vehicle. Next, the service provision server performs predictive diagnosis about necessity of maintenance for each vehicle, based on the accumulated vehicle information and environmental information, and generates maintenance prediction information that includes content and time of the maintenance, for each vehicle based on a result of the predictive diagnosis. Then, the service provision server predicts maintenance demand in an area where a maintenance business operator provides maintenance, based on the maintenance prediction information for a plurality of vehicles, and dynamically sets a maintenance price to be presented by the maintenance business operator, based on the predicted amount of maintenance demand and a reserve amount of maintenance resources reserved by the maintenance business operator.

titulo: Method for estimating vehicle price using neural network and system for the method
resumo: The present invention relates to a method for estimating a vehicle price using a neural network. According to the present invention, the method for estimating a vehicle price using a neural network performed in a vehicle price estimating server includes: a step of receiving the input of inspection information by vehicle evaluation item which is input by a user; a step of calculating an estimated price by inputting the inspection information in the neural network learned in advance with state information vectorized by being aligned according to a vehicle's structural features; and a step of providing the calculated estimated price. The neural network is learned by using learning data in which the estimated price is labeled in continuously provided state information according to the position relation of the structural features of the vehicle. According to the present invention, the method for estimating a vehicle price using a neural network can provide consumers with an accurate price based on the result of vehicle inspection by using Artificial Intelligence.

resumo: A chatbot system for vehicle sales and maintenance that can provide highly reliable chatbot services for each domain such as vehicle sales, purchase, and maintenance, and a chatbot-based vehicle sales and maintenance service method using the same are disclosed. titulo: INFORMATION COLLECTION SYSTEM
resumo: An information collection system includes a plurality of vehicles and a server. The server is configured to, when an event occurrence notification notifying that a specific event has occurred at least together with an event occurrence location is received, select at least one vehicle to move toward the event occurrence location from among the vehicles as an information collection vehicle, and transmit an information collection instruction notification to the information collection vehicle. The vehicles are configured to, when the information collection instruction notification is received, move toward the event occurrence location and collect images captured by a camera while the vehicles are moving as event-related information that is information related to the event.

titulo: SYSTEM FOR PROVIDING SAME-DAY DELIVERY SERVICE FOR CAR REPAIRS AND MAINTENANCE
depositantes: LEE YOUNG WOO [KR] | KANG SEONG HWAN [KR] | KIM NAK JUN [KR] | HAN SANG HYUN [KR]
resumo: Provided is a system for providing a consignment service at the day of vehicle maintenance, which comprises: a user terminal for outputting one or more maintenance companies on a map based on a GPS, selecting a reservation time to output a maintenance request event after selecting any one of the maintenance companies, performing a payment after sharing a consignment status of a vehicle in real time and receiving a maintenance result, and uploading a result of confirming vehicle maintenance; a consignment driver terminal for forcibly driving the GPS to share a real-time location with the user terminal after receiving and accepting a consignment request event on the basis of the maintenance request event, and transmitting an alarm to the user terminal earlier than a preset time before an arrival to locations of the user terminal and the maintenance company selected by the user terminal; a maintenance company terminal for uploading a GPS coordinate of a place where the maintenance company is located, the price and reservation status in accordance with a type of maintenance, and requesting registration as an affiliated store, transmitting acceptance or non-acceptance when the user terminal outputs the maintenance request event, outputting a receiving event when a vehicle is received, uploading a maintenance result to receive a payment, and outputting a shipping event when the vehicle is shipped; and a consignment service providing server. Therefore, the user terminal can perform a payment when the maintenance company terminal transmits the price and inspection details with a photo after maintenance.

titulo: Systems and Methods of Determining Vehicle Reparability
depositantes: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO [US]
resumo: Systems and methods for determining a reparability of a vehicle are provided. In some embodiments, vehicle data is obtained, and a list of variables is generated from the obtained data. A machine learning algorithm may then be trained to generate a reparability metric by: (i) generating correlation metrics between the variables and costs to repair the vehicle, (ii) removing variables with correlation metrics below a threshold, and (iii) training the machine learning algorithm based upon unremoved variables.

titulo: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR EVALUATING RESIDUAL VALUE BASED ON MILEAGE AND MAINTENANCE HISTORY OF VEHICLE AND SHARING RESIDUAL VALUE INFORMATION BASED ON BLOCKCHAIN
resumo: The present invention relates to a method and device for evaluating a residual value based on a vehicle's mileage and a maintenance history and sharing residual value information based on blockchain. More specifically, the present invention relates to a method and device, wherein the method which determines the residual value of a vehicle, based on the total driving distance of a vehicle, which is reliably determined based on a first driving distance measured using a driving distance measuring device built into the vehicle and the second driving distance measured based on GPS using a separate electronic device, and accident and maintenance history entered by a set user terminal, and shares residual value information through blockchain.

titulo: CAR RENTAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEM CAPABLE OF DETERMINING PRICE USING BIG DATA
resumo: The present invention relates to a car rental management system, and more specifically to a car rental management system capable of determining a price using big data, which enables a reasonable price determination for car rental, by: storing information on the utilization rate of rental cars and variables affecting the utilization rate thereof to generate big data; deriving a correlation therebetween to predict the utilization rate of a rental car at a particular point in time; and calculating and determining the price thereof on the basis of the predicted utilization rate.

titulo: INTEGRATED VEHICLE SUBSCRIPTION OPERATION AND MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
resumo: The present invention relates to an integrated vehicle subscription operation and management system, and more specifically to an integrated vehicle subscription operation and management system in which vehicles of used vehicle providers, rental providers, complete vehicle manufacturers, imported vehicle distributors, capital companies, etc. may be registered as subscription vehicles, a user may select and subscribe to a desired duration and vehicle through a user terminal, and vehicles may be freely swapped during the duration of the subscription, and thus a vehicle subscription fee may be reduced by reducing a cost burden for a new vehicle and maintenance costs, the experiencing of various vehicles may be provided even with a low subscription fee, and the applying for a subscription for and using a vehicle may be conveniently carried out.

titulo: ROLE ASSIGNMENT FOR ENHANCED ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE
resumo: An enhanced roadside assistance system may modify service provider role assignments in roadside assistance accounts. The system may be configured to modify a service provider role assignment associated with a roadside assistance account by assigning a service provider role to each of a plurality of service providers. The system may receive a service request from a roadside assistance device for an individual associated with a vehicle. The system may identify one or more of the service providers offering a type of service indicated by the service request. Based on the service provider role assignment, the system may transmit a notification of the service request to at least one of a plurality of computing devices associated with one of the service providers. The system may receive a response comprising one or more discounts and transmit the response to the roadside assistance device for presentation to the individual.

titulo: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR SKILLED MARKETPLACE SCHEDULING
resumo: A skilled service marketplace scheduling system and method is provided. The system can include a skilled service marketplace coordination system, one or more skilled service marketplace requester devices, and one or more skilled service marketplace provider devices. The coordination system may determine a schedule given a skilled service marketplace request and a skilled service marketplace provider schedule. The coordination system may assign a given request to a skilled service provider based on the skill level of the skilled service provider. titulo: System, Method, and Computer-Readable Medium for Comparing Automatically Determined Crash Information to Historical Collision Data to Estimate Repair Costs
depositantes: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE COMPANY
resumo: An example method for estimating vehicle repair costs includes receiving, via one or more sensors coupled to a damaged vehicle involved in a crash, crash information of the damaged vehicle, the crash information including vehicle operating information of the damaged vehicle; analyzing the crash information with respective collision data of a vehicle type that includes or is similar to the vehicle type of the damaged vehicle, the analyzing including comparing at least one of a velocity or an acceleration included in the vehicle operating information to vehicle operating characteristics indicated by the respective collision data of the vehicle type; determining one or more damaged vehicle parts of the damaged vehicle based on the analyzed crash information; determining a cost estimate to repair the damaged vehicle based on the one or more damaged vehicle parts; and transmitting an indication of the cost estimate.

titulo: VEHICLE FAILURE REPAIR METHOD AND VEHICLE FAILURE REPAIR SYSTEM
depositantes: DAIHATSU MOTOR CO LTD; ダイハツ工業株式会社
resumo:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a vehicle failure repair system capable of quickly selecting an available repair shop from among a wide range of repair shops, as well as repair shops affiliated with a vehicle manufacturer.

SOLUTION: A vehicle failure repair system 1 includes a vehicle failure information acquisition unit 11, a vehicle location information acquisition unit 12, and a vehicle-side communication unit 13 which transmits vehicle failure information and vehicle location information to a first service providing unit 30. The first service providing unit 30 receives the vehicle failure information and the vehicle location information, and transmits the information to a second service providing unit 40 that manages repair shops 50 integrally. The second service providing unit 40 searches for a repair shop 50 which can repair a vehicle 10 on the basis of the vehicle failure information and the vehicle location information, selects an available repair shop 50A, and transmits the vehicle failure information and the vehicle location information to a shop-side terminal device 51 of the available repair shop 50A. The shop-side terminal device 51 transmits repair instruction information and tow-truck dispatch instruction information on the basis of the vehicle failure information and the vehicle location information.

titulo: Electric vehicle charging station dynamic pricing method for regulating and controlling electric energy quality
resumo: The invention discloses a dynamic pricing method for an electric vehicle charging station for regulating and controlling electric energy quality, which mainly aims at the condition that a plurality of national power grid electric vehicle charging stations exist in a region, simulates the demand response of a user according to the comprehensive cost of the electric vehicle user for charging to different charging stations on the basis of historical operating data of the charging stations, and achieves the effect of regulating and controlling the electric energy quality by formulating reasonable service charge prices, so that the network loss and the voltage deviation influence caused by the connection of an electric vehicle load to a power grid are minimum. According to the invention, user demand response is simulated through specific influence on user decision factors, and under the condition that the same operator manages the operation charging station, the influence of electric vehicle load on the power quality of a power grid can be reduced on the premise that the total operation and the charge are not changed by formulating reasonable service fee price.

titulo: Vehicle maintenance management method and system
resumo: The invention provides a vehicle maintenance management method and a system, wherein the vehicle maintenance management method comprises the following steps: acquiring position information and fault types of a vehicle to be maintained; determining the vehicle estimated cost of the vehicle to be maintained according to the fault type of the vehicle to be maintained; generating a vehicle maintenance order based on the position information, the fault type and the estimated vehicle cost of the vehicle to be maintained; and pushing the optimal vehicle repair service information for the vehicle to be repaired according to the vehicle repair order. Through the technical scheme of the invention, the optimal automobile repair service information can be intelligently pushed for the user to select when the vehicle breaks down, so that the time of the user is saved, the whole maintenance period is greatly shortened, and the use experience of the user is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Oficinas e Manutenção (C2))

titulo: DYNAMIC MATCHING SYSTEM FOR DRIVER DISPATCHING WITH APPLICATION TO ON-DEMAND SERVICE PLATFORMS
depositantes: BIAN YUAN DR [CN] | WANG TIANYU DR [CN] | WU DESHENG PROF [CN]
resumo:
With the development of technological advances in mobile networks and Global Position System, 
on-demand services have emerged on a massive scale. We propose a measurement-based 
algorithm, which is capable to deal with online case in large scale and to approximate the optimum 
at a ratio o for cost minimization. The request-driver measurement is based on four factors: 
passenger's waiting time calculated by the drop-off time of its last request plus the drive from the 
drop-off location to the pick-up location of the request; the time to home after serving the request; 
the requests density to evaluate the benefit to serve the current order; the importance of the order, 
which may reflect the revenue or the willing to pay. The request is assigned to the driver with the 
lowest measurement. The system will also set a threshold and reject the requests whose 
measurement function is above the threshold for all drivers.

titulo: Vehicle price determination method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
depositantes: ZHEJIANG DASOUCHE SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD
resumo: The application provides a method and a device for determining vehicle price, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring vehicle information of a target vehicle to be evaluated; extracting the vehicle characteristics of the target vehicle from the vehicle information; respectively inputting the vehicle characteristics into at least two trained valuation models so as to predict the price of the target vehicle based on the vehicle characteristics by each valuation model; wherein, the building modes of the valuation models are different; and acquiring the price parameters output by each valuation model, and inputting all the output price parameters into an arbitration model so as to determine the price of the target vehicle by the arbitration model based on the price parameters output by each valuation model. By using the method provided by the application, the vehicle price can be determined.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Electric vehicle charging station selection method based on double-queue dynamic pricing model
resumo: The invention discloses an electric vehicle charging station selection method based on a double-queue dynamic pricing model, which comprises the steps of firstly, obtaining information such as (i) the position, the electric quantity, the vehicle model and the battery capacity of a charging demand point by utilizing a mobile internet technology, (ii) the position information of a charging station, queuing in the station and charging conditions; then predicting the total time consumption in the charging process according to the charging demand point, and calculating and updating the electricity price through an electricity price updating strategy; and finally, establishing a multi-objective optimization function model to obtain the best selected charging station. According to the invention, when the queuing waiting time is predicted, a double-queue queuing mode and a method for updating the achievement rate of the charging station in real time are adopted, so that the total time prediction is more accurate, and when the electricity price is determined, a dynamic pricing method is adopted, so that the uniform load of the charging station is ensured. Therefore, the charging station selection method and the charging station selection device can greatly increase the rationality of charging station selection during traveling on the premise of ensuring the load safety of the charging station, and can be applied to a general charging station selection strategy.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Data processing method and device based on full life cycle cost
resumo: The application discloses a data processing method based on vehicle full life cycle cost, which comprises the following steps: the full life cycle cost of the target object is obtained, wherein the target object can be the whole vehicle or parts on the vehicle. The full life cycle cost of the target object may be one or more of a design cost, a production cost, a procurement cost, a use cost, a maintenance cost, and a disposal cost. After the full life cycle cost of the target object is obtained, the full life cycle cost of the target object can be displayed according to a preset mode, and therefore a user can determine the full life cycle cost of the vehicle or parts on the vehicle according to the display content.

titulo: Online car-hailing estimated price determination method and device
depositantes: BEIJING BAILONGMA YUNXING TECH CO LTD
resumo: A method and device for determining pre-estimated value of network about vehicles are disclosed. And receiving the taxi-taking information of the user, wherein the taxi-taking information comprises a taxi-taking point. The predicted boarding time of the user is predicted based on at least one of available vehicle information near the boarding point, other taxi-restraining user information near the boarding point, traffic conditions near the boarding point, and user information. And determining a pre-estimation value based on the estimated boarding time and the corresponding time segment pricing rule. Therefore, the predicted time of the user on the bus can be calculated by using the predicted time of the user on the bus, so that the predicted time is closer to the actual time of the user, the accuracy of the predicted price is improved, and the difference between the predicted price and the settlement price is reduced.

titulo: CPS-considered electric vehicle charging station dynamic pricing method and system
depositantes: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD | UNIV SOUTHEAST | STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO
resumo: The invention relates to a CPS-considered electric vehicle charging station dynamic pricing method and system. Firstly, acquiring road traffic information through a GPS (global positioning system), then sending the GPS information and dynamic electricity price information of each charging station to each electric vehicle EV (electric vehicle), and determining the charging station to be approached by a user according to the acquired information and the driving and charging willingness of the user; meanwhile, each charging station uploads the received EV charging load, self position information, capacity information and charging queuing conditions to the main station of the electric power information physical system in real time, the main station determines an optimal charging load distribution mode through calculation and analysis, and charging behaviors of the EV are influenced and changed by dynamically adjusting pricing of the charging stations in the electric power market. The invention can reasonably allocate the charging load while considering the user intention and the capacity of the charging station, is beneficial to reducing the burden of the charging station, reduces the electric charge of the user and relieves the traffic jam condition to a certain extent.

titulo: Automatic dispatch system for tow service providers
resumo: A work assignment request message, generated by a user device based on input provided by a tow service provider via the user device, is received at an enterprise server device. An initial pool of tow request stocks for potential fulfillment by the tow service provider is selected from a set of pending tow request stocks. A refined pool of tow request stocks is generated to exclude, from the initial pool, tow request stocks for which the tow service provider does not meet at least one fulfillment requirement. An optimized pool of tow request stocks is generated to include one or more tow request stocks selected, according to one or more optimization criteria, from the refined pool of tow request stocks. Information assigning the tow request stocks in the optimized pool of tow request stocks is transmitted from the enterprise server device to the user device.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Socorro e Reboque (C1))

titulo: SYSTEM AND METHOD OF SELLING CUSTOMIZED USED CAR
resumo: A system according to an embodiment of the present disclosure is for selling a customized used car on the basis of information selected by a customer. The system may include an inspection terminal receiving score data for each inspection item of a warehoused car from an inspector, a customer terminal receiving car-type selection information and repair-request selection information from the customer, and a used-car sale server calculating a total score that represents condition of the warehoused car, by using the score data for each inspection item of the warehoused car, and transmitting, to the customer terminal, car price information that is calculated on the basis of the repair-request selection information and the total score corresponding to the car-type selection information among the total scores for the respective warehoused cars.

titulo: Concrete field service robot
resumo: The invention relates to the field of building construction, in particular to a concrete on-site service robot which is convenient for on-site construction information planning and concrete vehicle scheduling. The supporting palm and the supporting legs are used for supporting; the camera is used for collecting video information of a construction site and transmitting the video information to the function part; the mechanical arm is used for moving the detection part; the detection part is used for detecting the concrete technical indexes and transmitting detection data to the function part; the function part receives the video information and the image information of the camera, receives the data information of the detection part, processes and analyzes data according to the information, and commands the dispatching of the concrete vehicle. The concrete site service robot can orderly arrange the concrete site conditions and conveniently command the concrete transport vehicle by matching the functional part, the camera, the mechanical arm, the detection part, the concrete vehicle and the like, and has the characteristics of facilitating the integration of site construction information and the scheduling of the concrete vehicle compared with manual integration.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Roadside service system for supporting automatic driving control decision and control method thereof
depositantes: WUHU XIONGSHI AUTOMOBILE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD | CHERY AUTOMOBILE CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses a roadside service system for supporting automatic driving control decision, which comprises an automobile end, a roadside system and a cloud platform server, wherein the roadside system is a device arranged beside a road, the roadside system internally comprises a sensor assembly, a roadside data processing unit for receiving signals of the sensor assembly, and a roadside communication unit which is connected with the roadside data processing unit and sends the signals outwards, the roadside communication unit sends the signals to the automobile end and the cloud platform server, and the cloud platform server is communicated with the automobile end. The invention can improve the environmental information perception capability of the unmanned automobile, and simultaneously can provide information and management support for intelligent traffic, and the road side service system in key road sections and special traffic environments is beneficial to improving traffic safety. Through comprehensive management and scheduling of the background, the traffic efficiency of the universe can be improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Second-hand vehicle dynamic pricing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
resumo: The embodiment of the application discloses a second-hand vehicle dynamic pricing method, a second-hand vehicle dynamic pricing device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring public praise data related to the second-hand vehicles and inherent attribute data of the second-hand vehicles; reconstructing a training sample set based on the public praise data and the inherent attribute data; and training a pre-constructed price prediction model based on the training sample set, and dynamically pricing by using the trained price prediction model. According to the embodiment of the application, when the price of the second-hand car is predicted, public praise information of the second-hand car is referred to on the basis of the inherent attribute of the second-hand car, so that the accuracy of price prediction is improved, and meanwhile, due to the fact that public praise behaviors are different in time, when the price is predicted by referring to public praise data, the purpose of dynamically adjusting the price based on the public praise data is achieved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Online car-hailing ordering method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
depositantes: HANHAI INF TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses a method and a device for ordering and placing orders in a network appointment car. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a first network car booking pre-evaluation request for a target trip; responding to the first network car booking pre-evaluation request, acquiring a first candidate guide point matched with the POI of the end point in the target travel, and outputting first pre-evaluation information of the target travel based on the first candidate guide point of the start point and the end point of the target travel; receiving a first network car booking and ordering request of a first target network car booking platform in the first pre-evaluation information; and responding to a first network car booking ordering request, and sending a first order request to a first target network car booking platform, wherein the starting point of the first order request is the starting point, and the destination of the first order request is a first target guide point matched with the first target network car booking platform in the first candidate guide points. The method and the system can improve the accuracy of order data of the travel order under the scene that the order service is provided by the third-party network car booking platform.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Behavior monitoring method and device for field service personnel, electronic equipment and medium
depositantes: BEIJING SANKUAI ONLINE TECH CO LTD
resumo: The embodiment of the application discloses a behavior monitoring method and device for field service personnel, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving position information sent by a field service personnel terminal, and comparing the position information with the position of a user to be served to obtain a position comparison result; if the position information is within the preset range of the position of the user to be served, allowing the field service personnel terminal to start field recording monitoring; converting the field recording file into a field recording text; according to the field recording text, identifying abnormal behaviors of field service personnel to obtain a behavior identification result, and determining service effectiveness; comparing the product bar code identification sent by the field service personnel terminal with the product bar code identification of the work order to be serviced to obtain a bar code comparison result; and storing a position comparison result, a behavior identification result, service validity and a bar code comparison result corresponding to the work order to be serviced. The embodiment of the application realizes the behavior monitoring of the service process of the field service personnel.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Visual feedback-based secondary review method and system for automatic inspection unmanned aerial vehicle
depositantes: STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD HUAINAN POWER SUPPLY CO | STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD MAINTENANCE BRANCH | UNIV SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CHINA | STATE GRID CORP CHINA
resumo: The invention discloses a secondary rechecking method and a secondary rechecking system based on visual feedback for automatically polling an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, finding out suspected points which cannot be judged according to the target identification and fault judgment result of the first inspection, and sending out a secondary request; s2, the unmanned aerial vehicle autonomously determines the inspection point of the secondary inspection according to the pose of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the pose of the cloud platform and the number of the inspection point when the suspected point image is shot, determines the position of the suspension point of the secondary inspection and the pose information of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the cloud platform when the position of the suspension point of the secondary inspection reaches the position of the hovering point of the secondary inspection, and replans the local path; and S3, hovering when the flying reaches a secondary review suspension point, finishing controlling the pose of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the pose of the cloud deck according to the secondary review task information, photographing, and recognizing and processing the picture again to realize secondary review. The method improves the reliability and the practicability of autonomous unmanned aerial vehicle routing inspection under the power transmission tower line scene.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Electric vehicle charging station dynamic pricing method based on minimized electric energy quality model
depositantes: ZHEJIANG TUSHENG POWER TRANS AND TRANSFORMATION ENGINEERING CO LTD WENZHOU TECHNOLOGY BRANCH
resumo: The invention relates to a dynamic pricing method of an electric vehicle charging station based on a minimized electric energy quality model, which is mainly used for adding charging station capacity constraint by considering the change of the electric vehicle charging demand on time on the basis of historical operation data of the charging station when a plurality of national power grid electric vehicle charging stations exist in an area, performing optional modeling analysis on the charging direction of an electric vehicle user, and achieving the effect of regulating and controlling the electric energy quality by formulating a reasonable service charge price so as to minimize the network loss and voltage offset influence caused by the connection of an electric vehicle load to a power grid.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: A SYSTEM AND MEHTOD FOR ESTIMATING RESIDUAL VALUE OF USED VEHICLES BASED ON ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
resumo: An embodiment of the present invention provides a deep learning-based car part curation method. A part curation method of a part curation server, which provides a deep learning-based part curation service with respect to a part of a car under repair, comprises the steps of: allowing a condition data receiving unit to receive condition data on a part of the car under repair from a first client server; allowing a part order processing unit to generate part curation data for a part corresponding to the received condition data, and then to transmit the part curation data to a second client server as an object for approval of the part if validity for the part curation data is confirmed; and allowing a repair history management unit to generate a block including a part repair history for the part, and to confirm reliability of the block by comparing the generated block with block data of the block previously generated and stored at a memory of the part curation server by using a hash value recorded in a header. The present invention can increase convenience in ordering and receiving parts between a part distributor and a repair shop.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: SYSTEMS AND METHOD FOR MANAGEMENT OF ELECTRIC VEHICLE SUPPLY EQUIPMENT
resumo: A control system for a charging control network may include a primary server system that applies a control process to an Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment (“EVSE”), a secondary server system that applies a monitoring process to the EVSE, and a mediator system that maintains a virtualized connection there-between. The mediator system may: in response to receiving a first request from the EVSE, selectively route the first request to one or more server systems based on predetermined rules; in response to receiving at least one first reply, selectively route only one of the at least one first reply to the EVSE; in response to receiving a second request from one of the server systems directed toward the EVSE, route the second request to the EVSE; and, in response to receiving a second reply to the second request, route the second reply to the server system that transmitted the second request.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: VEHICLE DISPATCHING METHOD, ELECTRONIC DEVICE AND STORAGE MEDIUM
depositantes: APOLLO INTELLIGENT CONNECTIVITY BEIJING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]
resumo: A vehicle dispatching method, an electronic device and a storage medium, related to the fields of intelligent transportation, electronic maps, cloud computing and cloud platforms, are provided. The method includes: determining, in a case where it is determined that there are a first vehicle and a second vehicle traveling toward each other in a target road section, a position of the first vehicle and a position of the second vehicle, wherein the target road section is a road section through which vehicles cannot pass in parallel; determining a target crossing place, according to road data of an electronic map as well as the position of the first vehicle and the position of the second vehicle; and dispatching the first vehicle or the second vehicle to travel toward the target crossing place, according to a position of the target crossing place.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: ROUTE-BASED DIGITAL SERVICE MANAGEMENT
depositantes: SYDIR JAROSLAW J [US] | LI BIN [US] | METSCH THIJS [DE]
resumo: Various systems and methods for route-based digital service management are described herein, comprising receiving a request for service, such as a user request for service from a MaaS or digital service provider, estimating digital service usage with respect to the request, determining a MaaS route using the request and the estimated digital service usage, selecting an orchestration strategy comprising a server type using the estimated digital service usage, and scheduling a MaaS vehicle for the determined MaaS route in response to the request using the selected orchestration strategy and the determined candidate MaaS route.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Análogo - Field Service Management (C4))

titulo: SYSTEM FOR PROVIDING DIRECT TRADING SERVICE FOR USED CAR
resumo: Provided is a system for providing a direct trading service for a second-hand car, which comprises: a seller terminal transmitting an event of requesting a direct trading of a second-hand car, uploading data for the second-hand car including a certified copy of the register, age, maintenance state and record of any accidents, and receiving the remaining amount of money paid, where commission is subtracted, when a sales price is inputted and the sale is completed; at least one buyer terminal outputting online advertising of the second-hand car, transmitting an event of requesting to buy a car to the online advertising, holding an auction when a plurality of people want to buy the car, and paying when the purchase is completed or a successful bid is made; and a server for providing a direct trading service for a second-hand car, which includes a storage unit mapping the data for a second-hand car uploaded by the seller terminal to a seller terminal and storing the information, an advertising unit uploading the data for a second-hand car by writing down a valued amount apart from a sales price when data resulting from verification of the data for a second-hand car are inputted and putting an advertising online for attracting prospective buyers, a transmission unit designating and transmitting a date and place for the sale to at least one buyer terminal and the seller terminal when a buying request is uploaded on at least one buyer terminal, and a payment unit paying the remaining amount where a commission is subtracted at the seller terminal when a buying decision is made and payment is completed on any buyer terminal among the at least one buyer terminal.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: CAR MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
resumo: The present invention relates to a used car vehicle management system related to vehicle management tasks (maintenance, car washing, polishing, etc.), which are essential when selling a used car. More specifically, in a system in which a server and a user terminal communicate through a network, when vehicle management data is input through the input unit of a user terminal, a server analyzes the data and calculates the sorting, cost, and required time, so that the user can see the calculation at a glance, and can purchase items necessary for vehicle management fast at an economical price through a chatbot system.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Method for calculating economic and safe transportation range of liquid helium storage tank
resumo: The invention discloses a calculation method for an economic and safe transportation range of a liquid helium storage tank, which consists of an economic module and a safety module. Wherein the economics module calculates as follows: firstly, calculating freight of the liquid helium storage tank in different transportation ranges, wherein the freight mainly comprises cost depreciation cost, vehicle maintenance cost, road toll and the like; on the basis, a dimensionless method is adopted to calculate the dimensionless freight coefficient. Secondly, according to the pressure rise function of the liquid helium storage tank, dimensionless pressure rise coefficients under different transportation ranges are calculated. And finally, calculating a dimensionless economic safety index according to the calculation result of the dimensionless freight coefficient and the dimensionless pressure rise coefficient, wherein the transportation range corresponding to the minimum value of the index is the economic safety transportation range. The invention considers that the temperature of the liquid helium is much lower than that of low-temperature liquid such as LNG and the like, considers the safety problem caused by the pressure rise of the storage tank, calculates the optimal transportation range by integrating two factors of economy and safety, and ensures the economical and safe transportation of the liquid helium.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Concrete field service robot
resumo: The utility model relates to a construction field especially relates to a make things convenient for on-spot construction information to pool, make things convenient for concrete vehicle scheduling's concrete site service robot. The supporting palm and the supporting legs are used for supporting; the camera is used for collecting video information of a construction site and transmitting the video information to the function part; the mechanical arm is used for moving the detection part; the detection part is used for detecting the concrete technical indexes and transmitting detection data to the function part; the function part receives the video information and the image information of the camera, receives the data information of the detection part, processes and analyzes data according to the information, and commands the dispatching of the concrete vehicle. The utility model discloses a concrete site service robot through the cooperation of function portion, camera, robotic arm, detection portion and concrete car etc. can organize the concrete site conditions orderly to can command the concrete truck conveniently, compare artifical orchestration, have the characteristics that make things convenient for site operation information to organize, make things convenient for the concrete truck dispatch.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: REPARING SERVICE SYSTEM FOR VEHICLE
resumo: The technical idea of the present disclosure relates to a vehicle maintenance system. According to one embodiment of the present disclosure, the vehicle maintenance system includes: a maintenance terminal which transmits quote information for maintenance; a management server which manages a quote DB which stores the quote information; and a customer terminal which receives the quote information from the quote DB and transmits a maintenance request to the management server based on the quote information. In response to the maintenance request, the management server generates a communication channel through which the customer terminal and the maintenance terminal can directly communicate based on the customer ID corresponding to the customer terminal and the maintenance ID corresponding to the maintenance terminal. According to the present invention, accurate vehicle maintenance is performed, and the quality of maintenance can be ensured.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Incluída em CI/CE (N=96), mas reprovada em QQ (< 3,5)

titulo: METHOD OF DETERMINING REPAIR OPERATIONS FOR A DAMAGED VEHICLE
resumo: The present invention relates to the determination of repair operations for a damaged vehicle. More particularly, the present invention relates to determining repair operations, for example whether to repair or replace parts of a damaged vehicle and associated labour time required, for a damaged vehicle using images of the damage to the vehicle.Aspects and/or embodiments seek to provide a computer-implemented method for determining repair operations that are required to repair a damaged vehicle, using images of the damage to the damaged vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: VEHICLE POWERTRAIN ANALYSIS IN NETWORKED FLEETS
resumo: A computer-implemented method for generating recommendations for vehicle powertrain changes is described herein. Disclosed systems and methods include receiving operational data associated with one or more vehicles in a fleet of networked vehicles, and receiving maintenance data associated with the vehicles. The maintenance data can include a vehicle parts history associated with one or more fleet vehicle parts. A machine learning analytical model is described that determines, based in part on the operational data and the maintenance data, a total cost of ownership for the vehicles, and generates, based at least in part on the total cost of ownership for the vehicles, a vehicle recommendation indicative of a powertrain changes for the vehicles in the fleet. Aspects of the present disclosure may provide automated sources of crowdsourced vehicle fleet information with which vehicle fleet managers can make actionable decisions for fleet powertrain upgrades.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: A roadside assistance pushbutton communication system
resumo:

titulo: ESTIMATION APPARATUS, ESTIMATION SYSTEM, AND ESTIMATION METHOD
resumo: An estimation apparatus includes: a vehicle type information storage unit for storing vehicle type identification information for identifying a vehicle type and component region information indicating a region of a vehicle component; and a processor that identifies the vehicle type based on input about an estimation target vehicle that is a target for which an estimate for repair is to be made, acquires the component region information corresponding to the vehicle type that is identified, receives input about a region corresponding to a position in the vehicle sample image as input of a damaged range, determines whether the region indicated by the component region information and the damaged range overlap each other, determines a vehicle component and repair details for the vehicle component based on the region, and calculates the estimated amount of money based on the vehicle component and the repair details for the vehicle component.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: ELECTRONIC TOWING SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING ROUTE PLANNING APPARATUS
resumo: A route planning apparatus configured to create a travel plan that includes a planned travel route for a leading vehicle to electronically tow a following vehicle using inter-vehicle communication, the route planning apparatus comprising: a receiving unit configured to receive a request to stop at a waypoint during traveling by the electronic towing, the stop-over request being input on a second information processing apparatus that is used by an occupant of the following vehicle: a searching unit configured to search, for a waypoint according to the request, the planned travel route and a surrounding region of the planned travel route; and a transmitting unit configured to transmit information regarding a found waypoint and a route to the waypoint to a first information processing apparatus that is used by an occupant of the leading vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR ESTIMATING PRICE OF VEHICLE
resumo: Disclosed are a device and method for estimating a price of a vehicle. The device for estimating a price of a vehicle includes at least one processor, an input unit, a transceiver unit, and a memory. The input unit receives the vehicle number of a target vehicle and input mileage of the target vehicle. The transceiver unit receives basic information of the target vehicle corresponding to the vehicle number of the target vehicle from a server. The processor estimates expected mileage of the target vehicle based on mileage history information and maintenance history information of the target vehicle, and estimates an estimated price of the target vehicle based on the basic information and the estimated mileage.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: P2P METHOD FOR LENDING WINNING BID MONEY OF FULLY DAMAGED VEHICLE USING PEER TO PEER LENDING AND PROVIDING CONNECTIBLE ESTIMATION DATA AND APPARATUS THEREOF
resumo: According to a method for lending winning bid money of total loss vehicle using peer to peer (P2P) lending, a financial technology service device executes a P2P lending with respect to any total loss vehicle by connecting a loan applicant receiving a loan for the total loss vehicle with multiple investors. In the P2P lending process, the financial technology service device generates and stores used car sales evaluation data of the corresponding used car and used car sales evaluation data of the loan applicant. The financial technology service device, through periodic monitoring, detects a promotion of the used car sale for the total loss vehicle afterward, or a start of the used car sale participated by the loan applicant as an operator or collaborator in provision of parts or repair or sale of the used vehicle, so the detected data is provided to those who wish to purchase the used car as used car purchase reference data.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: NEAR-REAL-TIME COLLABORATIVE VEHICLE REPAIR ESTIMATING TOOL
resumo: A near-real-time collaborative vehicle repair estimating tool is provided. In general, one aspect disclosed features a system, comprising: a hardware processor; and a non-transitory machine-readable storage medium encoded with instructions executable by the hardware processor to perform a method comprising: providing at least one view of a repair estimate record to a plurality of client devices; receiving a revision of the repair estimate record from one of the client devices; generating a revised repair estimate record by revising the repair estimate record according to the received revision responsive to receiving the revision of the repair estimate record; and providing at least one view of the revised repair estimate record to the plurality of client devices in near real time with receiving the revision of the repair estimate record.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Orçamentação e Custos (C3))

titulo: Vehicle Repair Estimation System and Method
resumo: A vehicle repair estimate platform for collecting vehicle repair data from a depth and dimension measuring camera and generating a manipulatable three-dimensional model of the vehicle damage. An estimate is generated based on insured claim attributes and predefined vehicle damage parameters, and the estimate tagged for periodic selection for inclusion in a wide area repair estimate matrix.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Incluída em CI/CE (N=96), mas reprovada em QQ (< 3,5)

titulo: Vehicle safety maintenance method and device
depositantes: BEIJING WODONG TIANJUN INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD | BEIJING JINGDONG CENTURY TRADING CO LTD
resumo: The application discloses a vehicle safety maintenance method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: monitoring whether the current maintenance condition is met or not according to the running state information and the model of the vehicle, and if so, outputting vehicle maintenance prompt information; when a maintenance request of a user is received, logging in a cloud end by using account information of the user, acquiring detailed attribute information of a corresponding maintenance item, and determining a default service provider S n (ii) a Outputting the detail attribute information and the S n The related service information and the purchase prompt information; when a request of replacing a service provider of the user is received, triggering the user to confirm a new service provider; when a purchase request of the user is received, generating service order data according to the detailed attribute information of the maintenance items and the related service information of the service provider, and triggering the service order dataAnd the user confirms and pays for the service order data. By the method and the device, timeliness of vehicle safety maintenance can be achieved, and user experience is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: METHOD FOR PROVIDING MAINTENANCE SERVICE AND APPLICATION AND SERVER IMPLEMENTING THE SAME METHOD
resumo: A method for allowing a server to provide a vehicle maintenance service comprises the following steps of: storing maintenance item information including part information matching a vehicle identification number of each vehicle and a maintenance cycle for each part information and information on maintenance companies; receiving vehicle information including a vehicle identification number from a terminal; extracting maintenance item information matching the vehicle based on the received vehicle identification number and predicting a maintenance time for each maintenance item by inputting the vehicle information and the maintenance item information into a learned maintenance time prediction model; and transmitting estimated costs or part costs of the maintenance companies matching a corresponding maintenance item to a terminal according to the predicted maintenance time.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Oficinas e Manutenção (C2))

titulo: SYSTEM FOR MANAGING AUTOMOBILE REPAIRING SERVICE AND METHOD FOR PROVIDING SERVICE THEREOF
resumo: The present invention relates to a vehicle maintenance service integrated management system and a method, and relates to a vehicle maintenance service integrated management system and a method, which can integrally manage an entire process of the vehicle maintenance service through communication between transaction parties in consideration of distribution characteristics in an imported car parts market. According to the present invention, by providing imported car owners with maintenance reviews and evaluation information and maintenance history information for a number of maintenance companies, it is possible to broaden the selection of a maintenance company for vehicle maintenance and to make a reasonable choice at the time of vehicle maintenance.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: cost production system and methods for vehicle of accident for compensation for accident
resumo: The present invention relates to a system for calculating an accident vehicle price capable of calculating a loss caused by an accident in preparation for a current price of an accident vehicle and a depreciation after the accident. Specifically, the present invention relates to the system for calculating the accident vehicle price capable of calculating the depreciation of the accident vehicle by analyzing a driving distance of an accident vehicle, a market price according to a past repair history, and a current price of a damaged component as a result of an accident or a tendency to depreciate as a result of replacing or repairing of the relevant component. The system comprises: a price calculation server; an inquiry terminal; and a user terminal.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: PROCESS FOR A CENTRAL OPERATING SYSTEM TO REPAIR AND MAINTAIN UNMANNED VEHICLES ONSITE OR AT A REPAIR DEPOT WITH IDENTIFICATION OF A VEHICLE NEEDING ONSITE OR REPAIR DEPOT REPAIR OR MAINTENANCE, WITH AUTHORIZING, SCHEDULING, ESTIMATING THE COST, TRANSPORTING VEHICLES TO AND FROM A REPAIR DEPOT, PERFORMING A FULL SYSTEM, 'DOWNING' A VEHICLE, REMOVING A 'GROUNDED' STATUS FROM A VEHICLE AND RETURNING A VEHICLE TO SERVICE AFTER REPAIR OR MAINTENANCE
resumo: A process for a central operating system to repair and maintain unmanned Vehicles used for, but not limited to, inspection of commercial outdoor assets, agricultural crops, civil and public infrastructure, fire control, public safety and public emergency services. Perform the repair and maintenance of unmanned aerial Vehicles onsite or at a repair depot with identification of a Vehicle needing onsite or repair depot repair or maintenance, with authorizing, scheduling, estimating the cost, transporting Vehicles to and from a repair depot, performing a full system, ‘downing’ a Vehicle, removing a ‘grounded’ status from a Vehicle and returning a Vehicle to service after repair or maintenance.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE FOR AUTONOMOUS VEHICLES
resumo: Aspects of the disclosure relate to determining how to distribute roadside assistance vehicles within a service area for a fleet of autonomous vehicles. As one example, the service area may be divided into a grid including a plurality of cells. For each cell of the plurality of cells, a likelihood that a vehicle of the fleet will require roadside assistance may be determined. A distribution of the roadside assistance vehicles may be determined by assigning the roadside assistance vehicles to ones of the plurality of cells based on the likelihoods.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: The system that provides a quote for the sale of a used car

titulo: Vehicle Hailing In A Mobile Ecosystem
resumo: A mobile ecosystem is disclosed that includes a vehicle with an autonomous control system configured to obtain vehicle information including a vehicle location of the vehicle and obtain user information including a user location of a user device. Based on a cost function that estimates a value of a confidence level above a confidence threshold using the user information, the autonomous control system can determine that a user of the user device is ready for a pickup by the vehicle, identify a pickup location for the vehicle based on the user information and the vehicle information, and determine a trajectory from the vehicle location to the pickup location. The vehicle includes a propulsion system configured to cause motion of the vehicle from the vehicle location toward the pickup location according to the trajectory.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Automatic calculation system of automobile repairs and parts estimation with mapping interoperation of automobile model and data information
resumo: The present invention relates to an automatic calculation system of automobile repairs and parts estimation with mapping interoperation of automobile model and data information, and more specifically, to an automatic calculation system of automobile repairs and parts estimation with mapping interoperation of automobile model and data information, which comprises: a wireless transmission device installed in an automobile and receiving automobile model and data information; a wireless reception device which communicates with the wireless transmission device and receives the automobile model and data information of the wireless transmission device; a management server which communicates with the wireless reception device, stores a maintenance history, labor and parts price information for each maintenance item mapped with the automobile model and data information input from the wireless reception device, and updates, stores and manages the latest labor and parts price information in conjunction with an external server; and a local computer which is interlocked with the management server and automatically calculates a maintenance estimate including the maintenance history, the labor and parts price information for each maintenance item, and maintenance details and labor and parts price information for each new maintenance item. An automobile owner can accurately know and trust the maintenance estimate.

titulo: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR GUIDING CAR REPAIR BASED ON IMAGE ANALYSIS
resumo: According to an embodiment of the present invention, in a method for an estimate guidance server to provide guidance for vehicle repair based on images, provided a method for providing a vehicle repair guide, which includes the steps of: (a) receiving a photographed image of a damaged part of a vehicle from a user terminal or a repair shop terminal; (b) calculating an estimated range for vehicle repair by analyzing the image based on pre-learned data; and (c) determining whether insurance processing is necessary by comparing the estimated range with the total cost required for insurance processing based on the calculated estimated range.

titulo: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR USING MACHINE LEARNING FOR VEHICLE DAMAGE DETECTION AND REPAIR COST ESTIMATION
resumo: Systems and methods for estimating the repair cost of one or more instances of vehicle damage pictured in a digital image are disclosed herein. These systems and methods may first use a damage detection neural network (NN) model to determine location(s), type(s), intensit(ies), and corresponding repair part(s) for pictured damage. Then, a repair cost estimation NN model may be given a damage type, a damage intensity, and the repair part(s) needed to determine a repair cost estimation. The training of each of the damage detection NN model and the repair cost estimation NN model is described. The manner of outputting results data corresponding to the systems and methods disclosed herein is also described.

titulo: SYSTEM AND METHOD OF COMPARING CROSS-BRAND LEASE, FINANCE, AND/OR PURCHASE DATA FOR FACILITATING THE PURCHASE AND/OR LEASE OF A VEHICLE
resumo: A system and a method of facilitating purchase and/or lease of an automobile are disclosed. The system Automotive Sales Representative receives information from a customer or buyer for purchasing and/or leasing an automobile. The system allows an automotive retail sales or leasing representative to select one or more automobiles based on the information provided by the customer. The system selects purchase options for the customer. Further, the system selects a dealership which offers best pricing for the automobile suitable for the customer. The system checks inventory at the dealership and obtains an invoice from the dealership. Subsequently, the system checks rebates, insurance and other finance and insurance data applicable for the customer. Further, the system generates a deal structure or buyer order and transmits to the customer. The system allows automotive retail sales representatives to provide a buyer order or sales quote instantly to the customer.

titulo: Systems and Methods tor Updating Pickup and llropott Locations tor a Vehicle
resumo: An example method includes setting an initial pickup location. The method includes causing an autonomous vehicle to navigate towards the initial pickup location. The method includes periodically generating a plurality of candidate updated pickup locations. The method includes selecting a suggested pickup location from the plurality of candidate pickup locations that achieves a benchmark for reducing one or more of a time and a distance associated with the initial pickup location for one or more of the autonomous vehicle and the client device. The method includes determining that the suggested pickup location satisfies a set of pre-update checks for limiting a number of pickup location updates. The method includes responsive to (i) selecting the suggested pickup location, and (ii) determining that the suggested pickup location satisfies the set of pre-update checks, causing the autonomous vehicle to navigate to the suggested pickup location.

titulo: SYSTEM FOR PROVIDING NON FACE-TO-FACE BASED AUTOMOTIVE REPAIR SERVICE
resumo: A non-face-to-face vehicle repair agency service provision system is provided. The system includes: at least one AS center terminal that uploads quotations corresponding to a vehicle repair application when applying for merchant registration and receiving the vehicle repair application, uploads vehicle a repair result as a report if the quotation is selected, and receives settlement for vehicle repair in real time or periodically; a user terminal that uploads a vehicle repair request, receives quotations from at least one AS center terminal, selects one of the received quotations and output the request event, receives a report, which is the result of vehicle repair, and pays the payment; and a repair agency service providing server. The repair agency service providing server includes: a registration unit registering at least one AS center terminal as an affiliate; a request unit for requesting quotations to at least one AS center terminal when a vehicle repair application is uploaded from the user terminal; a transmission unit for performing transmission to a user terminal when the quotations are received from at least one AS center terminal; a request unit that transmits a request event to the AS center terminal that has uploaded the selected quotation when the user terminal selects one quotation; a requesting unit requesting payment to the user terminal when a report is uploaded from the AS center terminal; and a settlement unit that performs settlement to the AS center terminal when payment is completed in the user terminal.

titulo: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR PROVIDING MOBILITY SERVICE BASED ON AUTONOMOUS DRIVING VEHICLE
resumo: The present invention relates to a method and system for providing a mobility service that moves the users belonging to a group such as a school, a public institution, a local government, or a company to a destination using a vehicle (especially, an autonomous driving vehicle). Each organization having a usage limit of the mobility service pays contributions, prepayment fees, or membership fees to the mobility service provider and is granted the usage limit of the mobility service in order to efficiently provide the mobility service to users thereof. The server in charge of the mobility service receives the request of the mobility service from the user of the organization and provides the mobility service within the usage limit of the user group. In another method of providing the mobility service as a deferred payment system, the server preemptively provides the mobility services at the request of each user, and then charges the usage fee to each user or user's organization for the provided mobility service. This postpaid mobility service method usually sets the cost somewhat higher than the prepaid system, thereby inducing the user group to more actively collect funds, pay membership fees, or prepayment fees. In order to provide a more efficient mobility service, an A2A sharing mobility service is proposed to reduce traffic congestion. A2A allows a plurality of users to request a mobility service including origin and destination, so that people with similar departure and arrival destinations are first shared, thereby moving from a specific region to a specific region at a time. When a large number of people share, it is processed in such a way that the amount of usage is calculated by considering the distance or time traveled by each user, and a fee is charged to the organization of each member or the amount of usage is deducted.

titulo: Intelligent vehicle repair estimation system
resumo: Intelligent vehicle repair estimating techniques include an image processing component that extracts image attributes from one or more images of a damaged vehicle, and utilizes the attributes to predict an initial set of parts that are globally-identified. Based on a jurisdiction associated with the damaged vehicle, the initial set of parts is transformed into a set of jurisdictionally-based repairs (e.g., parts, labor operations, time intervals, costs, etc.), which may be included in a draft vehicle repair estimate. An estimate refinement component iteratively modifies/refines the draft estimate using a machine-only loop nested within a larger human-machine loop, where system-generated modifications are incrementally incorporated into the draft within the smaller loop, and user-generated modifications are incrementally incorporated into the draft within the larger loop. User-facing draft estimates may be of a WYSIWYG format, and draft estimate contents and/or guidance annotations are updated, via the nested loops, in-line upon each individual/unitary user modification.

titulo: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR OBTAINING ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE
resumo: Systems and methods for obtaining roadside assistance are disclosed herein. One embodiment monitors sensor data from one or more sensors in a vehicle; detects that the vehicle is in a disabled condition based, at least in part, on the monitored sensor data; communicates automatically with a roadside assistance provider to request roadside assistance; communicates automatically with a ridesharing service provider to request a rideshare vehicle; receives roadside assistance availability data from the roadside assistance provider and ridesharing availability data from the ridesharing service provider; analyzes the roadside assistance availability data and the ridesharing availability data; and arranges automatically, with the ridesharing service provider, a pickup time for the rideshare vehicle based, at least in part, on the analysis of the roadside assistance availability data and the ridesharing availability data.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: VEHICLE SERVICE SCHEDULING
resumo: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to scheduling maintenance services for a special-purpose vehicle. An example method for scheduling a service for a special-purpose vehicle includes: obtaining usage information for the special-purpose vehicle of a user, determining, based on the usage information, that the special-purpose vehicle is due for vehicle maintenance, providing, to a computing device of a service provider, a request to schedule the vehicle maintenance for the special-purpose vehicle according to an available service method type for the vehicle maintenance, receiving, from the computing device of the service provider, an indication that the service has been scheduled, and providing, in response to the received indication the service has been scheduled, an indication to a device of the user that the vehicle maintenance has been scheduled for the special-purpose vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Incluída em CI/CE (N=96), mas reprovada em QQ (< 3,5)

titulo: PROVIDING ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE TO VEHICLES
resumo: Systems and methods provide for enabling an autonomous vehicle to provide road assistance to a vehicle. The autonomous vehicle can analyze sensor data about the vehicle captured by one or more of its sensors as it navigates a route. Based on the analysis of the sensor data, the autonomous vehicle can determine that the vehicle needs maintenance. The autonomous vehicle can proactively send a request, based on the determination, to initiate a towing mechanism to tow the vehicle. Based on receiving an acceptance of the request from the vehicle, the autonomous vehicle can activate the towing mechanism.

titulo: Used car sales brokerage system and its operation method

One method may include: receiving, based on an incoming phone call from a vehicle user device, a request for roadside service for a disabled vehicle of a vehicle user; sending a text to a phone number of the vehicle user device, wherein the text includes a link to a mobile application for roadside service requests; receiving, from the vehicle user device and via the mobile application, information associated with the request for roadside service; determining, based on a location sensor of the vehicle user device, a location of the disabled vehicle; matching a roadside service provider with the disabled vehicle based on the request for roadside service; and enabling the vehicle user to track the service status of the roadside service provider through the mobile application.

titulo: DYNAMIC PROCESSING SYSTEM FOR ROADSIDE SERVICE CONTROL AND OUTPUT GENERATION
resumo: Aspects of the disclosure relate to a dynamic processing system for roadside service control and output generation. A computing platform may receive map interface information. The computing platform may generate and display a map interface that includes a visual identifier that is centrally located on the map interface and corresponds to a location of the computing platform. The computing platform may receive a location adjustment input adjusting the map interface. The visual identifier may remain centrally located on the map interface while the location adjustment input is received and may correspond to a vehicle location after the location adjustment input is received. titulo: CROWDSOURCED ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE SERVICE PROVIDER ASSIGNMENT SYSTEM
resumo: Aspects of the disclosure provide a computer-implemented method and system for the assignment of crowdsourced roadside assistance service providers to distressed vehicles/drivers requiring roadside assistance. The methods and systems may include a roadside assistance service provider system with a collection module, an assignment module, and a feedback module. The collection module collects roadside assistance service provider information and historical statistics from real-world information and stores the information in a database that may then be analyzed using particular rules and formulas. The assignment module assigns particular roadside assistance service providers to particular distressed vehicles/drivers based on one or more characteristics. The feedback module may provide near real-time cues to the roadside assistance service provider's mobile device, such as alerting when the amount of time spent on a task exceeds a predefined threshold, flagging high priority tasks/assignments, providing a technical reference for the repair.

titulo: Ad hoc location sharing group establishment for wireless devices with designated meeting point
resumo: A system for exchanging GPS or other position data between wireless devices for purposes of group activities, child location monitoring, work group coordination, dispatching of employees etc. Cell phones and other wireless devices with GPS receivers have loaded therein a Buddy Watch application and a TalkControl application. The Buddy Watch application communicates with the GPS receiver and other wireless devices operated by buddies registered in the users phone as part of buddy groups or individually. GPS position data and historical GPS position data can be exchanged between cell phones of buddies and instant buddies such as tow truck drivers via a buddy watch server. Emergency monitoring services can be set up with notifications to programmable individuals in case an individual does not respond. Positions and tracks can be displayed. TalkControl simplifies and automates the process of joining talk groups for walkie talkie services such as that provided by Nextel.
