titulo: ONLINE INTERMEDIATING APPARATUS FOR CARGO TRANSPORTATION VEHICLE
resumo: An online intermediating apparatus for a cargo transportation vehicle comprises: a cargo vehicle order reception unit for receiving, from a consignor terminal, a required cargo vehicle order including a loading place, an unloading place, and a vehicle type; a cargo vehicle unit price determination unit, which analyzes previously operated cargo vehicle unit prices so as to calculate a basic cargo vehicle unit price corresponding to the required cargo vehicle order, and links with the consignor terminal so as to adjust the basic cargo vehicle unit price, thereby determining a final cargo vehicle unit price; and a cargo vehicle owner determination unit, which determines a cargo vehicle within a specific distance from the loading place so as to preferentially announce the final cargo vehicle unit price to a corresponding cargo vehicle owner terminal. Accordingly, the intermediating apparatus for a cargo transportation vehicle can preferentially dispatch a cargo vehicle close to the loading place on the basis of cargo information.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: RECOGNIZING ASSIGNED PASSENGERS FOR AUTONOMOUS VEHICLES
resumo: Aspects of the disclosure provide systems and methods for recognizing an assigned passenger. For instance, dispatching instructions to pick up a passenger at a pickup location are received. The instructions include authentication information for authenticating a client computing device associated with the passenger. A vehicle is maneuvered in an autonomous driving mode towards the pickup location. The client device is then authenticated. After authentication, a set of pedestrians within a predetermined distance of the vehicle are identified from sensor information generated by a sensor of the vehicle and location information is received over a period of time from the client device. The received location information is used to estimate a velocity of the passenger. This estimated velocity is used to identify a subset of set of pedestrians that is likely to be the passenger. The vehicle is stopped to allow the passenger to enter the vehicle based on the subset.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: CONTEXT AWARE STOPPING FOR AUTONOMOUS VEHICLES
resumo: Aspects of the present disclosure relate to context aware stopping of a vehicle without a driver. As an example, after a passenger has entered the vehicle, the vehicle is maneuvered by one or more processors in an autonomous driving mode towards a destination location along a route. The route is divided into two or more stages. A signal is received by the one or more processors. The signal indicates that the passenger is requesting that the vehicle stop or pull over. In response to the signal, the one or more processors determine a current stage of the route based on a current distance of the vehicle from a pickup location where the passenger entered the vehicle or a current distance of the vehicle from the destination location. The one or more processors then stop the vehicle in accordance with the determined current stage.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Estimating time to pick up and drop off passengers for improved stopping analysis in autonomous vehicles
resumo: Aspects of the disclosure provide for stopping a vehicle 100 to pick up or drop off a passenger at a location. An example methods includes maneuvering a vehicle towards the location 680. An amount of time for the passenger to enter or exit a vehicle is estimated. Once the vehicle is a predetermine distance from the location, a set of possible places to stop the vehicle are determined. For each place of the set of possible places, a corresponding threshold value is determined. For each place of the set of possible places, the estimated amount of time is compared to the corresponding threshold value. A particular one of the set of possible places is identified based on the comparisons and the vehicle at the particular one to allow the passenger to enter or exit the vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Rapid Roadside Rescue System and Payment Fulfilment Platform
depositantes: SCHAEFFER LEE THOMAS [US] | CLAYTON JAMES PATRICK [US] | DEARIEN WILLIAM JENNINGS [US] | DEARIEN II JAMES NELSON [US]
resumo: The present invention employs software, communication links and various Systems to expedite the purchase and delivery of items or services commonly used to assist stranded motorist(s) and/or disabled vehicles, manned or otherwise, through an automated Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (also identified herein as a UAV) dispatch, or by dispatching another type vehicle, and a Payment Fulfilment Platform distributed to serve a plurality of locations through the use of a communication device or plurality of communication devices. This software transmits request(s) for service by permitting a Customer, to select and/or change selections such as price, fuel grades, a particular service, parts and payment methods, as examples, prior to registering a dispatch to Vendor(s) on the System. The present invention is configured to expeditiously facilitate service(s) and/or product(s) from Vendor(s) to Customer(s).
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: METHODS AND SYSTEMS OF RETAIL AUTOMOTIVE CHECK-IN WITH A MOBILE DEVICE
depositantes: VIJAYAN JAYAPRAKASH [US] | SANKARARAMAN GURUSANKAR [US] | RAMAKOTTI ANAND [US] | BAUTISTA SIGMUNDO [US] | HOU JUSTIN ALEXANDER CHI YOUNG [US]
resumo: In one aspect, a computerized method implements a vehicle check-in process at an automobile dealership with a mobile device includes the step of detecting the presence of the vehicle. The method includes the step of obtaining a customer information and a vehicle information. The method includes the step of matching the, vehicle with a service consultant. The method includes the step of communicating an electronic message comprising a notification to the mobile device of the service consultant. The method includes the step of implementing a set of vehicle diagnostics to determine a set of vehicle repair actions. The method includes the step of generating an estimate of costs to service the set of vehicle repair actions. The method includes the step of communicating the set of vehicle repair actions and the estimate of the costs to service the set of vehicle repair actions to the mobile device of the service consultant in a format for rendering on a display of the mobile device.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: VEHICLE DISPATCH SYSTEM, VEHICLE DISPATCH APPARATUS USED FOR THE SAME, AND VEHICLE DISPATCH METHOD
resumo: If a vehicle with a user on board becomes undrivable due to insufficient power, a server uses first information, second information, and third information to set a vehicle-switching location between a current location of the vehicle and a destination, and dispatches a vehicle to the vehicle-switching location. When the vehicle joins the vehicle at the vehicle-switching location, the vehicle travels toward the destination with the user on board. After the user gets off the vehicle, the vehicle travels by self-driving toward a charging station. The first information is positional information of the charging station. The second information is information on a self-driving route of the vehicle from the vehicle-switching location to the charging station. The third information is information indicating reliability about whether or not the vehicle can arrive at the charging station by self-driving.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Used car trading system reflecting guarantee insurance for checking performance
depositantes: AUTOMANAGEMENTCOMPANY INC [KR] | KOREA AUTO CHECK CENTER INC [KR]
resumo: The present invention relates to a used car trading system reflecting a performance check guarantee insurance which calculates an expected performance check cost of the future and calculates a market price of a used car by reflecting a performance check guarantee insurance against the expected performance check cost to provide more reliable information on the market price of the used car and to reduce a burden of the performance check cost of the used car of a used car buyer thorough the performance check guarantee insurance. In addition, the used car trading system reflecting a performance check guarantee insurance comprises a performance check information input unit, a performance check information DB, an initial market price calculation unit, a performance check cost calculation unit, an insurance calculation unit, a final market price determination unit, and a used car trading unit.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Network computer system to arrange pooled transport services
resumo: A network computer system operates to receive a plurality of service requests over a given time interval, where individual service requests specify a respective target destination and a current location of a respective requester device. For each service request, the network computer system arranges a pooled transport service for the corresponding requester by selecting a service start location, and instructions for enabling the requester to travel to the service start location. The network computer system may select the service provider based on a variety of considerations, including the service start location, the current location of the corresponding service provider, and the determined time interval.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: METHODS AND SYSTEMS FOR CARPOOL SERVICES
depositantes: BEIJING DIDI INFINITY TECHNOLOGY & DEV CO LTD [CN]
resumo: A method for carpool services includes obtaining a pending transportation service requested by a service requester. The pending transportation service may include a first origin and a first destination. The method may also include determining a first pick-up location and a first departure time from the first pick-up location for the pending transportation service based on the first origin and the first destination. The method may also include determining a target service provider based on the pending transportation service and a shareable transportation service that has been accepted by the target service provider and has not been completed.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: REAL-TIME SERVICE PROVIDER PROGRESS MONITORING
resumo: A network computer system provides a service instruction to a computing device. The service instruction can include offers, such as a service request to pick up and transport a user, and recommendations, such as a movement recommendation encouraging the service provider to relocate to another geographic area. The network computer system remotely monitors the computing device to receive a current position of the computing device as the service provider travels within a geographic area. The network computer system remotely monitors the computing device to receive a service state of the service provider. The network computer system periodically determines whether the service provider is making progress towards a target of the service instruction based on the current position of the computing device and a set of progress conditions, including determining whether the service provider satisfied the set of progress conditions in response to a change in the service state.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR ALLOCATING ORDERS IN AN ONLINE ON-DEMAND SERVICE
depositantes: BEIJING DIDI INFINITY TECHNOLOGY & DEV CO LTD [CN]
resumo: Systems and methods for allocating orders in an online on-demand service are provided. A method may include: obtaining a plurality of driver-order pairs, each driver-order pair including an order to be allocated and a driver to be allocated; for each driver-order pair, determining a first matching value based at least partly on the driver and the order in each driver-order pair, obtaining an allocation factor, wherein the allocation factor is associated with a service score of the driver in each driver-order pair, and determining an adjusted matching value based on the first matching value and the allocation factor; identifying a plurality of matched driver-order pairs from the plurality of driver-order pairs, each matched driver-order pair including an order to be allocated and a corresponding matching driver, wherein the plurality of matched driver-order pairs are independent of each other and a sum of a plurality of adjusted matching values corresponding to the plurality of matched driver-order pairs is maximized; and allocating each order to the corresponding matching driver.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Análogo - Field Service Management (C4))

titulo: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR MANAGING SHARING VEHICLE
depositantes: ERICSSON TELEFON AB L M [SE] | WANG ZHANCANG [CN]
resumo: Methods and apparatus for managing shared vehicles are disclosed. One method comprises the following steps: acquiring identity information of a shared vehicle to be rented by a user, wherein the identity information comprises an identity of a service provider of the shared vehicle and a code of the shared vehicle; sending a first lease request including identity information to a shared vehicle management node, the shared vehicle management node sending a second lease request including an identity associated with a user and the code to a service provider, wherein the identity is registered with the service provider, the shared vehicle management node being capable of interacting with one or more shared vehicle service providers; the results of renting the shared vehicle are received.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR PROVIDING COST-SHARING TRANSPORTATION SERVICES
depositantes: BEIJING DIDI INFINITY TECHNOLOGY & DEV CO LTD
resumo: Systems and methods for providing cost-apportioned transportation services are provided. An exemplary system may include a memory and at least one processor coupled to the memory. When executing instructions stored on the memory, the at least one processor will perform operations. The operations may include providing a cost apportionment option to the first user. The operations may also include receiving an input from the first user to indicate a selection of the cost-sharing option. The operations may also include providing information of the boarding area to the first user based on the starting location. The operations may further include searching for a second user associated with the cost apportionment option. The operations may further include determining a pick-up location associated with the cost apportionment option. The operations may also include providing information of the boarding location to the first user.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: ON-DEMAND PREDEFINED ROUTE AUTOMATED DRIVING VEHICLE
resumo: The present invention improves vehicle design freedom by reducing energy capacity while shortening the wait time of a user 701 who has performed a use request for an on-demand established route automatic traveling vehicle 100. The on-demand established route automatic traveling vehicle 100 automatically travels, regardless of whether a passenger is on board, along a circular-connecting established route 30 which has a circular established route 31 and a connecting established route 32. The in-vehicle control device 115 of the on-demand established route automatic traveling vehicle 100 transmits its current location to a fleet control device 501, and controls a drive mechanism 112, a braking mechanism 113 and a travel-direction control mechanism 114 in a manner such that the velocity V1 in a standby state is lower than the velocity V2 in an allocation state when changing states from the standby state, which is a state where no passenger is on board and it is possible to receive an allocation command signal, to the allocation state, which is a state in which a vehicle selected for allocation to a scheduled boarding location is traveling toward the scheduled boarding location on the basis of an allocation command signal transmitted from the fleet control device 501 in response to the use request from the user 701.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Automated vehicle diagnostics and maintenance
resumo: Systems, methods, and apparatuses described herein are directed to automated vehicle diagnostics and maintenance. For example, vehicles can include sensors monitoring vehicle components, for perceiving objects and obstacles in an environment, and for navigating the vehicle to a destination. Data from these and other sensors can be leveraged to track a performance of the vehicle over time to determine a state of vehicle components, and/or changes to acceleration/deceleration and steering behavior of the vehicle over time. As issues for servicing are determined, the methods, apparatuses, and systems can include automated scheduling of vehicle maintenance. For example, based on a determination of the potential issues based on sensor data and/or user indications, vehicle maintenance can be scheduled to be performed in the field or at a service center. Technicians can be assigned to perform vehicle maintenance based on the servicing issue and/or on capabilities of the technician.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle location assistance using audible signals
depositantes: ROTHENBERG JULIET [US] | KAJA KIRAN [US] | WAYMO LLC [US]
resumo: Aspects of the present disclosure relate to using audible cues to guide a passenger to a vehicle having an autonomous driving mode. For instance, one or more processors of the vehicle may receive, from a server computing device, instructions to pick up the passenger at a pickup location. The one or more processors may maneuver the vehicle towards the pickup location in the autonomous driving mode. The one or more processors may receive a signal indicating that the passenger requests assistance locating the vehicle. The one or more processors may use the signal to generate the audible cues. The audible cues may be played by the one or more processors through a speaker of the vehicle in order to guide the passenger towards the vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Scanning and measurement system for repair of structures
resumo: A scanning measurement systems for the repair of structures that includes laser base or hub assembly. The laser base assembly serves as a single rotating head emitting a pair of laser beams, and may include a device for detecting a reflected signal (if using retroreflective targets) such as an array of photo diodes, for example, and a system for transmitting this detected signal to a computer that analyzes the signals. One use of the system is to determine the amount of deformation from a manufacturer's standards of a structure such as a vehicle frame. The system provides a compact and cost-effective way to determining the deformation of various portions of the structure and a monitoring system to display real-time data as the structure is being changed (repaired). The system can be used to show a work plan for an estimate, or a detailed report of all changes made to the structure.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: DISTRIBUTED LEDGER SYSTEM FOR CLAIM PAYOUTS
depositantes: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO [US]
resumo: Systems and methods are disclosed with respect to using a distributed ledger, such as a blockchain, for managing claim payment activity. In particular, the distributed ledger may be utilized to track the status of a claim and to track payment activity associated with the claim. For example, the distributed ledger may be utilized to track estimates, offers, settlements, and payouts relating to insurance claims relating to injuries, property damage, (e.g., to homes, automobile, personal articles, or other insured assets), and other expenses (e.g., payments to vendors such as car repair shops, car rental companies, cleaning companies, contractors, etc.).
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR MODEL-BASED ANALYSIS OF DAMAGE TO A VEHICLE
depositantes: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO [US]
resumo: A system for model-based analysis of damage to an object configured to (i) receive, from a user, a request for an estimate to repair an object; (ii) receive a plurality of images of the object to repair, including at least one image of damage to the object; (iii) analyze the plurality of images in comparison to a plurality of models; (iv) determine an amount of damage to the object based on the analysis; and (v) determine a time to repair the object based on the amount of damage.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Intelligent service system and working method thereof for front end of building
depositantes: SHANGHAI YAZHI TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.; 上海雅直科技有限公司
resumo: The invention discloses an intelligent service system for front end of a building. The system comprises a client terminal and an intelligent service system, wherein the client terminal is provided with a client and a server, both output ends of the client and the server are connected to the intelligent service system; wherein the client is provided with a user module, an information inquiry module, a position navigation module, a visitor booking module, a fault repair module, a space reservation module, a payment module, a voice recognition module and a client server, the server is provided with a database module, a work order management module, a user management module and a server control hub. The intelligent service system for the front end of the building can not only replace the traditional artificial counseling desk, lower labor and space costs, but also provide convenient, accurate and efficient consulting services. The intelligent service system for the front end of the building mainly provides visitors' appointment in the building, location based service, three-dimensional map guidance service, building interior space reservation, facility repair service and the like.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: AUTOMATISCHE HAGELSCHADENDETEKTION UND -REPARATUR
resumo: Systems and methods for automatically determining damage information and publishing said damage information are provided. A notice of loss associated with a damaged item may be received. An apparatus may analyze the damaged item to determine damage information for any damage elements present on the damaged item The damage information may be transmitted to a damage estimate server to determine a line- item cost estimate for the damaged item based on expected costs of repair for the damaged elements. The line-item cost estimate may then be presented to a repair service provider as an offer to repair the damaged item. Further, a database comprising the damage information and/or line-item cost estimate may be published to a marketplace for use by service providers.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: System, method, and computer-readable medium for comparing automatically determined crash information to historical collision data to detect fraud
depositantes: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE COMPANY
resumo: A system, method, and computer-readable medium for detecting a risk of fraud in a vehicle insurance claim by comparing the cost of repair from a treatment facility to a cost estimate for the repair. If the cost of repair from the treatment facility exceeds the cost estimate by a substantial amount, the cost of repair may be flagged as a risk of fraud and a suspicious loss indicator may be generated and transmitted to an insurance agent, a claims center, etc.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Dynamically controlling sensors and processing sensor data for issue identification
resumo: Systems and apparatuses for identifying a type of issue associated with a stopped vehicle are provided. The system may determine a current location of the vehicle and determine whether the vehicle is currently located on a highway. In some examples, the determined location of the vehicle may cause the system to transmit instructions controlling an amount or type of data collected by sensors and/or transmitted to the system. If the vehicle is on a highway, the system may then determine whether the vehicle is stopped. If so, the system may determine a reason for the vehicle stopping. Upon determining that the vehicle is stopped for an urgent reason, the system may transmit a request for roadside assistance to a service provider computing device and may generate a first type of notification. Upon determining that the vehicle is stopped for a non-urgent situation reason, the system may generate and transmit a second type of notification for display.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Geotagging location data
resumo: Systems and apparatuses for capturing an image of a vehicle for which roadside assistance is being requested are provided. The image may be captured by a mobile device and the mobile device may geotag location information to the image. The image and associated geotag location information may then be processed to determine a location of the vehicle and a roadside assistance issue for which service is being requested. The image may be further analyzed to determine a context including, a make, model and/or year of the vehicle, whether special equipment is needed to service the vehicle, whether the vehicle is located in a particular situation (e.g., within a structure, in a ditch, or the like). The information obtained from the image may be used to determine a type of service to provide to the vehicle and to identify one or more service providers to dispatch to the vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Socorro e Reboque (C1))

titulo: Ad hoc location sharing group between first and second cellular wireless devices
resumo: A system for exchanging GPS or other position data between wireless devices for purposes of group activities, child location monitoring, work group coordination, dispatching of employees etc. Cell phones and other wireless devices with GPS receivers have loaded therein a Buddy Watch application and a TalkControl application. The Buddy Watch application communicates with the GPS receiver and other wireless devices operated by buddies registered in the users phone as part of buddy groups or individually. GPS position data and historical GPS position data can be exchanged between cell phones of buddies and instant buddies such as tow truck drivers via a buddy watch server. Emergency monitoring services can be set up with notifications to programmable individuals in case an individual does not respond. Positions and tracks can be displayed. TalkControl simplifies and automates the process of joining talk groups for walkie talkie services such as that provided by Nextel.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Vehicle repair cost estimate acquisition system and method
resumo: A computer-based method for obtaining repair estimates for a vehicle, and a related network server, are provided. The method comprises receiving a vehicle identification number (VIN) over a network from a customer computer, retrieving vehicle information, associated with the VIN, from a database, sending the vehicle information and a graphical representation of the vehicle, including a plurality of selectable vehicle damage locations, over the network to the customer computer, receiving a selection of at least one vehicle damage location over the network from the customer computer, receiving at least one image of the vehicle over the network from the customer computer, storing the vehicle information, the selected damage location and the vehicle image as a repair job in a non-volatile memory or the database, and sending a notification, indicating that the new repair job is available for review, over the network to at least one repair provider computer.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Intelligent dispatching method and system for dynamic ride sharing of taxi
resumo: The invention discloses an intelligent dispatching method and system for dynamic ride sharing of a taxi.The method comprises the steps that S1, a dispatching center loads map information, determines a ride sharing expense allocation rule and updates real-time road condition information, real-time taxi position information and passenger carrying state information; S2, the dispatching center receives a ride sharing request sent by a ride sharing request sender through a client terminal; S3, the dispatching center sends the ride sharing request to a ride sharing request receiver based on a ride sharing intention agreement, sends a ride sharing vehicle matching message to the ride sharing request sender, and confirms the ride sharing intention of the two parties, wherein the ride sharing request receiver in the two parties is a passenger already on the taxi providing the ride sharing service; S4, the dispatching center pushes a ride sharing scheme dispatching message to the taxi and ride sharing request sender bound by the ride sharing agreement.By the adoption of the method and system, ride sharing intention agreement speed and success rate can be increased, development of the taxi ride sharing service is promoted, and the problem that it is hard to take a taxi can be solved to a certain degree.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: AUTOMATIC ASSESSMENT OF DAMAGE AND REPAIR COSTS IN VEHICLES
resumo: A system and method are provided for automatically estimating a repair cost for a vehicle. A method includes: receiving, at a server computing device over an electronic network, one or more images of a damaged vehicle from a client computing device; performing image processing operations on each of the one or more images to detect external damage to a first set of parts of the vehicle; inferring internal damage to a second set of parts of the vehicle based on the detected external damage; and, calculating an estimated repair cost for the vehicle based on the detected external damage and inferred internal damage based on accessing a parts database that includes repair and labor costs for each part in the first and second sets of parts.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Electric power first-aid repair vehicle scheduling system
depositantes: GAOTANG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO
resumo: The invention belongs to the field of electric power emergency equipment, and especially relates to an electric power first-aid repair vehicle scheduling system. The system comprises a central control apparatus arranged in a dispatching room and a positioning mobile terminal arranged on a first-aid repair vehicle, wherein the central control apparatus is in communicating connection with the positioning mobile terminal, and the central control apparatus comprises a display unit, a communication unit, an input unit, a road condition access unit and a control unit; and the positioning mobile terminal comprises a mobile communication unit and a GPS positioning unit. Compared to the prior art, the electric power first-aid repair vehicle scheduling system provided by the invention has the following advantages: through cooperation between the central control apparatus and the positioning mobile terminal, real-time connection and control between the dispatching room and the first-aid repair vehicle are realized, and the first-aid repair vehicle is enabled to arrive at a first-aid repair place rapidly and timely so as to complete a first-aid repair task.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: ON-ROAD VEHICLE SERVICE HANDLING METHOD
resumo: A computerized, on-road, vehicle service handling system involves, a motor vehicle having therewithin a global positioning system (GPS) navigation system, an on-board diagnostic (OBD) system, a display within the vehicle, non-transitory storage having stored therein payment information, and at least one processor. While a user is driving a vehicle between first and second locations, upon receiving a fault condition signal from the OBD system, the processor will; automatically identify, and transmit information, to multiple vehicle service locations within a limited distance radius of the path towards the second location, receive service responses, receive a selection by the user of at least two of the vehicle service locations and an order of preference thereof; send a service request with payment information to the first selected vehicle service location; and receive a communication from the first vehicle service location either accepting or rejecting the request.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Socorro e Reboque (C1))

titulo: Automatic vehicle maintenance pre-estimation system
resumo: An automated vehicle maintenance prediction system, comprising: the vehicle-mounted equipment acquires vehicle data in real time and uploads the vehicle data to the cloud platform through a network; a cloud platform, comprising: the big data processing center module classifies the big data by using a hadoop technology and provides basic parameters required by maintenance operation; and the mobile phone APP automatically sends a service report to inform the owner of the vehicle of the immediate maintenance requirement and the quotation. The system accurately calculates the vehicle maintenance information according to the multidimensional data, provides the maintenance items and the labor cost of the vehicle, the maintenance spare parts and the unit price, and the number of the spare parts, and ensures that the maintenance is clear and transparent.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Incluída em CI/CE (N=96), mas reprovada em QQ (< 3,5)

titulo: Electric car high-voltage pre-charging contactor and master contactor misconnection protection device and method
depositantes: DONGFENG XIANGYANG TOURING CAR CO LTD
resumo: Electric automobile high-voltage precharge disclosed by the invention and main contactor misconnection protective device and method; the entire car controller collection vehicle key signal of the present apparatus and method simultaneously controls pre-charge contactor and main contactor closure and disconnects; if there are precharge and main contactor harness misconnection or software output channel error configurations; inform that failure code prompts driver to instrument in time; and it records; it is not executed when powering on again and is closed main contactor instruction, do not allow mule carriage.The present invention judges whether precharge and main contactor control harness misconnection or software channel configuration error by detection DC load end voltage build-up rate during initial power-on and quotes in time, it prevents from failing to find that misconnection causes main contactor to glue repeatedly extremely in time, arcing endangers electrical safety accident to DC load capacitance heavy current impact etc..The present invention does not increase any extra cost on the basis of original device, does not increase precharge time and driver's stand-by period.

titulo: Vehicle scheduling method and vehicle scheduling system for vehicle calling platform
depositantes: XIAMEN GNSS DEV & APPLICATION CO LTD
resumo: The invention relates to a vehicle scheduling method for a vehicle calling platform. The method comprises the steps of step A, acquiring login information of passenger clients which already log in, wherein the login information comprises user information and locating information of passengers; step B, generating potential vehicle calling demand data according to the login information; step C, pushing the potential vehicle calling demand data within preset geographical position ranges to driver clients according to locating information of the driver clients and the locating information of the passenger clients. According to the vehicle scheduling method, the potential vehicle calling demands of the passenger clients which already log in are judged and are then pushed to the driver clients by the vehicle calling platform, so that the driver clients can know the potential vehicle calling demand data within the preset geographical position ranges so as to know in which directions the vehicle calling demands are stronger, drivers can go towards the directions for waiting for the calling, and the efficiency is increased.

titulo: Roof light applied to automobile maintenance, management system and method
depositantes: SHANGHAI XUANWU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses a roof light applied to automobile maintenance, a management system and a method. The roof light is used as a tracking device which is temporarily installed on a to-be-maintained automobile. When an automobile maintainer is repairing and maintaining an automobile, he/she records the specific maintenance details into the management system through the roof light, thereby achieving refined recording for the automobile maintenance. The recording results can be used for autonomous query of vehicle owners and management of maintenance workshops of maintenance factories, so service quality of the automobile maintenance and working efficiency are improved. Software is used for analyzing the data recorded by the maintenance workshops so as to obtain all kinds of statistical information including average time consumption of all maintenance states of automobiles, scheduling time consumption of technicians, car returning rate in 2 hours, car returning rate on time, counting of automobile maintenance types, counting of working durance of the technicians and the like. Through the workshop data statistical information, it is facilitated that workshop managers can know the management details of the maintenance workshops quite precisely, so working efficiency of the workshops is improved.

titulo: Intelligent quotation system for car insurance
depositantes: ANHUI BAOTENG NETWORK TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses an intelligent quotation system for car insurance. The intelligent quotation system comprises a processor, an image processing module, an image collector, a power module, a repair factory quotation module and a display, wherein the image collector and the image processing module are connected; the image processing module, the power module and the repair factor quotation module are independently coupled with the processor; the image collector is configured for collecting the image of the damaged part of an accident car; the image processing module is configured for processing obtained image information into a digital signal and inputting the digital signal to the processor; the power module is configured for providing a stable power supply for a loss assessment and claim settlement system; the processor is configured for controlling each module to harmoniously work and carry out analysis processing on the collected image information; and the repair factory quotation module comprises the quotations of at least three repair factories. By use of the intelligent quotation system for the car insurance, the problems in the prior art that a claim settlement result for a client is unreasonable since multiple subjective factors are in the presence in a car insurance claim settlement scheme are solved.

titulo: On-demand service data packet scheduling greedy algorithm based on new greedy strategy
resumo: The invention belongs to the technical field of computer wireless communication and relates to an on-demand service data packet scheduling greedy algorithm based on a new greedy strategy in an environment that a wireless network is integrated with a base station. A mathematical model of a data packet scheduling problem in the environment is established; the mathematical model comprises a time slot model and a message request model; the original problem is converted into an integer planning problem; the integer planning problem can be proved to be an NP problem; and the optimum solution of the integer planning problem cannot be found in linear time, so the problem can be converted into a 0-1 integer planning problem according to the special condition of the model, and in this way, the complexity of solving the problem can be greatly reduced. Under a practical online condition (that only partial channel condition is known and partial to-be-scheduled messages arrive currently), the greedy strategy based on a function value of a utility function provided by the invention has a better simulation effect than that of the greedy strategy based on the existing utility function, and the total benefit of distributing the messages can be improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Local loss assessment price processing method and system based on vehicle insurance intelligent loss assessment platform
depositantes: CHINA PINGAN PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD
resumo: The invention discloses a kind of local setting loss price processing method and system based on vehicle insurance intelligence setting loss platform, methods described includes：The parts price and maintenance man-hours of each vehicle are gathered and stored, and parts price is stored in accessory database, maintenance man-hours is stored in manhour database；Corresponding local parts price is calculated to each branch according to parts price in accessory database, and updates accessory database；And the maintenance man-hours in manhour database calculates corresponding local working hour expense；The setting loss amount of money is calculated according to local parts price and corresponding local working hour expense.The present invention safeguards basic data by using general headquarters' data processing module, the parts price and working hour expense of each branch are calculated using general headquarters' data processing module simultaneously, so that each branch need to only receive the setting loss price of general headquarters' transmission, support each this ground price of facility maintenance, make price more reasonable, each inter-agency price variance is solved the problems, such as simultaneously, can be preferably readily accepted by customers.

titulo: Customer-service system through liaison between vehicle maintenance companies and car rental company
resumo:
본 발명은 차량 정비 업체와 렌터카 업체의 연계를 통한 고객 맞춤형 서비스 제공 시스템에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는 고객 단말에 점검 요청 모듈, 픽업과 딜리버리 그리고 렌터카 요청 모듈을 구비하고, 차량 정비 업체와 렌터카 업체가 연계되어 고객에게 편리한 서비스를 제공함으로써, 고객이 차량의 점검이나 정비가 필요한 상황에서 픽업과 딜리버리 서비스가 제공되며, 렌터카 서비스를 원하는 고객에 한해 렌트 차량의 특정 장소 픽업으로 고객의 차량은 정비 업체로 전달되어 점검 또는 수리가 수행되고, 고객은 렌트 차량으로 개인적인 용무를 볼 수 있는 시간이 제공되며, 정비 후에는 딜리버리를 통해 고객의 차량을 인계하고 렌터카는 회수되어, 차량정비업체에서 기약없는 기다림을 없애 고객의 불만을 최소화시키고, 시간 효율성을 증대시키며, 차량정비업체와 렌터카업체의 동시 서비스 제공으로 두 업체 모두 수익을 창출하여 상생하며, 고객의 만족도는 증대시키는 장점이 있고, 점검 및 교환 알림 서비스 모듈을 구비함으로써, 고객에게 차량의 점검, 부품의 교환 주기에 따라 정기적으로 해당 고객 단말로 점검, 교환에 관한 표준 정비시간, 공임 등을 포함하는 정보 및 점검 알림 서비스를 제공받을 수 있어 누락하고 넘어갈 수 있는 차량 점검에 대비할 수 있어 고객의 차량 운행에 안전성을 향상시키는 차량 정비 업체와 렌터카 업체의 연계를 통한 고객 맞춤형 서비스 제공 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
이를 위해 본 발명은 고객의 회원 가입 시 고객의 이름, 나이, 전화번호를 포함하는 인적사항과 고객 소유 차량의 차량번호, 차종을 포함하는 차량정보와 차량의 점검, 수리 내역을 포함하는 서비스 내역과 차량의 점검 또는 수리로 인한 렌터카의 이용 내역을 저장 및 관리하고, 회원 가입한 고객 중 특정 조건에 부합하면 전문가로 인증되도록 하여 특정 권한을 부여할 수 있도록 하는 서버; 회원정보를 회원가입을 통해 서버에 등록할 수 있으며, 소유 차량의 점검, 수리를 포함하는 서비스와 렌터카 서비스를 서버로 요청할 수 있는 고객 단말; 고객 단말을 통해 서버로 요청된 수리, 점검 서비스 요청을 수신하여 해당 서비스 소요 시간, 소요 금액을 포함하는 예상 서비스 소요 내역을 서버로 전송하고, 서버를 통해 고객 단말로 예상 서비스 소요 내역을 제공되도록 하고, 고객 단말로부터 최종 서비스 승인이 완료되면 해당 서비스를 제공하도록 하는 차량정비업체 단말; 및 고객 단말의 최종 서비스 승인이 완료된 차량정비업체 단말에서 제시한 예상 서비스 소요 내역을 토대로 고객 단말을 통해 선택된 렌트하는 차종, 렌트 시간에 따른 렌터카 서비스 소요 금액을 서버를 통해 고객 단말로 전송할 수 있고, 고객 단말로부터 소요 금액에 대해 최종 서비스 승인이 완료되면 해당 서비스를 제공하도록 하는 렌터카업체 단말을 포함하고, 고객 단말은 차량정비업체 방문 날짜 및 시간을 기재하여 차량의 점검 및 수리를 서버를 통해 차량정비업체 단말로 요청할 수 있는 점검 요청 모듈, 점검 요청 모듈로 요청되었던 서비스 요청 내역에 따른 차량정비업체의 서비스 소요 시간, 소요 비용을 포함하는 서비스 제공 예정 안건에 대한 승인을 할 수 있는 점검 승인 모듈, 차량정비업체 방문 날짜, 시간 또는 렌터카 서비스를 요청할 날짜와 시간, 렌트할 차종을 선택하여 서버를 통해 렌터카업체 단말로 렌터카 서비스를 요청할 수 있는 렌터카 요청 모듈, 및 렌터카 요청 모듈로 요청되었던 서비스 요청 내역에 따른 렌터카업체 단말의 차량 렌트 서비스 소요 비용을 포함하는 서비스 제공 예정 안건에 대한 승인을 할 수 있는 렌터카 승인 모듈을 포함하며, 차량정비업체 단말은 고객 단말의 점검 요청 모듈을 통해 의뢰된 점검 또는 수리 요청에 대한 차량정비업체의 서비스 소요 시간, 소요 비용을 포함하는 서비스 제공 예정 안건을 서버를 통해 고객 단말의 점검 승인 모듈로 송부하는 정비 서비스 예정 안 송부 모듈을 포함하고, 렌터카업체 단말은 고객 단말의 렌터카 요청 모듈을 통해 의뢰된 렌터카 요청에 대한 렌터카업체의 차량 렌트 서비스 소요 비용을 포함하는 서비스 제공 예정 안건을 서버를 통해 고객 단말의 렌터카 승인 모듈로 송부하는 렌터카 서비스 예정 안 송부 모듈을 포함하며, 고객 단말, 차량정비업체 단말, 및 렌터카업체 단말은 각 단말에서 서비스 요청 및 서비스 승인이 완료되면 점검 또는 수리 날짜, 소요 시간, 렌터카 차종, 렌터카 이용 시간을 포함하는 서비스 접수 내역을 확인할 수 있도록 하는 서비스 접수 확인모듈을 제공한다.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: VEHICLE MAINTENANCE SYSTEMS AND METHODS
resumo: The present disclosure is directed to systems and methods for receiving, via a computing device, registration information from a requester that is registering with a vehicle maintenance system; allowing, via the computing device, the addition of at least one vehicle requiring a service task; for the at least one added vehicle, accepting, via the computing device, a selection of a service task; accepting, via the computing device, attributes relevant to the selected service task to form a request; sending out the request to servicers, via the computing device, within a predetermined distance; receiving, via the computing device, quotes from servicers who respond to the request; displaying the quotes to the requester via a display device of the computing device; receiving, via the computing device, a selection of a quote from a servicer; and scheduling, via the computing device, a service task with the selected servicer.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Incluída em CI/CE (N=96), mas reprovada em QQ (< 3,5)

titulo: Methods and systems for carpooling
depositantes: BEIJING DIDI INFINITY TECHNOLOGY AND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD [CN]
resumo: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for carpooling. The systems may perform the methods to obtain a first transaction request associated with a first transportation service of a first service receiver at a first time point; obtain a second transaction request associated with a second transportation service of a second service receiver at a second time point; obtain service provider information of a service provider; determine an assignment strategy associated with combining the first transportation service and the second transportation service into a third transportation service according to at least one of the first transaction request, the second transaction request, or the service provider information; and send the assignment strategy to at least one of the first service receiver, the second service receiver or the service provider.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle maintenance and repair quotation method and system
depositantes: SUZHOU JUNFENG WEIYE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD
resumo: The present invention provides a kind of vehicle maintenance Maintenance price method and system.Wherein method includes：Obtain the maintenance information and information of vehicles of vehicle；The maintenance project of vehicle is determined according to maintenance information；Judge whether there is complete corresponding relation between maintenance project and information of vehicles；If so, then determining the quotation information of the vehicle according to the corresponding relation between information of vehicles and maintenance project；If it is not, then determining its degree of correlation with information of vehicles, and quotation information when determining that vehicle carries out maintenance project according to the degree of correlation according to maintenance project.The quotation information of vehicle can not only be obtained in the case where information of vehicles and maintenance project corresponding relation are complete, and the quotation information of vehicle can be also obtained under in the case of corresponding relation is incomplete, the flexibility of vehicle quotation can be realized, solve the problems, such as that enterprise realizes the data cold start-up of internet added-time, the demand that user predicts vehicle maintenance maintenance items price is met, customer churn is reduced.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: NETWORK COMPUTER SYSTEM TO ADDRESS SERVICE PROVIDERS TO CONTACTS
resumo: According to some examples, a network computer system is provided to perform a first process to authorize a service request using a contact identifier, and to perform a second process to obtain a service parameter for addressing a service provider to a contact. Upon completion of the first process, the network computer system provides a service graphical interface for display on a mobile device of the user. The service graphical interface may display dynamic information that is based on the service parameter.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: DEVICE AND METHOD FOR CALCULATING DAMAGE REPAIR COST
depositantes: FU TAI HUA IND (SHENZHEN) CO LTD [CN] | HON HAI PREC IND CO LTD [TW]
resumo: A cost calculating device mounted on a vehicle to calculate repair cost for damage includes a number of pressure sensors, at least one flaw detector, and a processor. The pressure sensors detect changes in pressure value in collisions. The processor acquires the pressure values from each of the pressure sensors and determines whether a pressure value is greater than a preset value. The flaw detector detects damage data if the acquired pressure value is greater than the preset value. The processor further determines a damage ratio according to the damage data and a pre-stored data for undamaged vehicle, and determines a repair cost according to the damage ratio and a pre-stored table recording a relationship between different damage ratios and repair costs. A cost calculating method is also provided.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Modifying map configurations based on established location points
resumo: A method of generating map content includes receiving a service request including at least a start location from a computing device of a user, and selecting a service provider to provide the service request. The method further includes transmitting a confirmation to the computing device indicating that the selected service provider is traveling to the start location, and enabling map content to be displayed on a user interface of a service application on the computing device, the map content indicating at least the start location, and a dynamic location of the selected service provider while the selected service provider is traveling to the start location. The method also includes enabling dynamic zooming of the map content on the user interface based on the dynamic location of the selected service provider and at least one of the start location or a current location of the user.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: METHOD FOR PROVIDING COMPARATIVE ESTIMATION SERVICE OF VEHICLE SERVICING
resumo: Disclosed are a method for providing a comparative estimation service of vehicle maintenance and a server operating the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the server providing a comparative estimation service of vehicle maintenance comprises: a communication part; a storing part storing at least one vehicle number and vehicle related information corresponding to the vehicle number; an information receiving part receiving the vehicle number of a user vehicle and a vehicle maintenance estimation request of the vehicle from the user device; an information confirming part confirming the vehicle related information related to the vehicle number of the user on the storing part; and an estimation managing part transmitting the confirmed vehicle related information and the vehicle maintenance estimation request to at least one maintenance company device receiving maintenance information according to the maintenance of the vehicle from the at least one maintenance company device, respectively, generating comparative estimation information based on the received estimation information, and transmitting the information to the user device.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Orçamentação e Custos (C3))

titulo: ENHANCEMENTS INTRODUCED IN A PORTABLE MOISTURE METER DEVICE FOR REMOTE USE
resumo: The patent of invention refers to enhancements introduced in a portable moisture measuring device for remote use, as applied in agribusiness, providing quality information for management reports, with the object to obtain precise information to feed a databank, historic data, statistics and control, by means of innovative embodiment with the introduction of communications blocks (1-G), (1-H) and a visualization block (1-1) in the moisture measuring device (1), complemented by a receiver device (2) with a communications block (2-A), a communications block (2-B), an image capture block (2-C), a processor block (2-D), an image processor block (2-E), a visualization block (2-F), a memory block (2-G) with saved dedicated software, a geo-reference block (2-H) with a power supply block (2-1) and a data transmission block (2-J), allowing data computerization, with the advantages of application flexibility, also on non-portable benches which are not remotely used, clear results since they are not manipulated, quickness, maintenance and precision of results, with no human mistakes, thus guaranteeing more complete information and better process management.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: System for mediating used car sales and method for operating the same
resumo: An embodiment of the present invention provides a method for operating a system for mediating used car sales, which may comprise: a member authentication step of logging into a used car mediation server of a used car seller to perform member authentication by a used car seller terminal; a main screen displaying step of receiving information on a main screen including a used car sale request field from the used car mediation server to be displayed by the used car seller terminal; a used car sale information transmission step of receiving an input of used car sale information through a used car sale information input screen to be transmitted to the used car mediation server by the used car seller terminal; a used car sale information registration step of receiving the used car sale information to be registered on a sale notice board by the used car mediation server; a sale notice board display step of receiving information on a sale notice board screen, on which the notice board of the used car mediating server is displayed, to be displayed by a used car purchaser terminal; an estimated price transmission step of receiving an input of an estimated price from the used car purchaser to be transmitted to the used car mediation server by the used car purchaser terminal; an estimate register list creation step performed by the used car mediation server; a negotiator determination step performed by the used car mediation server; and a preferred negotiator information providing step performed by the used car mediation server.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: NETWORK SYSTEM FOR PRESELECTING A SERVICE PROVIDER BASED ON PREDICTIVE INFORMATION
resumo: A computing system detects activation of a service application on a computing device of a user and performs a selection process to select a service provider to provide service for the user before receiving a request for service from the computing device of the user. Before receiving the request for service from the computing device of the user, the system transmits service provider information corresponding to the selected service provider to the computing device of the user. Subsequent to performing the selection process, the system receives the request for service, and transmits an invitation for providing service for the user to a provider device of the selected service provider.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SERVER AND METHOD FOR PROVIDING CAR PARTS PURCHASING SERVICE
resumo: 자동차 부품 구매 서비스 제공 서버 및 방법을 개시한다. 자동차 부품 구매 서비스 제공 방법은, (A) 제품 종류, 가격, 제조사, 판매사를 포함하는 자동차 부품 세부정보 데이터베이스를 구축하는 단계; (B) 고객에 의해 선택된 자동차 부품 세부 정보인 구매조건을 만족하는 자동차 부품을 추출하고, 추출된 자동차 부품의 배송비용을 포함하는 최종 구매 가격을 연산하는 단계; (C) 자동차 부품 세부정보를 기반으로 추출된 자동차 부품과 인접하여 연결되는 연관 부품을 추출하는 단계; (D) 추출된 자동차 부품 가격과 일정금액 미만으로 차이가 나는 동일한 종류의 부품 또는 치수, 무게, 성능특성을 포함하는 부품 제원 정보가 일정 수준 이상 유사한 호환 부품을 추출하는 단계; 및 (E) 자동차 부품 세부 정보 및 차종, 부품사용기간을 포함하는 사용조건정보를 기반으로 자동차 부품 성능 정보와, 자동차 부품의 정비가 필요한 기간을 예측하는 단계; 를 포함한다.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR ALLOCATING APPOINTMENT ORDERS
depositantes: BEIJING DIDI INFINITY TECHNOLOGY & DEV CO LTD [CN]
resumo: A system includes at least one computer-readable storage medium including a set of instructions for providing an on-demand service; and at least one processor in communication with the computer-readable storage medium to execute the set of instructions to: obtain an appointment request of an on-demand service from a requester; determine a first service provider terminal set based on a first criterion; send an appointment invitation of the appointment request to the first service provider terminal set; obtain at least one response to accept the appointment invitation from a second service provider terminal set in the first service provider terminal set; determine a target service provider terminal from the second service provider terminal set based on a second criterion; establish a contractual relationship between the requester and the target service provider terminal; and send a confirmation notification of the appointment request to the target service provider terminal and the requester.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Automobile water heating control system
depositantes: NANJING TIANHUI WATER POWER INSTALLATION ENG CO LTD
resumo: The present invention provides a set of Water heating for vehicle control system, including water purifier, filter, electric pump under roof water tank, control unit, water outlet equipment, automobile inner bottom plating, car；Raw water is passed directly under car inside water purifier, is purified using water purifier under car, after control unit detection water quality reaching standard, starts electric pump, and the water after purification is delivered into roof water tank storage；After water outlet equipment is opened, the water of roof water tank memory storage flows out along pipeline.It is practical by the combination of water purifier under car and roof water tank so that people can quote the pure water totally cleaned, greatly improve the quality of the life of people at any time while using car steering.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: VEHICLE MAINTENANCE MANAGER
resumo: A method and system are provided for managing maintenance services performed on a vehicle. A service provider system receives a request from an on-board vehicle diagnostic system for charging or replacement of a battery of a rechargeable electric vehicle. Based on a set of rules from one or more databases, the service provider selects a charging facility to perform the battery charging or replacement. The service provider system, based on dynamic pricing parameters, determines a value for the battery charging or replacement and provides to the vehicle the selected charging facility location and value for the battery charging or replacement.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Orçamentação e Custos (C3))

titulo: Used car unattended Quote Management System Using Image
resumo: The present invention relates to an unmanned estimate management system for a used car by using images, which can help determine an estimate of a used car in an objective and standardized state by photographing external appearances of a vehicle into standardized images through a vehicle image measuring device and providing the images to dealers through a vehicle estimate server. The unmanned estimate management system for a used car includes a vehicle image measuring device (100) and a vehicle estimate server (200). In addition, the vehicle image measuring device (100) comprises: a vehicle photographing area (110) where a vehicle is placed; a camera supporting board (130) which is positioned in an outside place that is separated at a fixed distance from the vehicle photographing area (110); and a network camera (140) which is installed in the camera supporting board (130) in order to photograph the external appearances of the vehicle positioned in a parking lot and to transmit the photographed external appearances through wire and wireless communications. The vehicle estimate server (200) comprises: a dealer management unit (210) which manages information on dealers who calculate the price of a used car; a vehicle image receiving unit (220) which receives the external appearance images of the vehicle, provided from the network camera (140); a vehicle additional information receiving unit (230) which is provided with the additional information of the vehicle, including a driven distance of the vehicle; a vehicle information providing unit (250) which provides the external appearance images, photographed by the network camera (140), and the additional information of the vehicle to the registered dealers for checking; a vehicle estimate receiving unit (260) which receives estimates of the vehicle from the dealers; and a vehicle estimate providing unit (270) which provides the estimates of the vehicle to a client for checking.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle Component Partitioner
resumo: In one embodiment, a method includes receiving input data related to a driver's vehicle and displaying a stock image of the driver's vehicle. The stock image includes multiple selectable body parts. The method further includes receiving a selection of a particular vehicle body part on the stock image that corresponds to a damaged body part of the driver's vehicle and displaying a partitioned image of the selected vehicle body part. The partitioned image includes multiple selectable regions. The method further includes receiving a selection of one or more particular regions of the partitioned image and determining a status of the damaged body part. The status indicates either to repair or to replace the damaged body part. The method further includes determining a line-item estimate for the damaged body part of the driver's vehicle and displaying one or more costs associated with the determined line-item estimate.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Indoor mirror device with dedicated vehicle terminal for near-field communication
resumo: The present invention relates to an indoor mirror device equipped with a dedicated short-range communication vehicle terminal, in which one or more vehicle terminal antennas are installed so that the received beam direction around a roadside device base station installed at an expressway toll station is the same as the vehicle terminal receiving direction, and the antenna having the best received power is selected, the indoor mirror device including: an indoor mirror housing part attached to a vehicle through a bracket; an antenna board, which is arranged on the rear surface of the indoor mirror outer cover part and is used for arranging a plurality of receiving and transmitting antennas for receiving and transmitting signals of the roadside base station; a button and an external movable input part for selecting an operation mode of the antenna; and an information processing module which is arranged inside the indoor mirror outer cover part and is used for transmitting and receiving signals with a roadside base station through the transmitting and receiving antenna to process the charging based on an electronic charging system, wherein the information processing module selects the transmitting and receiving antenna with the largest received signal size from the plurality of transmitting and receiving antennas and processes the charging by using the selected transmitting and receiving antenna.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: CONTENT PRESENTATION FOR A NETWORK-BASED SERVICE ON A MOBILE COMPUTING DEVICE
resumo: A mobile computing device can receive a set of service progress data corresponding to a transport service for a user of the mobile computing device and can present a user interface in a first configuration that includes a first section for displaying a map and a second section for displaying information related to the transport service, including a first set of information pertaining to a service provider identified by a remote computing system. In response to detecting the user input on the user interface, the mobile computing device can pivot the user interface from the first configuration to a second configuration by expanding the second section to replace at least a portion of the first section. The expanded second section can display the first set of information and service information of the transport service using at least a portion of the set of service progress data.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Automobile insurance company designated maintenance company network system
resumo: The present invention relates to an automobile insurance company designated maintenance company network system and a method thereof. More specifically, the present invention relates to a system for performing the insurance processing of a vehicle through a network, and a method thereof. The system includes first and second database servers and a processing server.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: METHOD, SYSTEM, AND DEVICE FOR ESTIMATING A COST OF ELECTRICITY PROVIDED TO AN ELECTRIC VEHICLE AT AN ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGER
resumo: A method, system, and server for estimating a cost of electricity provided to an electric vehicle. At a server, obtaining a host geographical location and at least one charging time indicator associated with charging an electric vehicle at an electric vehicle charger. At the server, computing a price of electricity based on the host geographical location. At the server, absent a measurement of electricity provided to the electric vehicle, computing an estimated cost of the electricity provided to the electric vehicle based on one or more physical characteristics of a battery of the electric vehicle, the price of electricity and the at least one charging time indicator. Sending through a network the estimated cost of the electricity from the server towards a host computing device and a driver computing device.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: AUTOMATIC ASSESSMENT OF DAMAGE AND REPAIR COSTS IN VEHICLES
resumo: A system and method are provided for automatically estimating a repair cost for a vehicle. A method includes: receiving, at a server computing device over an electronic network, one or more images of a damaged vehicle from a client computing device; performing image processing operations on each of the one or more images to detect external damage to a first set of parts of the vehicle; inferring internal damage to a second set of parts of the vehicle based on the detected external damage; and, calculating an estimated repair cost for the vehicle based on the detected external damage and inferred internal damage based on accessing a parts database that includes repair and labor costs for each part in the first and second sets of parts.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Automated Operation of Automobile Parts eStores with Automated Selection of Parts and Dynamic Pricing
resumo: Some embodiments relate to systems and methods for selection of auto parts with automatic part selection and dynamic pricing. A system may automatically connect to a plurality of auto parts electronic stores over a wide area network and receive user input specifying parts that the user desires to purchase. The user input may include vehicle information terms that may be mapped to an auto parts vocabulary particular to each respective auto parts electronic store. Required vehicle information and specific conditions for each auto parts electronic store may be automatically completed using the auto parts vocabulary particular to each auto parts electronic store and part/pricing information may be received from at least two of the auto parts electronic stores in response. At least a subset of the part/pricing information from the at least two auto parts electronic stores may be displayed.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR ENVIRONMENTAL ANALYSIS BASED UPON VEHICLE SENSOR DATA
depositantes: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO [US]
resumo: A system for analyzing the environment of a vehicle i) receives a plurality of data from at least one sensor associated with a vehicle, such that the plurality of data includes at least one environmental condition at a location; (ii) analyzes the plurality of data to determine the at least one environmental condition at the location; (iii) determines a condition of a building at the location based upon the at least one environmental condition; (iv) determines an insurance product for the building based upon the determined condition associated with the building; and (v) generates an insurance quote for the insurance product. As a result, the speed and accuracy of insurance providers learning about potential clients and the conditions of the potential client's property and needs is increased.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle damage estimation
resumo: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for receiving an indication that a vehicle has been in a collision. Receiving vehicle information system (VIS) data from a VIS associated with the vehicle. Determining a component damage probability (CDP) for each of a plurality of components of the vehicle based on the VIS data. Determining estimated costs to replace components having respective CDPs above a threshold value. Providing an estimated total repair cost for the vehicle to a user computing device.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Used Car Pricing Based on Telematics Information
resumo: A driving data analysis and vehicle maintenance server may be configured to receive vehicle driving data corresponding to vehicle operation data of a vehicle, analyze the received vehicle driving data, determine a driving behavior associated with the vehicle, determine recommended vehicle maintenance and calculate a vehicle resale price for the vehicle. The recommended vehicle maintenance may be determined based on vehicle driving data received from the plurality of sensors over a lifetime of the vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR AUTOMOBILE MAINTENANCE SCHEDULING
resumo: An automobile maintenance application may link automobile owners with service providers and provide service reminders based on manufacturers' recommended scheduled maintenance. The automobile maintenance application may maintain maintenance records for automobiles. The automobile maintenance application may provide a system for service providers to send targeted advertisements to automobile owners in need of a service. The maintenance application may allow automobile owners to compare the prices and services of local service providers and benefit from the value associated with competition between service providers that is realized during a live or proxy auction.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Orçamentação e Custos (C3))

titulo: Systems and methods for repairing a damaged vehicle using image processing
resumo: An image processing system and method obtains one or more source images in which a damaged vehicle is represented, and performs one or more image processing techniques on the obtained images to determine, predict, estimate, and/or detect damage that has occurred at various locations on the vehicle. Specifically, the system/method generates damage parameter values based on the image-processed images, where each value corresponds to damage at a particular location on the vehicle. The image processing techniques may include generating a composite image of the damaged vehicle, aligning and/or isolating the image, applying convolutional neural network techniques to the image to generate the damage parameter values, etc. Based on the generated values, the image processing system/method determines, predicts, estimates, and/or selects a set of parts that are needed to repair the vehicle and, in some embodiments, orders the parts needed to repair the vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Automatic Damage Detection Database
resumo: Systems and methods for automatically determining damage information and publishing said damage information are provided. A notice of loss associated with a damaged item may be received. An apparatus may analyze the damaged item to determine damage information for any damage elements present on the damaged item. The damage information may be transmitted to a damage estimate server to determine a line-item cost estimate for the damaged item based on expected costs of repair for the damaged elements. The line-item cost estimate may then be presented to a repair service provider as an offer to repair the damaged item. Further, a database comprising the damage information and/or line-item cost estimate may be published to a marketplace for use by service providers.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Automatic Hail Damage Detection And Repair
resumo: Systems and methods for automatically determining damage information and publishing said damage information are provided. A notice of loss associated with a damaged item may be received. The damage information may be transmitted to a damage estimate server to determine a line-item cost estimate for the damaged item based on expected costs of repair for the damaged elements.
