titulo: Tow and emergency roadside assistance locating and tracking mobile application
depositantes: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE COMPANY
resumo: A system for providing dynamic roadside assistance coordination may include a customer mobile device or vehicle in direct, or indirect, wireless communication with an insurance provider and/or service provider remote server. The customer's device may transmit a request for roadside assistance (e.g., towing services), and a current GPS location. In response, a closest, trusted service provider vehicle may be determined, and then directed to the customer's location. For instance, a software application may receive the customer location and compare it with availability information to match the customer with a close and trusted service provider. The customer's device may receive an acknowledgement that help is on the way, and be able to track the current location of the service provider vehicle while en route. Payment for the roadside assistance may be automatically and electronically paid by the insurance provider. As a result, prompt and safe roadside assistance may be provided.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Real-time update of a mobile workforce schedule
resumo: A method, apparatus and product for real-time update of a Mobile Workforce Scheduling Problem (MWSP), which comprises: agents and tasks to be performed by the agents, wherein a schedule which solves the mobile workforce scheduling problem exists and is being implemented by the agents. The method comprising: monitoring real time information update events provided to a Business Rule Management System (BRMS), activating, by the BRMS, business rules for schedule change detection; in response to a determination that re-planning is desired, automatically determining, using business rules, a portion of the MWSP to be re-planned; providing the portion of the MWSP to a MWSP solver; receiving from the MWSP solver, a new schedule for the portion of the MWSP; and updating the schedule based on the new schedule, whereby a first portion of the schedule is updated and a second portion of the schedule remains unchanged.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Análogo - Field Service Management (C4))

titulo: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR LOCATING NEARBY VEHICLE SERVICE PROVIDERS
resumo: A system and method for locating nearby vehicle service providers is disclosed. The method includes obtaining location information from a vehicle operator's mobile device that is used in vehicle breakdown situation to make a service request. The location information is used to determine a list of nearby service providers that are capable of assisting. Preferably, pricing information is provided so that the vehicle operator can select and pay the service provider from the mobile device in order to quickly return the vehicle to operational service.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Oficinas e Manutenção (C2))

titulo: Method and system for categorizing vehicle treatment facilities into treatment complexity levels
depositantes: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE COMPANY
resumo: To generate a repair code when repairing a damaged vehicle, impact characteristics are received for the damaged vehicle and damaged vehicle parts are identified based on the impact characteristics. An extent of the damage is identified for each vehicle part and a repair code is assigned to the vehicle part based on the type of vehicle part, the type of vehicle, the extent of the damage to the vehicle part, etc. The repair code may be from a set of repair codes, where each repair code is generated for a particular type of vehicle part, type of vehicle, extent of damage to the vehicle part, etc., and each repair code corresponds to a cost estimate for repairing or replacing the damaged vehicle part. Each of the repair codes assigned to the damaged vehicle parts are provided to a treatment facility for treating the damaged vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Techniques for sharing position data between first and second devices
resumo: A system for exchanging GPS or other position data between wireless devices for purposes of group activities, child location monitoring, work group coordination, dispatching of employees etc. Cell phones and other wireless devices with GPS receivers have loaded therein a Buddy Watch application and a TalkControl application. The Buddy Watch application communicates with the GPS receiver and other wireless devices operated by buddies registered in the users phone as part of buddy groups or individually. GPS position data and historical GPS position data can be exchanged between cell phones of buddies and instant buddies such as tow truck drivers via a buddy watch server. Emergency monitoring services can be set up with notifications to programmable individuals in case an individual does not respond. Positions and tracks can be displayed. TalkControl simplifies and automates the process of joining talk groups for walkie talkie services such as that provided by Nextel.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Automatic mahjong machine remote management system
resumo: The utility model provides an automatic mahjong machine remote management system belongs to the automatic control engineering field. It has solved many mahjong machine scheduling problems of prior art management and control simultaneously. This automatic mahjong machine remote management system includes an at least automatic mahjong machine and remote server, links to each other and can carry out data interchange through wireless and/or wired communication mode between automatic mahjong machine and the remote server, thereby be connected with on the automatic mahjong machine and control controlled module that automatic mahjong mechanic did and/or ability automatic locking when satisfy the settlement condition according to received remote server's instruction the automatic locking module of automatic mahjong machine. This automatic mahjong machine remote management system's advantage lies in: reasonable in design, automatic mahjong machine and remote server's combination has realized having saved administrative time and human cost to the management and control of many automatic mahjong machines, has improved managerial efficiency.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: car body damage quote mobile application.
resumo: This invention relates to online car body damage quote with smartphone. Quotes are requested from proximate repair shops based on brand and model, colour and photos of the car damage.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Incluída em CI/CE (N=96), mas reprovada em QQ (< 3,5)

titulo: Real time Tow Truck business model
resumo: Abstract (57) An application for booking a tow truck via a mobile device. User is able to choose a tow truck service based on availability, proximity, price and speed of service. Tow truck businesses that are part of the system get increased exposure to customers and jobs when they are available.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Socorro e Reboque (C1))

titulo: On -vehicle cell -phone control system and use car of system
resumo: The utility model discloses a kind of vehicle carried mobile phone control system and use the automobile of this system, this system comprises the Vehicle Controller for being connected with mobile phone by wireless communication module, the signal input part of Vehicle Controller and the on-vehicle information Acquire and process model calling for obtaining the traffic information that vehicle self information and GPS locate, the control output end of this Vehicle Controller is connected with the voice module for prompting information of road condition, information of vehicles and incoming information, and the control input end of Vehicle Controller is connected with the console switch for carrying out corresponding control to mobile phone.Vehicle carried mobile phone control system of the present utility model can Real-time Obtaining vehicle self and traffic information, reported by voice module, remind driver's careful driving, and then quote incoming person's information, driver realizes on-hook according to incoming information respectively by control switch and replys note two kinds of functions of setting, avoid driver in startup procedure to be answering cell phone and diverting one's attention, to improve travel safety.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Automobile after-sales market online and offline service system
depositantes: SUZHOU FRUIT SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD
resumo: The invention relates to an automobile after-sales market online and offline service system. An automobile fault diagnosis instrument is connected to an automobile OBD interface; a user downloads an app and connects the app to the diagnosis instrument; the diagnosis instrument detects an automobile fault and raises the alarm in real time to remind the user, and offers a maintenance service corresponding to the fault to the user; the user sends the fault information through the app to peripheral maintenance points for inquiry; maintenance shopkeepers with the app downloaded offer a quote for the fault when seeing the inquiry information; and the user selects a maintenance point and goes to the place under navigation of the app to repair the fault. With the system, the fault of an automobile can be detected accurately, users are prevented being fooled by businesses, benign competition makes businesses lower the artificially high maintenance cost, users send a request to the surrounding businesses through 'bidding', ask the businesses to offer a quote and selects the most appropriate business based on the quote offered by the businesses, the star level and comments to repair and maintain the automobile, and therefore, users can rest assured.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR EVALUATING VALUE OF USED CAR
resumo: The present invention provides a method and an apparatus for suggesting a correct estimated price of a used car in a way quantized with a regression analysis. The method comprises the steps of: receiving used car sales data including a selling price of the used car and a value of a continuous variable corresponding to the selling price; performing a linear conversion of the continuous variable; receiving information regarding the used car to be evaluated; calculating an estimated price of the used car by using a result of the regression analysis and the information regarding the used car to be evaluated; converting the data for the used car to be evaluated and used car sales data into coordinates of a multidimensional space; searching a car similar to the used car to be evaluated; and calculating an indirect estimated price of the used car using a relative distance of the used car sales data in the multidimensional space.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Alarm condition rescue method and apparatus thereof
resumo: The invention relates to an alarm condition rescue method. The method comprises the following steps of acquiring an alarm condition position coordinate; according to the alarm condition position coordinate, acquiring reinforcement vehicle information, wherein the reinforcement vehicle information includes a current position coordinate of a reinforcement vehicle; acquiring road network map layer data, and according to the road network map layer data, acquiring at least one path information from the current position coordinate of the reinforcement vehicle to the alarm condition position coordinate; according to the at least one path information, determining an optimum route. By using the method, according to the alarm condition position coordinate, the reinforcement vehicle information is acquired so that supplement of a rescue vehicle is flexible and timely.  Simultaneously, through combining the road network map layer data, the optimum route from a reinforcement vehicle position to the alarm condition position is made so that the reinforcement vehicle can rapidly arrive at the alarm condition position according to the optimum route. In addition, the invention also provides an alarm condition rescue apparatus.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: CAR SHOP MANAGEMENT SYSTEM USING SMARTPHONE APPLICATION
resumo: The present invention relates to a system, which allows a smart phone of a client to recognize a Bluetooth terminal installed in a repair shop when the client visits the repair shop by using a smartphone application, allows the Bluetooth terminal to report the client′s visit to a server, receives client information stored in the server through a management system in the repair shop, provides the repair history and repair pictures of a client vehicle and preventive maintenance parts of which the replacement time comes through a computer monitor of the repair shop or a large screen which the client can view, provides jobs left for another time when the client visited the repair shop last time, and allows the repair shop to quickly grasp the state of the client′s vehicle, thus repairing the vehicle and estimating for the repair of the vehicle quickly and accurately. The system can enable a rapid communication between the client and the repair shop and help to repair the vehicle by grasping all information on the vehicle while the client′s vehicle visits the repair shop.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: USER INTERFACE FOR PROVIDING PRICE OF AT LEAST ONE USED CAR
resumo: The present invention relates to a user interface for providing market price information of a used car. Since a user can intuitively recognize market price information of a used car in a visual aspect, user convenience can be improved. The user interface for providing market price information of a used car comprises: a central selection unit for selecting the type of vehicles by direction selection; a first class display unit for displaying market price information of a corresponding vehicle with a pie chart shape; a second class display unit for displaying production year information to select a production year of the corresponding vehicle with the pie chart shape; a class selection unit including a class modification unit and a third class display unit; and a market price range display unit for displaying a market price range according to a state of the selected type of the vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Method and System for On-line Vehicle Service
resumo: Abstract A system and a method for on-line vehicle service are provided. The system for on-line vehicle service may comprise: an electronic tag, a client and a server, wherein the electronic tag is mounted in a vehicle, and is used for storing a vehicle status; the client comprises: a reader, 5 configured to read the vehicle status stored in the electronic tag; and a transceiver, configured to send the vehicle status and vehicle information; the server equipped in the server located in an automobile 4S shop comprises: a receiver, configured to receive the vehicle status and the vehicle information; a calculator, configured to calculate vehicle maintenance items and corresponding costs based on the received vehicle status; and a feedback unit, configured to transmit the vehicle 10 maintenance items and the corresponding costs back to the client. According to this invention, the vehicle information about the maintenance is confirmed on line, rather than using a manual confirmation in the automobile 4S shop, thereby improving the customer experiences, reducing the burden of the staff in the automobile 4S shop, and reducing the cost for employing the staffs in the automobile 4S shop. Meanwhile, the technical solution of this invention greatly improves the 15 customer experiences, and therefore increases the attractiveness of the automobile 4S shop to customers. titulo: AUTONOMOUS DRONE SERVICE SYSTEM
resumo: An autonomous drone service system controls at least one drone vehicle configured to autonomously navigate along a flight path to provide one or more services requested by a user. The system includes an electronic service provider device to receive at least one service request signal generated by a user device. The request signal indicates at least one requested service provided by the drone service system and location or locations associated with the requested services. The electronic service provider device that automatically maps the at least one requested service to the at least one drone vehicle, and commands the at least one drone vehicle to perform the service request at the one or more locations.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: GUIDED VEHICLE REPAIR ESTIMATE SYSTEM AND METHOD
resumo: A device and method that provides a predictive list of parts to be repaired for a damaged vehicle. The apparatus includes an interface that receives input regarding damage to the damaged vehicle, a predictive model that generates at least one part that is to be repaired from the input, and an output display that displays said at least one part that is to be repaired.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: BROWSER EXTENSION FOR CAPTURING VEHICLE INFORMATION FROM WEBPAGE FOR GENERATING INSURANCE RATE QUOTE
depositantes: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO [US]
resumo: A browser extension for facilitating a user of a mobile device obtaining an insurance rate quote for a vehicle (or other property, real or personal) from an insurance provider, wherein vehicle information identifying the vehicle is provided on a webpage. The browser extension searches the webpage for vehicle information identifying one or more vehicles. The user is prompted to select the vehicle(s) for which the insurance rate quote is desired from a list of the vehicles is found on the webpage. The browser extension passes the vehicle information for the selected vehicle to a program application. The program application obtains user information useful for generating the insurance rate quote. Based upon the vehicle information and the user information, the program application generates and displays for the user the insurance rate quote for the vehicle. Additionally, the user may be similarly offered a loan and/or an extended warranty for the vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: VEHICLE MAINTENANCE APPARATUS AND METHOD UTILIZING REGIONAL HUB
depositantes: KOREA INFORMATION AND ENV TECH RES ASS [KR]
resumo: Disclosed according to the present invention are an apparatus and a method for vehicle maintenance utilizing a regional hub. According to the present invention, the apparatus and the method for vehicle maintenance utilizing a regional hub relate to a system to execute a vehicle repair using multiple vehicle repair centers located in each region. The system extracts at least one vehicle repair center located within a selected distance from a position in which a repair is requested among the multiple vehicle repair centers when data on candidate positions of repair including a request of vehicle repair is received from a call center server, and supports a user to receive a repair service at the nearest vehicle repair center and a vehicle repair center determined as the best repair service provider by transmitting a dispatch requesting message to the vehicle repair center having the highest repair quality rank out of at least one vehicle repair center after calculating scores in accordance with existing repair history for at least one vehicle repair center.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Incluída em CI/CE (N=96), mas reprovada em QQ (< 3,5)

titulo: Automatic calculation of car repair quote system and method
resumo: The present invention relates to an automatic calculation system for a vehicle repair estimate and a method for the same. The automatic calculation system for a vehicle repair estimate enables an owner to accurately estimate a vehicle repair estimate sum by recognizing an accident part of a vehicle by using an image photographed by a photographing unit (for example, a camera and a smartphone) and automatically calculating and providing a repair estimate based on the recognized image. The automatic calculation system for a vehicle repair estimate includes: an image obtaining unit obtaining and providing the image on an accident vehicle; a vehicle repair estimate calculating device recognizing a repair part by extracting the repair part from the image provided by the image obtaining unit, setting the repair part by linking components of the recognized repair part to a corresponding vehicle component which is registered in advance, and calculating and providing a vehicle repair part recognizing result and the vehicle repair estimate; and a user terminal requesting the calculation of the repair estimate on the accident vehicle by being connected to the vehicle repair estimate calculating device via a network and displaying the image on the vehicle repair part and vehicle repair estimate provided from the vehicle repair estimate calculating device on a screen.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Orçamentação e Custos (C3))

titulo: Automatic calculation of car tuning quote system and method
resumo: The present invention relates to an automatic calculation system for a tuning estimate of a vehicle and a method for the same. The automatic calculation system for a tuning estimate of a vehicle registers a tuning product by three-dimensionally modeling an image (a vehicle image and a tuning product image) photographed by a photographing unit (for example, a camera and a smartphone) and analyzing a finite element. The automatic calculation system for a tuning estimate of a vehicle virtually tunes a real vehicle by three-dimensional simulation in a tuning estimate request and examines tuning safety in order for an owner to accurately estimate a vehicle tuning estimate value amount. The automatic calculation system for a tuning estimate of a vehicle includes: a user terminal requesting the vehicle tuning estimate via a tuning estimate application and three-dimensionally displaying the provided vehicle tuning estimate on a screen; and a vehicle tuning estimate calculation device performing tuning based on the three-dimensional simulation in accordance with the tuning estimate request of the user terminal and providing the tuning estimate to the user terminal by calculating the three-dimensional tuning estimate.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: VEHICLE ESTIMATING SYSTEM THAT PROVIDES FEATHER PRIME AND BLOCK DATA
resumo: An apparatus and method for generating a repair estimate. The apparatus includes an input for receiving user input and a processor that generates one or more estimate screens with an FPB material field and an FPB labor time field. The processor receives input related to the FPB material and input related to the FPB labor time fields, and generates a repair estimate that list the FPB material input and the FPB labor time input.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: A matching system for on-demand service schedule management
resumo: A system is described for an on-demand service schedule matching management, enable customer to request services from multiple suppliers based on their service type and availability. System includes: Process on-demand service with requested schedule from customer. List of the suitable supplier can be filtered through the system based on matching the supplier service type and availability. Customer may select the available supplier from the list to proceed booking arrangement. Selected available supplier may choose to accept or decline the service request. Supplier upon accepting the request from customer, the system will update the availability of the supplier. System is design to help customer reduce the time and cost from searching and locate suitable supplier, also help supplier confirm task acceptance with availability management to help create more on-demand service matching opportunities.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Big data cloud system for vehicle maintenance, roadside assistance and comprehensive services
resumo: The invention relates to a big data cloud system for vehicle maintenance, roadside assistance and comprehensive services. The big data cloud system comprises cameras, scanners and terminal servers which are mounted in plurality of repairing plants in each area. Vehicle information which is output from the camera of each repairing plant in each area and vehicle owner identity information that is output from the scanner are transmitted to terminal network equipment through the terminal server. Each set of terminal network equipment transmits the information to main network equipment through Internet. The main network equipment transmits the information to a data storage server set. In the big data cloud system, a vehicle owner can transmit asking-for-help information through a mobile terminal for requesting roadside assistance or other comprehensive services, such as accommodation, dining and playing.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: INTELLIGENT TOWING SERVICE INTERMEDIATION SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR PROCESSING SAME
resumo: Disclosed is an intelligent towing service intermediation method comprising the steps of: (a) receiving a service request including location information and towing destination information from a terminal of a towing service user; (b) subdividing a route section between a departure and a destination into a plurality of element sections according to whether a service is provided for free and/or the availability of a service, and mapping different towing service providers to each element section so as to generate a cost-effective route plan for supporting a towing relay service; (c) transmitting towing command information to towing service providers assigned according to the cost-effective route plan; and (d) transmitting information on the cost-effective route plan to the terminal of the towing service user.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Socorro e Reboque (C1))

titulo: USAGE-BASED VEHICLE LEASING AND OTHER SERVICES WITH A DONGLE MODULE
depositantes: CONTINENTAL INTELLIGENT TRANSPORTATIONS SYSTEMS LLC [US] | CONTINENTAL INTELLIGENT TRANSPORATION SYSTEMS LLC [US]
resumo: An automated system for driver scoring and reporting maintains a performance history associated with particular drivers in a stored database of multiple drivers. An automated system tracks actual operation of the vehicle and maintenance performed on the vehicle to determine an estimated percentage of life remaining for the vehicle. The backend database stores the records of multiple vehicles. Services, such as i) usage-based vehicle leasing and ii) a certified life-expectancy of a vehicle, can use raw vehicle data and enriched vehicle data captured via a dongle module in the vehicle to determine the expected life remaining of that vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: ON-DEMAND AND ON-SITE VEHICLE MAINTENANCE SERVICE
resumo: A cloud based system for vehicle maintenance to a target vehicle includes a cloud based on-site vehicle maintenance service. A GPS-based proximity module in a first server associated with the on-site vehicle maintenance service receives both current GPS coordinates of a service vehicle associated with a first maintenance and service provider and current GPS coordinates of the target vehicle of a customer. The current GPS coordinates are used for at least one maintenance and service delivery session with the target vehicle of the customer. The vehicle maintenance and service operation includes 1) directing the service vehicle to the target vehicle of the customer, 2) opening and/or unlocking the target vehicle of the customer, 3) ensuring the one or more vehicle maintenance and service jobs have been performed, and 4) ensuring the target vehicle of the customer is closed and locked.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: A SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR ARRANGING ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE AMONGST PARTIES THROUGH USE OF A MOBILE DEVICE
resumo: A computer implemented method for a collaborative roadside assistance service hereby referred to as Ayuda, for reference purposes only. This application is developed to run on the iOS, Android operating system and/or its successors. The mobile application connects customers who require roadside assistance to the closest eligible helper who is able and willing to assist.  The customer may request help for one of the following roadside services: .cndot.    Towing .cndot.    Extrication .cndot.    Emergency Gas .cndot.    Flat Tire .cndot.    Battery Service .cndot.    Extreme Weather Condition .cndot.    Bicycle Help .cndot.    Mechanical First Aid The help request will be sent to a pool of eligible helpers who are qualified to assist in the requested service. Helpers that are closer to the site of service are prioritized by sending them the request first.  Customers are electronically charged a fee by Ayuda and helpers are also paid by Ayuda eliminating the need for a financial transaction between the helper and customer.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR PROVIDING AN INTEGRATED PUBLIC AND/OR PRIVATE TRANSPORTATION SERVICE
resumo: Embodiments of a transportation services platform that allows transit service provider and third party transportation providers to access the platform and provide rules that apply to a state-based view of a route provided to a user application executed by the user device. The application executed by the users device uses the rules to perform actions as a route is presented to a user via a user interface.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: System and method for obtaining vehicle servicing, repairs and parts pricing.
resumo: In order to obtain multiple pricing for vehicle parts, servicing or repair, a smart phone application is used to transfer specific vehicle data to a website, which allows a plurality of vehicle repair service providers (VRSPs) to review the information, and provide pricing. In at least some embodiments, one or more of the following types of processes are involved. The user retrieves VIN data through scanning, wireless or manually entering. The Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) is transferred to the VRSP. The VRSP can review previous VIN information for that vehicle. The requested selects their preference for date and time of service/repair, and the VRSP must accept this date if making an offer. The VRSP provides a one-time cost response. The requester handles responses via a smart phone application. The smart phone application database maintains all VIN data for that vehicle, for future advertising purposes, and can transfer to new owners.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Orçamentação e Custos (C3))

titulo: CONTROLLING AUTONOMOUS VEHICLES IN CONNECTION WITH TRANSPORT SERVICES
resumo: Systems for controlling autonomous vehicles are disclosed. Using one or more location detection resources, the system can receive vehicle data from an autonomous vehicle as the autonomous vehicle progresses towards a pickup location of a requesting user and receive requester data from a mobile computing device of the requester. The system can determine when the autonomous vehicle and the requester are at or within a threshold distance of the pickup location. Subsequently, the system can instruct the autonomous vehicle to perform one or more non-driving operations to facilitate use of the autonomous vehicle by the requester.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: DAMAGE ASSESSMENT AND REPAIR BASED ON OBJECTIVE SURFACE DATA
resumo: A scanning system captures a digital surface representation of an automotive vehicle that can be used to objectively assess hail damage and estimate repair costs. The system may also be used to administer downstream repair functions such as securing approvals from entities participating in the damage assessment and repair process and evaluating the adequacy of any physical repairs that have been performed.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: A USED CAR QUATES AND SALES INFORMATION DISPLAY METHOD
resumo: The present invention relates to a method for confirming a quotation and a used car for sale on a one-click batch display basis. The method for confirming a quotation and a used car for sale on a one-click batch display basis comprises the following steps of: inputting an execution command for executing a quotation and an item for sale confirmation program (S112); when the execution command for the program is inputted, displaying a list of model names of all used cars to be checked for a quotation and a page number having model names of the corresponding used cars, on one screen (10) (S114); selecting a model name of a used car desired to be checked for a quotation from the list of model names of all used cars to be checked for a quotation (S116); and when the model name of the used car desired to be checked for a quotation is selected, searching for a page number having the selected model name, and collectively displaying, on one screen (20), the price of a new car and the price of a used car by each grade, detail model name and model type for the model name of the selected used car on the searched page number (S118). Accordingly, the entire quotation information of a desired used car can be collectively confirmed on one screen with a single click.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Method for achieving automobile diagnosis and work project determination in network questionnaire mode
resumo: The invention discloses a method for achieving the automobile diagnosis and work project determination in a network questionnaire mode. The method comprises the steps that a car owner logs in an automobile diagnosis cloud server to obtain a questionnaire; the automobile diagnosis cloud server obtains the actual condition information of a car in a mode that the car owner fills in the questionnaire, and correspondingly searches and analyzes an automobile diagnosis cloud server database according to the car condition information in the questionnaire; the diagnosis result and work project are correspondingly extracted if there is the same car condition information, and the server correspondingly pushes the diagnosis result to a mobile terminal of the car owner; a mobile terminal of a maintainer is correspondingly used for diagnosis and analysis of the car condition information if there is no identical car condition information, and a new diagnosis result and work project are generated; and the correspondingly server pushes the diagnosis result to the mobile terminal of the car owner, and completes the request of work project maintenance. The method greatly meets the demands for the timely and accurate understanding of the actual car conditions during car diagnosis, and avoids the excessive maintenance.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: DIAGNOSTIC DATA VISUALIZATION METHODS
resumo: An apparatus includes an aggregation circuit, an analysis circuit, and a data visualization circuit. The aggregation circuit is structured to receive at least one of (i) vehicle data indicative of a least one operating characteristic of one or more vehicles from the one or more vehicles and (ii) technician data indicative of at least one diagnostic characteristic of the one or more vehicles representative of a technician servicing event. The analysis circuit is structured to interpret the at least one of the vehicle data and the technician data to facilitate remote monitoring of the one or more vehicles. The data visualization circuit is structured to receive a display request for providing a graphical user interface to a user display device. The display request includes configurable options for providing the graphical user interface in a desired graphical format including the at least one of the vehicle data and the technician data.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: AUTONOMOUS VEHICLE SERVICES
resumo: The technology relates to facilitating transportation services between a user and a vehicle having an autonomous driving mode. For instance, one or more server computing devices having one or more processors may information identifying the current location of the vehicle. The one or more server computing devices may determine that the user is likely to want to take a trip to a particular destination based on prior location history for the user. The one or more server computing devices may dispatch the vehicle to cause the vehicle to travel in the autonomous driving mode towards a location of the user. In addition, after dispatching, the one or more server computing devices sending a notification to a client computing device associated with the user indicating that the vehicle is currently available to take the passenger to the particular destination.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: TOW AND EMERGENCY ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE LOCATING AND TRACKING MOBILE APPLICATION
depositantes: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO [US]
resumo: A system for providing dynamic roadside assistance coordination may include a customer mobile device or vehicle in direct, or indirect, wireless communication with an insurance provider and/or service provider remote server. The customer's device may transmit a request for roadside assistance (e.g., towing services), and a current GPS location. In response, a closest, trusted service provider vehicle may be determined, and then directed to the customer's location. For instance, a software application may receive the customer location and compare it with availability information to match the customer with a close and trusted service provider. The customer's device may receive an acknowledgement that help is on the way, and be able to track the current location of the service provider vehicle while en route. Payment for the roadside assistance may be automatically and electronically paid by the insurance provider. As a result, prompt and safe roadside assistance may be provided.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Socorro e Reboque (C1))

titulo: Three dimensional image scan for vehicle
resumo: Systems and methods provide for an automated system for generating one or more three dimensional (3D) images of a vehicle and/or a baseline image for that vehicle. The system may receive 3D images of a plurality of vehicles of a same type (e.g., same make, model, year, etc.) and generate a 3D image of a baseline vehicle for vehicles of that same type based on 3D images of the plurality of vehicles of the particular type. The system may use a 3D image of the baseline vehicle to determine a characteristic of another vehicle, such as a modification made to the vehicle, damage to the vehicle, cost to repair the vehicle or replace parts of the vehicle, a value of the vehicle, an insurance quote for the vehicle, etc. In some aspects, the 3D images may optionally comprise 3D point clouds, and 3D laser scanners may be used to capture 3D images of vehicles.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: System controlled by data bearing records
resumo: A system controlled responsive at least in part to data read from data bearing records is operative to cause vehicle repair parts to be determined and furnished. Data read by a reader from a tag associated with a damaged vehicle is used to determine vehicle identifying data. A repair estimate calculation circuit (RECC) operates responsive to the read data to produce a needed parts record (NPR). The records produced by the RECC are operative to cause a vehicle repair entity (VRE) to be furnished the vehicle repair parts.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Broadcasting vehicle and insurance information to mobile devices in the vicinity of a vehicle
depositantes: STATE FARM MUTAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE COMPANY [US] | STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO [US]
resumo: A system for transmitting and receiving vehicle, insurance, and financial information comprises a communication beacon, a vehicle control system, and a mobile electronic device. The communication beacon is associated with one of a plurality of vehicles and transmits information about the associated vehicle. The vehicle control system is associated with one of the vehicles, and configured to transmit information about the associated vehicle after a trigger event occurs. The mobile electronic device includes a communication element and a processing element that executes a software application configured to receive vehicle information from the communication beacon or the vehicle control system (both of which may be Bluetooth® enabled and/or include an accelerometer), transmit vehicle information to a computer server, receive term information regarding an insurance quote or auto loan, the term information determined by the server based upon the vehicle information, and display the term information on a screen to a customer.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Role assignment for enhanced roadside assistance
resumo: An enhanced roadside assistance system may modify service provider role assignments in roadside assistance accounts. The system may be configured to modify a service provider role assignment associated with a roadside assistance account by assigning a service provider role to each of a plurality of service providers. The system may receive a service request from a roadside assistance device for an individual associated with a vehicle. The system may identify one or more of the service providers offering a type of service indicated by the service request. Based on the service provider role assignment, the system may transmit a notification of the service request to at least one of a plurality of computing devices associated with one of the service providers. The system may receive a response comprising one or more discounts and transmit the response to the roadside assistance device for presentation to the individual.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Orçamentação e Custos (C3))

titulo: SYSTEM AND COMPUTER-IMPLEMENTED METHOD FOR USING IMAGES TO EVALUATE PROPERTY DAMAGE CLAIMS AND PERFORM RELATED ACTIONS
depositantes: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO [US]
resumo: A system and method for processing an insurance claim for damage to a vehicle, home, or other property. Image data of the damaged property may be examined, with an insured's permission or affirmative consent, by a processor using a machine learning technology to determine the amount of damage; determine a repair or replacement cost; generate a proposed insurance claim and initiate processing the insurance claim; and perform additional actions relevant to handling the insurance claim or assisting the claimant. The additional actions may include estimating a repair or replacement cost and time; identifying a repair service; determining an availability of repair parts and appointments; identifying one or more salvage services; identifying settlement options; and identifying temporary replacement property (e.g., rental vehicles or hotel rooms). The processor may receive and account for GPS location of the damaged property or the insured's mobile device, and/or the forecasted weather for that location.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Roadside assistance service provider assignment system
resumo: Aspects of the disclosure provide a computer-implemented method and system for the assignment of roadside assistance service providers such as tow trucks to distressed vehicles/drivers requiring roadside assistance. The methods and systems may include a roadside assistance service provider system with a collection module, an assignment module, and a feedback module. The collection module collects roadside assistance service provider information and historical statistics from real-world information and stores the information in a database that may then be analyzed using particular rules and formulas. The assignment module assigns particular roadside assistance service providers to particular distressed vehicles/drivers based on one or more characteristics. The feedback module may provide near real-time cues to the tow truck driver's mobile device, such as alerting when the amount of time spent on a task exceeds a predefined threshold, flagging high priority tasks/assignments, providing a step-by-step checklist for the repair.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR VEHICLE MAINTENANCE UTILIZING REGIONAL HUB
resumo: Disclosed according to the present invention are an apparatus and a method for vehicle maintenance utilizing a regional hub. According to the present invention, the apparatus and the method for vehicle maintenance utilizing a regional hub relate to a system to execute a vehicle repair using multiple vehicle repair centers located in each region. The system extracts at least one vehicle repair center located within a selected distance from a position in which a repair is requested among the multiple vehicle repair centers when data on candidate positions of repair including a request of vehicle repair is received from a call center server, and supports a user to receive a repair service at the nearest vehicle repair center and a vehicle repair center determined as the best repair service provider by transmitting a dispatch requesting message to the vehicle repair center having the highest repair quality rank out of at least one vehicle repair center after calculating scores in accordance with existing repair history for at least one vehicle repair center. titulo: AUTOMATIC DAMAGE DETECTION AND REPAIR ASSESSMENT
resumo: Systems and methods for automatically detecting the damage that has occurred to an item and assessing the repairs needed to restore the item are provided. A notice of loss associated with a damaged item may be received. An apparatus may analyze the damaged item to determine damage information for any damage elements present on the damaged item. The damage information may be transmitted to a damage estimate server to determine a line-item cost estimate for the damaged item based on expected costs of repair for the damaged elements. The line-item cost estimate may then be presented to a repair service provider as an offer to repair the damaged item.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Apparatus and method for automated vehicle roadside assistance
resumo: A computer readable storage medium includes executable instructions to receive from a mobile device a request regarding a stranded vehicle. The request is processed to determine the location of the stranded vehicle. Additional information regarding the stranded vehicle may be retrieved. The location of the stranded vehicle and the additional information may be communicated as a dispatch request. The location of the stranded vehicle relative to a dispatched vehicle is delivered to the mobile device.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Apparatus and method for obtaining content on a cellular wireless device based on proximity
resumo: A system for exchanging GPS or other position data between wireless devices for purposes of group activities, child location monitoring, work group coordination, dispatching of employees etc. Cell phones and other wireless devices with GPS receivers have loaded therein a Buddy Watch application and a TalkControl application. The Buddy Watch application communicates with the GPS receiver and other wireless devices operated by buddies registered in the users phone as part of buddy groups or individually. GPS position data and historical GPS position data can be exchanged between cell phones of buddies and instant buddies such as tow truck drivers via a buddy watch server. Emergency monitoring services can be set up with notifications to programmable individuals in case an individual does not respond. Positions and tracks can be displayed. TalkControl simplifies and automates the process of joining talk groups for walkie talkie services such as that provided by Nextel.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Vehicle maintenance appointment method and system
resumo: The invention discloses a vehicle maintenance appointment method and system. The method comprises the following steps: a user logs in an intelligent mobile client side and builds communication connection with a server end; the user chooses an appointment time interval, a service type and service personnel and sends an appointment request to the server end; the server side receives the appointment request and judges whether the time interval exceeds the upper limit of service, if so, the server side feeds back to the mobile client side to remind the user to change the appointment request, and otherwise, an appointment is successful; after the success of the appointment, the server side notifies the appointed service personnel, and the service personnel notify a warehouse manager of preparing articles correspondingly according to the service type appointed by the user, and notify a maintenance factory of setting a maintenance sequence; after a vehicle enters an overhaul work station, the state information of the vehicle is submitted through the server side; the state information of the vehicle is displayed on the intelligent mobile client side in real time by a camera at the corresponding overhaul work station through a network. According to the method and the system, an appointment process is simplified, time is saved, the work load is reduced, and the working efficiency is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Oficinas e Manutenção (C2))

titulo: Method for automatic matching and dispatching for roadside rescue
depositantes: SINO ASSISTANCE CAR RESCUE INDUSTRY CO., LTD.; LIU YI
resumo: The invention relates to a method for automatic matching and dispatching for roadside rescue. The method comprises the steps that step 1, rescue request information of a vehicle owner and current first position information of the vehicle owner are obtained; step 2, an online first rescue vehicle set capable of being used for dispatching is determined and second position information of each rescue vehicle in the first rescue vehicle set is determined; step 3, whether the rescue vehicles are available in rescue vehicle signals or not is checked one by one, if yes, the step 5 is conducted, and if not, the unavailable vehicle is removed from the first rescue vehicle set and the step 3 is continuously repeated; step 4, whether one available vehicle obtained in the step 3 refuses a current rescue task or not is checked, if yes, the available vehicle refusing the current rescue task is removed from the first rescue vehicle set, the step 3 is repeated, the next available vehicle is continuously checked, and if not, the step 5 is conducted. The rescue vehicle can be obtained rapidly and efficiently through dispatching, the randomness and the cost of manual dispatching can be greatly reduced, and a large number of resources are greatly saved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Adjustable automobile connection shaft arm
resumo: The utility model discloses an adjustable auto axle arm, including the auto wheel girder, two guiding mechanism are all articulating at the both ends of auto wheel girder, and two guiding mechanism are horizontal interval arrangement from top to bottom, and every guiding mechanism all includes about one screw, controls and links to each other through stud between the screw respectively, and the wheel is being installed to left side screw outside end. The automobile accessory mounting and dismounting device is reasonable and compact in structure, simple and convenient to manufacture and modify, low in cost, convenient to assemble, disassemble and maintain, and suitable for being widely popularized and used by various automobile manufacturers.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Roadside assistance method
depositantes: SINO ASSISTANCE CAR RESCUE INDUSTRY CO LTD | LIU YI
resumo: The invention relates to a roadside assistance method which is characterized by comprising the steps: step 1, a breakdown vehicle feeds back its position information to a server; step 2, the server records the position information; step 3, the vehicle owner sends an assistance request to the server or staff at the service centre; step 4, the server or the staff at the service centre confirms owner's GPS information according to the assistance request; step 5, the server or the staff at the service centre finds out a recovery vehicle nearest to the GPS information from the corresponding breakdown vehicle of the position information; and step 6, the server or the staff at the service centre sends the assistance request to notify the recovery vehicle. As the assistance request is sent, the owner feeds back the GPS information to the server or the staff at the service centre, the recovery vehicle nearest to the owner's GPS position is found out according to the GPS information and is notified to go to the vehicle owner to offer assistance; therefore, the roadside assistance method has the features of simpliness, rapidness and high-efficiency.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Socorro e Reboque (C1))

titulo: Optimal scheduling method of power system participated by electric vehicle
depositantes: ELECTRIC AUTOMOBILE SERVICE BRANCH STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY | UNIV ZHEJIANG
resumo: The invention discloses the Optimization Scheduling that a kind of electric automobile participates in power system, comprise the following steps：First, establish meter and electric automobile agent participates in the mathematical modeling and the agential charge requirement model of electric automobile of system optimization scheduling；The estimation that system optimization is scheduling to the income that Utilities Electric Co. brings and the loss that electric automobile agency can suffer from is participated in electric automobile respectively according to electric automobile agent and Utilities Electric Co., respectively firm offer and constantly adjustment is corrected, until reaching an agreement.The present invention Optimization Scheduling can mitigation system load peak-valley difference, reduce system operation cost, electric automobile agent and electric power system dispatching can obtain income, reach the purpose of doulbe-sides' victory.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle data acquisition device for safe driving assessment
resumo: The utility model is applicable to technical field of vehicle, a kind of vehicle data gathering-device for safe driving assessment is provided, comprises satellite navigation module, acceleration transducer, azimuth sensor, memory module, power module, transport module, indicator lamp, processing module.The utility model device by various sensor integration together, achieve the actual travel data of collection vehicle, have recorded vehicle general performance in several situations, particularly can realize recording passing behavior, be convenient to the large data analysis of safety traffic and the insurance assessment in later stage, for individual and car dealer provide the feedback of automotive performance, for insurance company provides a kind of insurance premium accurate Calculation scheme that enormously simplify, the personalized insurance quote of fair relatively is made to become possibility.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Roadside Assistance Management
resumo: Methods, computer-readable media, software, and apparatuses provide a system for establishing base stations and allocating service vehicles to the base stations in order to provide roadside assistance. The system may include computing devices associated with customer vehicles and service vehicles as well as network computing devices. The system may receive a service request from a customer regarding a disabled vehicle. The system may then identify an appropriate service vehicle to assist the customer and assign the service request to the identified service vehicle. The system may select the appropriate service vehicle based on a location of the disabled vehicle. In an example, the system may choose a service vehicle from a base station closest to or within the shortest driving time to the disabled vehicle. By setting-up base stations in advance of service requests, service vehicles may reach disabled vehicles within a predetermined period of time.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Socorro e Reboque (C1))

titulo: Method and system for matching a gear and travel storage for processing a transaction in an on-demand service system
depositantes: ZENHAUSERN FREDERIC [US] | ZENHAUSERN RYAN STEPHEN [US] | ZENHAUSERN ALISSIA MARGUERITE [US] | ZENHAUSERN NICOLE MICHELE [US]
resumo: A matching of a traveler's gear and vehicle when engaging into an electronic transaction of on demand services, preferably for transportation. In a preferred embodiment, the present method and apparatus is suitable for assessing remotely from a digital image, the physical properties of a travel gear, for example its shape, size and weight dimensions or texture, in order to match the geometric parameters of the container storage of a vehicle, for example the trunk of an automobile, listed in a database of an electronic transportation service, in order to optimize the conditions of transportation, such as cost reduction and energy fuel efficiency, for improving the quality of the traveler's experience.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: REPORT THE ACCIDENT TO THE CAR INSURANCE COMPANY THAT IS DISCHARGED OR ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE, FLAT, HOW TO REQUEST TOWING ETC.
resumo: The present invention relates to a method capable of delivering car accident report or emergency dispatch request rapidly. The objective of the present invention is to enable a driver facing current situation of an accident to make connection simply and rapidly even though the driver does not know an applied car insurance company or a contact. According to a method for reporting a car accident or emergency dispatch such as battery discharge, flat and towing etc to the car insurance company, a server of an application operation company receiving the situation through an application is connected to a server of the car insurance company. The delivered content is transmitted to the car insurance company by searching the car insurance company with a received car plate number and thus a follow-up action is done. According to the present invention, time delayed in an accident and incident spot is reduced and the follow-up action is rapidly processed.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Socorro e Reboque (C1))

titulo: Field service providing system and method
depositantes: CHINESE ACAD INST ACOUSTICS | SHANGHAI SHANG EN HUAKE NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD | BEIJING ZHONGKE HAILI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD
resumo: The invention provides a field service providing system and method. The system comprises a plurality of nodes, wherein each node comprises a neighborhood node set generation module for generating a neighborhood node set based on a bidirectional link bandwidth between a current node and a neighbor node, a neighborhood information index table generation module for generating a neighborhood information index table of the current node, a candidate service point selection module for selecting a candidate service node from the neighborhood node set according to a selection function which is defined to calculate the difference between the QoS (Quality of Service) of a current service request executed by a neighbor node i and the QoS of the current service request executed by the node specific to the current service request, and take the neighbor node i as the candidate service node when the calculated difference is smaller than a set threshold value, and a service scheduling module for receiving state information and feedback information provided by the candidate service node in real time, and selecting a certain candidate node or the current node as a service execution node based on the information.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYSTEM AND METHOD OF AUTOMATED 3D SCANNING FOR VEHICLE MAINTENANCE
resumo: System and method for using automated 3D scans to diagnose the mechanical status of substantially intact vehicles. One or more processor controlled 3D scanners utilize optical and other methods to assess the exposed surfaces of various vehicle components. Computer vision and other computerized pattern recognition techniques then compare the 3D scanner output versus a reference computer database of these various vehicle components in various normal and malfunctioning states. Those components judged to be aberrant are flagged. These flagged components can be reported to the vehicle users, as well as various insurance or repair entities. In some embodiments, the 3D scans can be performed using time-of-flight cameras, and optionally infrared, stereoscopic, and even audio sensors attached to the processor controlled arm of a mobile robot. Much of the subsequent data analysis and management can be done using remote Internet servers.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR ESTIMATING VEHICLE DAMAGE
resumo: The present disclosure systems and methods for providing a repair quote for a car including damage associated with a user. The system is configured to receive information from a user, such as photos of a damaged car, wherein the system generates and/or retrieves the repair quote associated with repairing the damage. As a result, the user does not need to physically take the damaged car to an automobile repair company to retrieve a repair quote.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: A METHOD OF GENERATING OF VEHICLE MAINTENANCE QUOTE LIST AND MOBILE DEVICE
resumo: The present invention relates to a method for generating a vehicle repair estimate list in a mobile device and the mobile device generating the vehicle repair estimate list. The present invention can directly record a repair target vehicle in the field, select the component cost, labor cost, coating material cost, and coating paint cost of the repair target vehicle based on the recorded image or video, and generate the repair estimate for the repair target vehicle on a real-time basis. The method includes the steps of: executing an estimate application installed on a mobile device to be displayed on the main screen of the mobile device; displaying the image or video of the repair target vehicle recorded in the field after executing the estimate application; displaying upper selection groups corresponding to upper component parts generated by decomposing each parts of the repair target vehicle into multiple fragments and lower selection groups corresponding to lower component parts of the upper component parts on the screen; displaying detailed estimate option items to select the operation conditions corresponding to the one of the lower selection group selected by a selection input; generating a repair estimate list for the repair target vehicle according to the selection of the detailed estimate option items; and providing the repair estimate list to an estimate server and receiving the estimate cost for the repair target vehicle calculated based on the repair estimate list from the server.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Orçamentação e Custos (C3))

titulo: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR IMAGE-BASED VEHICLE REPAIR ESTIMATE VERIFICATION
resumo: A computer system for processing data for verification of vehicle repair estimates in connection with insurance claims includes an insurance claims database having data relating to insurance claims. One or more computer processors are configured to receive claim identifying data from a repair facility computer system; determine, based on the claim identifying data, an insurance claim associated with the claim identifying data; establish secure communication with the repair facility computer system; receive data indicative of a repair estimate associated with the insurance claim from the repair facility computer system; access an evaluation of the estimate based on a plurality of rules, compare the estimate to one or more thresholds, and forward the estimate to a claim handler system.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: SYSTEM AND METHODS FOR TRAVEL PLANNING THAT CALLS FOR AT LEAST ONE TRANSPORTATION VEHICLE UNIT
resumo: Computationally implemented methods and systems that are designed for receiving a request for transporting one or more end users towards a destination location; providing a travel plan for facilitating the one or more end users to travel to the destination location from a starting location, the travel plan identifying at least two route legs including at least one transport route leg that calls for at least one transportation vehicle unit to transport the one or more end users over the transport route leg; and directing the at least one transportation vehicle unit to rendezvous with the one or more end users at a rendezvous location in order to transport the one or more end users over the transport route leg. In addition to the foregoing, other aspects are described in the claims, drawings, and text.

titulo: Method and system for automatically streamlining the vehicle claims process
depositantes: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO [US]
resumo: To generate a repair code when repairing a damaged vehicle, impact characteristics are received for the damaged vehicle and damaged vehicle parts are identified based on the impact characteristics. An extent of the damage is identified for each vehicle part and a repair code is assigned to the vehicle part based on the type of vehicle part, the type of vehicle, the extent of the damage to the vehicle part, etc. The repair code may be from a set of repair codes, where each repair code is generated for a particular type of vehicle part, type of vehicle, extent of damage to the vehicle part, etc., and each repair code corresponds to a cost estimate for repairing or replacing the damaged vehicle part. Each of the repair codes assigned to the damaged vehicle parts are provided to a treatment facility for treating the damaged vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: VOICE OVER INTERNET PROTOCOL RELAY INTEGRATION FOR FIELD SERVICE MANAGEMENT
depositantes: SERVICE INC E [US] | E SERVICE INC [US] | SEND A JOB INC [US]
resumo: A VoIP relay integration management system including a service management application and a VoIP phone server that monitor and gather client interaction data between a client and a field agent. The system accepts a selection of service phone method, from a plurality of selection methods, for the field agent to use to call the client, and enables or disables the selection per the field agent. The system accepts, stores and schedules a task to be dispatched to the field agent, and calculates and displays a response time that includes a time from when the task is dispatched to the field agent to when the field agent generates a call. The system calculates and displays an average response time of all calls generated by the field agent, based on one or more of the field agent, an area of the task, a date of the task and a type of task.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: METHOD THAT PROVIDES ALL THE SERVICES TO THE AUTOMOBILE FACTORY IN SCRAP A CAR
resumo: The present invention relates to a method for providing all services from releasing of a car to scrapping which enables a purchaser to purchase a product under the best conditions without a disadvantage and enables a member store to sell a product to a customer without separate advertisement costs. The method for providing all services from releasing of a car to scrapping comprises: a step of downloading an exclusive Carplax solution (500) of an exclusive web operating company (A) in a smart phone; a step for a member store subscription; a step for a category access; a step for an estimate application registration; a step for an estimate request approving; a step for an estimate application notice; a step for a member store access; a step for a chatting window opening; a step for a GPS information provision; a step for sending a member store message; a step for a purchaser selection; a step for a member store selection notice; and a step of distributing and paying commissions of the web operating company (A), a communication service provider (B), and an escrow company (C).

titulo: SYSTEM, SERVER AND METHOD OF PROVIDING VISIT TYPE USED CAR AUCTION SERVICE
resumo: The present invention relates to a system, a server and a method for providing a door-to-door type used car auction service capable of carrying out online auction according to the performance evaluation and price estimation results when a seller asks for used car selling. A system, a server and a method of the present invention are capable of obtaining objective price of a used car by not using a used car selling company, and therefore a bidding process is easier. Also, the used car seller does not need to bring the car to an auction site, a bidder does not need to go to the auction place and the corresponding car can be used during the auction, by the following steps when the seller asks for used car selling using a plurality of seller terminals: a step that a performance evaluator and a price estimator pay a visit to the seller without the necessity of placing a used car to the auction site and merchandising process; a step that the performance evaluator and price estimator performs performance evaluation and price estimation; and a step that first and second online auctions with the price negotiated by the seller according to the evaluated performance and estimated price using the plurality of seller terminals are provided to an auction service providing server.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE SERVICE PROVIDER ASSIGNMENT SYSTEM
resumo: Aspects of the disclosure provide a computer-implemented method and system for the assignment of roadside assistance service providers such as tow trucks to distressed vehicles/drivers requiring roadside assistance. The methods and systems may include a roadside assistance service provider system with a collection module, an assignment module, and a feedback module. The collection module collects roadside assistance service provider information and historical statistics from real-world information and stores the information in a database that may then be analyzed using particular rules and formulas. The assignment module assigns particular roadside assistance service providers to particular distressed vehicles/drivers based on one or more characteristics. The feedback module may provide near real-time cues to the tow truck driver's mobile device, such as alerting when the amount of time spent on a task exceeds a predefined threshold, flagging high priority tasks/assignments, providing a step-by-step checklist for the repair.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Socorro e Reboque (C1))

titulo: METHOD OF GENERATING A PRELIMINARY ESTIMATE LIST FROM THE MOBILE DEVICE RECOGNIZING THE ACCIDENT SECTION OF THE VEHICLE
resumo: The present invention relates to a method of providing a list of preliminary estimation from a mobile device by recognizing damaged parts of a vehicle. The method comprises the following steps: executing an application for estimation on the main screen of the mobile device; inputting an image of a vehicle targeted to be serviced or an image of a vehicle having an accident on site using the application for estimation executed on the mobile device; extracting a type of vehicle which is identical to the targeted vehicle with the images of the vehicle targeted to be serviced or the vehicle having an accident as a standard; extracting distorted areas among areas targeted to be serviced after comparing the standard images with the images of the vehicle targeted to be serviced or the vehicle having an accident; displaying a top choice group corresponding to top component parts of the extracted distorted areas and a bottom choice group corresponding to bottom component parts of the top component parts on the main screen; displaying an estimation list of detailed options corresponding to the bottom choice group selected among the groups said above; producing a list of preliminary estimation for the vehicle targeted to be serviced or the vehicle having an accident based on the choice made in the estimation list of detailed options; and providing the estimation list for a main server (300) to receive estimated fees computed based on the list of preliminary estimation from the main server.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: System and Method for Assessing and Collecting Taxes for Motor Vehicle Fuel at the Point of Sale
depositantes: MILLIGAN MATTHEW W [US] | MILLIGAN TYLER K [US]
resumo: A system and method for assessing and collecting taxes for fuel for motor vehicles at the point of sale through use of a vehicle identification device; a reader or scanner to receive and process information received or obtained from the vehicle identification device; a tax rate and price determination controller that can determine an appropriate tax rate to be added to a base fuel price; a dispensing device configured to dispense motor fuel to an identified vehicle and track the quantity of motor fuel dispensed; a payment processor that can determine a total purchase price having at least a base fuel price component and at least one fuel tax component, and execute a payment transaction for a particular method of payment; and a payment distribution controller that can allocate portions of the total purchase price to an identified account and execute or report such distributions.

titulo: AUTONOMOUS VEHICLE INSURANCE BASED UPON USAGE
depositantes: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO [US]
resumo: Methods and systems for monitoring use, determining risk, and pricing insurance policies for a vehicle having autonomous or semi-autonomous operation features are provided. According to certain aspects, a computer-implemented method for generating or updating usage-based insurance policies for an autonomous or semi-autonomous vehicle may be provided. A request to generate an insurance quote may be received via wireless communication, and with the customer's permission, risk levels associated with intended usage by the customer of the vehicle may be determined. An insurance policy may be adjusted based upon the risk levels and the intended vehicle usage. The insurance policy may then be presented on the customer's mobile device for review and approval. In some aspects, the vehicle may be rented, and the intended vehicle usage is measured in distance or duration of vehicle operation. Insurance discounts may be provided to risk averse vehicle owners based upon low risk levels.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: System and method for determining an insurance premium based on analysis of human telematic data and vehicle telematic data
resumo: Systems and methods are disclosed herein for pricing an insurance premium based on telematics data. The system includes a communications interface and a business logic processor in communication with the communications interface. The communications interface receives telematics data collected by a telematics acquisition device. A business logic processor determines an insurance quote for a user based on the received telematics data, vehicle data, and vehicle owner data. The communications interface transmits the insurance quote to the user of the vehicle.
