titulo: TICKET APPROVAL SYSTEM FOR AND METHOD OF PERFORMING QUALITY CONTROL IN FIELD SERVICE APPLICATIONS
depositantes: CERTUSVIEW TECHNOLOGIES LLC [US] | NIELSEN STEVEN E [US] | CHAMBERS CURTIS [US] | PENNINGTON DAVID [US]
resumo: Methods for overseeing and assessing a locate and marking operation. A ticket is received including ticket information regarding the operation, and a first locate technician is dispatched to perform the operation pursuant to the ticket information. A locate manifest is received that includes at least one digital image associated with a dig area in which the locate technician performed the operation. The locate manifest is compared to the ticket information, and a determination is made if the operation is 1) satisfactory, 2) unsatisfactory and requires further quality control assessment and/or at least partial re-performance, or 3) satisfactory but the first locate technician requires coaching. One or more electronic indications of one of 1), 2) and 3) are provided so as to generate an electronic record of a quality assessment of the locate and marking operation.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Method and system for controlling automatic route selection on railway vehicle
resumo: The invention relates to automatic route selection technology for a railway vehicle. In a method and a system for controlling automatic route selection of the invention, a microelectronic module is adopted to replace the prior relay, the logical relation is completed by an MCU, and the logical design is simpler and more reliable; a wireless remote control mode is introduced to complete the opposing change of a railroad switch, so the work intensity of a driver is reduced; electromagnetic sensing technology is quoted to determine the direction and speed of a train; and a remote integrated monitoring function is increased to master the work states of equipment such as an electric point switch, a railroad switch, a wheel sensor and the like at any time. Therefore, the new functions improve the running safety of the train greatly, ensure the stability of the equipment, and really achieve automatic route selection of the train.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Consumer initiated, service provider direct dispatching system
resumo: A customer originated and directed dispatching system to provide direct coordination of requested service to service providers without the need for intermediary dispatching assistance. A database stores records each documenting needed services and customer and service provider profiles. Processing circuitry (which may be one or several networked computers) performs a dispatching process which reviews these records, locates records indicating a need for immediate service, locates the customer, identifies potential service responders, carries out an auction for the requested service and collects a list of potential service provides with their bids and profiles. The processing circuitry also performs a monitoring process which monitors service provider's activities by reviewing the records, and automatically obtained service provider's activity information, and records customer and service provider performance ratings to the database. Communications circuitry enables direct communication between the service provider and the customer as well as updates of the service provider's activity and review customer and service provider performance records.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Análogo - Field Service Management (C4))

titulo: System and method for sales generation in conjunction with a vehicle data system
resumo: Sales generation embodiments are presented herein, including sales generation employing reverse boot generation using vehicle data systems and methods. Specifically, in certain embodiments, a user may utilize a vehicle data system to obtain pricing data corresponding to a desired vehicle configuration. When the user is presented with pricing data associated with a specified vehicle configuration, the user may also be presented with an upfront price quoted by the dealer, wherein by providing the user's personal information, the user may obtain the name of the dealer that quoted the upfront price and may also be provided with an opportunity to purchase the desired or similar vehicle at the upfront price.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR PROVIDING IN-LINE SCHEDULING IN AN ON-DEMAND SERVICE
resumo: A mechanism for providing in-line scheduling in an on-demand service in a database system is proved. The mechanism provides a multi-tenant database that stores client scheduling information, client customer contact information, and enables drag and drop event scheduling. In a multi-tenant database, a system for managing client customer contact information and event scheduling is established, which is useful for a tenant that is a salesperson or that employs salespersons. The multi-tenant database includes a combined view application that provides for the simultaneous display of a calendar view and list view of contact information. The multi-tenant database includes drag and drop functionality, allowing list view information to be dragged and dropped onto the calendar view for event scheduling. The ability of embodiments to provide drag and drop inline event scheduling can enable efficient calendaring of events by rapidly transferring relevant information onto a calendar.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: COMMUNICATION OF INSURANCE CLAIM DATA
depositantes: HANSON RANDALL [US] | LEDDER JAMES A [US] | O'HALLORAN CHARLES RONALD [US] | ALLSTATE INSURANCE CO [US]
resumo: Aspects of the invention are directed to methods and systems for efficiently communicating data between an insurer and a non-referral repair shop, e.g., vehicle repair shops that are normally not preapproved by the insurer to perform the estimating and repair work. The methods and systems described herein are particularly useful for insurers utilizing non-referral repair shops for servicing vehicles involved in insurance claims. According to aspects of this invention, the insured may be able to select a non-referral repair shop, not delegated or preapproved by the insurer, thereby generally allowing the insured to select any available vehicle repair shop.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Communication of insurance claim data
resumo: Aspects of the invention include methods and systems for a vehicle insurance claim management application which improves communication and streamline tasks between a vehicle repair shop and an insurance company system in three general task groups: assignment (comprising work requests, estimates/photos, and reinspections), financial management, and performance measurement. Aspects of the invention also provide interoperability with different types of estimating systems that do not necessarily follow an industry standard. This interoperability is provided through an adapter module with a claim processing system to communicate with the insurance company system and the vehicle insurance claim management application. The invention is preferably accessed by a user over a computer network such as the Internet, from a remote location such as a vehicle repair shop.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: METHODS AND APPARATUS FOR SCHEDULING AN IN-HOME APPLIANCE REPAIR SERVICE
resumo: A system for scheduling an in-home appliance repair service is disclosed. The system receives inputs from a user via a client device. The inputs are used to identify one or more home appliances in need of repair. For example, the user may have a clogged dishwasher. Data identifying the appliance is then transmitted to a repair scheduling server. The repair scheduling server executes a program which determines a plurality of available repair time slots and transmits a list of choices to the client device for display. The available repair time slots may depend on the type of appliance, the brand of the appliance, the particular model, the user's identify, and/or the geographical location of the appliance. Preferably, time slots are dynamically determined in cooperation with a plurality of service providers. Once the user selects a timeslot, the service is confirmed and scheduled.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: System for power facility navigation
depositantes: Shin Jin Ho; Korea Electric Power Corporation; Kim Young Il; Lee Bong Jae; Song Jae Ju
resumo: A system for power facility navigation is disclosed. For rapid dispatch in the field service including power failure recovery and maintenance, the destination location can be set using various items such as pole numbers, computerization codes, customer names, trade names, equipment numbers and GIS coordinates. Destination location setting and path finding can be performed in order of priorities assigned to these items and in consideration of characteristics of field service activities. Location coordinates are received through a GPS receiver, coordinate conversion is performed according to a facility GIS coordinate system, and map matching is processed when GPS coordinates do not match facility GIS coordinates. The road network database is composed of linear array structures and the structure of a link is configured to include information regarding all other links connected to the start node and end node in a manner that link information and node attributes are integrated together.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Location sharing and tracking using mobile phones or other wireless devices
depositantes: Haney Richard D.; X One, Inc.
resumo: A system for exchanging GPS or other position data between wireless devices for purposes of group activities, child location monitoring, work group coordination, dispatching of employees etc. Cell phones and other wireless devices with GPS receivers have loaded therein a Buddy Watch application and a TalkControl application. The Buddy Watch application communicates with the GPS receiver and other wireless devices operated by buddies registered in the users phone as part of buddy groups or individually. GPS position data and historical GPS position data can be exchanged between cell phones of buddies and instant buddies such as tow truck drivers via a buddy watch server. Emergency monitoring services can be set up with notifications to programmable individuals in case an individual does not respond. Positions and tracks can be displayed. TalkControl simplifies and automates the process of joining talk groups for walkie talkie services such as that provided by Nextel.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Systems and methods for creating and reviewing vehicle damage repair estimates, and notifying entities of issues relating to manufacturer's warranty or repair content
resumo: Methods and systems for generating a damage repair estimate, generating information relating to warranty and short sheet issues for a particular damage repair estimate, identifying included/non-included operations in a target damage repair estimate, and notifying entities of the existence of warranty and short sheet issues. The analysis portion accesses a central database of records for particular vehicles and determines whether a warranty, short sheet, or deviation from pre-determined repair procedures exists and creates a displayable file. Depending on the analysis requested, the system and method displays an appropriate damage estimate analysis. The notification portion accesses a central database of records for particular entities to contact for particular vehicles and electronically notifies entities of the existence of a damage estimate analysis.

titulo: OPTION FRAMEWORK FOR MANAGING ON DEMAND SERVICE OFFERINGS
depositantes: Grey William; International Business Machines Corporation; Hampshire Robert C.; Liu Zhen; Shi Dailun H.
resumo: A method of and system for managing on-demand service offerings in a service delivery chain. The method comprises the steps of a service provider announcing upfront capacity pricing, an on-demand premium structure, and an on-demand exercise structure; a service distributor committing to upfront capacity and to units of on-demand options; and the service provider provisioning a number of resources to the collection of service distributors. Preferably, the upfront capacity pricing includes three components. A first component is a price structure for capacity or resources to be purchased for immediate use, a second component is an on-demand premium structure, and a third component is an on-demand usage fee structure.

titulo: Systems And Methods For Unbundling Scheduled Maintenance Operations
resumo: A computer system running software operating as a vehicle service advisor is presented. The software on the computer system identifies one or more sets of scheduled maintenance operations for specific vehicles identified by make or build. The sets of the maintenance operations are unbundled into an individual operations that are recombined based on additional factors relating to the vehicles into a recommendation of maintenance operations. An estimate on the cost can be calculated and presented to a customer by correlating specific parts or labor costs with the operations in the recommendation.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Automotive Diagnostic and Estimate System and Method
resumo: The method provides users with estimates for vehicle repairs. The user, typically the vehicle owner, provides details sufficient to identify the vehicle, and location details to enable the system to locate suitable mechanics and replacement parts, and determine labor costs and times. The user may provide symptoms of the problem, and the system provider automatically determines the likely cause of the symptoms. Once a diagnosis has been generated, local labor and replacement auto part prices are automatically located, and a repair estimate automatically calculated. The estimate, along with a list of local mechanics with interest or expertise in the particular type of repair, is then automatically communicated to the vehicle owner.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Incluída em CI/CE (N=96), mas reprovada em QQ (< 3,5)

titulo: Electric Vehicle Network
resumo: An electric vehicle network is provided. The electric vehicle network includes a plurality of battery service stations and a service provider. The battery service stations are configured to service the batteries of a plurality of electric vehicles, and the electric vehicles are operated by a plurality of users. Battery service stations are configured to recharge batteries, replace spent batteries, or both. The service provider communicates with the battery service stations to facilitate servicing of the electric vehicles as the service stations based on subscription plans associated with the users. A plurality of subscription plan options is provided to the users.

titulo: Computerized driverless vehicles and traffic control system
resumo: A transportation system, including a network of roads for traveling to and from various destinations, a plurality of vehicles for transporting passengers, each vehicle situated within the network of roads, and each vehicle including a power supply, a positioning system, for identifying the position of the vehicle, a transmitter, coupled with the positioning system, for transmitting position and velocity information of the vehicle to other vehicles in its vicinity, a receiver for receiving position and velocity information from other vehicles in the vicinity of the vehicle, and an automatic steering system, coupled with the receiver, for steering the vehicle through the network of roads without collision, in order (i) to travel to a destination designated by the at least one passenger, when the vehicle is transporting the at least one passenger, (ii) to travel to a source for picking up the at least one passenger, when the vehicle is empty and the power supply is not low, and (iii) to travel to an available docking station, when the vehicle is empty and the power supply is low, and a plurality of docking stations, each docking station situated at a roadside of the network of roads, and each docking station including a charger for charging the power supply of a vehicle that is docked at the docking station.

titulo: INSURANCE CLAIMS AND RATE EVASION FRAUD SYSTEM BASED UPON VEHICLE HISTORY
resumo: A system and method of identifying warning signs of fraud associated with vehicle insurance transactions is presented. The system and method operate by identifying a vehicle, retrieving vehicle history information about the vehicle and determining if the vehicle history information indicates potential fraud based on factors which show a relationship between said vehicle history information and potential fraud incidents. Inferences related to an insurance claim or quote are made based on the results of the determination.

titulo: Signal collecting structure of mixed power energy recovering control based on ABS system for automobile
depositantes: CHANG AN VEHICLE CO LTD CHONGQ [CN]
resumo: The utility model relates to a mixed power automobile energy recuperation control signal collecting structure base on ABS system. A right-front wheel sensor, a right-back wheel sensor, a left-front wheel sensor and a left-back wheel sensor o the ABS system are connected with the ECU of the ABS system through signal cable and the ECU of the ABS system is connected with the automobile energy recuperation control unit through CAN bus. During vehicle braking or decelerating, the four wheel speed sensors transmit the wheel speed signals to the controller ECU of the ABS system for transforming them into braking strength signal, which is transmitted to the energy recuperation control unit directly as a braking strength judging signal for the energy recuperation control unit. The utility model has the advantages that the wheel speed signals collected by the ABS system is used directly and the controller ECU of the ABS system is applied for processing the signals, so the braking strength signal, which reflects the automobile braking strength truly and accurately, can be attained only through CAN bus without any additional signal collecting and processing system so as to simplify the structure.

titulo: Method for quick identifying missing bicycle and electric booster vehicle
resumo: This invention relates to a method for sealing read-write chips in bikes and electromotion boosting cars, and a special unit writes the identity information of a car legal owner or the code decided by the owner into the chips and verifying personnel carry out random verification to routine cars, when a code-reader reads the information not in conformity with that reported by the vehicle user, then it is determined that the car is lost, in which, the input chip information is encrypted and not easy to be stolen or juggled, and when the special unit inputs information to vehicles, it registers the related information of its legal owners, when the car is lost, it can quickly find the owner by the information stored in the car.

titulo: COMPUTER-BASED PRODUCT AND SERVICE MARKETPLACE

titulo: Dynamic Linking of Part Items to Repair Data
resumo: Providing repair information for a part. A first website may be provided which includes part information. The part information may include at least one of a plurality of possible vehicles and/or a plurality of possible parts. First user input may be received to the first website specifying a vehicle from the plurality of possible vehicles. Second user input may be received specifying a part of the plurality of possible parts, and third user input may be received to view labor cost information associated with the part. Correspondingly, labor cost information may be automatically provided which is associated with the part in response to the third user input to the first website to view the labor cost information. Automatically providing the labor cost information may be performed without further user input specifying the part or another website.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: System and method for ride matching
resumo: Users are matched for ridesharing based on where they are from (origin), where they are going (destination), when they are traveling (time), and how often (frequency). Other commuting preferences may also be considered. Geographic matching is based on cross-streets rather than exact street addresses. Locations are geocoded for latitude and longitude. The other users stored in the database are matched with the user by comparing the user's data with the other user's data stored in a database. The user is presented with alias information regarding the matched users in the database for ridesharing. The order in which the matched users are presented may be weighed towards distance or time. Along with the alias information, ratings of these matched users can be displayed. The rating of a user is based on the past impressions of the rated user by other users.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Agricultural information gathering system
resumo: An agricultural portal system for use along a transportation route upon which agricultural containers having a responding device are transported, the agricultural portal system including at least one movable support, at least one identification system connected to the movable support and a communications system. The at least one identification system is directed toward the transportation route. The at least one identification system receives a signal from the responding device thereby obtaining information about the agricultural containers. The communications system communicates the information.

titulo: WEB-BASED SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR PROVIDING SERVICES RELATED TO AUTOMOBILE SAFETY AND AN INSURANCE PRODUCT
resumo: Systems and methods provide services relating to driving safety and insurance in connection with insuring selected segments of a population, such as young drivers or elderly drivers. A web-based system provides a web site having a home web page configured to provide links to web pages accessible by a user over the Internet, configured to provide program elements such as an interface to a GPS vehicle monitoring system connected to provide vehicle information to the user via one or more of the web pages and to receive instructions from the user to select features of the GPS system, a display of or link to educational information relating to safe driving, stored by the web-based system or provided by interface to a third party web site; or a display of or link to a tool providing an estimate of an insurance premium discount based on use of the program. A system for providing an insurance price estimate, a computer-implemented method of promoting the sale of vehicle insurance to a population segment, a computer system for providing an insurance premium discount, and a computer program product are also provided.

titulo: System and method for the assessment, pricing, and provisioning of distance-based vehicle insurance
resumo: A system and method for assessing, pricing, and provisioning distance-based vehicle insurance are provided. In one example, the method receives identification information of a customer and an associated vehicle, and a current odometer reading. Multiple coverage types are provided to the customer, as is at least one quote when the customer selects one of the coverage types. The quote includes a policy rate identifying a cost per distance unit based on the identification information. The customer is provided with multiple items based on the quote, where each item includes a total number of distance units for purchase at the policy rate. titulo: Supplemental diagnostic and service resource planning for mobile systems

Multiple cycles of selection, downloading and execution of supplemental diagnostics may be performed until fault isolation is achieved, following which the opportunity server issues requests for bids to potential repair service provides. titulo: MICROTELEFONO MOVIL CON CAPACIDAD DE LOCALIZACION.
resumo: Briefly, the location capable mobile handset allows the user to provide a call recipient with the location of an unsuccessful attempted emergency call. In one specific example, the call may be an E911 call to a PSAP dispatcher, however, it will be appreciated that the call may be to request assistance from a family member, or friend. Additionally, the call may be to a towing service. The call could be any call that a mobile handset user wants to send location information to the party that has been called. Returning to the E911 call example, the location information reported to dispatcher can include the location of initial E911 call, current location during a successful E911 call, or ground track information from the initial location to the current location. When an E911 call is unsuccessfully attempted the mobile handset stores the location of the mobile handset at that time. This information can later be transmitted when the mobile handset is in a coverage area. Additionally, the mobile handset can auto-dial 911 upon entering a service area after an unsuccessful E911 attempt. Alternately the user can be prompted to initiate an E911 call when the mobile handset enters a service area.

titulo: REPAIR ESTIMATE SHEET TRANSFER METHOD
depositantes: TSUBASA SYSTEM CO LTD; 株式会社ブロードリーフ; カーコンビニ倶楽部株式会社
resumo:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an estimate sheet transfer method and a program capable of transferring a repair cost estimate sheet prepared in a specified format surely even without using transfer software.

SOLUTION: The repair estimate sheet transfer method comprises a procedure (S2) for inputting possessor information of an accident car, vehicle information, and damage information and preparing a repair cost file to calculate the repair costs of the accident car; a procedure (S3) for preparing an image file for photographing the accident car; and a procedure (S4) for recording in the repair cost file link information to an image data file. In recording the link information, data stored in the repair cost file are linked to data stored in the image file, and the repair estimate sheet in the specified format is displayed on the screen (S5 and S7).

titulo: AUTOMATICALLY CALLING AND CONNECTING METHODS FOR TRANSPORTATION VEHICLES BY USING COMMUNICATION NETWORK AND VOICE RECOGNITION
resumo: Disclosed herein is the present invention relates generally to an automated transportation vehicle dispatching method of selecting an available vehicle at the customer’s call and automatically connecting it to the customer, and more particularly to an automated transportation vehicle dispatching method, in which a customer can call a transportation vehicle through a communication network without personally ascertaining his position and informing a transportation vehicle call service provider about his position, and a central station ascertains a customer’s position, enables the customer to cal an available vehicle closest to the customer’s current position, provides the vehicle with the optimal route to his destination after receiving the destination, monitoring if the vehicle moves out of the transport route, and recognizes voice messages by means of the voice recognition device when receiving other information like the customer’s destination, enabling all the processes of the vehicle dispatching service to be automated.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: owner driver service clinic
resumo: PURPOSE: An owner driver clinic service method is provided to dispatch a car mechanic to an owner driver periodically for checking a car overhaul state so that it can reduce an overhaul cost and prevent a car accident. CONSTITUTION: The method comprises steps of periodically dispatching an affiliated car mechanic to a member, i.e. an owner driver, checking if there exists an abnormal state in the car of the member, notifying the member of a corresponding abnormal state of the car if the mechanic finds an abnormal state in the car, and guiding the member to overhaul the car. The dispatched sites are classified into a self parking space and a business parking facility. The member, driving a car for a long time or frequently, can visit an owner driver service clinic center periodically. The owner driver service clinic issues a weekly report or car check list for guiding the member to follow a correct drive manner or culture.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR AUTHORIZING SERVICE REQUESTS FOR FLEET VEHICLES
resumo: Fleet vehicles are brought into a service provider to have various services performed. The service provider accesses an automated work authorization system and provides an identification of the service provider, the vehicle, the service to be performed and their associated costs. The system processes the request to determine if the requested service is necessary or appropriate for this specific vehicle based on the current status of the vehicle as well as that vehicle's service history. In addition, the cost of the service is analyzed to determine if it is appropriate. The system can then automatically generate a work authorization and communicate the work authorization to the service provider. If the system is unable to fully process the request, the call can be transferred to a human technical assistant for further processing. All of the information gathered by the system is passed to the technical assistant and automatically populates an interface used by the technical assistant.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Online method and system for advising customers on service needs, facilitating the scheduling of vehicle service appointments, and checking vehicle service status
resumo: The present invention relates to an online method and system for advising customers on service needs, facilitating the scheduling of vehicle service appointments, and checking vehicle service status. A preferred method embodiment of the present invention includes receiving a service inquiry, receiving input information regarding the potential service of the vehicle, and transmitting the input information and an appointment request to a vehicle service provider to facilitate the scheduling of the vehicle service appointment. A preferred computer system of the present invention is configured to receive a service inquiry, receive input information regarding the potential service of the vehicle, and transmit the input information and an appointment request to a vehicle service provider to facilitate the scheduling of the vehicle service appointment.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Aprovada após QQ (Automotivo - Orçamentação e Custos (C3))

titulo: Method of taxi service management with intelligent transport system
resumo: PURPOSE: A method for managing a taxi service, using an ITS(Intelligent Transport System) is provided to efficiently manage the taxi service by automatically retrieving positions of taxis, using the ITS, when a passenger inputs taxi request information on a display unit and transmitting taxi request information of the passenger to the nearest taxi. CONSTITUTION: A passenger, who wants to get into a taxi, inputs taxi request information, using a display unit installed in a taxi platform(S101). A roadside base station connected to the display unit receives inputted taxi request information, and transmits received taxi request information to a taxi service management server connected with a communication network(S102). The taxi service management server judges whether taxi request information is received from a display unit of any position, and confirms the current position of the passenger(S103). The taxi service management server receives empty taxi information from the roadside base station near the display unit(S104). The taxi service management server retrieves the nearest empty taxi, transmits taxi request information to the roadside base station of a communication area in which the empty taxi exists, for transmitting taxi request information to the empty taxi(S105). If the empty taxi moves to the position of the display unit(S106), the passenger gets into the empty taxi(S107).
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: System and method for supporting sales of vehicle
resumo: There is disclosed a server which provides a high quality service taking into account a balance of business processing of a dealer and a desire of a client. More specifically, the server in accordance with the present invention receives specification information specifying specifications of a vehicle and an estimation request, and decides whether to sends an estimated price stored in an estimated price database to the client terminal or to inquire an estimated price from a dealer. In addition, the server in accordance with the present invention refers to automatic reply prohibited client data and decides whether or not the client is stored in the data as a client to whom an estimated price should not be automatically returned. Moreover, the server in accordance with the present invention decides whether or not a comment of the client is included in estimation request data from the client. If the client is stored in the automatic reply prohibited client data or a comment is included in the estimation request data, the server sends specification information and client information to the dealer terminal and requests calculation of an individual estimated price.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Location based services revenue sharing and cost offsetting
resumo: A method for brokering a repair to a vehicle with multiple potential repair service providers by temporarily associating a random user-anonymous session identifier with a brokering session for the vehicle's access device, transmitting the session identifier and a service request to each potential service provider, receiving multiple offers identifying a cost associated with responding to the repair request, determining a total response repair cost aggregated from the responding providers, selecting a winning offer, determining a cost to the access device for resource usage during the brokering session representing, reducing a gross revenue to the selected winner by the total response cost; and subsequently, re-using the session identifier for aggregating other usage records and offsetting costs to compensate non-winning responders.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: On-demand system for supplemental diagnostic and service resource planning for mobile systems
resumo: Enhanced diagnostic service is provided by determining availability of and downloading a supplemental diagnostic function to isolate a failure according to a service signal from a mobile system; coalescing offers for a repair service according to results of the execution of the downloaded diagnostic function; presenting the offers to an operator of the mobile system; executing the diagnostic function by an on-demand computing system wherein transactions provided by the diagnostic function are automatically shared by simultaneously serving multiple customers; differentiating and recording each customer's usage of the diagnostic functions according to one or more parameters included in the transactions, the parameters uniquely identifying each customer and a type of transaction conducted for that customer; and, responsive to a number of simultaneous transactions to any one server exceeding a performance limit of a given server, automatically accessing one or more additional servers to increase capacity and to share workload.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Supplemental diagnostic and services resource planning for mobile systems
resumo: Diagnostic codes from a vehicle or other system in transit are transmitted to an opportunity server, which forwards the codes to a supplemental diagnostic service provider. The diagnostic service provider determines if supplemental diagnostics software functions are available, and if so, downloads them to the vehicle. After executing the supplemental diagnostics, the vehicle reports updated codes to the opportunity server. Multiple cycles of selection, downloading and execution of supplemental diagnostics may be performed until fault isolation is achieved, following which the opportunity server issues requests for bids to potential repair service provides. Responding offers are received, coalesced and presented to the operator. The operator of the vehicle is presented with one or more coalesced offers, upon selection of which, a service is scheduled.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: AUTOMOTIVE FINANCE PORTAL
resumo: A method of processing an automotive finance transaction online by a portal participant including the steps of inputting business rules and rates for financial institutions into a database; entering criteria of chosen vehicle into a finance quotation generator; selecting a financial institution; generating a comparative quote scheme for the chosen vehicle according to the business rules and rates; and selecting a set of terms from the comparative quote scheme. The method may further include transmitting the selected set of terms to the financial institution; providing credit information to the financial institution; the financial institution evaluating the credit information and providing approval; and preparing financing documentation incorporating the vehicle information, terms and credit information. Furthermore, a system for processing an automotive financing transaction by a dealer or manufacturer is provided.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: ESTIMATED PRICE PROVIDING METHOD AND ESTIMATED PRICE PROVIDING DEVICE FOR AUTOMOBILE INSPECTION SERVICE OR CHECK SERVICE, AND COMPUTER PROGRAM THEREFOR
resumo: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To efficiently provide an estimated price for an automobile inspection service or check service providable by a sales agent to a user. SOLUTION: A vehicle maker-side server determines, according to the information inputted by the user on a screen displayed on a user terminal under access, the estimated price when performing the automobile inspection service or check service desired by the user in a sales agent desired by the user by referring to an estimated price 35 in which the estimated prices for the automobile inspection service or check service providable by sales agents are preliminarily registered, and provides the determined estimated price and the information related to the sales agent concerned to the user terminal.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: subscribe and call service system
resumo: PURPOSE: The system for the reservation service of the automobile using the computer and wire/wireless internet, and the method for the visitation service is provided to maximize the benefit by securing a regular customer through better qualified service, and to create the economic advantage by reducing the time and cost for the auto maintenance CONSTITUTION: A user connects to a service site and receives the user authentication. Each different information concerned to the vehicle management is inputted/outputted. The user requests the service for the vehicle such as the auto maintenance and check according to the necessity. The information about the service that the user requests is provided to the user. The user selects the desirable service date, time, and place and checks the information. A service provider checks the required service item in real time through the internet, wire/wireless communication device, or fax. The service provider visits the service-need place, offers the service, and recorded the serviced information. The recorded information is stored to a server in real time and the service user data is automatically updated according to the information.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: System for network_based providing remote picture admission service and method thereof
resumo: PURPOSE: A network-based remote video attendance system and a method thereof are provided to avoid waste of time and prevent future trouble by identifying damage of a vehicular accident in real time with a motion picture and determining the repair range and method in conference with the repair shop. CONSTITUTION: If an insurant requests for an insurance treatment for a damaged vehicle, an insurance company computer(20) downloads the video data of the damaged vehicle through a communication network(10). Information about insured vehicles and video data of damaged vehicles are stored in an insurance company DB(database) through the communication network(10). A moving camera(50) photographs the damaged vehicle according to the request of an insurance company staff and transmits it. A repair shop computer(40) receives the photographed video data through the communication network(10).
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Automotive collision repair claims management method and system
resumo: A method and system for managing the collision repair process after a vehicle has been damaged in a collision. The system includes a single point of contact that handles the auto insurance claims and manages the repair work to improve the entire claims handling process, from the initial claim to the final repair work.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYSTEM AND METHOD OF ESTIMATING TRAVEL TIMES
depositantes: BRITISH TELECOMMUNICAITONS PLC [GB] | AZVINE BEHNAM [GB] | NAUCK DETLEF DANIEL [GB] | HO COLIN KOK MENG [CN]
resumo: The present invention relates to generating a predicted duration for a journey, where the journey is characterised by a start location, an end location and times corresponding thereto. The predicted journey duration can then be used to evaluate measured journey data between a start location and an end location by comparing the measured journey duration with the generated predicted journey duration. The journey data can be further characterised by at least some of road works, weather, time of day, time of year, day of week, road type, road condition, technician driving style, and traffic conditions. Preferably the modelling means can involve a linear regression algorithm, or a heuristic learning means.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle sales support system, vehicle sales support program and vehicle sales support method
resumo: In the case where an estimated price of a vehicle is presented online to a customer, reference information database for storing reference information to be used by each of a plurality of vehicle distributors in examining estimated prices of vehicles having various specifications is previously prepared, so that the reference information read from the reference information database can be presented to a distributor when the distributor inputs an estimated price.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle sales support system, vehicle sales support program and vehicle sales support method
resumo: In providing an estimated price of a vehicle to a customer online, an access history information database for storing access history information of accesses made by each customer for specification selection and/or estimate request regarding a vehicle is previously prepared. When a vehicle distributor inputs an estimated price in response to an estimate request from a customer, the access history information of the customer having made the estimate request read from the access history information database and/or information introducible from the access history information is presented to the distributor.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Method of providing automatic connection service for taxis using communication network
resumo: Disclosed herein is the present invention relates generally to a method of providing an automatic connection service for taxis using a communication network, and more particularly to a method of providing an automatic connection service for taxis using a communication network, in which a client can call a taxi using his mobile phone through a communication network without the client personally ascertaining his position and informing a taxi call service provider his position, a central control office ascertains a client's position and transmits information of an available taxi closest to the client's position to the client by the client accessing the central control office of the taxi call service provider, and the client selects and calls the available taxi, thus enabling the client automatically connect to a selectable taxi.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle value appraisal system
resumo: A vehicle appraisal system in accordance with the present invention includes a processor, a reference databank of published values for different makes and models of vehicles and an enclosure having diagnostic tools for determining and recording the mechanical condition of the vehicle. The vehicle is positioned within the enclosure and data concerning the interior condition of the vehicle alignment, undercarriage, engine, interior and body are recorded by the diagnostic equipment within the enclosure. The processor accesses the reference databank for a baseline value for the vehicle under consideration. The processor then receives this data collected from inspection of the vehicle and access a plurality of discrete databanks containing repair data to determine the cost of repairing the vehicle. The processor then adjust the baseline value by the repair cost of the vehicle according to a predetermined algorithm to yield an appraisal value for the vehicle.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Vehicle sales support system, vehicle sales support program and vehicle sales support method
resumo: In a vehicle sales support system for supporting vehicle sales to customers online by providing an estimated price of a vehicle calculated on the basis of calculation data stored in an estimated price DB, the calculation data stored in the estimated price DB is corrected/updated on the basis of prescribed data stored in a reference information DB. Thus, an improper estimated price can be prevented from being provided to a customer.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYSTEM, PROGRAM AND METHOD FOR SUPPORTING CAR SALES
resumo: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To present an estimated price meeting the desire of a customer in a car sales support system constituted so that car sales to the customer is supported on-line by presenting the estimated price of the car calculated based on the calculation data stored in an estimated price DB 35 to the customer.  <P>SOLUTION: When the estimated price is calculated based on the calculation data stored in the estimated price DB 35, a correcting means corrects the estimated price based on the customer access history data stored in the customer DB (access history DB) 34.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2003,JPO

titulo: VEHICLE REPAIR SIMPLE ESTIMATE SYSTEM, VEHICLE REPAIR SIMPLE ESTIMATE SERVER AND PROGRAM
depositantes: SYSTEM KOBO M:KK; 株式会社システム工房エム
resumo:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To easily estimate vehicle repair.

SOLUTION: In the vehicle repair simple estimate system 1 is provided with a plurality of terminals 2 and the vehicle repair simple estimate server 3 connected to the plurality of terminals 2 via a network 4, the vehicle simple estimate server 3 is provided with an estimate reference value registering means of registering an estimate reference value on the basis of vehicular condition items, a vehicular condition selecting means of selecting the vehicular condition items by an estimate requester, and an estimated price calculating means of calculating and presenting an estimated price on the basis of the estimate reference value registering means from a selection result of the vehicular condition selecting means, and it is composed so that it can give a simple estimate for repair by acquiring information about a vehicular condition from the estimate requester.

titulo: method of calculating an automobile estimated value based on internet
resumo: PURPOSE: A car price estimate calculation method is provided to prevent a prearrangement of a car price among sellers, or a jump of the price caused by a purchase competition and to reduce a purchase time by estimating a car price over the internet. CONSTITUTION: The method comprises steps of an auction manager of a reverse auction site checking if an accessing client is an authenticated member(100), the auction manager enabling the accessing client to subscribe for the reverse auction site as a seller or buyer member(102), the auction manager checking if the accessing client is a seller or a buyer(104), in a case of the seller, the auction manager enabling the seller member to offer a car price estimate(106), in a case of the buyer, the auction manager checking if the buyer inputs a purchase condition at a purchase management database(108), and the auction manager enabling the buyer to input the purchase condition at the database in a case that the buyer does not input the purchase condition(110, 112), the auction manager notifying the buyer of a proper one among the estimates offered by the sellers(114), the auction manager checking if the buyer is satisfied with the offered estimate(116), and the buyer making a payment for the car in a case that the buyer is satisfied with the offered estimate(118).
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Checkup system for cars
resumo: PURPOSE: A car examination system is provided to present a free car examination service to read the number of a vehicle, approaching the parking lot of a large-sized shopping mall, carry out an examination after judging whether it is required, transmit an examination result to the client and a client management server, and store the examination history. CONSTITUTION: A client management server(100) in a car examination system contains a control part(101), a database(102), a communication part(103), and an updating part(104). The database(102) stores an examination time, received from a client computer(400) or inputted when a client purchases a car, and an examination history, received from an examination center computer(200). The communication part(103) transmits and receives the client information, vehicle information, examination information and maintenance information of the database(102) through a network. The updating part(104) updates the database(102) according to updated client information, updated vehicle information, updated examination information or updated maintenance information transmitted through the communication part(103). The control part(101) controls the database(102), the communication part(103), and the updating part(104).
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Automobile repair estimation method apparatus, and system
resumo: A method, system and apparatus for estimating automobile damage susceptible of paintless dent repair (P.D.R.). The method includes characterizing damage susceptible of P.D.R. by inspection of the vehicle; communicating those characterizations to a central computer, processing the characterizations based on predetermined rules stored in the central computer, and generating a report including a estimation of repair costs for the vehicle. The communication can be over a global computer network, a WAN, a LAN, or other ways to communicate between remote and central devices. A template can be used to assist in the characterization of damage.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Automobile speedometer
resumo: The utility model relates to a speed reporting machine, which comprises a loudspeaker, a power supply and a sampling device, and also a comparing device and a controlling device. The comparing device is connected with the sampling device; the comparing device is connected with the controlling device; the controlling device is connected with an output device; the output device is mainly the loudspeaker. The utility model can compare the practical driving speed with the setting alert speed, and report the driving speed which is higher than the alert speed, thus the driver can control the driving speed, and the driving security is improved.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: Customer driven, sponsor controlled network-based graphical scheduling system and method
resumo: A customer driven, sponsor controlled network-based graphical scheduling system and method effectuates bi-lateral customer driven appointment scheduling with a sponsoring organization. The scheduling system facilitates the sponsoring organization, such as a doctor's office, clinic, auto repair shop or the like, to communicate an invitation to the customer, such as a patient, client or consumer, whereby the customer schedules an appointment with the sponsoring organization. The scheduling system may include a controller which receives an appointment time offered by the sponsoring organization. The schedule is synchronized with a desktop and an on-line component allowing the sponsoring organization to schedule on the local desktop/file server and allowing the customer to schedule through an Internet World Wide Web site. The controller can offer time slot options to the customer via a well-informed electronic scheduler. The display of the schedule is filtered to show only time segments which meet the criteria associated with the individual customer. The criteria will include sponsoring organization availability, contiguous time slot availability and resource availability. The customer will have the opportunity to accept the most desirable appointment time. The controller will communicate the information to the sponsoring organization.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: METHOD FOR SELLING AUTOMOBILE BY USING B2B NETWORK AMONG SELLER, INTERACTIVE IMAGE MAIL AND AUTOMOBILE MAINTENANCE LOG OVER INTERNET
resumo:
PURPOSE: An automobile selling method is provided to enable a customer to search a wanted car in moving pictures or text data, registered by car sellers, to transmit the searched data to other customers, and to receive an automobile maintenance log service by using a database storing personal data and car repair records.

CONSTITUTION: The method comprises steps of a customer accessing a service site, the customer inputting personal data, automobile data of the customer's own, and wanted automobile data, the service site storing the input data, a main server of the service site enabling a car seller to transmit moving pictures or text data to a customer based on the input data, the main server offering an automobile maintenance log service by using a car repair record database, a car repair company transmitting parts or oil exchange data to the main server, the main server constructing the car repair record database, the car seller loading moving pictures or text data to the main server, and the main server updating an automobile shopping mall, an Internet auction or a direct transaction marketplace service site. The method enables also a B2B transaction among the car sellers.

titulo: SERVICE PROVIDER EVALUATION SYSTEM AND ITS PROGRAM
depositantes: SEIKO EPSON CORP; セイコーエプソン株式会社
resumo:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To adequately evaluate provided service which is provided by a service provider.

SOLUTION: A customer company 10 accesses a questionnaire disclosure site opened on a Web server 72 of a repair engineer evaluation system 70, opens a questionnaire form and writes opinions about repair service that the company received, and transmits them to a system managing computer 74 of the repair engineer evaluation system 70. The system managing computer 74 makes the currently received questionnaire result correspond to the repair engineer, and computes the degree of customer's satisfaction to the corresponding repair engineer according to the questionnaire result. The repair service that the repair engineer provides can adequately be evaluated.

titulo: Methods and apparatus for scheduling an in-home appliance repair service
resumo: A system for scheduling an in-home appliance repair service is disclosed. The system receives inputs from a user via a client device. The inputs are used to identify one or more home appliances in need of repair. For example, the user may have a clogged dishwasher. Data identifying the appliance is then transmitted to a repair scheduling server. The repair scheduling server executes a program which determines a plurality of available repair time slots and transmits a list of choices to the client device for display. The available repair time slots may depend on the type of appliance, the brand of the appliance, the particular model, the user's identify, and/or the geographical location of the appliance. Preferably, time slots are dynamically determined in cooperation with a plurality of service providers. Once the user selects a timeslot, the service is confirmed and scheduled.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: VEHICLE REPAIR COST ESTIMATE SYSTEM
depositantes: TSUBASA SYSTEM CO LTD; 株式会社ブロードリーフ
resumo:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a vehicle repair cost estimate system capable of easily performing the accurate estimate work.

SOLUTION: The system estimating the repair cost of a repair object vehicle is provided with an input device inputting the repair vehicle data of the repair object vehicle, a storage device storing vehicle attribute data including portion data of vehicles, repair work contents data at individual portions, and parts data corresponding to the repair work contents for individual vehicle types, a display device displaying the data, and a control device retrieving a vehicle type based on the repair vehicle data inputted by the input device, specifying the damaged portion of the vehicle, retrieving the repair work contents data corresponding to the damaged portion, extracting the parts data corresponding to the repair work contents data, and calculating the repair cost based on the repair work contents data and the parts data.

titulo: Passenger transportation system and method
resumo: The invention relates to a passenger transportation system and method for transporting a passenger from a starting point (P 1 ) along a passenger route to a destination (P 2 ) by at least one transporter using a transporter route (B′-B″) which overlaps at least partially with the passenger route. The system comprises a transport service provider TSP unit ( 1 ) comprising transporter route information and served network area information and being enabled for communicating passenger position data and transporter identification data with the passenger and transporter position data as well as pick-up and release notification data with the transporter; such that the passenger route is composed of at least one section of a selected overlapping transporter route. Using said system and method is more convenient to the passenger.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na leitura manual de título/resumo (CE02/CE03/CE04/CE05)

titulo: Electronic taximeter
resumo: The taximeter includes a sensor circuit containing an antenna engraved upon a printed circuit fitted into the meter on taximeter base fitted on the rear windscreen so that the antenna is in the transmitter field of the toll gate terminal. The meter has a cellular phone or radio location system (12), including Global Positioning (GPS), designed to receive signals emitted by a cellular telephone network towers. The system determines the tower identification number for a connection close to the vehicle (5). Taximeter including a sensor designed to detect a signal emitted by a toll gate terminal when the vehicle passes through the toll gate; a location system designed to determine the vehicles location. The system is activated at least when the sensor detects the proximity of the toll gate terminal; a toll gate identifier designed to identify the toll gate as a function of the vehicles location; a computer to count the cost of the toll at the vehicles location; a display for the calculated sum.
Decisao_Final_Triagem: Excluída na pré-triagem (CE02/CE03 - validada por amostragem de 10%)

titulo: SYSTEM FOR ESTIMATING CAR REPAIR EXPENSE AND ESTIMATING METHOD
resumo: A system and method for estimating the expense for repairing an accident-involved car, promoting use of rebuild parts. The system comprises a main server connected to a network and a client terminal. The main server has a storage unit where rebuild part data is stored. The client terminal has a storage unit where a car attribute data set and a car part data set are stored and a controller. The controller specifies a damaged part of an accident-involved car, searches the main server for information about a rebuild part corresponding to the specified damaged part, selects a suitable one of the damaged part, a new part, and a rebuild part on the basis of the rebuild part data set and the part data set to judge if the specified damaged part is to be repaired.

titulo: System and method of tracking vehicle information and bill consolidation
resumo: A server company can track expenditures for a client company's individual vehicles and fleets of vehicles. The server company can automatically take care of paying the bills relating to outside service repairs from multiple vendors and forward a single itemized bill to the client company. The server company can also notify the client company regarding usage characteristics of various types of vehicles, expenditure trends, and even notify the client company when vehicle needs routine maintenance. The present invention reduces the expenditures a client company associates with maintaining a vehicle fleet, whether the vehicles are leased or owned by the client company

titulo: METHOD FOR CALCULATING ESTIMATION OF VEHICLE USING COMPUTER NETWORK
resumo: PURPOSE: A method for calculating an estimation of a vehicle using a computer network is provided to calculate an estimation for a vehicle desired by a user in accordance with a demand of user computers being connected to a communication network and a recording medium capable of being read by a computer recording a program for embodying the method by storing data for calculating an estimation for a vehicle using a communication network as the internet. CONSTITUTION: Price information and allotment information of a vehicle is received from a vehicle selling company and stored in a database of a server(31). A client who wants to buy a vehicle is connected to a server computer through a communication network using the user computer(32). If the user confirming process is completed, the server computer displays vehicle information on a user computer based on information stored in a database(33). The client selects one vehicle model and option in accordance with a menu provided from the server(34). The server makes the client select a buying method by displaying a plurality of buying methods on the user computer(35). titulo: FULLY AUTOMATED VEHICLE RENTAL SYSTEM
resumo: An automated vehicle rental system with individual vehicle transmitting sensors for keeping track of vehicle mileage, fill state of vehicle fuel tank, and localized position status in a storage, rental or maintenance lot, with tie-in to unique vehicles identification such as a VIN, and with contemporaneous link to authorized user. Sensors are linked to the vehicle odometer reading and to the vehicle fuel tank float sensor with compensation for types of driving and fuel fill-ups which affect float level readings. The sensors are integrated with or are linked with communicating tags operable in a defined site for ultimate communication of stored vehicle related sensor data, vehicle location and type to a central data base for automatically completely effecting check out, charges and state of vehicle readiness for renewed rental. titulo: System and method for eliminating an unnecessary dispatch of a service technician
resumo: The present invention is directed to a system and method for eliminating the unnecessary dispatch of a service technician. The service orders generated by the service order control system are monitored to identify service orders that require a dispatch. If a service order is identified as requiring a dispatch, then the service order is selected for further analysis. The service order is initially analyzed to determine whether the service order meets a set of predefined criteria that identify service orders that are likely to cause an unnecessary dispatch. If the service order meets the set of predefined criteria, then the service order is further analyzed to determine whether the dispatch associated with the service order is unnecessary and should be canceled. Once the dispatch is determined to be unnecessary, then the service order is corrected and the dispatch is canceled.

titulo: Integrated automotive service system and method
resumo: An integrated automotive repair shop network is designed to greatly enhance the efficiency and quality of diagnostic and repair work performed in an automotive repair shop. The network employs a data entry terminal for the entry of routine customer information into a shop management system, including the identification of the vehicle to undergo diagnosis or repair. The shop management system is configured to generate an appropriate repair order. Computerized diagnostic and repair devices linked through the network to the shop management system are configured to access the customer information contained in the repair orders, as well as to extract relevant technical specifications, service bulletins, parts listings, and prior services records from interconnected information databases. Each computerized diagnostic and repair device provides updated information to the repair shop management system upon the completion of a diagnostic routine, enabling other computerized diagnostic and repair devices to access the most current vehicle parameters. Completed repair orders are stored in a customer information database for rapid retrieval and display of the prior work history for each vehicle serviced.

titulo: Apparatus and method of use for calculating an estimate of damaged surface repair cost
resumo: A method of use and apparatus for estimating repair cost, particularly applicable to cost estimation of interspaced defect damaged vehicle surfaces. The method of use of the present invention provides that a defect count be made for a predetermined representative area; that a determination of relative severity be made with respect to at least one defect within the representative area; and that the repair estimate is then based upon the defect count information and defect severity. A set of physical templates may be provided, with a first template allowing the calculation of the number of dents per surface area, and a second template for grading, comparing, or otherwise determining the size or severity of the individual dents. Additionally, the defect count data and defect severity data may be determined with an electronic scanning means. Various formulae may be employed (manually or electronically) for calculating the cost estimate to repair the damaged surface.

titulo: Method and system for facilitating vehicle inspection to detect previous damage and repairs
resumo: Computer-based methods and systems for facilitating the inspection of a vehicle to detect the presence of prior damage and problems with previous repair are provided. Exemplary embodiments provide an inspection facilitator, which includes an inspection engine and an inspection interface. The inspection engine and inspection interface are implemented as an expert system, which directs a technician or apparatus to perform a uniform inspection process. The inspection facilitator, after receiving vehicle specific information, first directs and guides an inspection of the underbody of the vehicle to detect gross level damage or repair. The inspection facilitator then dynamically directs and guides an inspection of the outerbody of the vehicle based upon the nonconformities indicated in response to each directed inspection task. The areas to be inspected and inspection tasks are determined dynamically by comparing nonconformity input to facts and rules programmed into the inference engine of the inspection facilitator in combination with retrieved manufacturing specifications and industry standard repair procedures.

Polar plates in the vehicle-mounted storage batteries are difficultly bent, the service life of the storage batteries is prolonged and the storage batteries work normally.

titulo: Software planning program for coatings
resumo: An interactive computer program for forecasting, prioritizing, planning and tracking paint, coating and lining maintenance work for the Facility assets of industrial and commercial complexes using an IBM compatible type computer. The assets include but are not limited to buildings, tanks, towers, structures, pools, docks and their sub components such as process piping, structure steel members, concrete floors, overhead cranes, blowers, pumps, motors, vehicle hoists, hardware, paneling, conduit, facades, exterior doors, interior doors, windows, and gutters that require painting over time. The novel invention uses a four step process. The first step is to break down the facility into asset groups, master components, and sub components. Second a condition survey of the master components and subcomponents is conducted followed by making work recommendations for each sub component. The third step is to develop coating system standards where coating systems, and cost data for the maintenance work is calculated. The fourth step covers work management which includes an assessment by sub component, recommendations are accepted and altered, costs are recalculated and various types of data operations are performed such as preparing management reports, historical data is reported and cost and schedule data is reported.

titulo: System and method for controlling a vehicle emergency response network
resumo: A vehicle assistance request system includes a device and methodology for preventing inadvertent or mistaken assistance request calls. The system enables a vehicle driver to request roadside assistance with a single push of a button (52, 54, 56) on a user interface module (28) inside the vehicle (22) or a remote, portable key fob (70). The data communication signal that is generated when the button is pushed communicates location information and the type of assistance that is needed to a dispatcher of the appropriate services. The system includes a timer function that requires that a user press a request button (52, 54, 56) for a minimum time period before a request is initiated. Also provided is a protective shield, which further ensures that a request button is not pushed inadvertently.

titulo: Video file server maintaining sliding windows of a video data set in random access memories of stream server computers for immediate video-on-demand service beginning at any specified location
resumo: A video file server includes an integrated cached disk array storage subsystem and a plurality of stream server computers linking the cached disk storage subsystem to a data network for the transfer of video data streams. The video file server further includes a server controller for applying an admission control policy to client requests and assigning stream servers to service the client requests. The stream servers include a real-time scheduler for scheduling isochronous tasks, and supports at least one industry standard network file access protocol and one file access protocol for continuous media file access. The cached disk storage subsystem is responsive to video prefetch commands, and the data specified for a prefetch command for a process are retained in an allocated portion of the cache memory from the time that the cached disk storage subsystem has responded to the prefetch command to the time that the cached disk storage subsystem responds to a fetch command specifying the data for the process. The time between prefetching and fetching is selected based on available disk and cache resources. The video file server provides video-on-demand service by maintaining and dynamically allocating sliding windows of video data in the random access memories of the stream server computers.

titulo: Method and apparatus for compiling data relating to damage extent, panel and chassis member rectification work, painting work and costs
resumo: The amount of time required to perform panel beating and/or repainting and like repair work is estimated by sequentially compiling data which indicate which panel is damaged, the degree of the damage, the degree of repair difficulty and the area thereof. The compliation is made firstly for large deformations, then for intermediate damages. After this, in the case of sections wherein the damage is considered as being small, the area data alone is compiled. This large intermediate and small data is compiled for each of the damaged panels and converted into time and used in combination with labor rates and/or materials costs, to estimate the cost of the repair. Other embodiments feature the compilation of repainting data including painting and undercoating of panels which define the chassis and/or form part of the vehicle compartments and the like. Inclusion of the time to check wheel alignment and the like in the case where the chassis has been twisted or warped after the panels involved have been repaired is included in an embodiment directed to structural members and panels which are not normally seen from outside of the vehicle.
